A magnificent, twinkling goblet, covered cryptic inscriptions that talk of triumphal victories and staggering defeats in a great football tournament. The mysterious monument exudes an aura of infectious euphoria and confidence. You find yourself wondering whether you'll get to keep it longer than four years.
Dress your island in the colours of the team you support. This flowerbed let's you nail your colours to the mast. Or ground. At the very worst you might still be able to make a nice wreath from it.

The hordes of supporters that you have acquired throughout the championship require housing. Therefore, it might make sense to provide some quarters. Best inform the neighbours that it might get noisy these next few days.
The festive mood seems to have a peculiar effect on the reproductive behavior of your community. The frenzy of competition and victory seems to bring people closer together.
Buy a sack of useful training materials in order to prepare your boys properly for this major event.

A strong build, terrifying scar across one eye and a mean mien. You better not mess with this guy!
He likes to stay back, mauling his enemies from a distance with stones.
Compared to his cronies/combatants, this scoundrel seems rather harmless. But that does not apply to his longbow!
Battle-hardened warriors attacking on horseback. Especially effective against ranged troops.
As soon as his enemies close in on him, most of them are routed by his terrible smell.
Even if he can only see with one eye, he is as quick as a flash and built like a mountain.
His shiny, metal-toothed appearance makes it clear that he will never avoid a good brawl.
Behind his full beard hides a dull and fearless face, which instills the feeling of hopeless inferiority in his enemies.
Half man, half tree! Up until now, a single sight of this weird bandit leader has made every enemy turn on its heels.
Lightning speed, merciless precision and his tough build have rightly earned him the title "King of Bandits".
A gigantic cannon that can sweep away whole cavalry battalions with one shot.
Used to swabbing the deck full-time, he has become rather skilled in handling a mop.
In spite of his weathered sabre and uncoordinated movements, his grim gaze lends him an air of danger. Furthermore, he reeks of rum.
This gutless character excels in hiding behind his comrades, occasionally throwing a rusty knife into the fray.
Even if his rusty old pistol does not appear fully functional, this nasty guy can cause a lot of trouble.
Tiny, barbed metal spikes. Lying around almost invisible, they can cause nasty injuries.
His razor-sharp hook has often been of great service during battles, frightening both enemies and subordinates.
Woe betide you if you criticise his culinary skills! Regardless of the consequences, this muddleheaded cook will hunt you down with his giant meat cleaver.
Under his large robe hides a sparkling, sharp dagger which he uses with stunning precision.
This weird fanatic is able to move very fast and uses his bare hands to take enemies out.
Gloomy and absolutely terrifying to look at. His magical powers can cause severe physical damage.
His body is in flames, making him hard to attack. He can pick pieces of himself off and transform them into fireballs.
A ghost that sneaks up on enemy troops to eliminate them with a well-directed bite.
At first glance it is unimaginable that this beautiful woman will shortly be slicing through a whole host of enemies.
This old and frail apparition gives her enemies a false sense of security that they regret afterwards.
This exalted aura puts the fear of God into his enemies. And if you see him shooting bolts of lightning from his hands, it may be the last thing you ever see.
You have never seen a creature like this before. A spiky being that moves incredibly fast and attacks its enemies with razor-sharp claws.
The days of these experienced, but simply too frail, warriors are numbered. They are sent into battle on foot, because it would be a pity to lose a horse.
Short, swift and surprisingly unerring with a bow. However, these young scallywags are still too inexperienced to effectively use them on horseback.
With his chain mail cap, a long lance and a noble warhorse, the mere sight of him intimidates the enemy.
No other people has ever managed to combine the advantages of bowmen and mounted units with such impressive perfection. The warrior's faces beam with the pride of this accomplishment.
The women of the horsemen tribe are in perfect symbiosis with their horses. Atypically, they are even more brawny - and thereby dangerous - than the men of the tribe.
Tremendous lance and heavy body armour. However this killing machine has made it onto his warhorse; you will not bring him down so fast again.
The bull-mask on his face says it all: tough like a bull, he wreaks havoc wherever he strikes.
Even if his current job is gathering firewood, he knows how to use his axe against advancing enemies too.
Even if he looks a little funny with his head squeezed into a leather helmet, he generally has the last laugh on the battlefield.
It is rumoured that his thick beard can shield him from numerous sword attacks.
The evil glance from underneath his horned helmet is almost as penetrating as his two-handed sword.
The female warriors of this tribe traditionally use a bow, making them faster than their male foes.
With his monstrous battle axe he can plough through enemy troops like a maniac.
An undomesticated animal which lives in the local forests. Appears only in large wolf packs. Always hungry and dangerous.

Gather as many balloons (1) as you can and donate them to bring victory to your server! This will be the main goal during this Event.
You will have the following ways of gathering balloons: a. Loot from adventures b. Rewards from quests (special daily quests and special quest chains) c. Converting resources to balloons in your provision house (2) d. Playing the game -> Trading, constructing buildings, upgrading buildings, treasure hunts, buffs and many more. While you play the game and perform certain actions (from point d), the resources gathered will be sent regularly via mail, so don't forget to check and accept them.
Once you have gathered some balloons, you can donate them from your storage. (3) They will be counted for your server as soon as they are taken out of your storage.
The first four days of the event will be phase 1. Each server has to reach a certain amount of gathered balloons during this time. The faster the server reaches the amount of balloons, the more rewards the players will get. After phase 1 and before the competition starts (phase 2), the donate button will be blocked. When it gets activated again, it means collecting all the balloons you can. For the competition itself some servers will be grouped in pools so that everyone has the chance to win. There are certain balloon goals (100%, 150% and 200% on the list), which will give the server additional rewards.
The Event will last four weeks.. After this period, everyone on the servers who has reached the particular percentage will get a reward. Additional rewards will be given to the servers which: - reach 200% first - gather the most balloons overall
There will be two special quest chains during the Event. The first one starts at level 1 and briefly explains the main mechanics. The second quest chain starts at level 26, as soon as the first quest chain is finished. It features two special military adventures, with an individual story and tasks. Furthermore, there will be special daily quests giving each player a retro click adventure, including original Settlers 2 graphics (5). By the way, the graphics aren't the only retro part. Take a listen while playing...
Besides the Settlers 2 Headquarters, you will be able to obtain Medipacks (6), Hired troops (7), cool retro skins for some of your buildings (8), special adventures from the second quest chain, and gems.

The Halloween Event is all about gathering pumpkins. There are many ways to get them, like through adventures, quests or collectibles. The most common way is from the pumpkin cemetery (1). They can also be bought at the merchant, and come in many different sizes, with different rates of production. Previously, the amount of pumpkins you could get from a field was limited - but now the fields can be refilled! You can obtain refillers for pumpkins by participating in adventures. Keep in mind that if a pumpkin field runs out, it will wither and you will not be able to refill it anymore. So make sure you always keep the fields full of pumpkins, or stop production until you can refill them to avoid this! Please note that the omniseeds will NOT work on the pumpkin field.
Another way of collecting pumpkins is to defeat the golems that spawn on your zone. (2)
To defeat the golems, you'll have to exploit their weaknesses. For that, you'll have to produce buffs in your provision house. There is always one specific buff that's effective against each golem type, and you can find out which one you need by selecting the monster with your mouse.
If you have some buffs left, you can use them to help your friends, or you can redeem them after the Event by using them on the Mayor's house.
Having defeated your first monster, after a certain period of time, the monster will re-spawn and you can defeat it again. But beware, the more you defeat it, the stronger it will return! Also, based on your level, after defeating it five times, the monster will change type, becoming even stronger. Will you be able to defeat them all?
After gathering pumpkins (3) through adventures, monsters, collectibles, quests and trading, you can spend them on attractive items from the merchant (4). Besides a spooky looking general and some nice new buffs, you can also obtain rare buildings and decorations, not to mention the critically acclaimed "grout" resource with which you can upgrade your buildings to level 6!
So there you have it! Get ready for the best Halloween ever!
Note: The following adventures can give you pumpkin refillers for your fields as reward: Split City in Summer, Split City in Fall, Return to the Bandit Nest, Horseback, The Lost Skull, Witch of the Swamp, The Dark Priests, Island of the Pirates, Sleeping Volcano, The Siege, Buccaneer Roundup, Traitors, Outlaws, Stealing from the Rich, Old Friends, Tropical Sun, Sleepy Reef, Lakeside Treasure, Bandit Nest, Gunpowder, Tikki island, Raiding the Raiders, Tomb Raiders, Sons of the Veld, The Nords, Surprise Attack, The Invasion of the Nords, Pirate Life, Bastille Island, Wild Mary, Mother Love, Arctic Explosion, More Secluded Experiments, Whirlwind, Victor the Vicious, Dark Brotherhood, The Black Knights, Secluded Experiments, Roaring Bull, The Valiant Little Tailor, The Clever Little Tailor, Sons of the Little Tailor, Heroic Little Tailor, Betrayed Little Tailor, Storm Recovery, Ali Baba the Young Woodcutter, Ali Baba and the first thief, Ali Baba and the second thief, Ali Baba and the third thief, Ali Baba and the treasure of knowledge, Ali Baba and the treasure of wisdom, Sindbad and the Besieged city, Sindbad and the sea snake, Aladdin and the Oil Lamp, Aladdin and the beautiful princess, and all colony maps.

We want to help join in the celebrations for Red Nose Day, which takes place on December 5th this year. Each year throughout Germany, people collect donations to give to charity.
To show our support for Red Nose Day, we will start a server event in which you can directly contribute to the cause by collecting red noses.
1) You can get noses in the following ways: - Your Explorers can find noses during a treasure search - When you finish an adventure, you can earn noses as additional loot - By collecting herbs and scarecrows you can build a basket full of red noses in the mayor’s house - Or, you can always buy noses from the shop
2) When the people on your server have collected enough noses during the event, we will donate a certain amount of money to the Red Nose Campaign.
3) To support Red Nose Day even more, you can buy red noses for your Avatar in the shop! We will donate the entire proceeds from those Avatar Noses to the Red Nose Campaign.

Easter is coming!
And you know what that means! The hunt for Easter eggs will begin soon. Much like in previous years, over the holiday season you'll be able to gather Easter eggs which you can use to buy special items in the shop. There is, however, one major difference this time around:
The latest Easter fashion is stripes rather than dots. So, going with the latest trend, the Easter bunny decided to hide some stripy eggs (1)! Whoever finds the most stripy eggs will be able to get some awesome rewards (2).
You can get stripy eggs by (3): - Sending your explorers on treasure searches - Completing the weekly quest chains (when you're level 17 or above) - Collecting stripy eggs on your Home Zone - Getting them as adventure loot - Getting them as expedition loot - Buying them in the shop
As an added bonus, this Easter the Easter bunny is rewarding all his most diligent friends and supporters with a special residence building (4). You can get the building by completing the quest "For my most loyal egg-hiders". Right now it is very small, but when you manage to gather a lot of achievement points from our brand new Easter 2015 achievements, you'll be able to upgrade the building so it can house more and more tenants. Only the best will reach the maximum level upgrade!

Welcome to the Settlers’ Football Championship! During this 4 week tournament you will be able to achieve fame and glory, and win awesome rewards - provided we succeed against our competitors on our way to the football championship!
Your main goal is to gather as many footballs as possible, and trade them in for great rewards in the shop. There are several ways (1) to get them: • Winning tournament games (many footballs to loot) • Fulfilling event related quests (as a reward) • Treasure searches (random chance) • Collectibles (random chance) • Stefan’s Sports Box in the Shop (random chance) • Adventure loot
The central element during the tournament is the fixture list (2). If you check it every day, you will get some extra rewards. Most importantly, your next opponents will be drawn here. • Brown door - contains a random reward (can only be opened on the respective day in the calendar) • Green door – contains a football adventure (can also be opened at a later point) • Trophy door – special door in which you can choose a reward (can only be opened if you've opened all previous doors)
The football matches (3) have their own set of rules compared to adventures. In each football adventure you will encounter enemy players (4) who have certain skills (5). To defeat them, you will need to produce certain tactical items (6) in your provision house or rarity provision house to counter a specific skill. The materials to produce those tactical items can be found in different ways: • Some are collectibles only; • Some can be found through treasure searches; • You can get them as quest rewards, especially for daily quests; • You can also trade them.
The only thing left to say is good luck, coach! Lead our great kingdom to the Football Cup!

Christmas is coming!
And you know what that means! Much like in previous years, over the holiday season you'll be able to get presents which you can use to buy special items in the shop. You can get those presents by (1): - Collecting Christmas bells, candy canes and gingerbread to produce baskets full of presents. - Opening certain doors on the calendar - Sending your explorers on treasure searches - Completing the brand-new quest chain - Completing Daily Quests - Finishing the two Christmas adventures "The stolen Sleigh" and "Save the Christmas Feast" - Buying them in the Shop - Or, through Christmas Surprise Packages
Just like last year, but even cooler, you can get great things through the Event Calendar (2). Each day you can open a door and receive resources and buffs. On special days, you'll even get a special bonus if you've opened all the previous doors. And, if you manage to open all the doors, you'll receive a rare "frosty" reward!
This year, on certain days, you'll get special adventures from the Event Calendar. These adventures will require you to help Santa make some unfortunate settlers happy (3) by delivering them some gifts (4) which you can produce in your Provision House. These adventures will reward you with extra presents.
We've also added new blueprints that can be used on your Rarity Provision House to unlock the production of special new buffs. The Rarity Provision House and the new recipes can be bought in the Christmas shop category (5). Grout is also available during this event, and can be used to upgrade more buildings to level 6 (stone and marble masons, farms, bakeries, millers and now also the silos).

Christmas is coming!
And you know what that means! Much like in previous years, over the holiday season you'll be able to get presents which you can use to buy special items in the shop. You can get those presents by (1): - Collecting Christmas bells, candy canes and gingerbread to produce baskets full of presents. - Opening certain doors on the calendar - Sending your explorers on treasure searches - Completing Santa's quest chain - Completing Daily Quests - Earning event achievements - Finishing the two Christmas adventures "The Stolen Sleigh" and "Save the Christmas Feast" - Buying them in the shop - Or, through Christmas Surprise Packages
Just like last year, but even cooler, you can get great things through the Event Calendar (2). Each day you can open a door and receive resources and buffs. On special days, you'll even get a special bonus if you've opened all the previous doors. And, if you manage to open all the doors, you'll receive a rare "frosty" reward!
This year, on certain days, you'll get special adventures from the Event Calendar. These adventures will require you to help Santa make some unfortunate settlers happy (3) by delivering them some gifts (4) which you can produce in your provision house. These adventures will reward you with extra presents.
We've also added new blueprints that can be used on your Rarity Provision House to unlock the production of special new buffs. The Rarity Provision House and the new recipes can be bought in the Christmas shop category (5).

The party crashers will make an appearance on your island every day, and set up camp in the center of your island (3). You can choose to deal with this problem by asking your friends for help so you can bribe them off your island, or by taking up arms yourself and sending your general to deal with them. Consult the quest details in the questbook for more information.
Last but not least, this Easter the Easter bunny is rewarding all his most diligent friends and supporters with a special warehouse (4). You can get the building by completing the quest "For My Most Loyal Egghiders". Right now it is very small, but as you gain achievement points from the brand new annual Easter achievements, you'll be able to upgrade the building, and it'll keep getting bigger and bigger in storage capacity and appearance. Only the best will reach the maximum level upgrade!

Welcome to the Settlers’ Soccer Championship! During this 3 week tournament, you'll be able to win awesome rewards - provided we succeed against our competitors on our way to the soccer championship! For the duration of the event, you'll earn double loot from adventures, while the XP you gain from adventures has been tripled!
Your main goal is to gather as many soccer balls as possible, and trade them in for great rewards in the shop. There are several ways (1) to get them, some guaranteed, some subject to chance: • Winning tournament games • Rewards for some event related quests • Treasure searches • Collectibles • Loot from certain adventures • Buying the small fan package in the shop
The central element during the tournament is the fixture list (2). If you check it every day, you can earn extra rewards. Most importantly, your next opponents will be drawn here. • Brown door - contains a fixed, or random reward (can only be opened on the respective day in the calendar) • Green door – contains a soccer adventure (can also be opened at a later point) • Trophy door – special door in which you can choose a reward (can only be opened if you've opened all previous doors)
The soccer games (3) work like scenario adventures. In each game you will encounter enemy players (4) who have certain skills (5). To defeat them, you will need to produce certain tactical items (6) in your provision house or rarity provision house (7). The materials to produce those tactical items can be found in different ways: • Some are collectibles only • Some can be found through treasure searches • You can get them as rewards for some event-related quests, especially for daily quests • You can get them as loot from (regular) adventures • You can buy resource packages in the shop • You can also trade them with other players
The only thing left to say is good luck, coach! Lead our great kingdom to the Soccer Championship Cup!

And you know what that means! Much like in previous years, over the holiday season you'll be able to get presents which you can use to buy special items in the shop. You can get those presents by (1): - Collecting Christmas bells, candy canes and gingerbread to produce baskets full of presents. - Opening certain doors on the calendar - Sending your explorers on treasure searches - Completing Santa's quest chain - Completing Daily Quests - Earning event achievements - Completing the two Christmas adventures "The Stolen Sleigh" and "Save the Christmas Feast" - Or by buying them in the shop

Come celebrate our anniversary with us! We need to gather as many balloons (1) as possible for the party - and your help won't go unrewarded!
You can donate balloons by clicking them in the event tab in your Mayor's House. You can earn a handful of balloons by completing quests, but the best way is to convert your resources at the Festival Hall (2). You can run up to three conversions at the same time, for maximum productivity.
If you want to shoot for the biggest rewards, you can improve your balloon output even further with birthday cake buffs (3). You can create these buffs by combining candles and cake dough (4). However, you'll only be able to find one or the other, with the resource you find being determined by your level. You'll have to trade with other players to get the other one. Either way, you can get your ingredient from several sources: - Collectibles - Treasure searches - Adventure loot
There are two types of rewards for donating balloons: Personal and worldwide. - Quests will reward you for your personal contributions. - Every week, there will be a worldwide objective, which everyone contributes towards. If the goal is met, everyone will receive the reward! (5)
Unlike many other event resources, balloons are not a currency to be spent at the merchant. However, he still offers a selection of celebratory items in exchange for gems! (6)

Welcome to the Settlers' Valentines Event! During this time you'll be able to obtain awesome rewards, and help your friends reach their goals.
Your main goal is to gather Valentine's Flowers, and trade those against unique rewards at the merchant. There are several ways to obtain Valentine's Flowers. • Produce them using Flower Farms. These farms have a deposit which contains Valentine's Flowers, and can be refilled with refills earned by playing co-op and multiplayer adventures. • Find them through Treasure Searches. • Trade them with other players. • Or buy Flower Packages from the merchant.
This event is all about cooperation between you and your friends/loved ones.
Use a small amount of Valentine's Flowers to craft Flower Bouquets in both provision houses, which can be applied on the residences of your friends. Applying those buffs will create a lovely buff animation, and having several Flower Bouquets active will trigger certain zone wide buffs. • 5x triggers the "Heart Locks" buff, boosting population recruitment. The buff will remain applied so long as at least 5 Flower Bouquets remain active. • 10x triggers the "Family Day" buff, boosting unit recruitment speed. The buff will remain applied so long as at least 10 Flower Bouquets remain active.
In addition, a Valentine's Card Box can be crafted in both provision houses. Opening this box will grant one of nine Valentine's Cards. Those cards can be applied to Flower Farms to boost their output, but they also have an additional effect. • Each Valentine's Card sends a lovely short message to your friend. • Having all 3 Flower Farms buffed with Valentine's Cards will trigger the "Valentine" zone wide buff. This buff provides a +200% bonus to resource, refill and XP rewards from co-op and multiplayer adventures.
Exchange cards and bouquets with your friends to boost your islands and complete your achievements!

End of the World Mini-Event

An obscure group of priests prophesied the end of the world would occur before the end of the year 2012. As it turned out, they were wrong. But rumors point to a curious case of transposed digits. And actually, it’s true - some of their records clearly state the year 2021. Now, the priests are back to get their revenge, and have already tried to end your island’s legacy by shutting off Adobe Flash. But we will fight them together. This will be your role: You will have to gather all your military forces to defeat the priests in a special adventure – as often as possible. All servers will have to work together to overturn our impending fate.
+200% experience, resources and refills for the adventure “The End Of The World”.

Each player will need to complete the adventure “The End Of The World” as many times as possible in order to save the world.
The amount of adventures that will need to be completed depends on the number of active players. There are 3 reward tiers, based on how many adventures are completed globally. The countdown for all the completed adventures will start on March 5th and end March 15th.
For more details, please take a look at the forum.

Welcome, friend!
I will teach you all there is to know about managing your town. Start your settlement by building a woodcutter to gather some wood.
- Build 1 pinewood cutter

To construct more buildings, you will need different building materials. The first building material is planks. The sawmill produces pinewood planks out of pinewood.
- Build 1 pinewood sawmill

Wood is a limited resource. Make sure your woods are reforested regularly.
- Build 1 pinewood forester

You have received your first specialist, the geologist. He will help you find the next building material: Stone.
- Open the star menu - Send the geologist to find a stone deposit
TIP: You can always see the active quest by clicking the quest button.

It's time to harvest some stones.
- Build 1 mason
NOTE: Stone deposits are not bound to one mason, so you can place several masons next to the deposit.

Your population needs living space. Since your mayor's house only supports a limited number of people, you'll need more space.
- Build 1 residence

Providing your workyards with food packages will increase their productivity. To create your first food packages you will need fish.
- Build 1 fisherman

In order to process your fish into food packages you will need a provision house.
- Build 1 provision house

Now create your first fish platter in the provision house. Make sure you have the required resources in your storehouse.
- Create 1 fish platter

The fish platter can be used to increase the productivity of a workyard temporarily.
- Open star menu - Use 1 fish platter on a workyard

A new sector has been discovered in the north. It seems that nobody owns this sector, so you can claim it.
- Build 1 storehouse in a new sector

With all the copper and coal available you are now able to produce tools.
- Build 1 copper smelter - Build 1 toolmaker

You might have noticed that some sectors are infested with bandits. In order to clear out these vermin you'll need troops.
- Build 1 barracks
TIP: Barracks require a fair amount of building materials. If you are short on materials, check the store for some attractive deals!

In order to train recruits and keep them happy, you will need to produce brew. You can now create all the necessary buildings to do that.
- Build 1 farm - Build 1 wheatfield - Build 1 well - Build 1 brewery
NOTE: A farm always needs at least one wheatfield to produce wheat. Two or more farms can harvest wheat from the same wheatfield.

Bronze swords are needed to train recruits. You can now create all the necessary buildings to produce bronze swords.
- Produce 1 bronze sword

Now it's time to prepare your first army.
- Train 5 recruits in the barracks

Military units aren't able to go into battle on their own. They need a General to lead them. The General is the second Specialist that you can hire. All Specialists can be hired in the Tavern. - Create a Tavern.

Military units can't go to battle on their own. They need a general to lead them. Specialists, like the general, can be hired in the tavern.
- Build 1 tavern - Hire 1 general

You can now assign your recruits to this garrison. This will create an actual army that can attack the pesky bandits.
- Assign your recruits to the garrison

Check your nearby sectors. There are bandit camps there. In order to clear this sector you have to attack them.
- Defeat 1 bandit camp

Wheat is not only used to brew. You can also use flour to produce bread which your workers will like much more than eating fish all the time.
Create all the necessary buildings and produce one bread.
You have produced enough bread to create a better Food Buff. Go to your Provision House and create it.

As you may remember, the first four sectors were discovered automatically. All following sectors have to be discovered manually by another Specialist: The Explorer. You can hire Explorers in your Tavern...

In the outer sectors you will find a new type of wood: Hardwood. Advanced buildings will need planks of this material to be created.
- Produce 1 hardwood plank

The outer sectors also provide a new type of stone: Marble. Check your geologists, claim sectors and search for marble deposits.
- Produce 1 marble

Your Recruits are good fighters, but later on you will need more powerful units. You can now create all buildings needed to train a new type of military unit.
- Create 1 militia unit

You can now create all buildings needed to train cavalry units.
- Create 1 cavalry unit

Your final quest is at hand! Gold, precious gold! Defeat all the bandits and get access to the gold deposits in the northeastern mountains.
- Build 1 gold mine - Build 1 gold smelter - Build 1 coinage

You can upgrade your buildings to increase their productivity.
- Select one of your buildings and click the upgrade button.

The Mayor's house is your first storehouse. All goods are stored here. A click on a storehouse gives you an overview of your current stock level.
- Select the Mayor's house and take a look at your current stock level

Your geologist can now search for copper.
- Find 1 copper deposit

Now you can build a copper mine.
- Build 1 copper mine
NOTE: Contrary to masons, mines have to be placed directly on top of the found deposit.

In order to process your copper ore you will need coal. A coking plant can produce coal out of wood. Keep in mind that you might need another woodcutter to cope with the increased wood usage.
- Build 1 coking plant

In the barracks you can choose from various troop types
- Select the barracks and check how much resources are required to train a recruit.

The general can be placed in your sectors. He will create a garrison after arriving at his destination.
- Open the Star menu - Select the general and place him in one of your sectors

Besides melee fighters, you are now able to create your first ranged troops, the bowmen.
- Create 1 bowman unit

Your next task will be to explore this zone a little more. For this you have received an explorer.
- Open star menu - Send your explorer to map a new sector

More XP will grant higher levels and unlock new buildings, military units and other rewards.
- Defeat enemy units in bandit camps to gain XP
TIP: Explore sectors in the northwest or southeast to find new bandit camps.

You'll need your army to defeat the bandits. Go back to your home zone, assign your units to one of your generals and send him to the adventure.
- Send your army to the adventure zone.
NOTE: Your general needs a few minutes to travel to the adventure zone.
Defeat the first bandit leader to clear the sector.
Defeat the witch tower and get a reward
Defeat all dark castles and get a reward
Defeat all bone churches and get a reward
Defeat all witch towers and bone churches to get a reward

Send your explorer to search for adventures. Win adventures to gain XP and rewards. More XP will grant higher levels and unlock new buildings, military units and other rewards.
- Defeat enemy units in your home zone or adventure zones to gain XP

One of your explorers found an old shrine high up on a mountain to the north. It seems to me that it was built to honor an old king who loved these lands. We want to honor the king by rebuilding the shrine, but we'll need some materials. Please provide the materials we need!

There's a new exhibition in the city, about a bunch of rare ore! The only problem is, the lady who's organizing it has lost some of the exhibits! Let's see if we can provide the missing ore they need!
I heard that there's been golden rain over our wheatfields! That means the market will be interested in buying our wheat! Let's stock up and head for the markets!

We have had complains from Capital Island that we're keeping our best resources for ourselves! That's not true! Well… maybe it is, but we need to prove them wrong! Let's sell some of our most precious resources!

We're about to welcome a group of high ranking visitors from Capital Island, all friends of King Damien! I fear we will not be able to provide them with all the goods they need! Maybe one of your friends can help?
You know those loudmouths down at the pier? They're spreading rumours that you do not have true friends, because you never receive anything in return for your generosity. Prove them wrong.

Your brother Theodor is visiting, and tells you incessantly of his economic success. It strikes you that he does not seem to have any friends, and does everything on his own. Show him that friends can be a great help.

We've managed to open that little box our hunters found the other day! The box contained a message that reads: When trouble comes, a friend will hold the first sword against it! Sounds weird, I know, but it makes you think, right? Let's help our friends. I'm sure they'll be happy!
Oh no! Theodor, your brother, is about to visit us! Again! He almost certainly wants goods from you. Quick! Use any excess resources to support someone who really needs them.
One of our sages has predicted a heat wave that's going to hit one of your friends' islands! We should go and help him prepare! You never know what a heat wave can do…

Our settlers seem very tired lately. It must be because of those weird scents coming from the woods. They are making everyone sleepy and hungry. We should prepare some food for them! Maybe the food will raise their spirits!
Your cousin Frederik has sold too much food. Now he doesn't have enough left to feed his settlers. Quick! Help him so that his people do not have to suffer.

Last week one of our lords made a deal with some foreigners. He sold them some old statues he found in his backyard. Now the lords have asked you to help them welcome the buyers! I guess we can surprise them with our best food!
Your troops in the barracks are really bored because they have run out of glorious stories to tell! I think it's time for a fresh adventure that could provide some new tales!

A bandit leader named Chuck has mocked you in a letter and displayed it publicly for all to see. We have found out that he is hiding in a nearby forest with his brother, Norys. Do not let him get away with this smear on your name!
We have obtained a request for help from a nearby seaport. The inhabitants of Dagger Island have been attacked by cruel bandits, and urgently need military support!

Your military advisor has confided in you, telling of the feelings of insecurity among your settlers, brought on by tales of people disappearing at the border of your realm. You should show them quickly that they have nothing to fear.

Your younger brother Theodor has written you a letter. Oh joy! He writes that he's finally begun to settle down, just like you. Unfortunately, he has miscalculated and is now out of hardwood. Unsurprisingly, he's asked if you could help him out.
Once again, Theodor is in desperate need of your help. He's received an order from King Damien, but hasn't got the resources to fulfill it. Perhaps you can assist?

Your scouts bring word of an attack planned against your brother. Although you'd decided not to help him again, you cannot let the attacker get away with this! After all, family comes first, right? Let's send his military leader some quality weapons… just to be sure he can defend himself!

A mysterious heat wave has burned down everything on one of the neighboring islands! Something is wrong here - this is not the first time we've heard about powerful sunbeams that burn everything they "shine" upon… Anyway, we should be supportive, as always.

We have some farmers living at the foot of the old mountain. Why is it called the old mountain? I guess because it's old, he he! The farmers want to build some more farms, but they need some stone. Let's provide some!
One of your stonecutters is extremely excited, talking of an epoch-making invention of his that can transform stone into marble! You should try it!

The old alchemist has come up with a new serum that can turn swords into iron swords. He says that he found the formula inside an old tree near the waterfalls. The problem is that the serum treatment consumes a lot of bronze swords to produce the iron swords. No matter though - it might come useful!
One of your townswomen approaches, drenched in tears, and tells you how her husband is deep in debt because of gambling. She begs you for help and offers brew in return. Convert the brew into gold.
One of your servants has found a totally neglected family of dogs in his back yard. The poor dogs are ravenous and weak. Provide them something to eat.
These are uncertain times, and reports accumulate of attacked camps in the surroundings. Raise your steel resources to be prepared for the worst case scenario.
A traveller residing at your royal court has introduced you to hunting. Now, you want to establish a group for that sport. Provide the necessary resources.
You should always keep your negotiation skills finely honed. To have the right touch in this area can be of great advantage.
You have heard about profitable prices for exotic wood. Check your storage! Maybe you can dispense with some?!
Effective wood production is always important for your economy. Make sure you have a well filled wood storage at all times.
During operations over the last few weeks, the equipment of your soldiers has become tattered. Raise your stock of steel to be able to afford repairs.
You extended your land, and with this comes lots of resources. Time to harvest them and increase your stocks.
Rumours of a shortage of Titanium have started to spread in the marketplace, causing a sudden jump in prices. Quick! Make sure you have some in reserve, just in case.

You remember the Quasadi brothers? The ones that claimed they can cut a tree with one slash? Well they're back on the island and they're about to put on a show. However, sadly they have been attacked by some pirates and had their swords stolen! No problem - we'll get them new ones!
Old Tempar, the cannon master, has told me that they've received a new kind of cannon that can deal more damage if loaded with sufficient gunpowder. That means they're going to need a lot of it!

One of your cousins wants to claim one of his neighbour's islands that is being occupied by devious bandits. Unfortunately, he has no idea about military and resources management. You decide to help him, because chasing bandits is always a good idea.
Your cousin has finished the first phase, and the first wave of recruits is on its way. Now he needs new resources for the next one.
Your cousin's attack was not as effective as he'd hoped. Furthermore, he forgot to pay his mercenaries! You should send him some coins if you want to avoid a mutiny!
Your cousin encountered tougher defences than expected. He needs more effective equipment, and therefore more resources.

Our troops found a new island last summer that has a swamp on it. It was filled with weird wooden structures. They believed it to be a witch hut, but they never got back to make sure. Well, it actually was a witch hut, and that witch is back. We need to take care of it!
I bring ill news! I have received reports from my spies that the upper nobility is about to turn against you! This cannot be allowed!
We were on the lookout for a new adventure when a letter reached us, asking that you bring a former bowman to justice. Nice timing!

Oh dear! We've lost some cannons! At first we believed they had been stolen by the pirates but… but no! They actually got stolen by some renegade knights of ours, and they have taken over Greenmoor castle in the valley! We need to take back the castle and the cannons! Our city is in danger!

An exotic bird arrived this morning with a letter attached to its back. The letter is an open challenge from a raider clan called "The Sons of the Veld". They say that you're ugly. I have already prepared the ships, so let's go visit them. They need to be taught that insults do not go unpunished.

One of my friends, a knight patrolling the wilderness, has told me of some terrible screams coming from the deep forests at night. He believes there is a secret bandit camp in there, somewhere! Who knows what they are up to... We should go and investigate!

Dark clouds have gathered above an island to the south! We've never seen such manifestations before! Our alchemist, Waltor the Grey, believes it to be the work of an old friend of his who is adept in dark magic! Let's not waste any more time! We need to take care of the problem!

A strange murmur goes through your land. Dark shapes wander through our streets at night and inhabitants disappear without a trace! People tell of a new brotherhood. Apparently they have found some true shadow essence and now can use it to travel around quickly! We must stop them before it's too late!
Problems again! We've found out that somebody is recruiting our people for unknown reasons! And now we've also received a message! If you would be so kind and follow me to the main chambers…
The miner's union keeps sending us these letters to ensure that we're constantly looking after the condition of our mines! We should do that, right?

Water is a basic production good that is essential to several production chains. You should always produce enough water to secure an effective and steady flow of goods. Luckily, our architects are doing a nice job making everything look so beautiful!

A farmer came to the Mayor's House today to complain about some wild animals destroying his wheatfield. We've already sent a search party to capture the wild animals, but in the meantime we should also support the inhabitant. Let's build him a wheatfield!

One of your ships has disappeared during its most recent voyage, with several of your soldiers on board. They were heading for the Maioranna Triangle. We have sent a search party in hope of finding them, but until they get back we should train some new soldiers!
One of the battlemasters from your barracks has suggested drilling elite soldiers to keep up with your enemies. Maybe you should give it a try?
Many of your settlers are being harassed by roaming animals, and carriages are often hindered by deer crossing. Attend to this problem immediately.
A group of people from a neighbouring region has come to you and wants to settle on your land. Provide them with the necessary materials to build their houses.
Your new settlers have built their houses very fast and are quite hard-working. However, they are in need of food. Provide them some nutrition until they can produce enough food of their own.
The new settlers have opened a bakery. However, they do not yet produce enough flour to fully supply the bakery. Come to their aid a little.
The new settlers have been working diligently for you for several months now. Give them a present as a token of your esteem and thanks for their loyalty.
A huge animal market will soon be held in a neighbouring country. One of your cousins wants to participate and buy some new horses, but he is out of gold. Maybe, you can help him out?
A competition is about to be held: who makes the best sausage? You can't miss out on this! Submit your sausage for judging.
A terrible disease has ravaged a neighbouring city, killing many animals. Now, meat is in extremely short supply. Can you spare some from your stock?

Your brother Theodor is anxious. He has a new beloved he wants to marry. For the proposal, he wants to build a pavilion on a hillside, but he needs additional granite. Will you have pity on him and give him what he needs?
Your favorite brother Theodor wants to start large-scale trading. However, he has no idea how to go about it. Show him how trading functions.

Your brother Theodor has been trading for a short while now. Although he has traded iron ore, he seems to have forgotten that he does not have enough in stock to complete the deal. Quickly obtain some iron ore for him before he gets in trouble.
Your brother Theodor has invited you to his estate. Of course, he has a ulterior motive; he needs a few small things. Produce some carriages to make transportation possible.

Either there's a freak fog or we have a serious case of ghost ships cruising around our island! They have even attacked some of our fishermen! We should prepare our cannons and defend ourselves if we have to!

The trees of Capital Island are being attacked by a timber worm which has already gouged through over 50 percent of the trees. King Damien is angry! We need to send some examples of our wood to the king's scientists, to make sure that our trees are not affected.

King Damien wants to build himself a monument, and of course it has to be made of gold. Because he says he doesn't have any at the moment - a fact that I very much doubt - he wants you to send him some gold ore. Organize this quickly and deliver it as soon as possible to Capital Island!
King Damien is preparing a food donation for the poor people of his islands, and is asking everyone for support. Surely he can count on you?
A courier reaches you with a message saying that a ship has run aground along your coast. Unfortunately, it is not possible for them to send help, so they ask you for tools to repair the ships.

Your last treasure search brought back a map! And you know what? There is treasure on this island! However, it's hidden deep in the old mountain. Whoever hid it made sure nobody was going to get at it easily, and has sealed the entrance to the cave holding the treasure with a huge block of marble. Don't ask me how they did it. We need to dig our way in.
A holiday draws near that is going to boost the social attitude of the people. You should set a good example and show them how social behavior works.
One of your settlers wants to become a fisherman, but has no experience in this field. Help him out a little with his first fish.
A great feast approaches and experience tells you that a lot of drinking is to be expected. Build up stocks so that your settlers are not left high and dry.
You want to organize an exhibition of valuable jugs. Unfortunately, you don't really have enough beautiful examples to fill an exhibition. Produce some copper so that additional ones can be produced.
One of your horse breeders has produced a promising new race of horses. They might bring a high price at market. Make him give you some of them and see what you get for them.

One of your farmers is teaching his son to follow in his footsteps, the main training areas being the wheatfields around their farm. Maybe you can lend them a hand and help them a bit with harvesting?!

A strong glow is emanating underwater near the southern shore. One of our fishermen has made a discovery underwater! However, he needs supplies to recuperate his find. Give him what he needs. Maybe he'll come back with great treasure?

Settlers are reporting a huge beast lurking around in the forest. It only comes out at night! Your inhabitants feel insecure and ask you to check on it. Prepare a search party to deal with the monster.
One of your prospectors has just found a new gold deposit. As a loyal subject, he naturally tells you immediately. You should check it out and begin mining immediately.

Helvian Kones, a famous archeologist from Capital Island, comes to us excitedly and reports of a bone discovery. Unluckily, the find is buried too deep in the mountain for you to dig it out alone. Help Kones expose the bones!

A long while ago you helped Helvian Kones, the archeologist, to launch an excavation of a bone. Now, it is complete… and the bones look like they are from a huge animal. Because you have never seen anything like it, you do not want to withhold the find from your settlers. Exhibit the bones publicly.

A short while ago, you exhibited the bones of a huge animal. Even though it was absolutely fascinating, your settlers also got frightened, and now they long for proof that such an animal does not exist anymore. Helvian Kones has offered his services, but he really needs some specialists to help explore this phenomenon. Hire some!

Your cousin Frederik, who is known as a wannabe treasure hunter, honours you with a visit once again, and tells you about a hidden treasure. Unfortunately, he is missing some parts of the map and the clues lead him here, to this island. Try to find them, by any means!

To guarantee the continued survival of different kinds of animals, King Damien has decided to catch animals and exchange them with other lands in order to refresh the bloodlines and introduce new animals to the land. Support the king with this initiative!
You decide once again to take a long walk through your lands. As you reach the woodcutting area, the wood appears to be thinner than it used to be. You decide to have it reforested.

You have sent some explorers to investigate a nearby area which seems to have rich copper deposits. However, it appears you are not the only one interested. Build some copper mines quickly, before someone else does.

You have heard of someone speaking ill of you behind your back and denigrating you in front of your inhabitants. Even though your people trust you, you should investigate. Find out who is behind this smear campaign and take them to task.

The King likes parades, but do you know what he loves even more than parades? Military parades! However, such a big event requires a lot of military units, so we're going to send some of our troops to attend!
King Damien has announced that once again the time has come to decide which are the most beautiful cities. Noble residences give an obvious advantage. Does your city stand a chance?
Your settlers are unsatisfied and have started moaning about bad weather and the excessively long paths they have to walk. You can find a remedy for at least one of these problems.

A short while ago, King Damien came for a visit and was unsure whether to nominate your city. Now, he has announced a new visit and will be arriving soon. Help persuade the king to make a positive decision.

A good friend of yours contacts you with a request for a favor. He is the leader of a small desert tribe, and recently the animals in his area have become quite aggressive. The trouble is, he has no weapons to defend the village. Help him out with a few bows.

As a sign of peace, King Damien decides on a public display of weapons being destroyed in front of the Tyrhand Palace. Because you support the basic idea, you decide to take part and volunteer some of your weapons.

A huge bear is making trouble in your land and the people are understandably afraid of it. You have to do something, but do not want to harm the bear. So, here's your brilliant idea; why not build a compound for it and allow the people to see it in captivity?

King Damien wants to build a small island in the sea, right in front of Capital Island, and it will require a great amount of resources. The idea is to build a huge statue on the island to welcome all new settlers. Everyone is requested to help the king build the monument.

A few weeks ago, your city was designated as one of the most beautiful in all the land. Now you'd like to celebrate this in the proper manner and arrange a great feast for your inhabitants. Make all necessary preparations.

We have received several complaints lately about a shadowy figure lurking around the city, scaring people and stealing coins! We must do something! Setting a trap would be the best idea. Let's make sure the shadow hears about the huge amount of "wink wink" gold we're about to send to Capital Island!
Your mother-in-law has invited herself for a visit and you are not keen on answering her stupid questions. Better make yourself scarce for a while.

Santa Claus is having to deal with a huge wave of illness among his helpers, leading to the faltering production of presents. Buff your friends' buildings so that they can send some of their settlers to help.
To reward your settlers and secure a cozy Christmas evening, you have decided to place firewood at your settlers' disposal.
Santa Claus' reindeers only have a wooden crate for protection, not much good against wind and snow. You propose to build one out of stone.
Santa's helpers have worked hard, but the delivery of new tools is still missing. There aren't enough tools left to finish all the presents. Help Santa Claus out.

One of your attendants has been enthusing recently about a beverage called mulled wine. You have become curious, and decide to trade some of it to see whether it really is as tasty as you have been told.
The Christmas bakery has run out of flour for the cookies. Christmas without cookies? Unthinkable! Quick! Help them out with some flour!
You have received a strange message telling of a mysterious creature calling itself "Croaker" that is surrounding itself with all kinds of bad people. Go and investigate!
You have decided to erect a huge Christmas tree in the village square. This requires building an adequate wooden holder, capable of holding the weight of the tree.
After having been very reasonable for quite some time, you decide to treat yourself by manufacturing a new mantelpiece out of marble. It will be a much more suitable place to hang up your stockings!
You have received a strange message telling of a mysterious creature calling itself "Croaker" that is surrounding itself with all kinds of bad people. Go and investigate!
Because mother Holle has a lot to do at the moment, Santa Claus wants to send her some of his elves to help out, but they'll need provisions for the journey. Help Santa with some sausages.
Wood is an important resource. As recycling is more and more crucial, you have decided to recycle old bows in order to make new ones.

As you walk through your streets, you come across two citizens, talking about a drunkard in the tavern babbling strange things about Christmas eve. You decide to visit the tavern and investigate.
After completing the quest you will receive the adventure "Save the Christmas Feast" via mail..

As you walk through your streets, you come across two citizens, talking about a drunkard in the tavern babbling strange things about Christmas eve. You decide to visit the tavern and investigate.
After completing the quest you will receive the adventure "Save the Christmas Feast" via mail.
Ask around in the Tavern
In the tavern you are told that a local salesman has gone missing. He was last seen moving east with his baggage and has not been seen since. Search for clues and find out the salesman's whereabouts.
Follow the clues to find out about the salesman's whereabouts.
Follow the clues to find out about the salesman's whereabouts.
Follow the clues to find out the salesman's whereabouts.
Defeat the bandits and free the salesman
Please don't hurt our boys!

"They just want to play," says the old forester's wife. "I beg you, don't hurt my boys! They decided to form their own little gang and thought a flimsy tent and bad breath was enough to form a band of robbers. Then they set up camp in the north. Please, let them live and I assure you, you shall not regret it!"
They're in the trees

A terrified townsman complains to you: "Nowhere's safe these days! Not only do these scallywags entrench themselves in their camps, they also lurk in the dark of the forest! Do these lands a great service and cast these vermin out from their treetop hideouts!"

Bored, you take a look at your mail as you recognize a letter from the Easter bunny. He invites you to a paper chase. Should you be able to catch him, you will get a nice reward. You accept the invitation. First, you need to build a big basket for the Easter eggs.

You have got the coordinates for the first stage of the paper chase. Follow the instructions on the map. Note: You can start the adventure by clicking on it. No general is required to complete it. Just go to the coordinates and gather all the Easter eggs.
Before the paper chase can go on, you must store the Easter eggs somewhere. You should build a little shed where they can be stored without getting wet.
The coordinates for the second stage have arrived. Now the paper chase can continue. So, take your basket and keep on collecting…

A message from the Easter bunny reaches you, telling you that he went all out and fell ill. His brother inherited the task, but he cannot find the map for the last stage of the paper chase. Gather a search party and help him with the search.
The Easter bunny's brother has already left to hide the remaining Easter eggs. You decide to do the same and visit the last paper chase island.

As you return to your island, the Easter bunny's brother awaits you with noticeably drooping ears. He tells you that while hiding the Easter eggs he realised too late that he had a hole in his backpack. You decide to help him to get his backpack repaired.
You take a look at the map and quickly get an idea of what the brother is about to say. He asks you to help collect the missing eggs, and promises to let you keep some of the eggs if you do.

The settler reports excitedly about the Easter bunny's brother being found unconscious in the garden. It seems he had no energy left because he hadn't eaten for quite some time. Provide him something to eat so that he can recover.
The map with the new coordinates lies on the desk waiting to be picked up. So, let's go on the next Easter egg hunt!
Today is a day for relaxing, my friend. How about a brew on the field?
No sweat. Now let's move on. According to the Easter bunny's brother, this is the last area where he lost Easter eggs. So, let's go!

After returning you speak immediately to the rabbit, but he cannot remember anything before dropping from exhaustion. One of your settlers tells you about a memory potion that brings back memory completely. Provide all necessary ingredients to the settler.
You got an exact description of the old man. It really seems like the Easter bunny's brother hid the eggs in the wrong area. So, the mission "Easter egg recovery" must goes on.

Unfortunately, the potion still isn't working. No matter how intensively you ask, the rabbit still can't remember. One of your treasurers comes to you and requests you take care of business while the rabbit regains its memory.

The Easter bunny's brother remembers the first island where he hid Easter eggs by mistake. He also remembers that he could not read his brother's handwriting, so he improvised... incorrectly. You should start a new search.

The moment your arrive, you visit the rabbit. He tells you of the last island where he hid Easter eggs. He wants to accompany you, but there are wild beasts on the island. Recruit some military units to protect him.
Now it seems the end of the chase is really drawing near. You decide to be extraordinarily efficient this time. And with the help of the rabbit, what could possibly go wrong?
Now that the Easter adventure seems to have ended, you should take a look at trading. Prices have very likely changed and maybe you can get a bargain.

A letter lies on your bed. You open it and see new coordinates for an island. Furthermore, you find an accompanying handwritten letter saying “Thank you for your help. Without you, Easter would have been a disaster. As a gift, we have hidden some more Easter eggs. Have fun searching."
Inspect the ruins

9 Easter eggs are hidden on the island. Find them all to complete this adventure. Note: to gather the Easter eggs, all you have to do is click on them with your mouse cursor. Click once on every egg to complete the adventure.
9 Easter eggs are hidden on the island. Find them all to complete this adventure.
9 Easter eggs are hidden on the island. Find them all to complete this adventure.
9 Easter eggs are hidden on the island. Find them all to complete this adventure.
9 Easter eggs are hidden on the island. Find them all to complete this adventure.
9 Easter eggs are hidden on the island. Find them all to complete this adventure.
9 Easter eggs are hidden on the island. Find them all to complete this adventure.

The old hermit inhabiting the ruins whispers to you: "The old witch is afraid of nothing, not even the king's troops! Not all her minions are vile creatures; only recently has she bedeviled a squad of the king's men and forced them serve her. The king will certainly be grateful if you manage to let his men to escape."
9 Easter eggs are hidden on the island. Find them all to complete this adventure.
15 Easter eggs are hidden on the island. Find them all to complete this adventure.
9 Easter eggs are hidden on the island. Find them all to complete this adventure.
Select the Witch Tower with your mouse cursor!
The Witch has cast a nasty curse over this swamp and guards the souls of lost explorers to haunt these lands. Find the 7 hidden graves to free their cursed souls!
Visit the Tavern
A deserted royal regiment is reported to hide among Victor's troops. Make sure they survive so they can be taken before the king for a fair trial.
Click any Camp

Vicious Victor seems to have driven some local scoundrels to the woods when seizing these lands. His old rival Ruppert the Revengeful is secretly gathering troops and is just waiting for Victor to be cast out so he can return to pester the righteous folks. Stop the evildoer's scheming, and the local regent will increase your rewards even further!
Ask around at the tavern!

A slightly tipsy mayor welcomes you with open arms: "What a fortunate coincidence to have you here in our lovely little town! We're being harassed by a bunch of marauders that sneak around in the bushes at night and steal our cattle. Drive these wretches away and we will reward you accordingly!"
Click the guild house

The Guild Master is upset because the preparations for the guild's annual celebration aren't going as planned. "We still don't have enough water lilies to weave into our traditional wreathes! Just how can we get them in time? Help us and collect as many as you can and you won't regret it!"

The defensive stance of your first opponent might suggest diffidence, and tempt the foolhardy general into carelessness. However, rest assured that these men, hardened by some fateful battles, have quite a few perfidious tricks up their sleeves, and their injuries may not be as serious as they make out.

They seem unpredictable and wayward, but it would not be advisable to underestimate them. Among them are some of the most experienced and well versed fighters, yet word is that their own trainers seem to struggle with their rigidity. It is even reported that in the face of defeat, some of them become inappropriately headstrong...

You are now facing veterans of this tournament, even if their historical feats are not always undisputed. These all-weather champions seem quick to battle and always ready for a jolly knees-up, but they can also quickly turn a battle in their favor without much of a plan.

One ought to be surprised how ruthless the men from these otherwise cultivated lands can act in battle. These valiant combatants used to win their battles with skill and finesse, proving to be formidable opponents. These days, it is said that when particularly challenged, they resort to combat techniques similar to those practiced in the east.

With almost mechanical routine these contestants have turned many a battle in their favor, often not exactly with tactical flair. It seems that only their predictability and confidence in victory could possibly be their undoing. Yet, they may have met their match with you. If you manage to bring them out of their shell, victory is already within reach.

How deceptively graceful these apparitions may appear when seen scurrying across the battlefield. These sinuous combatants might tempt the short-witted to underestimate their actual proficiency. But beware, your opponents are astute strategists that are up to every trick in the book. Many opponents have already fallen prey to their clever tactical scheming.

It is a contest of the strongest and fiercest, a challenge of will, the promise of eternal glory... and you have just received an invitation to this tournament of champions from afar! Awestruck, you marvel at the ornate document, the receipt of which alone is a privilege. Glory and riches await you. And there's talk of brew, too!
Your invitation lies ready in your mailbox, so quickly go and prepare for the oncoming challenges, then gather your men and face your contenders!

You have won your first spurs and are ready for the next challenge. The tournament is in full swing now and has taken hold of your island as well. Excitedly bustling everywhere, your settlers elatedly go about their preparations for the upcoming event. This way your men should be up and running in no time! And here comes your next invitation already! Don't make your opponents wait!

You have successfully moved on to the next round and quickly acquired a reputation that earns you numerous enthusiastic followers. Already bets are being placed on your upcoming victories, and your settlers are pleased with your efforts. Time to prepare your next match. Get a selection of your finest men to the venue!

If you thought things were tough so far, then beware! You have successfully mastered the first half of this tournament, but the true challenges are yet to come. Brace yourself, because from here on your opponents know no mercy. Muster your men and set out for the next match!

The upcoming match promises a thrilling battle. Your opponents travel to the contest from faraway countries, often dressing up peculiarly and employing wondrous tactics. Look out, chose your troops with care, and maybe you'll even get to learn a few tricks from your adversaries. Travel to the next venue with your men!

You have done well to get this far. It took some grim battles and many a brew, but your settlers went through all the highs and lows together with you. Now the final stand-off lies ahead, and a palpable tension is in the air all across your island. In the past, you have proven to be a great contestant with remarkable endurance, but now you will have to show what you have learned in this tournament! Ready your men and prepare for the final match!

Discipline is important. Your coaches seem to be having trouble getting through to their charges, judging by the chaos in your barracks. Your boys will never get in shape in time at this rate! Perhaps a few whistles would give your instructors some authority, and allow for some more orderly training. Provide bronze for whistles!

Daily jogging takes its toll, and not just on your recruits; the roads of your empire show serious signs of wear, with the trampling of your well-fed boys literally leaving its mark. To make sure your economy continues running smoothly, you should order repairs of your sidewalks. Place stone at disposal to repair your streets!

It would certainly help the concentration of your athletes if the spectators stands didn't creak so loudly! How is one to exercise properly when the entire hall is groaning and moaning? You should take care of this nuisance; supply some wood for the repairs of your gym!

Your athletes complain about having the feeling they're being watched sometimes. Certainly, the dilapidated cubicles and missing doors in your dressing rooms might have something to do with that. Some privacy would certainly help them concentrate before the matches. If you can spare some wood planks, you'll be able to order the repair of your cubicles!

Enthusiasm for the tournament occasionally seems to go a little overboard among your settlers. Over the course of a little vespertine drinking session, some of your supporters have scrawled inspirational slogans across the walls of the mayor's house. Regrettably, the markings are not always family friendly, so it is recommended that you get them cleaned up quickly. Provide some marble for repairs on the mayor's house!

Your athletes are a little concerned about the quality of their travel comfort. Specifically, they seem worried they might not even reach their destination alive, due to the state of their current means of transport. Be lenient and send a few craftsmen with tools for inspection!

It might not be essential for success in the tournament, but it should concern you that even cattle is hot-footing it away from your athletes. Perhaps hygiene hasn't been a priority lately, with all the training they've been doing?! A hot bath never hurt anyone, so provide some coal to get your boys scrubbed off in hot water!

Your Settlers have been exceedingly committed to preparing their next match lately. In order to keep up the good spirit and to properly show your appreciation you should hand out some free brew for everyone!

Astonishingly, the brew diet for your athletes seems to come with some unforeseen side effects. Along with some difficulties in expressing themselves and an alarming sense of balance, your men also complain of feeling bloated. Your medical officers recommend switching to water. Supply them with enough fresh water, and your men should be back on track in no time!

Travel to the venues is long and tedious, and it's common knowledge there is really nothing useful one can do on a journey besides eating. Make the journey more bearable for everyone by providing bread for some decent sandwiches along the way.

A group of particularly enterprising Settlers has approached you with a promising business idea. They intend to sell all sorts of crispy snacks and nibbles to the audiences at the tournament venues. It's a lucrative idea, and all they need is for you to sell them enough flour and water.

Your men have completely worn their training equipment out. They've used their training dummies so much that effective training just isn't possible anymore. In order keep up with the level of competition in this international tournament, you should waste no time investing in top quality materials this time.

Your inhabitants are thrilled about the ongoing tournament. They demand souvenirs of the spectacle so they can reminisce about it with their offspring. Provide the required iron ore so they can produce the much sought-after souvenirs!

With fascination, you inspect your opponent's equipment and find that they have some quite advanced material. Apparently, your foes put their trust in boots with metal cleats, and cozy calf warmers. Well, you certainly don't want to look second-rate, so you task your best men to produce some of these impressive boosts. Make sure that enough iron is available!

Your athletes are revered by your Settlers. They even demand to meet their idols in the flesh in order to express their adoration. Consequently, you decide to arrange a grand parade in honour of your heroes. No decent parade can do without horses though. Provide a few freshly-trained specimen for the event!

After the many privations and hard training, your men deserve a hearty meal every once in a while. To raise their spirits and strengthen their morale, you'd like to serve them some very decent fillets. Supply your men with fresh meat!

The support from your Settlers during this competition so far has been a pure delight, and leads to you expressing your gratitude by decreeing a new public holiday, the celebration of which demands a special holiday sausage! Provide some sausage to celebrate the championship!

You have been informed that other kingdoms are granting their athletes souvenir rings of this great tournament. As your men have rendered outstanding service, you find their demand for such rings only fair. Provide some gold ore to appropriately immortalize the efforts of this championship.

Some of your opponents have employed some really mean kicks, a technique that appears to you as unfittingly rude for such a fair competition. Consequently, you feel that this ploy needs to be faced with proper equipment. Shin protection made of steel seems like an appropriate response. Bring some steel to arm your men!

The many exotic nations of the tournament send a wave of inspiration through the kitchens of your empire. Suddenly, your people lust for foreign fruit and fancy spices! Meet the demands of your Settlers and trade using some of that brew that sparkles so nicely!

You can't help but notice a certain tension between your Settlers and those of the neighbouring islands. The ongoing competition appears to have fostered a competitive attitude that you feel should not be tolerated. Set a good example and spread the fraternal spirit: visit a friend's island and buff one of their workyards!

It is a contest of the strongest and fiercest, a challenge of will, the promise of eternal glory... and you have just received an invitation to this tournament of champions from afar! Awestruck, you marvel at the ornate document, the receipt of which alone is a privilege. Glory and riches await you. And there's talk of brew, too!
Your invitation lies ready in your mailbox, so quickly go and prepare for the oncoming challenges, then gather your men and face your contenders!

You have won your first spurs and are ready for the next challenge. The tournament is in full swing now and has taken hold of your island as well. Excitedly bustling everywhere, your settlers elatedly go about their preparations for the upcoming event. This way your men should be up and running in no time! And here comes your next invitation already! Don't make your opponents wait!

You have successfully moved on to the next round and quickly acquired a reputation that earns you numerous enthusiastic followers. Already bets are being placed on your upcoming victories, and your settlers are pleased with your efforts. Time to prepare your next match. Get a selection of your finest men to the venue!

The upcoming match promises a thrilling battle. Your opponents travel to the contest from faraway countries, often dressing up peculiarly and employing wondrous tactics. Look out, chose your troops with care, and maybe you'll even get to learn a few tricks from your adversaries. Travel to the next venue with your men!

You have done well to get this far. It took some grim battles and many a brew, but your settlers went through all the highs and lows together with you. Now the final stand-off lies ahead, and a palpable tension is in the air all across your island. In the past, you have proven to be a great contestant with remarkable endurance, but now you will have to show what you have learned in this tournament! Ready your men and prepare for the final match!
Select the tavern

The tavern owner wears a worried expression on his face: "My daughter should have been home a long time ago! The children like to play near the caves, although we explicitly forbid it. Can you help us search them? Inspect all the caves and mines and bring our children home!"

"So you have inspected all the caves but found no sign of the children? Surely they wouldn't be foolish enough to hang about near the ruins? Ghastly creatures loiter there! Hurry and search the old temples. I have a bad feeling about this…"

"No sign of them near the ruins either? That means they can only have gone to the old well in the woods. Those foolish kids! That's where the old witch dwells, lurking and waiting for unsuspecting victims! We have no more time to lose - find the old well!"
"Oh no, we were right - the old witch has our children! Free the children from her clutches!"

This economy overview is the newest invention of the king's treasurer. I took the liberty of integrating it here as well. With it, you can check whether there are any problems in your production chains and whether you can do something more effectively. For example, it seems your tree deposits are decreasing. You should check them.
The economy overview shows that you do not have enough foresters to provide a constant wood supply. Build another forester to provide more wood.
Anyway... The economy overview can show you more detailed information about what exactly improved in your wood production. Take a look.
Hmm… Take a look at your economy overview. Your stone production is quite low. You should think about building another mason. We will need a lot of stone for upcoming buildings.

Looks like the letter is from your brother Theodor, and there's a package of resources accompanying it. I took the liberty of adding the resources to your star menu, and you can read the letter in your mailbox. I am curious to know what your brother wants to tell you.

I have a little suggestion. It is possible to make settling more comfortable using different options. In the top left, below your avatar, you can find certain options, including some to tweak the camera or the sound. You should take a look.
Since we have produced enough buffs, it's time to reproduce the fish, because when the basic resource of the buffs is exhausted, no more buffs can be produced.
Did you see already? The king sent a merchant some time ago, offering a large variety of different items. If you find something to your fancy, do not hesitate to buy it.
I have some more information for you, so please listen. A master builder has settled on your island. He has the ability to reposition your buildings. Fantastic, isn't it?

You are learning very fast. I know, I expect a lot from you. Settling isn’t easy. In case you need any further help, or are unsure of how to handle certain things, there are buttons just below your avatar that will take you to the forum, support, or the tutorial.

Oh, it looks like your tool stock is decreasing rapidly. For constructing buildings you need a lot of tools. Since we are not yet able to produce them on our own, we should buy some from the merchant.
If you buy something from the merchant, he transfers it to your star menu free of charge. As soon as you have transferred it to your stock we can begin to build.
