Your explorer reports a friend has told him about a treasure. He would be glad to retrieve it for you, but needs the time to do it. Once you agree, simply check your star menu and send him on short treasure search.
I see that a lot of other settlers have settled very close to you. Maybe you should become friends with some of them? Having allies is never a bad thing…
Now that you have built another building that requires pinewood, the balance of your economy has changed. It would be best to check exactly how it's been affected.
Because you have already made great progress, I will not tell you exactly what to do. I am sure you will make work it out. However, I would advise optimizing your pinewood production.
Hmm… I have heard some troubling rumours. The settlers tell of bandits making trouble. I cannot confirm this yet, but we should be cautious. It might be best to process the copper into bars.

I offer you my compliments. My name is Henry. I am one of your craftsmen. My colleague the fisherman told me that the fish stocks are decreasing. You should know that you can refill these kinds of deposits. Would you be so kind as to produce some refillers?
Excuse me… It's me again. You most likely know already, but I just wanted to make sure: you have multiple fish deposits and can refill them, even beyond their original maximum.

So, do you get on with Sardin? He might seem a bit rude but he is a brilliant tactician. But let's get back on topic; the king attaches great importance to neighbourly help at the moment. I think it would be good to join forces with one of your neighbours and help them.

Hello and greetings. Some days ago we made some tests on the earth on the island, and found that it is perfect for growing wheat. We could use that to bake bread. What do you think about building some farms for cultivating wheat?

Ah, I see you've already built a wheat field. Every farm harvests only from the nearest wheat field. However, it's wise to have multiple wheat fields, as they deplete after a while. If there's no other wheat field left, the farm will stop production.

The farmer has already got busy and started harvesting wheat. But to produce bread, we still need water. It can be gathered from wells, but there's no need to build them near the farms, as we can get the water from the storehouse.

Bread? Don't make me laugh. Bread can wait. What we really need is brew! After all, we want to create an army. Luckily, wheat and water are also the two ingredients needed to produce brew, so it wasn't all in vain. All that is left to do is to build a brewery.
My scouts have discovered the first bandit camp. Now is the time to start weapon production! Build a weaponsmith for bronze swords as soon as possible!

So, how is your military establishment going? I have been following your economic growth with much interest. Since you produce swords, did you check your tool production in your economy overview? Maybe some changes are necessary?
Oh, something comes to my mind. Have you already looked into upgrading a building? In the detail tab you can see how many resources will be produced and how many are needed.
My scouts report there are more bandits than expected. Send your explorer out to explore more sectors so that we can be completely sure.

Lady Amidale from the neighbouring Kingdom wishes to hire your guild in order to build her a replica of the world famous Mirror Ponds. This work definitely requires a lot of preparation, but your guild can be sure that she will be most grateful when admiring her face in the ponds.
To see exactly what went well (or not so well), you can check the battle report to be found in your message inbox.

Have you already taken a look at your recruits? They are quite robust when attacked, but not quite so good at fighting back. We need a unit that's able to deal out more damage. Bowmen would be the best. Build a bowmaker so we can train bowmen.
Greetings. I hear that your wheat production is working well. With your permission, I would like to get your bread production organized, starting with the construction of a mill.
The time has come. I can build the bakery. Ever since I've lived on this island, I've dreamed of being able to eat fresh bread. I am so excited!

You really should concentrate more on your soldiers and not waste your time with bagatelles. Wait a minute... I think the bread may actually be of use here. Maybe we can improve our military capabilities with it somehow?
Ah, I think I know what you're up to. You plan to buff all relevant production facilities to get more military resources out of them at the same time. Very clever, I have to admit.
So, boy, things are getting serious now! My scouts have located a bandit leader. If we defeat him, it will disperse the enemy's units and free the sector.

The fat man… What is he called? Holger? Whatever, you know who I mean. Anyway, he really wanted me to tell you that the way to obtain building licences is by freeing sectors. You can find them in your star menu, and have to use them on your Mayor's house.
Don't you think that it is becoming rather cramped here? I think it is time to expand your holdings. I know Lord Sardin is not here at the moment, but I am sure you will make it on your own.
Have you taken a look at your trades already? You'll find them by clicking the scales in the menu list. There, you can offer items or accept offers from other traders. Knock yourself out.

You won't believe the news I've got! The king is trying to establish a trading network. As soon as you build a trade office, you'll be able to trade with anyone else who has a similar office. We shouldn't let this chance pass!

Hmm… I can see a lot happened while I was away… Fancy-schmancy trade office. However, reports have reached me that this island holds iron deposits. If true, that would be splendid, because we could use them to produce better weapons.
But first we have to smelt the iron. Basically, you should proceed in the same way as with copper ore, so build an iron smelter and smelt away.
Correct! We still need an iron weaponsmith. Just remember that the production of iron weapons uses more resources than for bronze ones.
In order to prepare for digging, you must first produce the required amount of tools. You can't expect your settlers to use their hands, can you now?

Those ponds will need water to become actual ponds, and water does not travel by itself. You'll need to produce enough wood to make buckets to transport the water. We need to make sure you can produce the wood!

Well, we're going to need a lot of manpower if we want to provide all those resources for lady Amidale's ponds. I've heard your settlement has some really strong men in it, but they're kind of picky when it comes to carrying goods around. Maybe if we give them some planks so they can make their own carts to carry the goods around, hmm?

There are a lot of settlers working on this operation, and even though they are devoted, they are also hungry. We would like to ask you to be the one to provide the rations. We've heard your bakers make the best bread around these parts, and we'll be needing a lot.
Training finished. Now things can begin. Let your militia fight for you and see for yourself what they are capable of. You can also mix up different unit types in one army.

Water may give a perfect reflection if still, but we've just found out that the bottom of the ponds need to be covered with polished marble. As your island has many marble deposits, we would like you to provide the amount of marble needed.

Apparently you can't use any old kind of water to fill the ponds. We know that the underground rivers that run through your lands are the clearest around, so we require you to provide us with the water. These ponds need to be crystal clear, you know, like a mirror.

King Damien had just returned from a foreign country he was visiting, and was astonished by the hospitality he received there. He wants your guild to prepare resources for the new royal shipyard which will build new tourist ships.

Our guild has received the strangest request. We are to build a mountain. Yes, you heard me correctly - Lord Edword, the king's nephew from the Sunset islands, is prepared to pay a fortune to have his own artificial mountain. I trust we can do it. I mean, nobody has tried such a thing yet. Who knows, it might even work.

The miner's union on your island has decided that in order for them to operate at full potential, they will need a system of tunnels connecting all the mines around the island. We don't want to upset them, so let's start working on it. He he, if we try hard enough we might even be able to build a city down there!... I'm sorry, that's nonsense.

Listen to this! King Damien has visited the western islands once again, where he encountered a nation that lives in the trees! Yes! They've actually built their homes at the top of the trees! The King is really exited to have his own little sky town, and we're going to help him get one!

The ruler of a neighbouring island, Milady Verena, has heard about our guild and wants to hire us to organize transport of the famous Dragon Rose Seeds. What is a Dragon Rose? Well apparently, when the seed is ready, it blossoms, then burns. Don't ask me why, but I find this rather disturbing, although I suppose others might find it rather beautiful. In any case, we are going to help her and the escort!

The year of the Fat Pork is upon us, and as you know, a huge feast is being held in his honour! We call it: The Feast of the Century! We have to do our part in preparing the feast, so let's get to work. We don’t want to disappoint King Damien!

We've just received a letter from the King! He is worried! Somebody has told him that our kingdom is not being friendly enough with the travellers who cross our realms, and now he wants to make sure we are! So let's make sure we show those travellers how welcoming we are! Let's give them a taste of our hospitality, right?

This is an awfully awkward request, but the King's spoiled nephew will be having his birthday soon and as a gift he has requested... golden rain. We are to supply all the gold and resources to make it happen. I can't find the words to describe this nonsense. What... they will shoot the gold into the air?
The leaders of the guild of hunters have made a bet about whose island will be the most populated with animals! We mustn't lose this bet - make sure we have the most animals in our forests!

The King has a new friend, a man from Tagalia, a mysterious island to the south. Apparently, the man, who also walks around with a cat on his shoulder, will be moving to Capital Island to build a genuine Tagalian repository. The building will be able to hold a lot of goods. They will call it The Eternal Repository. We are to help them with our share of supplies.

I'm sorry to bother you but it seems there is a matter to which we must attend quickly. Lord Sardin has somehow managed to persuade the King to sign a law that requires every guild to have its own army. So now we must make sure we have the required forces. Better inform the barracks!

The king wants to honour those who have fallen in the kingdom's battles over the ages by building a wall of swords, to be called (hold your breath)... The Wall of Swords. So now we must deliver a huge number of swords to the royal repository, and to top it all we haven't been given much time to do it.

A very rich and famous cook wants to surprise the King for his birthday by baking the world's biggest pretzel. We all know that King Damien loves pretzels, don't we? The cook has asked our guild to help him, and we're most eager to do so.

The nobles of Capital Island have managed to convince King Damien that they need better and cleaner roads for their travels. Logically, the King has assigned us the great task of supplying the construction materials for the new road.

One of my scouts has brought me a strange report. Apparently, an abandoned ship has been found, and some of the farmers have reported a group of people passing through the land. Finally, it was discovered that the queen of the Summer Island has come to visit us. Why we were not aware of this visit, I do not know. We should find her at once!

I swear this world is going crazy! We have just received a letter from the King! A famous musician is about to visit Capital Island and hold a special event in the royal gardens! Apparently, he has one hundred singing chickens! Yes, you heard me correctly. Chickens. That sing. The musician requires an oversized chicken coop to be built for his precious singers... and guess who has been given the honour of providing the resources. Yes... we have.

Our seafarers returned last night! And with good news! They have found the island that the bandits are coming from! It's called Dagger Island and is not far from here! I say we ready our men and storm the island! Let's teach them a lesson!

A group of people arrived on a magnificent ship today. They claim to be ore collectors from a land far away. They are fascinated with the ore we have here and would love to buy some. What a good opportunity to make a little profit! Let's get to work, shall we?

Every now and then our geologists organize this race where they compete with each other. Now the time has come for another race! Each guild must send out their geologists to find certain deposits! In the time it takes them to get back, we must prepare a feast! Get to it! We must duly honour our geologists for their hard work!

A legend exists telling of an old pirate who lost his ship and crew. He used to be spotted regularly, dragging his treasure with him, and was known for being extremely rude. However, no-one has seen him lately, and it is thought that he has passed away. Nevertheless, his treasure is out there somewhere… waiting for somebody to claim it! Let's have our guild work together to find it!

Yet again our most beloved King Damien has requested our aid! Queen Anita believes that Capital Island should have all its bridges made of pure marble, so the King wants to surprise her when she get back from visiting another Kingdom. Let's prepare our best settlers for this task!

The Merchants' Guild needs our urgent help. Their island is filled with repositories, but there was a huge hurricane some weeks ago and it destroyed most of the buildings. They want to rebuild them using a special blueprint obtained through a merchant from a far away land. Let us help them as much as we can. They are usually really grateful!

Our lords and ladies have yet again had a stupid argument and yes, we're going to have to clean up the mess. The latest issue is about the land they own, and the problem is that many of our buildings might be on their lands. Unfortunately, nobody knows for sure. I guess the deeds were burned in that nasty fire some years ago. Let's try to calm the lords down... nobody likes an angry lord.

We have received news that the King is to be visited by one of his friends, some prince. The prince wants to know which of the King's followers has the safest island. Sound like a challenge! Let us prove that we have the safest island in the Kingdom!

Captain Ironplank, the marshal of the King's navy has arrived this morning at our island. He wants our guild to help him with an important matter. Some months ago he sent out some of his men to scout the border islands, and all his ships returned except one. We are to prepare a search expedition with Captain Ironplank and find his crew! What a honourable task!
Good news! The famous mapmaker, Coron Franz is visiting us in order to map our island and the surroundings! Great! Let's do all we can to help him, shall we?

King Damien wants to hold a ceremony in honour of the generals of his armies. As you might imagine, this means our generals must be present too! Let us prepare the generals and their troops for the ceremony!

One of the neighbouring islands has a serious problem with a group of bandits who are hiding in their forest. These bandits have even gone so far as to burn down all bridges that could provide safe passage over the large river dividing the island, and are thus occupying one half of the island. The lord of the island wants to get rid of the bandits, and is ready to use his most talented archers to counter them with a rain of arrows! Let us be sure we provide the necessary resources.

The King has a special group of young apprentices who would one day like to become part of the royal army. The higher section, that is. Each year the King sends these young apprentices out to live real adventures. This year our guild has been given the honour of taking take care of them, so it would be best if we brought them along to observe how we complete our adventures!
The King knows that your settlement makes the best tools in the Kingdom. He has sent a special letter with his request. Better make sure those tools live up to their reputation!
Over time, the new royal shipyard will need a lot of wood to build ships. The guild just requires you to provide a certain amount of pinewood!

One of the foreign shipbuilders has told the King's men that a good ship must be reinforced with a lot of steel. Given this information, the royal shipyard has requested a shipment of steel to be delivered as soon as possible.

The ships soon to be built at the royal shipyard will require proper decoration. We must think about first class travellers, the noble kind, if you know what I mean. What else would satisfy their needs if not iron cutlery? Be sure to prepare the iron so we can make the cutlery!

The cook that will serve on the main ship is a specialist and has a world famous recipe that requires quite a large quantity of sausages. We know that your settlement has some really talented butchers, so it falls to you to provide the best sausages you have!
All the ships should have lookout nests, right? We need to make sure we build those small nests using our strongest hardwood planks!
In order to build an actual mountain we will need a lot of stone. And when I say "a lot", I mean it. We would like to ask for your master masons to work double shifts.

While we do need a lot more stone, we must not forget that we also need something to transport the blocks with. For this reason, I would advise you to provide carriages. Using carriages for transportation is the safest way.

Though we have already sent out some stone shipments, we still need a lot of stone to build the mountain, and there's no time to waste. Let's send out our workers; those masons won't get the stone by themselves.
We will eventually get the carriages, but we also need horses to pull them. I would advise you to visit your stables and have them prepare their best steeds. There's a lot of stone to be pulled.

Granite is stronger than stone because its mineral composition has bound together tightly during the very slow cooling period. And the quartz and feldspar of which it is composed it are harder than steel! Than steel! So in order to build a strong mountain we're going to use granite. And here's where you come in. We need you to provide it. We're sure you know where to find the best! The best!

We have received word that those who are to work on the mountain are on a very strict diet of fish. I guess they live healthily, right? Anyway, they just can't get enough fish, so we will provide them with our finest. Alert your fishermen; they have work to do!

Though our miners could simply use their own tools to start work on the tunnels, I believe we should provide them with new ones. It would be a good idea to start production of some brand new tools. Once they are ready, we can send them down the tunnels.

So, I hear that they will be needing a loot of wood and wood planks too. The tunnels need a structure, like… a supportive frame? I don't know how that works, but alert your settlers at the sawmill; we need pinewood planks.

The main shafts require stronger wood to hold fast, so we need to ask you to provide the miners with some of your famous planks made of hardwood. Please have your settlers at the sawmill prepare some good quality hardwood planks.

Apparently there are not enough mine entrances to fill the new tunnels with sufficient air, so the union would like to be sure the tunnel system has enough air holes. However, the holes need to be clad with iron, so we'll need some iron ore from the union. They're kind of working for themselves on this one. Air is important, right?
We have a problem. The union workers are refusing to eat just any kind of vegetable; they want meat, and they want a lot of it! Let's give them them meat and keep them quiet.

You won't believe this. The miner's union wants to build a walkway inside the tunnels! Well we need to satisfy their needs, so let's provide them with some marble they can use. Bah… next they will ask for an underground lake or something.

We weren't able to find a dense forest on Capital Island, so we've decided to grow one. We'll be needing a lot of saplings form the foresters! I've spoken to them and all they ask in return is water. I guess they're too lazy to just walk over to the river.

I still don't understand how anyone can live so high up from the ground! Madness! Well if there have to be houses up there, there will also have to be roads. Plank roads, that is. You are required to provide the shipment of hardwood planks, as they are the strongest... well, almost the strongest.

Though I'm not sure how many citizens are to move up there of their own will, I'm sure they're going to be hungry. Until they can actually cook their own meals, we should provide them with bread. After all, not everything grows on trees...

If the workers want to do a good job building that sky town, they will need a lot of quality tools. No problem there - we have a lot of those, right? Please make sure that we have a sufficient quantity of tools for them, will you?

Living in the sky town doesn't mean that you can feel safe all the time. You won't encounter a bear, that's for sure, but let's not forget about winged menaces. The King has asked me to make sure that the town gets some troops to act as guards, and who better to defend a city so high up if not a group of dedicated archers? Alert the bow makers to make us some bows!

The first storehouse will be inside a small group of clouds, and we need to make sure we add some basic resources to it. They will eventually fill it, I'm sure. What we need to bring is some meat, right?
Did you know that an architect is currently in your town? He has brought the latest plans from the kingdom for new residences. Not only do they look better, but they also have room for more settlers.

It will do us a lot of good to help milady! First we must provide the necessary number of horses so all her guards and servants have a comfortable trip. Be sure to prepare the best horses your stable master can provide!

Do you see how the settlers are already floating into your country? Feel free to take some time to enjoy it. By the way, I have heard about a mysterious potion that has the power to speed the growth up.
The road will be long and we can't have milady starve! She would love some sandwiches. We need to use our best sausages! Make some!
We know that even guards need to have a good time when they're off duty. To help milady's guards relax, we should provide them with some of our finest brew, right? I'm sure they would love it!

It is well knows that milady Verena owns the Steel Guards. They are called this because they use steel swords! I'm sure they would love some brand new steel swords for the trip, so let us talk with our weaponsmiths!

The servants mending the supply wagons have requested we aid them with some spare wheels. You can never be too careful on a long trip like this, can you now? I was thinking it would be a nice deed to gift the escort some good quality wheels.

Though I am sure the Steel Guard can protect milady, if there is an ambush, their armour might get broken. The Guard's blacksmith has asked for some steel so he can fix the armour if necessary. Let's give the man some steel.

One of the dishes will be fish. They plan to bring in a cook from the east whose specialty is a meal of raw fish. Who would eat raw fish? He calls it "sushi". Sounds like something you would call your cat! Anyway, what we need to do now is provide the feast with fish.

The feast organizer has told me that they're going to bake a lot of food, and he would be most grateful if he could have some of our fine flour. Let's hope the wind continues to blow so our millers can do their best!

Some of our settlers have decided to take part in the feast, and told one of the cooks our grain is 'gold'. I guess they mean it's really good. We've received a request to provide the feast with our golden grain, so let's do it.

This food artist who will be part of the feast is famous for his boiled eggs, but apparently he is very picky when it comes to water. He has heard that we can provide crystal clear water from our wells, and now he wants some. Let's send them some water, then. Weird people...

We have just received news that a storm has destroyed one of the ships that was delivering the meat for the feast! They have asked if we can help them. Our hunters have reported a lot of game in the surrounding woods, so it shouldn't be a problem to provide the required meat, right?

The feast is going be so big, they'll need to close down the Capital's harbors. They've started crafting these really long tables for the people and are using some kind of new technique where they piece together the tables, resulting in a lot of space for the food. However, they need our hardwood planks, so let's send them some!

Most of our travellers are hunters, so let's prepare some good quality bows for them. They might even use them to take care of our critter problem! How perfect would that be! Have your bow makers prove their worth!
Travellers often arrive on horseback, but some arrive by sea! Let's make sure we have some horses ready for when they arrive, shall we?
Every traveller enjoys a good cup of fresh water, especially if it comes from our underground crystal lakes! Let's make sure we have fresh water ready for them!

Travellers do tend to make campfires and spend a lot of time around them. There are many things one can do near a campfire, but eating is one of the most delicious! Let's make sure we have some bread in our storehouses!

We do know that travellers are not usually rich. I mean why would you travel by yourself if you were rich, right? Let's prepare a game of bones for them, with gold as a reward! I'm sure we can spare some gold ore pieces to make them happy!
We have heard that travellers are often looking for trouble, and we want to avoid that. I'd like you to make new iron swords for your troops! We need to keep those troublemakers at bay!
The rain of gold will require gold. A lot of gold. We should provide the King's men with the necessary amount of gold ore.

Listen to this! The rain of gold must contain coins! The King's nephew wants the coins to roll away after they land! As if the whole thing wasn't sufficient already! We can provide them with the gold coins they need, but we need to work fast as the coins have to fall first!

They want to shoot the gold and coins from cannons, and they're afraid the cannons might get damaged. If that happens, the King would like to borrow some cannons from our stocks. Let us talk with the cannonmaster; we need to ready some strong cannons!

I want to make sure that if the King needs more gold ore, we can provide him the best we have! For that, we not only need to work faster - we also need to ensure the right work conditions for our miners! And by right conditions, I mean food. Some freshly baked bread will do the trick!

That "little" request from the King really emptied our gold resources. Some of the lords on our island have started to question our decisions, and we don't like that, do we? I want to throw a fancy dinner to calm them down! Our chefs should make their famous fish soup, the Golden Fin Bowl! Yes! Get some fresh fish ready!

It's likely this event will provoke some rowdy behavior from the settlers, but even they know it's not a good idea to steal from the King. After the ceremony, we will need to clear the ground. Imagine all that gold… Well, to clean we'll need carriages to transport the gold back to the royal treasury, and for the carriages we need horses. We should visit the stables, then.

In order to increase the island's wildlife, we need to have more trees so the animals can hide and feel safe. We need our foresters to come up with their best seeds! Let's send them some sausages as a thank you gift!

I am not convinced the new animals will move into our forests fast enough, so how about we help them make a quick decision? Let's place stashes of wheat in random places. I'm sure that will get their attention. Have your farms provide wheat!
We'll be needing more wheat than we thought to lure the first animals, so we have to make sure we can provide the required amount. The best wheat comes from the best farms!
Sadly, we don't have very many lakes in the new forest, so we need to create some watering pools. And for that we need water. Fast.

We need to be sure that our animals have a good time and feel peaceful. It would be best to know exactly where the animals are going to dwell. We need to build some wooden lookouts in the woods, and for that we'll need planks!

We need to feed the animals for the first weeks, so we've decided to build a feeding garden. It's like a normal garden but for animals, you see? We have to keep it natural though, so we're going to use mostly hardwood.
We need to provide the brew for the repository. They've heard our brew is really good, which is good news! Let's send them some!
The repository has an area that will be filled with food. We have been given the task of delivering the fish. I would alert the fishermen if I were you; we need to deliver the fish quickly!
The repository has a special area where all kinds of ore will be stored. We have been asked to provide the iron ore, so we should tell the miner's union to get to work.
I thought that maybe we would have to deliver the bread too, but they only need our flour. We have to provide them with several sacks. Our millers will be happy to hear about this!

I've heard that there will be a lot of shelves inside the repository and they need the strongest wood available to construct them. We have the "honour" of delivering the shipment of hardwood planks. To the sawmills!

We are not yet sure whether the repository will hold weapons, but I've heard a rumour they might want us to make some steel swords. It would be a good idea to be prepared. Let's make some steel swords!

Lord Sardin wants us to prove to him that we have the kind of men ready to go into battle. He didn't specify what kind of military he wanted to see, but he insisted the swords be made of steel. Let's get to work; I don't want him on our back. Prepare the steel swords he needs.

I always thought the militia was made up of a bunch of grumpy old men, but in fact they're really devoted and we need them! Keeping them happy is our first priority, and what else would make them happy if not a good load of quality brew?
Every army needs cavalry, right? So, if our troops are to become an army, we better prepare those horses! Send word to the stables; we need horses!

The front lines are often made up of well trained soldiers, and we need some! Lord Sardin does not allow undisciplined soldiers in the military, so we need to make sure we train them well! However, training must be done using copper swords. I hope you have some ready!

Lord Sardin believes that "every battle is fought with every weapon". I wasn't sure what he meant, to be honest. Eventually, I found out that he wants you to train some longbowmen at your barracks. We need new logbows!
Well, we might have an army soon, but we need to make sure we have the equipment too. We need to send some steel to the blacksmith!

The miners union believes that they're protected by the Maiden, some woman that took care of them after an unfortunate accident. I hope the Maiden really is with them, because we need a lot of iron in order to start production of our share of the swords. Have your miners provide the iron ore.
Your military has grown really fast, and I've just checked out your new militia. Tough men. They need iron swords, am I right? Have you optimized your iron production already?

There was a time when there was so much steel ore that we allowed the smelters to have these steel panther statues made. Apparently, they're still around somewhere, but I've never seen them. Anyway, we need to call upon the smelters; we need steel!
We're about to produce a huge amount of swords, so we need to make sure our blacksmiths are ready for the task! I've heard that some freshly baked bread might well motivate them!

So the Wall of Swords will contain a lot of swords. Its rim will be made from steel swords, and our guild is to provide a certain amount of them, so you better have your weaponsmith ready; he will need to work day and night I'm afraid.

Oh dear. The King wants the top of the wall to be decorated with genuine Damascene swords. Does he realise how hard it is to obtain such swords? I know a man who sells them; maybe we can pay him to take some of his finest to Capital Island? Just make sure we can pay the man with our coins!

So, the base of the wall will be made entirely of stone. I guess that's the part that gets dirtiest after the rains. Stone is not so easy to polish, I reckon. We've received an order to provide a shipments of stone.
The cook has requested we provide him with our clearest water. I guess we're going to be lowering a lot of buckets into those crystal clear wells of ours, right?

We all know that you can't make a good pretzel without the right flour. We promised the cook that we were going to provide the best flour our mills can yield, but we need to do it fast; baking has to start soon, so let's get to it!
Demand for flour is high right now, thanks to the cook and his idea, so we better make sure we have our mills running. Build at least two mills so we'll be prepared if the demand for flour increases.

Although we have a lot of good quality wheat, the cook wants to use *new* wheat. I wasn't sure what he meant by that, but he was kind enough to explain. So, we need to get him the best wheat we have. I told him that all of our wheat is good quality, but who am I to argue with the master cook?

The cook wants to apply a new kind of salted glaze to the pretzel, so he'll be needing a lot of salt. One of our neighbours has a salt mine and is willing provide the salt, but it needs to be mined. We can send our man, but he'll need the necessary tools. Let's make some good quality tools, shall we?

We've received a report that demand for water is very high at the moment. It must be because we've allocated most of the water to the cook. The best move now would be to build some more wells, but we'll need stone for that.
The noble road, as it is apparently called, will be made using stone and then coated, or covered, with marble. You are to provide the stone from your rich stone deposits.
The workers who are to build the road will almost certainly get very hungry. We are to provide our best bread and meat! Let them know that this guild makes the best food out there!

A marble paved road requires marble. The King was very specific that the marble should come from us. I guess he knows that we can provide the best! And we should be proud! They need our marble? We'll send them our marble!
The group of riders arrived a short while ago. They would like to rest but we have no place for their horses. Maybe we can build them a little stable?
Demand for marble might be higher that we expected! We need to make sure that we won't run out! Let us motivate our workers with some fine brew!
We need to make sure all our workers at the marble deposits are working as fast as they can! It might help motivate them if we sent some sausages. Everybody loves sausages!

Apparently Capital Island does not have enough workers, so they need us to send some over. It wouldn't be a bad thing for our workers; Capital Island has a lot to offer them. Prepare your men for the long voyage by ensuring there are enough horses to transport them all!

We're not sure where the queen and her escort might be heading, so next time we send a scout out to look for treasure, let's ask him to keep his eyes open for clues… I want you to send out some scouts, but we need to give them horses first!

The queen sure knows how to hide her tracks. Lord Saradin thinks they may be spies… but I don't think so. She can't just have become invisible… or can she? We need to send some scouts! They have requested some bread for the mission, let's make them some.

We could track down the queen by sending out some of our scouts, but they'll need lookout towers. The leader of the scouts has asked me to tell you that he can set the towers up, but they need hardwood planks for that.

Even if we don't know where the queen is right now, we better make sure she is safe. I have organized a group of guards to patrol the island. They lack quality weapons, so I want to ask you to give them some of our finest steel swords.

I think it would be a good idea to organize a search party to look for the lost queen. We'll need some cavalry, as they travel fast on horseback. I've already talked with the stablemaster - he needs copper ore to coat the horseshoes. Send the man some copper ore, will you?

We need all the eyes we can get to look for the queen. I've already convinced our hunters to help out! However, they've said they'll be needing longbows. Fair enough, I mean weapons are kind of important out there, in the wilderness.
The king wants to be sure we're up for the task, and needs to know how efficient we are. I think the best idea would be to get some wood! Wood stacks are always a symbol picture of hard work.
To build a chicken coop big enough to hold that many chickens we'll need hardwood planks. Let's have our hardwood sawmills do their best! Maybe we could even go help them?
Building the coop requires not only wood but also steel to reinforce the structure. Imagine what would happen if a coop so big suddenly collapsed. Anyway, let's supply Capital Island with steel!

You can't expect a chicken to sing if it's hungry, can you now? The musician has told us his chicken won't eat anything we have to offer, but I reckon they won't be able to resist our best quality wheat! Let’s show the musician that we can feed his chickens! Anyway, be quick about it!
Do chickens get thirsty when they sing? I don't know. Just in case, we should prepare some kegs of our finest water to quench their thirst. Best be quick about it!

Er, the musician has just requested we send over some of our settlers to take care of the… primadonnas? Do we even have any people who can attend to chickens? I sure hope we do; we don’t want to anger the king. My cousin told me he would do it for some coins. I trust my cousin.
We don't know if the pirates are aware we've found them, but before we can assemble an army it would be wise to ready some troops in case they surprise us! Ready the iron swords!

If we are to organize an assault we'll need to organize our army. The front line will be held by the militia, so you'll have to train them! I hope you'll use your famous trainer to look after it! We all know he tends to get hungry. Ready some fish for him!
We have stables and nobody tells me? That is splendid! Now, we can begin to train the cavalry. There are a lot of qualified settlers we can train as cavalrymen. The more the better.
The militia will hold the front line! Behind them, we need our bowmen! You are to provide the bows as fast as you can! Have them use the best weapons, and help them win the battle!
After our militia and bowmen are engaged in battle, we will have our cavalry flank our enemy! I need you to get your best horses for our cavalry! We better make haste!

We are not sure how hard the bandits will fight back, so we had better be prepared! We need some cannons on our ships in case things get ugly. That way, we can help things to get even uglier, if you know what I mean. Deliver the cannons and mount them on the support ships, would you please?

I can't believe it! You know that captain who was supposed to transport our units to Dagger Island? Well, he wants to be paid! The nerve! Oh well, I guess a small bag of gold ore will do the trick. Do we have any to spare?

We want to make sure the newcomers feel comfortable while we fill their ships with our ore, so I've invited them to a feast! We have everything we need except sausages. We'll be needing more of those, I'm afraid.
They seem to love the copper ore more than any of the other types we have, so make sure you can supply the quantity they require!

One of the men took a look at one of the iron bars, licked it, and smiled. I have no idea what to think of that. I guess he likes the… taste of iron? Anyway, you need to provide them with iron ore, and make sure it's tasty. Ha ha!

Listen to this! Gold ore is practically the most precious type we have, and you know what they said when we gave them some? "We don't like it!" They don't like gold! Hah! They're going to take some of it regardless, so best make sure we have enough.

We showed them a titanium ore sample, and some of them got sick! Can you imagine that? What's wrong with them? Anyway, their supposed leader said he would take only a small load of titanium ore, so let's do this.
We asked them if they're hungry, but they kept looking at the ore. I swear one of them started to chew on a piece of copper. We have to feed them! Be sure to bring some bread as soon as possible!
Our guild's geologist has been tasked to find a marble deposit! In order to do that, he's going to need some tools! This is so much fun!
Our geologist has been tasked to find an iron deposit! We've already prepared an escort but they will need some food too! When asked what he wants he said : Sausages!

Our geologist is to find a gold deposit! It's not the easiest of tasks, but I'm sure he can do it! I don't want to worry you too much, but looking for gold is dangerous! You know, bandits, and all that. I want to send some guards to escort him. Get some horses ready!

The settler in charge of the stables came to see me a while ago and told me the farmers refuse to give him wheat unless they have official confirmation that enough wheat is being produced. Could you please check if there is any way to improve wheat production, and inform the farmers?

Our geologist needs to find a coal mine. I hope he knows what he's doing; a deposit like that could be tricky to find! He also asked us to get him some water he can take along. Looking for coal can get you dirty.

Our geologists are about to return from the race and we want to have the feasts ready by then! Our cooks are ready to do their magic and you are the one who can provide them with the necessary ingredients! They want to make a special fish meal! So… let's bring them fish!
We don’t usually do this, but we would like to give a prize of coins to the best geologist! You are to provide the coins! I hope you realise this is a great honour?

In order to find the treasure we'll need to use our explorers! We can't ask them to become treasure hunters, but they've promised to keep their eyes open. Send out your explorer, and let's see if he finds something! I presume he will get hungry, so some meat will help him! Prepare the meat!

Our explorer has promised that next time he is out looking for whatever you send him to look for, he will also keep an eye out for the treasure. How nice. Be sure to send him out as soon as possible! He's taking along his family and he asked for some bread. We should make some bread for him, I guess.

I've talked with our explorer, and he said that next time he is out he will keep his eyes peeled for the treasure. Good man! Hope you require his services soon! While he's gone, we're going to fix his wooden hut. It's a way to say thank you! We'll need some pinewood planks for that!

Listen! Our explorer has told us that he will definitely look for the treasure next time you have a task for him! I say! What a lovely man! He also asked us to take care of his mother's farm while he's gone. We talked to her, and she needs water. Time to grab you bucket…

Our explorer came to me today and said he will look for any clues leading to the treasure while is he working on his task. He told us he needs to finish a statue for his brother, and I told him that we would be glad to handle it for him while he's looking for clues about the treasure! Anyway the statue is made of granite. You know what to do.

You know what our explorer told me? He said he's going to look for clues when he is out there doing his task! Great! Before he left, he asked us to tend to his dogs, and it turned out he has around one hundred of them. The dogs like fish, and feeding time is approaching fast.

Marble is not an easy material to chisel or even to cut. We will need new, strong tools! Given that your toolmakers are the best of the best, I would like to you to provide the workers with new, marble-shattering tools!
So… all the bridges on Capital Island will be made of pure marble eh? Well then… I guess they will need a lot of marble, won't they? I hope you have got your settlers ready! We need marble!

In order to provide the best marble, we need to ensure we have the best marble masons! We spoke with one of the masons, and he told us he wants to experiment with a new kind of wooden structure that would hasten the production of marble. He needs some pinewood planks for that!
The little… What? Oh, I just got a letter from the former comrade I was telling you about earlier. He says that I'm incapable of defeating a bandit camp using just 50 cavalry or more.

Given that this is a request from the King himself, we can't risk running out of marble. I mean, imagine the shame! No no, don't imagine it, it's terrible! But let's focus! I need you to make sure we send a stock of marble to Capital Island! Will you look after that please?

The King wants our very own settlers to work on the bridges, so let's send them to Capital Island! As far as I know, most of the settlers are really eager to work there! All we need is todo is ensure they have enough food for the voyage! They want sausages!

Our men will leave for Capital Island to help with the bridge building! We are all really excited, but what if they go hungry? Well, we'll just have to make sure they have enough food for the trip, right? Let's pack them some bread!
Before we start sending the traders our resources, it would be wise to make sure we have enough space to store them! We need new rooms! It would be a good idea prepare the stones!

Apparently, one of the traders knows a way of using flour to fortify the walls. I know it sounds absurd… but as long as they pay, I don't really care what they do with it. We have to provide them with the flour.
We could really do with some strong planks to reinforce the storm damaged buildings. I think we need some strong hardwood planks!

They have asked us if they can store their wares inside our storehouses until their storage buildings are repaired, and that's fine. The only problem is that the wares are really heavy, so we need to build some steel racks. And for those, we need steel.

The traders have told us the wood they used to build the old storehouses was of very poor quality. Thanks to our foresters, our trees are really strong. Let's send the traders some of our finest hardwood! I'm sure they'll be amazed!

The traders will receive a lot of resources that will help them reinforce or repair their repositories. They are missing just one resource - some hardwood planks. Given that your sawmills are in top shape, you are to provide the hardwood planks for the traders!

Yes, well our lords are so mad at each other that a few of them have requested you place some of the noble houses further away from each other. I don't think they really want that; maybe they're just mad. Anyway, maybe some good quality brew would calm down the spirits?

There is some debate about who owns how much land. The problem is that one of the lords claims our farms were built on land belonging to him. Sadly, he is somewhat right. We have decided to pay him off by offering him some gold. I mean who can say no to gold, right?
The lords claim their horses are old and dirty, so to calm them down we should give them some new ones as a gift! Ask your stable masters to provide us with the best horses they have!

The lords have had a fight about the quality of food on the islands, and I fear things may start to get ugly. Luckily, I have a solution! We need to make sure we have a satisfying supply of sausages in our storehouses! And then we're going to need to gift the sausages... to show how much we appreciate our noblemen!
The lords have had a debate about the safety of the island. Basically, they don't feel safe, and it's in our interest to make sure they do. A new stock of iron swords would do the trick!
One of the lords is not sure of your trading abilities. How dare he? No... I must calm down. We must prove to him that we are outstanding traders! Prepare some fish! Fish is easy to trade!

To ensure our victory we must be sure our island is safe! Maybe have your scout commander can take care of the problem? Cleaning some land… is always a good idea, right? In any case, he has requested iron so he can equip his people with some nice armour.

We need to prove to the prince that we own the safest island, but I fear there may still be some bandits lurking around! We need to make sure there are no more bandits in the sector in question. I've assembled a group of soldiers to check ebery bush, look behind every tree. Ahh, and they will need some horses!
You know what makes a place look safe? Weapons. I think that if we install some cannons here and there, the place will feel safer already. Let's get some cannons!

The bandits from the forest know we won't be able to catch them, no matter what, so I've dediced to make a deal with them. We give them some bread and they will leave our settlers alone… for a while. It's the best way, trust me!

I fear we have detected some pirate ships near your island. To make sure we're not invaded by bandits, we should prepare ourselves! We don't want problems now, while the prince is watching! I think our coast patrol could use some new steel swords… just to scare away any pirates that might decide to land on our island.
Our scouts have informed us they have run out of the coal they use for campfires while patrolling the island. Let's get them some coal!

Though we're making sure they'll get our support for their food supply, the Captain has said that some of the men love their meat just as it is.... i.e. raw. They have some special kind of mixture of spices that they use to make their own meals. Let's make sure we give them some good meat.

Captain Ironplank tells me that he loves seagulls and that they bring luck. His ship is filled with seagulls actually, a fact I find most disturbing. Anyway, I'm telling you this because he has requested an unusual amount of bread, and I'm not really sure it's for his crew... but who am I to ask questions? Let's give the man his bread!

The Captain is renowned as fearless, but he also knows that going into combat without proper equipment is simply foolish. To avoid defeat, he has requested we provide him with some of our finest steel swords. I think we can manage that, don't you?

The Captain believes morale is more important than the sword, and can be lifted by giving a rousing speech, handing out rewards, etc. And then there's the question of brew. Not only does it raise morale, but it can also slake thirst! So, we are to provide some of our finest brew for the crew! Let's do it!

The Captain says that the sea is teeming with pirates and you never feel safe out there. He and his crew must be very brave men and women! He has asked us to provide some of the longbows we make on the island. I guess they might come in handy if they get into a skirmish at sea. Good thinking!
As it turns out, the Captain's favorite food is a good plate of fried fish with some squeezed lemon. Let's make sure we give the captain some fish from our stock!

We must make sure no harm is done to Coron as he travels across our island! Training some new military units would be a good idea! We need strong men with strong weapons, so what we must do now is make some shiny iron swords!

Though Coron was not very eager to ride a horse, we encouraged him to. It will make the mapping of the island go much faster, and you get a clearer view from horseback. Let's admit it, Coron is not a very tall man. Just don’t tell him I said that!
Coron will have a long journey, so we had better pack him some good food from our kitchens! We need some sausages! The best meal out there!

Coron will need to draw his maps and he can't just do it on the ground, can he now? He has told us he will need map tables. At every stop. Given that we won't be carrying a table from place to place each time, we had better assemble new ones at each stop. Make sure we have the necessary hardwood planks and tools!

Coron seems to be a clean man. And when I say that, I mean it. He actually washes his clothes every time he gets the chance, and has asked us to make sure we have enough clean water available. Prepare seom water for the trip!

Working with paper, there is always a chance the wind will become a cartographer's second worst enemy, fire being the first. Anyway, we're going to get some steel weights to hold down the maps while Coron works. Provide the necessary steel.
Your general will be represented by a group of selected bowmen! They will also need some new bows!

Your selected general will represent the proud and swift cavalry! Though usually horses are not allowed to enter the main square, King Damien will make an exception this time, to honour the celebration. Ready your best horses!

Recruits are an important part of an army, as is any other brave men or woman who fights for peace or justice. Your general is to be escorted by recruits, but we need to fix their swords. Provide a load of copper ore so we can fix their swords!

Your general has insisted on being represented by the cannonneers. We can't take too many cannons to the ship, so we need to limit his request a little. I hope he'll accept that. Bring out the cannons!

The crossbowmen are known to be a grumpy bunch of people, but they do know how to win a battle. This is why your general wanted them to represent him. We need new crossbows, though, so let's make some.

Your general wants to be represented by soldiers. We all know that soldiers require a lot of armour and weaponry, so it didn't surprise us when the blacksmith asked for more water, to finish all the requested equipment. We need to supply him with water!

It's obvious our friends will require a lot of bows to win that battle at the river. Though we've already ordered the arrows, we might need to make more. Our stock of bows might not be sufficient to satisfy demand! Make some bows for them!
As I said, to win such a combat, they will need to use the best longbows we can offer. Have your bowmakers produce the required amount of longbows!
Many of their archers are trained to use longbows, and yes their supplies are limited. No worries though - we're here to help! Provide our friends with longbows!
Our friends are about to be supplied with the weapons they need, but it seems we need more wood to make the bows. Make sure you have a decent supply of wood!

Our friends have told us that one of their squads intends to attack from the water! They're going to storm the front lines on the other side of the beach, and for that they'll need strong swords, so let's send them some of our iron swords!

One of the alchemists has told us about a small globe that can explode and do serious damage. They want to use it in battle, and the globes seem to be filled with gunpowder, so we've asked how we can help and they have told us they would welcome some gunpowder. Hard to find, for sure, but essential I guess.
Your young apprentice has arrived and is ready to join you in your adventure! We've heard he likes his food, so we'd better pack some extra fish for the road.

Your young apprentice has arrived and is ready to join you in your adventure! He did bring along a lot of luggage claiming he needs all of it. And he seems to be a little bit lazy, as he has requested that he and his belongings should be carried around in carriages. Sadly, we can't say no.

Your young apprentice has arrived and is ready to join you in your adventure! As it turns out, he adores drinking tea, and loves boiling loads of it. He even offered some tea to his escort, but our men looked scared and refused. The apprentice asked us to bring along a lot of water. We'll do as he wishes.

Your young apprentice has arrived and is ready to join you in your adventure! Sadly, the apprentice was attacked by some pirates on his way to our island, and this has made him act all weird and scared. He will only join our adventure if we send along some military to guard him. I think this calls for some new iron swords to place in the hands of the guards - that will calm him.

Your young apprentice has arrived and is ready to join you in your adventure! The apprentice seems to be extremely allergic to sunlight, so he must be protected at all times. We are to build him a huge umbrella, and we're going to need exotic planks to do so.

Your young apprentice has arrived and is ready to join you in your adventure! He seems to be a vegetarian, and refuses to eat anything but wheat seeds. We've been asked to provide him with a lot of wheat, alright?
A settler has come to me and said that during one of his journeys he found coins - quite a lot of them. Maybe your explorers will also find some when they go searching for treasures?

I've just received a message from the king. He has decided to assign you a task. He wants you to have the biggest storage capacity in all the land. Before that though, he'd like to test whether you are up to the task, so he'll start with a smaller goal.

Have you heard about the latest trend in the kingdom? Newly-built residences built in a kind of residential community. We should think about taking the idea onboard. The king likes his ideas to be adopted.
It is widely known that with a contribution at the royal council, the guilds can gain certain advantages. Place some capital at your guild's disposal.
For a long time the forests had been exploited carelessly, and now whole patches are completely bare. The king likes guilds to take care of the woods. Do something to help the ecological problem.
Stone is not only a basic product for building but also an effective good for trading. To be of help to your guild, you should always produce sufficient stone.
Because you are quite new to the guild, you need to expand your economy quickly. When the king has a new request, the person to react the quickest often gets the king's favor.

A traveller has arrived at your land and requests lodging for a few days. He promises to put in a good word for you and your guild with the king if you help him. Place the requested materials at the traveller's disposal.
You have heard of shrinking fishing grounds throughout the ocean. As the king seems very concerned about this sort of thing, perhaps you can use the situation to the advantage of your guild?
The Nights of the Catfish feast is right around the corner, and our guild is one of the main suppliers! It seems there's huge demand for fish already, so we should go to the market and sell some.
They keep saying the bread currently sold on the market is the best bread ever. In order to see if that's true, you need to become the guild's delegate, so go to the market and get some bread!

Last night an old friend of mine visited me, and it felt so good to see him again. It's really important to keep in touch with friends, you know? Especially if you're in a guild that holds friendship in such high regard! To celebrate friendship, we should visit a friend's island and lend him a helping hand!

Our settlers have great confidence in your guild, but they would also love to be sure you have good diplomacy skills. Your settlers have asked whether your friends can visit the island and help out. I'm sure you can handle such an easy request!

The Miner's Union believes the workers around the island have slowed down lately. Maybe they've gotten tired? No, no, it can't be that! They've asked you to make some nice sandwiches, as maybe that will raise morale! It would certainly help your guild to be more appreciated by the Miner's Union!

Any great man or woman should eventually look for a new challenge, right? I think the time has come for you to maybe take a break and look for an adventure that would benefit not only you, but also your guild! What do you say?

A wealthy merchant just arrived in the city with the strangest of requests. Apparently, he wants to find his long lost friend - but he doesn't know where to look! He's also oddly paranoid about a potential bandit attack He wants to buy some iron ore from our guild in order to make himself an iron wagon. And who are we to question him?

A scout has arrived this morning, reporting several unknown ships near our island. It could just be some lost fishermen... but it might also mean trouble! Our guild should be prepared for every eventuality, so let's make sure we have enough iron swords in our storehouse!

Our wheatfields really are a beautiful sight to see! Nevertheless, the problem remains - we need more wheat! Our farmers say they need more farms to keep up with demand! Your guild wants you to make sure you have enough farms on our island!

I always feel nervous when the King sends his specialists to share their knowledge with us. They're usually really grumpy. The one that came last week wrote a note saying our forges are really old fashioned. We must not let this news reach the ears of the King! Make sure you own at least two upgraded forges!

Many settlers have asked me what exactly goes on inside our barracks. I find it intriguing they show so much interest in our military affairs. We should hold an open day where any settler can come and see! Train some militia and let the settlers witness how our army is trained!

A guild supervisor has just arrived from Capital Island. He is to spend some time with you and oversee production. He is mostly interested in seeing how our mills work. Well, let's make the man happy! Have your mills produce flour!

Your explorer has told me that last time he was out in the wilderness he saw something sparkle in the grass down in the valley, near the stone deposits. It would have been a long detour for him, so at the time he decided not to check it out. Next time you send your men to look for stone, he'll go that way and perhaps find out exactly what was sparkling. Who knows, maybe it can benefit your guild?!

One of the bandit camps our soldiers wiped out during a patrol was ruled by a fearless leader. Though our soldiers have destroyed the camp, the leader managed to escape back to Dagger Island, where we believe the bandits are based. Why am I telling you this? Apparently the leader wants vengeance. We should be ready to protect ourselves from his wrath, should he decide to attack. Let's make sure we will be able to defend ourselves!

One of our geologists has visited all our wells to taste the water… and he is not happy. He believes we should move our wells in the hope of finding newer, fresher water deposits. So… I suppose we should follow his advice. He knows best, and we can't allow this matter to shame our guild! Move at least two wells!
Though we're not known as an aggressive settlement, the King wants to be sure we are capable of controlling our enemies. We should show him our guild has the bandit problem under control!

You remember the house our guild built for the old hermit ages ago? It seems that a storm has damaged it, and it might collapse soon! Another storm may come at any time, and we should be ready for any damage it could do! Make sure you have a hardwood sawmill and some hardwood planks! We need to prepare fast!

One of the main captains of the Royal Fleet, captain Ironplank, has sent out several ships with a "secret" cargo. The ships are to dock at random islands where the cargo will be stored, and we may be among their choices. The captain wants all the islands to be able to store these goods if possible. We need to make sure we have enough brew and sausages in case our guild is chosen.

Queen Anita has a habit of choosing an island that she will favor for the rest for the year. Her choice is based on the island's workflow. A busy island is a good island! Let's make sure she chooses us! We need to produce some resources! This would be a great honour for our guild!

Did you notice that our miners are starting to look a bit tubby? I mean, one would think that working in the mines would keep them in shape! I've sniffed around and found out that our miners are eating a lot of sausages! No wonder that they're so fat! That's it! The guild is cutting rations! However, we need to fill our stocks back up, so make sure we have enough sausages in our storeroom.

This morning we found a crate on our shores. One of our settlers opened it and found a brand new cannon inside. I'm not sure where it came from, so it's probably best to get rid of it! The guild certainly doesn't need it. Make sure you trade it at the market!

Our guild has hired some woodcutters, and they came to see me yesterday to complain about the quality of our tools! They claim that imported tools are much better, which I doubt very much! Let's prove that our tools are the best! Obtain the required amount of tools through trading!

We need to be sure our friends don't forget how much we and our guild care for them. And we care for them a lot! Let's make sure we take some of our Aunt Irma's baskets over, and buff one of their buildings.

Our lady of the southern coast had a dream last night! In her dream, an angel appeared from the sky and dropped stars on our buildings! She believes this to be a sign! Our guild should make her dream come true! Let's ask our friends to come over and gift us some buffs!

While walking through the forest, I met Aunt Irma. She was very glad to see me, and pleased to hear her special basked of goodies helped our settlers do their work! She even accompanied me to the mayor's house! Let's make five Aunt Irma's Baskets - she's promised she will attend to make sure everything is done correctly!
Good morning! Or is it? The guild has just received a letter containing information about a new task you should not leave unattended! Make sure you read the letter as soon as possible!

The lord of one of our lumberyards has decided to have a banner made from iron, and now every lord wants an iron banner. It's not like we jump every time they want something, but I think we can make an exception this time. Iron banners do look rather good, after all. Let's make sure we provide them with all the iron they need.

It seems that with so much to do around the island, our tools are getting worn out really fast. We need to ensure our settlers always have the required tools. Be sure to have enough tools in your storehouse!

In the early morning, when our settlers and our guild members wake up, they want the air to be filled with the smell of fresh bread! I can't blame them; fresh bread does smell amazing! You love it too I'm sure, but do we have enough bakeries? Perhaps not! Let's build at least two more bakeries!

Some of our settlers have complained that every time their relatives come to visit, they don't have enough room! We better do something about that! We can't have visitors sleeping outside in the haystacks! Be sure you have enough room and food for their next visit! Our guild must not only take care of our settlers, but their kin too!

Our hunters have bad news! Apparently there's a new breed of wolves in the woods and they attack humans! What if they approach the main settlement? The guild must be ready for them! We need to make sure we have not only melee weapons but ranged support also!

"A guild must be built on a strong base of trust and cooperation," the book of the Guilds reads. I guess it must be true! It's in this extremely important-looking book, after all. It also says here that every guild must have its own stash of coins, marked with the banner, so we must start striking some coins! Make sure we own all the coins we need!

I can't believe it! You remember the people who left civilization only to continue life in the midst of mother nature? Well, they're back, and they seem angry! I'm not sure if we can calm them down or not… but we should be ready for a clash nevertheless! Your guild is most respected, so you have been asked to provide the guards for the meeting! Make sure you have the necessary troops!

The technician who came up with a number of good building ideas is back again! He wants to build a moveable house, and has asked our guild to help him with the resources he needs for the tests! So! Let's help!

You know, King Damien still thinks that our guild makes the best swords in the kingdom! And every time he sends his men to our island, they want to visit the sword storeroom! Let's make sure our iron weaponsmiths can make the swords without any problems!

Have you ever heard of gold termites? No? Me neither. Apparently, all these little creatures do is eat gold ore. We need to keep them out! The only way to do that is to get a lot of water! The termites hate wate, but we will be needing a lot - the Miner's Union has many tunnels down there.

There is a new "master" fisherman who claims he can catch one hundred fish in one go. Ha! I'll believe it when I see it, but it would be a great spectacle for the people! Our guild will rise to the challenge! Let us show him that our fishermen are the best!

The guild has received a letter from the scouts. They require some shelters up in the mountains. We can't build them ourselves, but they assure us that if we give them the hardwood planks they will look after it themselves. And it's windy up there; they'll need strong planks indeed. Let's get them their hardwood planks.

The librarians have heard about our guild and come to me with an interesting request. They want to clear out the library, and that means removing all the papers, books, and scrolls. However, high winds are to be expected, so they need us to give them some iron bars to lay on the papers and books, so the wind won't blow them away. Sounds like a very wise tactic. If it's iron they want, iron they shall get.

A lady from Capital Island has written a letter to our guild. She has an amazing garden and wants it filled with pets! Not live pets, no no! Marble pets! Apparently she believes that pets made from marble won't run away from home… well I can't really argue with that. Let's send her some of our finest marble!

There have been a lot of robberies near the farms, so one of the "brighter" captains has asked our guild for help. He wants some sacks of flour! Why? So he can - listen to this - cover the perimeter with flour. When the robbers come back, this will allow him to follow their footsteps to their hideout. Given that our guild does not question the decisions of the local guard, we are to provide them with flour.

Our best archer is about to take our youngest for some good old archer training in the forest! Our guild is always very supportive when it comes to such activities. Let's make sure we provide him with our finest bows!

Capital Island has sent our guild a message about a new system they want to implement regarding mail delivery. They have some people from the west who claim they are able to tame horses like no other! They are to be hired as scouts if they speak the truth! We are to provide our finest horses!

You know what that old woman living in the dark woods has told me? That she boils the meat! Boiled meat! I tried it and it tastes amazing! Let's do a good deed for our guild and send some meat to the King! Provide the best meat you can!
Oh no! Once again a deer has gnawed at my documents. I've had enough! These wild animals are becoming a plague. We have to find someone to get rid of the animals!
I'm getting near daily reports of settlers being robbed by bandits. It is time to strike back! We should completely decimate the bandits and make an example of them.

I was en route today with my scouts and saw something rather worrying. Some bandit camps have very strong units. Most have just one, but that's already sufficient to cause problems. To counter these units we will need more damage than our bowmen can offer.

Have you heard? A kind of grizzly bear has been seen in the woods, and it's highly aggressive. A number of settlers have been attacked. We have to act. It might be a good idea to let the hunter produce some meat and mix it up with a sleeping potion so we can relocate the bear.
After that business with the bear, we still have a lot of meat left. I'm sure there's something useful we can do with it. How about building a butcher? He could process the meat into sausage.
Remember the king's last task? I've received a message. He has a new task for you, offering support as long as you accommodate a certain number of settlers.

There is a countrywide competition among the settlers to see who is able to build the highest and most stable sausage pyramid. Actually, I didn't want to bother you with it, but Sir Oliver said I should ask anyway. So, would you sponsor us and provide the sausages? Of course, we would be happy to share the reward with you.

A suspicious looking person has been sneaking around your city. I will take care of him and find out who he is. Meanwhile, you should concentrate on hardwood production so we can produce enough longbows quickly.

Eek! We have rats in our storehouses! We should renovate as soon as possible and chase the rats away. The best thing would be to combine renovation with an increase in storage capacity. The king is sure to ask for this soon anyway.
Now that we have longbowmen, the time has come to push the bandits back further. It is also a good opportunity to test their abilities. Have fun.

It still weighs heavy on my mind that I didn't manage to catch that person. Should she try to enter the city a second time, I will arrest her immediately. Anyway, we should continue according to plan and produce the longbows.
My scouts report of enemy activities on other islands. My instinct tells me we should keep on expanding the military, so it would be a good idea to have a steel smelter.
But first, to more important matters - we need a steel weaponsmith to process steel into steel swords. I am so looking forward to commanding the first soldiers.

Psssst… Come here! I have to be careful because I do not want to be detected. Have you heard about other islands already? There are lots of treasures to be found and mischief that needs to be dealt with. I would gladly tell you more if you give me some longbowmen.

It seems the coast is clear. I promised to tell you more and I am always true to my word. Here I have a map of a small island. Click on the map in your star menu and start the adventure. Afterwards, you can travel there. Take some units with you and I'll meet with you there. Note: The adventure can also be bought a limited number of times in the shop, in exchange for fish.

If you want to find more maps, you'll have to do it by yourself. Just send your explorer on an adventure search, and if you are lucky, he'll find one. However, the strength of enemy units varies, so always take enough units with you.
A new letter from the king has arrived, but it is meant for your eyes only, which is why I have placed the letter in your mail box. I wonder what it says…

An emissary of your brother Theodor has just arrived, completely hysterical, and told me your brother fears he will soon be attacked. He beseeches your help. Before we send him troops, we should check our weapon productions, starting with the bronze swords.
Psssst… It's me again. How is the adventure search going? Could you get me some exotic wood by trading? I cannot trade myself… for a number of reasons I don't want to go into.

Strange... It's been a while since we were tasked with expanding our storage capacity. Don't you think that's a little curious too? Do you believe we should just keep on expanding? Maybe the king expect us to show some initiative.
Your brother is becoming more and more impatient. We should send him some units soon to stop him going insane with fear. Train a few recruits and I will send them to him as soon as they are done.

Tell me this is not true. Now Theodor wants soldiers from us because he is afraid that recruits might not suffice. Whatever. After all, he is your brother. Just check whether your steel production is well balanced first.

It seems your economy is working quite well. Have you already noticed that we do not need a lot of stones and planks anymore? In case you have a large amount of any specific resource left, you can trade it in and get more useful resources.

Almost! I almost caught her. It was really close, but even during the chase we must not forget your home island is still threatened by bandits. I think it is time to end this once and for all. Banish them from your island forever!

I must talk to you once again about the fears of your brother Theodor. He has sent a message saying he prefers not to wait so long for the soldiers, and hence would like us to send steel swords to start off with.

I have just returned from a visit of the king's court. I have to admit, his city looks really beautiful. I think this is mainly because of its harmonious cityscape. You too should try to keep your building upgrades on the same level. It just looks better.

Pssst… During my last journey, I came upon a messenger who had been robbed. He gave me this letter and asked me to bring it to you. It has no sender details. I thought it had to be important, so I decided to do you this favor.

Have you already found some exotic wood? It is the very best wood that exists. Unfortunately, we don't have any exotic trees to cut down here. You can only get the wood from your explorer or through your adventures. Build up a supply of it, because we will be needing it very soon.
Well, the swords didn't calm your brother down for very long it seems. He has become very agitated again. It is time to send him the soldiers. After that, hopefully, he will finally calm down.

Pssst… I've explored a new route containing many treasures. It takes a little time, because the paths are often very steep, but you can find the nicest things there. I'll give you the information, but you'll owe me a favor…

Pssst… It's me again. I'm just about to go on a journey to find new adventures. Since I'm going quite far this time, I might find a new route for your explorer, and more challenging adventures. If I do, you will need more units for them. Maybe you should upgrade your noble residences to claim more settlers?
