You subjects are reporting increased sightings of useful trinkets lying around the countryside. Perhaps if they were gathered, we could make something useful out of them. Every little bit counts you know. Long term quest chain: to complete this main quest, finish all sub-quests.
To check your available collections, open the Collections tab in the mayor's house. They will become available progressively as your level increases.

Collecting the items on the map is no easy task! You'll need to look closely, as they're so easy to miss. To start off, gather 10 Scarecrows and 12 Herbs. If you don't see them all on the map at once, don't worry - they'll re-appear during the day.
Complete the "Country Saying" collection by gathering all the required ingredients! Why are you still reading this? Get going!
Collect a Bronze Cauldron from an adventure map. It can only be found on adventure maps you visit and will not reappear on that adventure once you have collected it. Best of luck!

Hi there. I've been watching your adventure efforts, and I'm really impressed by your skills. You know, lately I heard about some strange things happening far away. Until today I thought this task might be too difficult for you, but now I think you could well be capable. Maybe you should take a look?

OK, so you accept the challenge?! Well well, you are brave, but we'll soon see exactly how brave you really are. Of course, you can't just go now and win the fight. You'll have to prepare well, and by "well" I mean **really** well!

The time has come. I've put the new adventure in your star menu. When you arrive on the new island, a friend of mine will welcome you. He seems a bit weird on first sight but he's OK really. Just help him and he will reward you accordingly. Good luck.

Maybe you already realised this, but there are more new adventures besides the one you already tried. To get them, you need to play the first adventure and the others will probably come as follow-ups. The rewards increase with every follow up-adventure, so it will be worth your while!

You got Magic Beans as reward? Hmm… They look pretty ordinary. Did you already check what you can get for them? … What? A giant castle? A tower that produces coins? Wow, that's epic. So, what are you waiting for? Gather more of them to get the epic rewards!
Man, we need more beans. There are so many things to be bought. You should continue gathering beans. Maybe there are also other ways to gather beans?! In any case, we need more!

Oh, this castle is gorgeous, don't you think? You have to build it on your island. I've heard that when you upgrade it, it produces something from these beans that you can use to buy even more marvellous items.

If I've understood correctly, we need to upgrade the Fairytale Castle to level 5 to make it produce Magic beanstalks. It may take some time but it seems to be worth it! With the stalks you can buy even more cool new items. So, let's start!
Hello there my friend! I come bearing news of a most wonderful new invention - so listen very carefully, because I shall share this only once.

There is a new so-called "Premium Time", which you can buy from the merchant and put into your account. The king was so kind as to give me one of these, er, Premium days so that you can try it out for yourself. You can find it in your star menu.

One of the benefits you'll receive is an increase in your friend buff time. You may already know that your buffs on friend zones last longer, but during Premium time, they'll last even longer still. Why not try it out!

The best thing about the Premium status is that you'll earn more loot from your adventures. But not only do you get more loot, you'll earn more experience points too. Completing adventures will now pay better than it ever has done before. But don't just take my word for it - take a look for yourself.

It seems the treasure map has led us to this strange looking island! The scouts say that the treasure we seek is hidden in the ruins of an old temple somewhere on this island. The bad news is that it seems to be being worshipped by a band of cultists. If we want to find the treasure, we shall have to clear out their camps. Their strange magic appears to be controlling some barriers on the other side of the island. We need to work together, and clear out those bone churches.
The cultists seem rather confused. No wonder - they're being attacked from both sides! It seems we've unraveled their defences. Time to take care of those big towers.
Now that the cultists are out of the way, we need to get searching for that treasure.
The scouts have reported that the collectible items have appeared on our island. You should go and gather them up!

This is definitely the place! It seems to be heavily guarded... We need to destroy those camps quickly and make a beachhead on the island. The camps also seem to be reinforcing a nearby wall through that dense patch of woods. If we can take them out, our allies can pass through their defences.
Quickly now, we must make use of our advantage. They were not expecting us to move so swiftly! Go forth and destroy the leaders of their forward guard.
It seems we've reached their second line of defence. The only way to breach it is to destroy those fortified camps on the Eastern and Western sides; then the wall should fall.
We've reached the second wall, but we know how to beat it. The fortifications are sustained by fortified camps on the North and South sides of the wall. Destroy them!
Victory is before us. The keep of our enemies is within our grasp. Go get them!

While our pumpkins are still growing, we can always try to find some ready-grown ones on your island. If you spot one, just click on it to collect it.
Keep in mind that they need some time to grow too. If you're unlucky today, why not try your luck again tomorrow.
- Collect 1 pumpkin on your island
The scouts have reported that collectible items have been spotted. You should have a look around and collect them in before we finish our business here.

Another way to get pumpkins is to go on an adventure. Perhaps you want to give it a try?
- Complete an Adventure

You know that awkward feeling you get when you're carving your pumpkins, doing some magic potion brewing and are absentmindedly chanting some old spells you learned during your apprenticeship, when suddenly you invoke a giant golem in your garden and don’t know what to do with it?
No? Oh… Well, nevertheless, do you think you could help me to get rid of this golem before he eats or tramples me... Er... I mean your settlers?
There is just one teensy, tiny detail you should know before you begin, though... I’m afraid I may have summoned more than just one golem… In fact, I think I've summoned so many your neighbours and friends will probably have to join in the fight too.
I need some time to prepare a banishing spell, and will need to seek out ingredients from all over the world. Each golem your neighbours defeat will buy me some time. If we all pull together, we should be able to clean up this mess!
In fact, I think I already have an idea on how to beat the golem on your island.

Listen closely my friend, because I have a cunning plan. Things aren't looking great as they stand. Our weapons cannot harm its stony-skin. Even our cannons are shrugged off like mosquito-bites. But there is another way to defeat him.
What animates this golem is its inner fire. If we could extinguish it, it should freeze and turn into stone. We tried regular water, but it had no effect. Perhaps now we should take the concentrated approach, and try purified water instead!
It's worth a try. Tell your settlers to drop what they're doing, and start producing purified water as soon as they can!
Alright, now let’s test those canisters of purified water! Simply click on the golem and a new window will appear. You can use your purified water there.

It works! The pure water's weakened him! Just imagine what a few more canisters would do!
Quick - let's produce enough pure water to bring him down!
- Defeat the golem by using enough pure water.

I'm afraid another golem has gone astray on your island. I've already gathered everything I need from him, but I'd expect your settlers would be grateful if you could defeat this one too.
- Defeat the golem by using enough purified water on it
In this quest, you have to use the Premium Account buff, which we sent you from your star menu.
In this quest, you have to use the Bookbinder buff, which we sent you from your star menu.
In this quest, you have to use the Gold Fever buff, which we sent you from your star menu.
In this quest, you have to use the Chocolate Rabbit buff, which we sent you from your star menu.
In this quest, you have to use the Supporter Hats buff, which we sent you from your star menu.

Looking around this island, it doesn't take a genius to see that the finite space of our cherished home will someday get us into trouble. If we keep growing as we've done so far, we'll need to find a way to make some more space.

I don't know about you, but I've always hated the mountains. Yet what can one man do against the forces of nature? If only there were more of us, perhaps some bright mind would eventually rise up to the task. The village needs to grow! Makes sense, right?

The cultural achievements of our settlement are remarkable, I must admit. But these accursed mountains - they just take up so much space! Gunpowder seemed like a great idea, but our handling of it needs to mature just a little bit more. I say throw more people at the problem, and someone shall find a way!

We have truly begun to shape the land according to our vision! The secret is in the numbers, just as I have always thought. Our Shotfirers can overcome any obstacle, so all we need is more! More people, more firepower! Mooore!

Good day, Milord! Our scientists have come up with a new contraption: they call it an Epic Workyard. It's a huge, imposing structure that houses complex mechanisms which can transform and produce resources at incredible speed. Truly a magnificent achievement and a wonder of technology! Much time and effort has been involved in its creation, so the Scientists Guild is demanding Magic Beans in compensation for the structure - but I say it's well worth it!

A historic moment, Milord! Today we start our first production at our Epic Workyard. It's an event of great significance which proclaims Your great foresight and penchant for new things, as well as the undeniable greatness of our island!
Start a seed to pinewood production chain at your Epic Workyard.
We've got our Epic Workyard is up and running, but it can do so much more! Use the remaining two slots to start additional Tree Planting production chains.

Can you hear the machines? They purr like a kitten - now let's make them roar like a lion! Use the "Magic Bean Soup" buff to double the Epic Workyard's production, and then select the building to see it in action.

I'm afraid another golem has gone astray on your island. I've already gathered everything I need from him, but I'd expect your settlers would be grateful if you could defeat this one too.
- Defeat the golem by using enough purified water on it

I'm afraid another golem has gone astray on your island. I've already gathered everything I need from him, but I'd expect your settlers would be grateful if you could defeat this one too.
- Defeat the golem by using enough purified water on it

Before we can overcome the golem, we have to get you to a certain level. There's no way you'll be able to take him on as you are! Keep on leveling as you were, and I'll come back to you when you're ready.

Have we met before? Your face looks... familiar. But where are my manners! My name is Eliot and you look like you're confused about what's happening on your island. Don't worry - I'll talk you through everything you need to know. So, where shall we begin?!

First of all, you should try to get as many pumpkins as you can! Why? Because you can buy cool stuff with them, of course! Even buildings! One way of getting them is through buying pumpkin cemeteries. You find them at the merchant. There are different kinds, sizes and speeds available, so why not take a look and buy some?

Of course, you can also collect pumpkins in other ways. Besides pumpkin cemeteries, you can earn them as rewards for quests, by taking part in several adventures, as collectibles in your home zone, by buying them at the merchant, or as a reward for defeating a golem! Trading with other players is also possible too! So happy collecting!

It's time we set-up our first Epic Workyard. It will bring both glory to our island, and a much-needed boost to our economy. Great journeys start with but a single step, remember!
Purchase an Epic Woodyard from the Shop (Epic items) and place it on the island.
Using a special type of saw blades, made with a heavy, compact bronze core and replaceable iron cutting edges, the Epic Woodyard can produce Pinewood Planks at a remarkable pace.

Magic Beans have been successfully tested as a power source, amongst their other amazing properties. The Science Guild believes that, with the proper resources, they will be able to produce a saw blade that can spin in perpetuity. The application of this invention in pinewood processing will provide huge improvements over any current method.

Besides being an excellent material for ornaments and fancy buildings, marble has some interesting properties that allow for some superior furnaces to be built from it. These furnaces are able to withstand the temperatures needed to coke Pinewood logs at incredible speed. Our scientists are eager to implement them in our Epic Woodyard, should you provide resources for the prototypes.

Magic Beans, Water and Pinewood Planks are the ingredients used in a very complex reaction that, once started, will provide an inextinguishable, high-temperature fire that will coke entire Pinewood logs almost instantly.

Hardwood is a demanding plant to grow. However, within the Epic Woodyard, a system of circulating steam, raised beds and automatic tillers allow for great amounts of Hardwood saplings to be grown in a single batch, equaling and surpassing all but the best hardwood foresters we have to-date.

A new generation of jointers is required to handle the intensity of the automated hardwood processing system. Steel blades are much more effective than the Iron ones that were previously used on manual processing.

By imbuing Magic Bean extract into the metal, our scientists have been able to manufacture sawblades that require no additional power source and just keep spinning in place, powered by their own momentum. This will greatly reduce the space requirements for the sawmill and will allow many more sawblades to be installed, multiplying its already impressive output.

Granite has the best heat resistance of all the known materials we have. This has led our scientists to come up with the idea of using it to build coking ovens that can stand the constant heat of the near-automated coking process in the Epic Woodyard, while processing coal out of hardwood.

Using Magic Beans as a power source is nothing new - but using this power directly as heat is an innovation. The heat resulting from channeling a Magic Bean mixture's blast is enough to transform hardwood into coal at incredible speed.

Exotic Wood's resilience may be legendary, but it has met its match in the amazing durability of titanium-built blades. Using titanium as a material for tools has allowed us to use hardwood processing equipment to manufacture exotic wood planks.

The titanium blades are excellent for cutting exotic wood into planks, but the process was throttled by the exhausting task of polishing the planks to create a usable surface. Using Magic Beans, yet again, has allowed us to power automated polishers to amazing speeds and thus, enhance an already great production line even further.

Have you heard? Red Nose Day is coming on December 5th. This is a great chance to help out a good cause!
To show our support, we'll be starting a server event in which you can contribute by collecting and donating red noses.
When the total amount of noses collected reaches a set level,, we'll donate a certain amount of money to the Red Nose Day Initiative.

The easiest way to find red noses is to send your explorers on a treasure search.
The longer the search lasts, the more noses your explorer can find. Why not try it out now, and send one of your explorers on a short treasure search?

You've collected quite a few red noses, so why not donate them to the cause? To do so, simply visit your storehouse or mayor’s house, and choose the ‘Event’ tab. You'll find your red noses in inside, and can donate them by clicking on them.
If you want more noses, you can always produce some from your collectible items. Let’s try to collect the items we need to produce a small basket of red noses.

Now that you've collected the necessary items, you can start producing your own red noses. To do so, simply visit your Mayor's House, select the ‘Collections’ tab and click to produce a basket of red noses. When the basket is finished, simply use it on your Mayor’s House to collect your red noses.
In order to reach the donation goal we need to collect and donate as many red noses as possible. If you work together with your friends, this should be a cakewalk!
There are various ways to get noses, but you'll need more experience if you want to take advantage of them. Just keep on leveling, and I'll come back to you when you're ready.

Merry Christmas, old friend! I’ve brought some new things with me to make this year’s Christmas even better.
I will show you the new Christmas surprise and how to get presents.
My reindeers are gone, someone must have stolen them! Without them I can't deliver all those presents! But you can save the day!

First take a look at the brand-new Christmas surprise. Each day you can open a door and find valuable things inside!
For special days like Christmas Eve or New Year’s Eve you can choose in advance what reward you'd like to have.
And if you manage to open all the doors. you'll get a really special reward!
Even if you miss a door, you can always come back and open it afterwards with some gems.

The next thing I want to show you is how you can produce your own Christmas presents.
For this we need Christmas Bells, Candy Canes and Gingerbread. You can find those things on your Island - all you have to do is pick them up.

Now that we have enough things to build our presents from, we should give it a try!
Click on your Mayor's House, select the 'Collections' tab and produce a Basket of Presents.

The last thing I wanted to tell you is that your explorers can also find presents during their treasure searches.
Try it out, and send one of your explorers on a treasure search (short).

Let me tell you a little secret. It's not the reindeers that let my sleigh fly. They're just for show. I mean, I could use kittens, but imagine how silly that would look…
The trick here is a magic potion which can make any animal fly. So here's the plan: First, we train some horses, and we gather some wood to build fake antlers with. After all, they need to look like reindeers when people see them flying.
Then I simply give them my potion, and they should be able to help me deliver my presents.

I'm back, but unfortunately, I can't find the ingredients I need to brew the potion I mentioned.
Perhaps you could help me out?
Here, take this list. That's everything you need to get. Oh, and could you bring me some malt brew while you’re at it?
I found the evildoer who stole my Reindeers! He's hiding on an Island. I guess we need to set sail and pay him a visit!
I found the evildoer who stole my Reindeers! He's hiding on an Island. I guess we need to set sail and pay him a visit!
I found the evildoer who stole my Reindeers! He's hiding on an Island. I guess we need to set sail and pay him a visit!

Unfortunately, the guy who stole my reindeers has bribed the rulers of the island to protect him!
It seems we'll need to take an Army with us if we're going to get them back!

Unfortunately, the guy who stole my reindeers has bribed the rulers of the island to protect him!

I should have known! The evildoer was hired by the Croaker!
I don't know where he's hiding right now, but I think we need to build ourselves back up, and get ready for a showdown.

I should have known! The evildoer was hired by the Croaker!
I don't know where he's hiding right now, but I think we need to build ourselves back up, and get ready for a showdown.

I should have known! The evildoer was hired by the Croaker!
I don't know where he's hiding right now, but I think we need to build ourselves back up, and get ready for a showdown.

I'm so glad you're here! The Croaker has stolen my sleigh! It was an extra-wide one with low skids, go-faster stripes, and loads of space for presents. There's no way I can let it keep my sleigh… whatever it is.
Unfortunately, the Croaker seems to have learned from our last meeting, as he's reinforced his defences. Two towers now stand guarding the only way to reach him.
They are too strong to attack directly. But the leader camps on this side of the river are being used to store cannons and explosives. If we can defeat them, we can use their equipment to destroy the towers.
I can already see the Croaker's hut. He only has a few more servants left! Then we can show him it was a bad idea to steal my sleigh.
The operators of this particular shop can only be recruited from the most technologically advanced Sawmills we have.
Here are the materials we'll need to complete the prototype, together with the first batch of blades. If there's any excess material, it will be returned to our storehouse.
Transporting the Magic Beans to the Woodyard will require some special equipment. For such a small batch, a secure steel case should suffice.
The construction of the actual sawblades will require a large batch of pure Iron. Accelerating the blades to the point where they'll never stop will require us to feed them some planks.

To start the production for these ovens, one must first gather the necessary items and knowledge. While the tools we need may be found locally, the marble masonry work will require the finest masons on the island.
The furnaces will be both a marvel of technology and a work of art, each and every one of them.

The reaction needed to power this new type of coking will need to take place in a well contained area. The only design we've found that's capable of withstanding such a reaction is made of granite, with steel reinforcements. As usual, anything we have left over after construction will be delivered to the storehouse.
Time to fuel that furnace and strike the first spark. Let's keep our fingers crossed!
We'll need to establish a good seed base first, if we are to proceed with this research. We need our supplies to be of the absolute top quality and can settle for nothing less.
A complex set of steam pipes, that can deliver the necessary amount of heat and water to the seedlings, will need to be set-up before we move on with the construction.

The final step is to build the raised beds and the complex mechanism that will automatically till the earth and plant the seeds. It's going to take a lot of skill to get this done - and all while the pipes are leaking all over the place!

Assembling a team of crack professionals will be the key to our success. We won't be able to get this done without the right people. Unfortunately, that means spending some coin to attract the finest in the land.
Building the actual joiners will require high quality materials that can stand the stress of the process.

The energy produced by the magic beans reaction will need to be contained. We have to build an enclosure strong enough to withstand their heat, but light enough that men can carry it. Any beans that are left over will be returned to us.
The beans have to be mixed with 100 parts water, and carefully grinded with a granite mortar and pestle - the only thing that can safely contain the mixture.
Steel core sawblades with titanium tips - a splendid target for our scientist's "Animation Mixture".
The granite ovens will have to be built on-site as they are too heavy to carry around. Their extremely thick walls have to be built up high, which will require some elaborate scaffolding.
Stone, dust and water - basic building mortar - when pressed between extremely heavy granite blocks, becomes a part of the structure, holding everything in place.
Carefully mixing ground Magic Beans and common flour has yielded a mixture which, when exposed to flame, unleashes a powerful high-temperature blast.
The Coking Ovens, even when built from granite, are severely weakened by the blast waves of this coking process. Titanium bracing has been deemed necessary if we are to keep them working.
The incredibly complex manufacturing process for exotic wood planks is only made possible by the skill and dedication of the men working the logs.
While we prepare the tools, the schematics will have to be guarded. Employing a bunch of soldiers and making sure they're paid enough to keep them bribe-free sounds like a plan.

These tools are the embodiment of the most cutting-edge technology we have achieved so far. Built from the finest materials, used by our finest workmen they will deliver the coveted exotic planks at tremendous speed.
The science guild will not start researching this incredible innovation until they know you're completely committed to Exotic Wood processing.
The building schematics for these tools are so complex that the Science Guild has actually requested additional paper and nibs so that they can finally complete them.
The sacrifices we made were well worth it - the final stage of constructing these incredible machines is to gather the materials required to build and power them.

Together, we are stronger - and potentially richer, too. To take advantage of your extra buying power, you should build a guild bank to support your guild with resources. Perhaps the guild already has some resources stored, which you might be able to use?
The next thing I want to show you requires you to be Level 16. Please come back when you've gained enough experience. For someone with your potential, that shouldn't take too long!

The guild bank gives you a lot of options for sharing and trading resources and items. To see what's stored in the bank, click on the building. Because there are so many possibilities, the architects left a manual in the building, which explains how the bank works. You can find the manual by clicking on the question mark.
For the next task you need to be Level 23. Please come back when you've gained enough experience.
For the next task you need to be Level 26. Please come back when you've gained enough experience.
We made landfall, now we must be swift! Strike at the pirate forts and their barricades will fall. If you all work together, you can clear a way to the cove!

The Red Ship is here! And it's moored for repairs at the docks. What a great opportunity! Make haste, torch every hut in your path, and burn the ship to the ground. This will be a heavy blow to the pirate activity in these seas!

A great evil is on the verge of being awoken on this land.
Make haste and disrupt the ritual. Destroying the Unholy Altars that can be seen near the tomb should do the trick. Go forth and purge the taint from this island!

The tomb lies quiet now that the ritual has been broken. The tremors have stopped and the sun shines again on the ancient stones.
Time to take whatever precious, non-cursed artefacts we might find inside and seal this place for good.

We need to move quickly and decisively. The siege vanguard is almost at the mansion's entrance!
First, you'll need to free the occupied sectors as you advance towards the mansion.
Then, in one swift action, you must simultaneously strike at both the besieging party and their command camps to dispatch the military leaders. A good execution of this manoeuvre will break the bandits' grip on the trader's mansion.

We made landfall right inside their raid staging area. We have the element of surprise, so we must move quickly.
Eliminate the forces stationed in the harbor area and dispose of the harbor masters to access the city area.

The inner city defences are not to be taken lightly.
Keep your force's momentum going and strike at their leaders with all your strength. After they're gone, the plunder is ours.
It's high time we paid them back for all their looting. Open their storehouse and take everything you find!

Hello my lord. I am Istvan, one of your young followers, and I need your help. The weather has been terribly dry lately, and thus our crop harvest was poor last year. We don't have enough food to last us until the next harvest. Please, help us.
First, we'll need to plow the fields for a new harvest, but they're covered in debris. Could you help us and collect some of this debris?
We don't have enough tools and utensils left to plow the complete area. It would be a great help if you could help us find the materials to do so. Here, I made a note of everything we need.

Phew, we're all done! Now, all that's left to do is to wait until the wheat has grown. We'd better wait and see how things go. I'm sure you've got plenty of other things to be getting on with - I'll let you know when the crops have grown.
To be on the safe side, we'll keep some wheat on one side, as a backup We don't want to risk a new shortage, after all!

Scouts reporting: Garrun's hunting parties are spread all over the island. They're organized in small poaching sites centered around bigger Hunting Camps.
- Destroy all the Hunting Camps

A friend of yours has visited you and has hidden some eggs on your island. Try to find them before the buff on your Mayor's house expires. Once the buff expires, both you and your friend will be awarded the number of Easter Eggs you discovered.
- Find all Hidden Easter Eggs

Only Garrun and his closest followers now stand between the bunnies and their freedom!
- Defeat Garrun in his camp

Hey, hi! Before I say any more, please allow me to show you a special map that I happen to hold. It can unveil great fortunes to the patient adventurer, but you must hold on to it until I can fully explain what's going on ...

Hey, hi! Before I say any more, please allow me to show you a special map that I happen to hold. It can unveil great fortunes to the patient adventurer, but you must hold on to it until I can fully explain what's going on ...

Pssst! Hey! I got a new game going on, that you can also play with your friends. Take this basket of eggs - at a bargain price I might add - and wait for further instructions from me. Trust me - it's going to be a blast!

Hey, it's me again! Here's the tricky part of the deal - take the buff I gave, er... sold you earlier and apply it to one of your friend's Mayor's House. This will create hidden eggs on their island. After this, they have 12 hours to find them! Whatever they find, you both get to keep! Come on - give them a challenge!
- Apply the "Easter Egg Hunt" buff to a friend's Mayor's House

Something isn't right… Our settlers feel tired and exhausted all day. Even nature itself has yet to come out of its hibernation. It is as if the whole kingdom is miserable. Maybe you can provide some refreshments to get your settlers going again?

This whole thing is really alarming. I think we might need some help... It is said that a kind healer travels the lands. Some folks say she is just a herb peddler, others say she might even be a witch. If anyone can help, it will be her. She is said to be very shy, but as she is looking for ingridients for her potions on the island, maybe we can scratch her back if she'll scratch ours.

As you suspected, the witch won't agree to meet you in person. You receive a letter from her with a poorly-drawn picture of what looks like a red monkey. The letter reads: "I am Ma'Bristley and this little reddish fellow is Munchkin. So you need help, you say? You know, you mighty kings and queens, you always seem to appear in times of greatest desperation. But other than that you hardly tolerate an old lady wanting to trespass your kingdom. Well, you say you are different. Prove it to us. Do something truly selfless for somebody else in need."

You know, you mighty kings and queens, you always seem to appear in times of greatest desperation. But other than that you hardly tolerate an old lady wanting to trespass your kingdom. Well, you say you are different. Prove it to us. Do something truly selfless for somebody else in need."

Let’s begin! Your goal is to defeat all your opponents. To achieve this, you should first make yourself aware of each opposing player’s skills. Only then you will know what you'll have to do to defeat them. Each opponent has his own weak spot. To see which skills the player has, simply click on him.

Midfielders are either especially skillful at dribbling, with impressive speed, or are more defensive oriented players. It's a versatile role, to say the least. Here we have a player who's a really good dribbler. To separate him from the ball, use the Tackle. Your opponent will lose his balance, and before he knows what happened, you're off with the ball!

Now that you know how to stop the opposing team, we should try winning that match. Defeat each remaining opponent individually. But be aware that you will need to use different means to defeat each of them.
Let's try and figure out how to defeat the enemy team. This set of tasks should help us get on the right tracks.

Oh… this is exciting! A practice match against the Knight of Crowrock and his entourage. Here we can figure out how to play this match. Luckily for us, they are also new to this sport. While most of their players are rookies, people say the team has some decent midfielders. So let’s see what we can do here.
Remember, to win the match, you'll need to use different tactical tools, which you can produce in the Provision House.

Did you hear? The Settlers Football Championship is coming up again! Counties and kingdoms from all over the continent will be taking part - and we should too, to gain glory and honour for our kingdom. There are prizes to be won, too! By trading the footballs we gather through quests and activities, we could win some amazing stuff! Let me explain how it all works!
Finish all introduction quests in order to participate in the tournament.
To be allowed to participate in the World Championship, all parties need to be at least level 16.
Now the first step. To get information about the World Championship, open the Event Window. You can reach it via the options panel, which is right beneath your avatar picture

Did you notice the football-button next to your avatar picture? Using it opens the championship fixture list. This is the main port of call for you during the tournament. Every day, you can open a new door and get a reward. Green doors contain your next tournament opponent, brown doors hold a nice present for you, and trophy doors contain a special thank you. However, you can only open a trophy door if you managed to open every door that came before it. By the way, you can open green doors at any time after the day they unlock.

However, you can only open a trophy door if you managed to open every door that came before it. By the way, you can open green doors at any time after the day they unlock.

In order to produce tactic items, for example, the Red Card in the Provision House, you'll need to use different resources. There are several different ways to get these. For example, we can find some items on our home island, we can get them by doing daily quests, or we can send our Explorers to search for them. Let's try the different methods.

At the moment, all our Settlers are literally crazy about football. As they aren't the tidiest bunch, it's actually possible to find some items by simply collecting the things these football maniacs have left behind.
To find some more exotic items, you can send your Scout to, er, scout. He'll observe the other teams, and return with interesting items, so we can improve our own tactics.

Now that we have collected enough resources, we should start to transform those into tactics we can use on the playing field. Go to your Provision House and order a Foul. We are going to need it to defeat their midfielder.
Hint: If you have a Rarity Provision House, you can produce the same items there much faster.
Finish the practice match against the Knight of Crowrock.

The tournament has started. To win the Settlers‘ World championship we have to win 6 matches in a row. Just remember to regularly check the World Championship fixture list. There you can find your next opponents by opening the green doors.

So, this will be our first real match. Our opponent is the barony of Tepidwater. Similar to us, they haven't played many matches yet. Folks say the barony is playing a very offensive 4-3-3 system. We should be especially aware of their midfielders, but at the same time watch out for their three strikers. The baron of Tepidwater has some strong players in his team.

Here comes the next match of the group stage. Today our opponent will be the Barony of Emberstream. The guys from Emberstream are a very defensive team with a strong defensive squad. If we want to make it to their goal, we'll need a plan.

Now it's getting serious. Our first knock-out match, against the Shire of Oxwater. During the group stage they showed skill in attacking, while maintaining a stabile defence. They play in a 4-2-4 system – that means with four set strikers.

In the quarter finals, we will play the Electorate of Sunflower Grove. They've certainly earnt their place amongst the last eight teams in the tournament. Similar to our former opponent they play with a strong attacking squad, although their midfield is a little more balanced. This will be a tough enemy.

Semi-finals… what a wonderful day. If you'd have told me at the beginning of the tournament that we would make it this far, I wouldn’t have believed you. But here we are, up against the grand Duchy of Darkwood. What do you need to know about this opponent? They stand closely staggered in a 1-4-1-4 system and have many strong players.

Can you feel it? The air is filled with a mixture of tension, anticipation, and energy… it’s the day of the finals. Our opponent is the Kingdom of Dragonhead. They were always one of the best teams in the tournament, but they'll soon be second best! All players in this team are strong, and they are confident to boot. But they've never played us. Go out on the field and show them what we're made of!

Sometimes you can eliminate an opponent using only a single tactic item. If you take a look at the Tepidwater goalkeeper, you will see that he has both the “High Jumper” and “Fast Reflexes” skills. Both can be countered with a Penalty Kick.
If a tactic item can be used against several skills, it will always affect them in a certain order, as shown in the tactic item’s tooltip. Watch how the skill “High Jumper” gets removed first, followed by “Fast Reflexes”.

An island rich with resources - the perfect place for a colony! However, it looks like someone else has beaten us to it. Let's prepare an expedition, and see if we can chase them off! Maybe we can even convince the local bandits to help us guard this island afterwards?
But remember: Seeing as the defenders outnumber us, we should choose our strategy wisely. Use your heavy troops to block regular camps and carry out a decisive strike against each sector's boss. This way, we should be able to minimize our losses!

What?! That golem looks somehow... different? And bigger!? Looks like the purified water we were using is no longer effective. But what else can we try?
Ah - our settlers do have another technique for making enriched water! Perhaps that could put out the golem's inner fire!
Come on - let's make some enriched water, and bring the greater golem down.

Before we can overcome the golem, we have to get you to a certain level. There's no way you'll be able to take him on as you are! Keep on leveling as you were, and I'll come back to you when you're ready.

Listen closely my friend, because I have a cunning plan. Things aren't looking great as they stand. Our weapons cannot harm its stony-skin. Even our cannons are shrugged off like mosquito-bites. But there is another way to defeat him.
What animates this golem is its inner fire. If we could extinguish it, it should freeze and turn into stone. We tried regular water, but it had no effect. Perhaps now we should take the concentrated approach, and try purified water instead!
It's worth a try. Tell your settlers to drop what they're doing, and start producing purified water as soon as they can!
Alright, now let’s test those canisters of purified water! Simply click on the golem and a new window will appear. You can use your purified water there.

It works! The pure water's weakened him! Just imagine what a few more canisters would do!
Quick - let's produce enough pure water to bring him down!
- Defeat the golem by using enough pure water.

Have we met before? Your face looks... familiar. But where are my manners! My name is Eliot and you look like you're confused about what's happening on your island. Don't worry - I'll talk you through everything you need to know. So, where shall we begin?!

First of all, you should try to get as many pumpkins as you can! Why? Because you can buy cool stuff with them, of course! Even buildings! One way of getting them is through buying pumpkin cemeteries. You find them at the merchant. There are different kinds, sizes and speeds available, so why not take a look and buy some?

Of course, you can also collect pumpkins in other ways. Besides pumpkin cemeteries, you can earn them as rewards for quests, by taking part in several adventures, as collectibles in your home zone, by buying them at the merchant, or as a reward for defeating a golem! Trading with other players is also possible too! So happy collecting!

Our explorers report that beyond the known regions lies an undiscovered land. Many islands, rich with resources, are waiting to be explored and colonised. But we are not alone in this knowledge. Other kingdoms are preparing to compete for the resources, and bandits and other shady folk are said to have colonised these islands.
In order to participate in the race for glory and resources, we should build up an expedition force. I shall show you what we need to do, in order to prepare for this great enterprise.

Exploring unknown islands and sectors is dangerous. Thus, we need to prepare our expedition carefully. For that we should first set up some new buildings to hire specialised troops and provide them with the necessary equipment.

In the Combat Armoury you can produce new weapons for our expedition forces. The armoury works like a provision house, letting you produce weapons just like you would a regular buff. To begin with, we'll need some heavy maces, attack pikes, and attack bows.

When sending out troops on an expedition, they'll require an expert leader. Luckily, our nearest tavern contains plenty of expert marshals. These battle-hardened strategists know how to deal with the unknown dangers of unexplored worlds.
Remember: You can't use your standard generals on expeditions, so you'll need to use marshals instead.

Our new troops can be trained in the Combat Academy. For our first expedition, I would recommend training some Heavy infantry units, alongside attack archers and attack infantry.
Keep in mind that you cannot use regular troops- those that have been recruited in the barracks - on an expedition island. You need troops from the combat academy.
Once you've selected the expedition island, choose the option "Send Army" from the quest tracker, and send off your three marshals with your trained troops.

Now that we're all set, it's starting to get serious. Our explorers have made it to an island at the edge of the uncharted territories. We should send expedition troops there to find out what dangers we will be dealing with. You can find the expedition map in your Star Menu.
Note: If you want to play the expedition again for more practice, you can get it in the Shop for a low price.

That small island we just cleared was only the beginning. It's time to continue towards the core of the uncharted territories. Set up an expedition force and send your explorers out to find an island to claim. But beware - you will encounter bandit forces, and might even meet troops from other kingdoms!
Defeat all the bandits on this small island and come home safely!

Now that we've gathered our forces, and found an island we'd like to explore, we should send our army to the expedition.
Do so by clicking on the Quest Tracker and then choosing "Send Army".

To find a suitable island to colonise, we need to make use of our explorer's expertise. Go to your Star Menu, select any explorer and then chose the option "Find Expedition". Then fight for a small colony.
Good luck!
Engage and conquer your first small colony. Utilize all troops and marshals you have, but don't forget to produce more troops while fighting. You might need them!

We've freed our first potential colony from its adversaries! Now, we should build up our defences and claim it so it'll produce resources for us.
You can build defence buildings by opening the build menu in your colony zone. There you can spend the defence points you acquired by conquering the colony to construct defensive buildings.

Once a colony island has been conquered, you can build additional defences on it to protect it. Handily, our show of force and determination has convinced the local bandit leaders to fight on our side. We should improve their defence, cover its weak points, and do all we can to prevent other conquerors from taking the island from us.

Now that we've put our defences in place, we should make this island officially ours:
Claim the island by pressing the "Claim Colony" button in the Colony Management menu. It will then start producing your resources.

In each sector, you will see two camps - a melee camp and a sector boss camp. This first melee camp does not look well defended, so we should try to defeat that first.
Use a marshal, along with some attack archers to defeat the camp. Attack units are good for defeating enemies quickly.
Also note that attack archers will do bonus damage to enemy melee units, while your own melee units won't. Melee units do well against cavalry instead.

Now, let's see what we can do against that sector leader... When you hover over the camp, you'll notice that there are two unit types in there, plus the leader itself. This battle will require some tactical skill.
You'll need to change your units mid-battle. When attacking, note that the first enemy unit to be deployed is marked with an extra frame. You should bring a unit that'll be strong against it, and switch your unit type when the enemy makes a switch.

Ok, now that we managed to succeed, let's see if we can refine our strategy. This is where our heavy units come into play.
Heavy units are excellent at taking a lot of damage, and can last a long time in combat. Attack a melee camp with your heavy units, so the camp will have its watch area deactivated. As there is only one unit type in there, you can let them fight on their own.
Once the battle's begun, you can lead another marshal, along with some attack units, past the melee camp to attack the leader's camp.
And here's the best bit: When you defeat the leader, all other units in this sector will flee. That way, we can save a lot of our troops.

Before actually looking for a new island to explore, we should recruit some more troops.
Remember: A colony island is only available for a short amount of time, so you should always have troops prepared before starting the expedition.

Merry Christmas, old friend! I’ve brought some new things with me to make this year’s Christmas even better!
Let me show you the new Christmas surprise, and how to get presents!
My reindeers are gone! Someone must have stolen them! How am I ever going to deliver those presents now!? This is your chance! You can save the day!
I found the evildoer who stole my Reindeers! He's hiding on an Island. I guess we should set sail and pay him a visit!
I found the evildoer who stole my Reindeers! He's hiding on an Island. I guess we should set sail and pay him a visit!
I found the evildoer who stole my Reindeers! He's hiding on an Island. I guess we should set sail and pay him a visit!
The next thing I want to show you requires you to be Level 16. Please come back when you've gained enough experience. For someone with your potential, that shouldn't take too long!
For the next task you need to be Level 23. Please come back when you've gained enough experience.
For the next task you need to be Level 26. Please come back when you've gained enough experience.

First, let's take a look at the brand-new Christmas surprise. Every day, you get to open a door, and find valuable things inside!
For special days like Christmas Eve or New Year’s Eve, you can choose in advance what reward you'd like to have.
And if you manage to open all the doors, you'll get a really special reward!
Even if you miss a door, you can always come back and open it afterwards with some gems.

The next thing I want to show you is how you can produce your own Christmas presents.
For this we need Christmas Bells, Candy Canes and Gingerbread. You can find those things on your Island - all you have to do is pick them up.

Now that we have enough things to build our presents, we should give it a try!
Click on your mayor's house, select the "Collections" tab and produce a basket of presents.

The last thing I wanted to tell you is that your explorers can also find presents during their treasure searches.
Try it out, and send one of your explorers on a short treasure search.

Let me tell you a little secret. It's not the reindeers that let my sleigh fly. They're just for show. I mean, I could use kittens, but imagine how silly that would look…
The trick here is a magic potion which can make any animal fly. So here's the plan: First, we'll train some horses, and we'll gather some wood to build fake antlers with. After all, they need to look like reindeers when people see them flying!
Then I simply give them my potion, and they should be able to help me deliver my presents.

I'm back, but I'm afraid I can't find the ingredients I need to brew the potion...
Perhaps you could help me out?
Here, take this list. That's everything you need to get. Oh, and could you bring me some malt brew while you’re at it?

Unfortunately, the guy who stole my reindeers has bribed the rulers of the island to protect him!
It seems we'll need to take an army with us if we're going to get them back!

I should have known! The evildoer was hired by the Croaker!
I don't know where he's hiding right now, but I think we need to build ourselves back up, and get ready for a showdown.

I should have known! The evildoer was hired by the Croaker!
I don't know where he's hiding right now, but I think we need to build ourselves back up, and get ready for a showdown.

I should have known! The evildoer was hired by the Croaker!
I don't know where he's hiding right now, but I think we need to build ourselves back up, and get ready for a showdown.

Unfortunately, the guy who stole my reindeers has bribed the rulers of the island to protect him!
It seems we'll need to take an Army with us if we're going to get them back!

Unfortunately, the guy who stole my reindeers has bribed the rulers of the island to protect him!
It seems we'll need to take an Army with us if we're going to get them back!
To get information about the Christmas event, open the Event Window. You can reach it via the option panel right underneath your avatar picture

We need to help Santa deliver some of his presents! It might be an idea to start with the first adventure. Open your Star Menu, start the gift delivery adventure and visit the adventure zone.
Hint: You'll get the adventure from the first green door in the Christmas calendar.

Now that we know what gifts we need to deliver, we should start to produce them! Go to your Provision House and produce some of the objects required. We're going to need them if we want to make everyone happy!
Hint: If you have a Rarity Provision House, you can produce the same items there much faster.

Now that we know what gifts we need to deliver, we should start to produce them! Go to your Provision House and produce some of the objects required. We're going to need them if we want to make everyone happy!
Hint: If you have a Rarity Provision House, you can produce the same items there much faster.

Now that we know what gifts we need to deliver, we should start to produce them! Go to your Provision House and produce some of the objects required. We're going to need them if we want to make everyone happy!
Hint: If you have a Rarity Provision House, you can produce the same items there much faster.
Now finish delivering the presents to all the inhabitants on that island. This should give Santa a bit of a helping hand!
Use the Christmas present buffs being produced in the provision house and the rarity provision house to help all family members in non-Christmassy houses get into the Christmas spirit.

In order to learn about the Colony mode and PvP, please check out the PvP section in our archive.
You will also find some important information on maintenance that's well worth a read.

These expeditions can be very dangerous. We need to be sure that not only are we taking enough troops with us, but that we have enough medical supplies too. Our provisioner now can produce expedition medipacks. With these, we can instantly revive our marshals, should they be defeated in battle. You should probably produce some - just in case, of course.

Hello there! I'm glad you agreed to help us! Allow me to introduce myself - my name's Oliver, and I'm the mining supervisor. Still, there's no time to waste - let's get stuck in!
Hint: All required buffs can be produced in the provision house.
I'm glad we have you on board! We need to check the quality of the ore on this island. Take a look around, and let's find some sample mountain ore.
This is the important bit. With the ground cleared, we can build the outpost. Please provide us with a tavern, a storehouse and some masons.
Before we can construct our mining post, we'll have to clear some space. At the moment, there's just no room for construction. Let's get rid of some trees and stones.
Most of the ore is hidden deep in the mountain. That means we'll need to make a hole in the mountain, and we'll need something to stabilize the hole, so that mountain doesn't collapse.

Good stuff! The miners are hard at work, and everything's going according to plan. However, they'll soon need some food and support. We're still working on a food supply line, but could you help bring the first provisions?
Hint: If you've already applied the food provision, wait 10 minutes, then you can apply them a second time.
We have a problem. A nearby village sent some forces to sabotage our mining efforts. Please, stop them, before they can do us any harm or everything we've achieved here will have been in vain!

I'm glad you've answered our call for help. This sickness has infested the forest, and it keeps spreading. It seems to be coming from the center of the forest, where the heart tree, the magical tree that keeps everything green, has started to wither. We need to treat all the trees and animals, before they all die out!
Hint: All required buffs can be produced in the provision house.

The sickness from the woods is spreading to the local wildlife. Some of the animals are so sick that they can't even find the strength to leave their caves! We need to feed them up, so that they can build up their strength.
I know of a special medicinal plant you can find on our island. Gather it, and use it to make some animal feed, so we can treat the animals in those caves.

Most of the living things on our island depend on the magic of the heart tree. You've probably seen this massive tree in the middle of the forest. That is the heart tree, a plant that brings life to the forest itself.
While you were away taking care of the animals, we found the cause of the disease. Our heart tree is ill, and now, rather than life, it's been spreading its disease to the other trees. We need to cure it.
We need to gather some special flowers and make a potion that might revive it.

Now that the heart tree has been healed, we need to take care of the other trees. Especially some of the older ones. They will not be able to recover all by themselves.
You'll have to use the heart fruits from the heart tree to rejuvenate them.

Sadly, some of the trees were too far gone, and could not be saved. Could you please cut them down? Maybe we can at least find a good use for their wood. We could use the dead wood to make some special fertilizer that should strengthen the heart tree for the future.

The guilds in both towns used to share their grain harvest. They used to meet in the Grain House to negotiate and distribute it equally - but one day, an argument began over who'd produced the best products, and who deserved the most grain. Since that day, the Grain House has gone unused, and each guild has simply fought to keep the most grain. Maybe you can help the two guilds to re-enter negotiations?
Hint: All required buffs can be produced in the provision house.

Oh, hi there! I'm the administrator of this estate... or what's left of it. It was me who called you here for help! Those stubborn Grain Islanders - bakers, brewers, the lot of 'em - have been driving me insane! They used to negotiate the grain split here, but they can't do much more than bicker recently...
If we want to get them back at the table and start negotiating again, we need to fix up this... place... I wouldn't mind seeing the old place tarted up a bit either...

Alrighty then! Now that we have a place where we can sit the brewers and bakers back together again, we get to the most delicate part: Actually getting them here in the first place! I'll leave it up to your expert negotiation skills to convince each party to come back to the table. The origin of all this fighting is that each party claimed they would create the best product. We need a ruse to get them back at the table:
Help me produce some bread and beer. Then, all we need to do is to feed it to the opposing party, and sell it like it was yours! If they love it like I think they will, we'll just tell them the truth - that this kind of quality has been on that island all along!

Alright then! We've got everybody coming to the Grain House's reopening. This time, I really want to make sure that everything goes smoothly... No, not just smoothly! Everything needs to be perfect! Nobody likes to negotiate on an empty stomach. Thus, I was wondering if you could delight us with a specialty of your own kingdom?

Thank you for the help. However, I did have another urgent task. Two children from our town are missing. They're twins and were last seen yesterday. We have a big, dangerous swamp nearby, and we're worried they may have strayed nearby... You have to find them!
Hint: All required buffs can be produced in the provision house.

First of all, we need to create a safe path for our rescue team. There aren't too many areas of firm ground in the swamp. Please, set up bridges over these impassable areas, so that our rescue team can cross the swamp.

While the search patrols are combing the area, we should check with the villagers to see if anyone's seen something. Let's make some broadsheets and ask around. Maybe we'll get lucky?!
Hint: If you've already applied the broadsheets, wait 10 minutes, then you can apply them a second time.

We found them! Thanks to the hints, we managed to find the twins - but they're trapped in an old ruin within the swamps and cannot come out on their own. Please, help the patrol get them out of there.

You're not going to believe who's offered to work for us. A shotfirer wants to demonstrate his skills, by blowing up a mountain for us. Shall we give it a try? If yes, you can find him in the star menu.

For a long time now, where Easter eggs come from has been one of life's biggest mysteries. Well, here's the truth. In a well hidden village, on a well hidden island, in a well hidden part of the world, there lies a small egg farm. But lately, there's been a problem. Polecats have overrun the island, and occupied the chickens' nests so they can't lay any eggs! Help the chickens to get their nests back.
A group of polecats scared away the chickens! If we want the chickens to hatch their eggs, we'll have to drive them away from the nests.
In order to make sure that the polecats don't cause any more havoc, we should try to catch them. The best bait to use is a special polecat gin.
Now that the predators have been safely removed from the island, all we need to do is to find the chickens. They should be hiding somewhere on the island
Now we have all the chickens - but they look a little bit scared? Perhaps even... unhinged? Maybe we can calm them down a little bit, and get them to roost?
The scouts report that collectible items have appeared on the island. You should go and gather them up! If you can find them all, they'll be transferred to your home island.

Ok, you won't believe me when I say this, but... I've brought you a little present. You know, since it's Easter and all. Easter!
Anyway, I need your help with some various Easter related tasks. Since I know there are a lot of slackers out there, I've decided to only be nice to those who really help me out.
So, here's the deal: I'll give you this cool Easter residence building for free. It's unique, and only for this Easter. But instead of paying for your upgrade, I want you to do stuff for me. What kind of stuff? Well, let's start at the beginning.

So, you want to know what I need you to do?
Check out the achievement panel! There are specific Easter-related achievements there, which you can only complete during this event. Each achievement is worth a certain amount of points.
I will give you the Easter achievement building now. Instead of spending resources on upgrades, it can be upgraded when you earn achievements and collect achievement points from the Easter event. Every new upgrade level will require more points.
Check out how you can go about earning points in the respective achievement section.

Now I need you to place the building. It's a specific residence which currently holds 40 settlers. With every upgrade, it will be able to hold more tenants.
To get the highest level, you'll need to finish almost all the achievements for me. Sounds like a lot of work? Well, it will be - but it'll be worth it when you can show off your shiny new level 5 achievement building.
Who else can say, he has a giant Easter egg-like house in his kingdom?

An anxious villager approaches you asking for help. There was a serious storm on their island, and the villagers can't afford the essential repairs. The harvest was bad, and hunger is starting to haunt the people. Are you willing to help them?

As you arrive on the island, you can see the destruction the storm has caused. But no matter how much you want to help rebuild the houses, the fields are more important now. Clear the fields of the dead crops, and ready them up for new ones.

Until the crops grow, we should start to rebuild the town. There are so many things to do! First, the area needs to be cleared of any debris so we can start afresh on the construction. We should count how many boulders there are, and produce just enough dynamite at the provision house to destroy them all! We don't want to spend valuable goods making dynamite that we won't use! Boulders of different sizes need different types of dynamite.

After clearing the area, it's time to get to the buildings! But first, there are some preparations we need to take care of. Create some stinky potions and decomposers in your provision house, but don't use them yet! We're going to need them all later.
Attention: This quest will fail if you use a Stinky potion or a Decomposer.

Now that we've moved everything out of the way, it's time to get on with the reconstruction! Be careful, though. Not every building can be placed on every slot! Pay attention to which slots highlight when you choose a building kit, and then plan very carefully which buildings you can place where. Do you have some pen and paper around?
Note: If you run out of spaces to place the required buildings before you've placed them, you will fail this quest!

Now that we've put everything back to normal, it's time to make sure this won't happen again. Help them repair their prevention system! The tubes outside the building seem to have developed some cracks. Do you have anything that might fix them?

Congratulations! By completing the training expedition, you have reached PvP level 2. Check out the PvP progression window beneath your avatar to collect your rewards. Your rewards will be saved for you, until you collect them.

As the great leader of the expedition forces, you have been awarded a water castle. This water castle shall be a symbol of your experience. Place it in the lake in the middle of your island. Right now, it may only look like a small tower, but with every 2 PvP levels you gain, it will increase its size - and our kingdom's glory.

Ahh! What a surprise! Welcome to the islands of Enhar, the most exotic place you will ever see! My name is Noble Ludwig, but my friends call me Master Ludwig. Judging from your garments, I see that you are a noble yourself! Please, follow me to my abode. I have a proposition for you.

You might ask why I would choose to live alone here. Unfortunately, I have the perfect answer: I didn't. I was robbed. A warlord known as Berim Khalar raided my islands and took everything from me! I was the only one who escaped! Help me recover my fortune, and I promise you will be well rewarded! Explore the region and find a place where we can start a new settlement.

The smell of a new beginning! It's in your mouth, in your eyes and in your hair. But there is no time to waste! The next step is to build a storehouse on the newly explored sector! Don't worry, I have a diploma in engineering, so I can help you draw up the plans! Go now, and order your settlers to build a storehouse.

Quick! Wake up! Berim Khalar's men were spotted by your scouts! They have a small camp not far from here. I don't think they know we're here yet, though, so we must strike as soon as possible! Call on your general to gather his men and clear out the enemy's camp!

Now that everything's been prepared, you can start getting rid of the rats, worms and other obstacles. When presented with a choice about what to use to get rid of them, pay attention to your item availability! The stinky potions and decomposers are very limited. I recommend using them only when it is strictly necessary!
Attention: This quest will fail if you don't have enough stinky potions or decomposers to clear the remaining vermin.

My, what an unusual coin. Did someone really pay with this? It looks so exotic... Maybe it's even worth something! I have an... acquaintance... that really knows his foreign currency. Perhaps we should get him to give it an appraisal?

The surroundings of Tikki Island have been afflicted by a curse due to the missing sacred coin! We can't leave the Tikki like this... We must get this coin back to them! We'll need to craft the best ships and pack enough supplies to make it through the cursed storm.

This is terrible! Most of the bandits that came to steal the Tikki's treasure got stranded on Tikki Island due to the curse, and now they've decided to settle there! They're oppressing the poor Tikki, and making them do their bidding by force! This deed cannot go unpunished. We must save the Tikki tribe!

One of our merchants stopped by earlier, and told me he'd been paid with a strange coin. It looks similar to ours, but it's definitely not from around here. It's a pretty looking thing, and clearly hand-crafted. Maybe we should investigate this some more?

We just stopped some smugglers at the port, who were trying to get illegal merchandise onto our island. Hidden amongst their goods, we found a malnourished panda cub. Poor little panda... Who would do something like this? We must return him to his habitat and to his mother!

Oh no, this is terrible! The smugglers took this little panda away from his mother, and now he's too sad to eat or drink anything. Perhaps you should try to feed him. He seems to have taken a shining to you.

Now the little panda's been nursed back to good health, it's time we return him to his mother. We need to create a cage that resembles the trees on his homeland so he won't get nervous on the trip back - and we'll need a sailor that can get him there safely.

The king of a neighbouring kingdom has cordially invited us to the wedding of his son, the prince, and humbly asks us to make and deliver the wedding cake. There will be a lot of people, so apparently "it better be huge"!
I have already arranged the best bakers in our kingdom to help us create the best wedding cake of all time. They're all ready to start, as soon as you provide them with the required ingredients.

Greetings my dear friend. May I introduce myself? My name is Schahri and I am the king of a small empire, which lies far away in the sands. I am approaching you to discuss an urgent matter. I am searching for my lovely wife Scheherazade, who went missing several days ago. The tracks led us here, but those sword clashers have forced us to call off our search. Will you help me defeat them?

One of the bandits was very talkative. He told us about a stronghold, where they keep their prisoners. I want to ask you for another favor. Will you help me find this stronghold? My wife might be there.

The sun is burning and the sand is hot, what strange lands these are. Ali Baba approaches you holding a map in his hand. The map shows a location where a woman is hold captive, and a path showing you how to get there. But there are outposts guarding the path.

Travelling during the night was a lot easier than doing so during the day, so we reached the location in good time Ali Baba and some of your scouts searched the area, and found a bandit camp close by.
Travelling through day and night you finally caught up with the caravan. It’s time to strike - and don’t give the thief chance to make another escape.

My lord, it has caught my attention that your settlers are not taking advantage of the resources that grow on the Enhar islands! Have you ever heard of the amazing mahogany wood? No? Well then, prepare to be astonished!

My love for wood is endless, but sadly, mahogany wood is very rare. There are certain merchants who'll pay off gangs of woodcutters to locate this rare wood. They pay a good coin for it. Send your armies to explore the new adventures, so they can bring back some of that mahogany wood!

Mahogany wood, when it comes in its natural form, can be used to build all kinds of structures or vehicles. But I gather you know best what you will use it for! I heard one of your woodcutters talking, and apparently your people know a way to shape wood! The "sawmill", I believe they called it. So why not build one mahogany sawmill!

I want to see with my own eyes how these sawmills work. Can you please indulge me, my lord, and produce a number of planks for me? I, well, I mean, not for me - for the people, of course… of course. Produce some mahogany planks!
Mahogany wood is hard to get around these islands. It is a privilege, you see? But fear not! We have plenty of exotic wood!

We cannot waste the rare wood! I will… I mean, we, will need wood in order to rebuild my empire… I, er, I mean my settlement - what is wrong with me today…? All in all, you should build an exotic woodcutter. That would be a good start.

Hold it! Your men are cutting down the wood like there's no tomorrow! I don't want to rule over a land that has no trees! Here, I've managed to save a bag of exotic wood seeds. Give this bag to your settlers and build an exotic wood forester's hut to take care of the problem.
Now that we have everything we need to produce wood, I think the next step should be to fill up the storehouse. Let's produce some exotic wood - it's always good to have some on hand.
Platinum is an amazing ore. I love how it shines - and how you can craft so many valuable things using it. The next step is to make sure we're ready to produce it!

Platinum is a rare ore to find, but not the rarest! If you have an educated smelter, he can work magic with it! But before he can do that, you'll need to smelt it and make those shiny bars. Build a platinum smelter!

I see your settlers have some talent when it comes to weapon crafting! The best way for us to make use of that platinum is to turn it into weapons! We'll need weapons if we're to take on the armies of Berim Khalar after all! Build a platinum weaponsmith.

In my kingdo- er, I mean, on my island, we equip our best soldiers with weapons forged from platinum. I'm sure you do the same for your own elite guard? The enemy should never be underestimated, we need the best! Build an elite barrack.

My lord, I've been doing some mathematics and crunching the numbers, and I'm pleased to say I've reached my conclusion. We need more ore! Yes, you see here? If we want to have a proper army we'll need all the weapons we can produce. Wake up your settlers and have them look for some platinum ore!

You can make the most exquisite swords out of platinum! The strongest warrior I ever encountered fought using only swords crafted from the finest platinum. I'm sure your weaponsmith is familiar with the crafting technique! Have him make us some platinum swords!
We need to show the people that they're always safe! I would suggest a small ceremony where soldiers can mingle amongst the people, and talk to the folk! Train a swordsman at the barracks!
Berim Khalar has a talent for finding and hiring the most dangerous mischief makers out there. In order to defeat him, we're going to need some horsemen!

As I've mentioned before, in order to defeat Berim Khalar and his armies, we'll need some troops of our own. Plain soldiers will simply not suffice - we need to aim for the best. Let us prepare! What we need first is a homestead for the wool.

The pack of wool the shepherd sent over needs to be taken care of! I'm not too fond of wool myself, as it often… produces a very unpleasant smell, if you know what I mean. We need to build a clothier's hut.

My future plans include horses, and soldiers that can ride them. We need to provide them with comfortable saddles, for comfort should not be an issue when they run into battle. Build a saddlecloth weaver!
We have the best horses and the best saddles! The only thing we need to do now is to add those two together! Have your stable master produce some battle horses for us.

The best way to engage the enemy is by doing it on horseback. I know this, because I have a diploma in battle-tactics. The enemy should be surprised when they see your mounted regiment! Order your trainers to train some mounted swordsmen!

I once owned a book that originated from your lands! It tells a story of a knight that battled countless enemies to save a damsel in distress! I believe we need knights like that in our army! Have some knights trained at the barracks.
We have the frontline ready! Now we need to create the ranged division of the army! Let us ready the archers!

My lord, do you know what an arquebus is? Well of course you do! A beautiful ranged weapon like this cannot remain unnoticed. I would like to advise you summon your artisan, and see if they can make you one. Build an arquebus maker.

Your artisan seems to lack patience. He's sent me countless letters describing what he needs to make those weapons, even though I'm sure you've already prepared everything for him! Please, have him produce us some arquebuses.

While we're spending most of our time preparing for the battle, your army is getting… how should I put it… sloppy? Maybe not the best word to use. Anyway, I've spoken with one of your explorers, and he told me he's more than eager to go exploring. Have your explorer search for an epic adventure!

We need arrows, to rain DEADLY HELL FIRE down on our hated enemies!! Ahhh ha ha haaaaa! Oh, er, I... I'm sorry, I got carried away. We have our horsemen and our knights. Now, we need some ranged support. For this, we need people who can man the ranged weapons. Our best bet would be to train a number of marksmen.

One of your archers found me the other day, and expressed his concerns regarding their armour. Apparently the boiled leather we're giving them is not enough - they want more. I believe it would be best to train some armoured marksmen who could protect the others in need.

Now this… ahh! This is unexpected! Some of your marksmen requested to be transferred to the frontline! Can you imagine? A frontline that contains ranged soldiers? I have never heard of such… wait a second, that's actually not such a bad idea after all! Train some mounted marksmen, and let's see what comes out of this.

Every good army needs siege weapons. You never know where the enemy may hole themselves up. Even if they hide behind their precious walls, if we bring siege weapons with us, we can crush their defences!

My lord, our enemies often hide behind solid walls. Instead of climbing those walls, we could destroy them. But for that we need big explosives! And to move big things, we'll need wagons. I think it's time to build a wagon maker.

I was told about the mortars your people can build. My lord, if you don't mind me saying, you seem a dangerous sort. Yet I want my islands back, and I will not back out. Build a foundry so we can continue our preparations!

Mortars! This is exciting, my lord! When we reconquer my islands, I will make sure King Schahri learns about this new breed of warfare! What? You've never met King Schahri? Well then - I'd best introduce you as soon as time allows! But let us not get lost in details, make me... err... make us some mortars!

My lord! While browsing your library, I found a book that mentioned a machine called "the besieger"! We absolutely need to build some of these! We could even adapt the mortar we made! These machines can destroy even the most fortified walls if used correctly! Build some besiegers!

My lord, we need to expand, and we need to do it quickly. Several scouts were sent out, and most of them returned with the news that the surrounding areas are all occupied by bandits! Gather your men and defeat the bandits!

Oh my. A bird just flew into the room - an exotic one! It came bearing a message. Let me read it to you: "Ahem! Help! I am being held as a prisoner in the Watery Woods! Please send help!" The Watery Woods... That's where all those bandits come from! The prisoner seems to be a member of the royal family, as he was using a special kind of writing. Prepare an expedition to save him! We will need horses, wagons and arquebuses!
Oh no! The wood's causing problems again! It seems we have another shortage. Most of the buildings we built require wood. I think we should consider filling up our storehouses again.
