The Nords are back! Our explorers report that they spotted the Nords on a nearby island. Ready our troops! We need to take down this threat as soon as possible.

Our gold deposits are not providing enough ore to satisfy the coin makers' needs. What a greedy bunch! Since we're in times of need, I'd suggest we "cheat" and obtain some extra coins from adventure loot.

Working with a guild comes with plenty of advantages. You get a bunch of helpful allies, and can obtain exclusive rewards by working together and accruing guild coins. Why not get a few of those exclusive rewards?

Some of our allies, especially those who haven't progressed as much as we have, are often in need of a helping hand. Let's show them that we're willing to help without getting anything in return by sending them some gift baskets.
Our tax manager has suggested that if we want to obtain the best possible profit, we'll need to use the trade office more often. He's right, you know. Let's do something about it!
The hardest materials to come by at this point are mahogany wood and platinum ore, and clearly this is what we need the most right now. Let's buy some at the trade office.

Collectibles are a great way of giving yourself a slight advantage, without putting in a whole lot of effort. If I let you in on a little secret, I actually find looking for them quite fun. Care to join me?
The king has requested that we provide certain materials and weapons to keep one of his most notorious prisons working at full capacity. Can we spare a few of these?
We've received a surprise visit from an inspector that's come to check on your production chains. He will settle for nothing less than absolute perfection, so make sure they're working at full-force.
Some say that certain skilled geologists can actually find more than the maximum deposit size for certain minerals. I've never seen one of them in action, can you show me how they work?
Our elite army is where our true strength lies. As we all know, it can never really have enough units, so let's work on increasing our elite ranks a little.
There are rumours that a sea monster has been observed on a desert island to the east, and is wreaking havoc on the nearby villages. Maybe we should check that everything's OK.

We aren't the only ones who think colonies are valuable. Some other ill-intentioned ne'er-do-wells may try to take our colonies from us. In order to keep the income flowing we need to retain as many colonies as possible. Notify your marshals! We're departing immediately!
A refugee from an eastern island has come asking for help. Apparently a bunch of bandits and enraged... "apes?" have taken their city under siege. We must help!

If we want to obtain the really big rewards from our combined efforts, the entire guild is going to have to cooperate to obtain the precious guild coins. Let's work on that! Otherwise, I guess you can always buy guild coins at the trade office...
The day of the books is here! Some of our neighbours don't yet have access to the finest books, and it's traditional that we help them out. Let's offer a few of them up for trade.
We need to remind our allies that we're grateful for their constant support. Maybe a bunch of gift baskets will do the trick.
One of our scientists is convinced that he can turn gunpowder into gold. I personally think he's insane, but he's asked that we buy some for him to try.
Croaker is hiding in a camp in the north of this island. Take it out and return the presents he stole!
Will you help Santa deliver some presents? I hid an adventure in the first door of your Christmas calendar. Open the door, start the adventure and off we go!

Let's try using a zone-wide buff! You can easily identify them in the star menu thanks to their green border. Buff your home island with the fairy fire I gave you earlier and observe its effects in the zone-wide buffs window.

Not all buffs are applied to buildings; some are applied to a whole island! You can check which of these are currently active by clicking on the golden sparkles in the resource bar at the top of the screen.
No offence, but the way your city is right now, it's really not ready to hold the festivities. If you can grow it just a little bit more, we'll be all set!

Surprise! I've brought you a little present since it's Easter, and, well, you know, Easter! Anyway, I need your help with some Easter related tasks. Since I know there are a lot of slackers out there, I've decided to only be generous to those who really help me out.
So, here's the deal: I'll give you this cool university for your island. It's unique and only available this Easter. But instead of paying for your upgrade, I want you to do stuff for me. What kind of stuff? Well, let's start at the beginning.

So, what do I need you to do?
Check out the Achievement panel! There are specific Easter-related achievements that you can only do during this event. Each achievement gives you points specific to this event.
I will give you the Easter Achievement building now. Instead of spending resources on upgrades, it can be upgraded when you earn achievements and collect more achievement points from the Easter event. Every new upgrade level will require more points.
Check out what you can do in the Achievement panel!

Of course, before you can start upgrading it and take advantage of this lovely building, you'll need to place it somewhere on your island.
A university, though? Where would you put a university? Maybe near to plenty of residencies? I can imagine people not wanting to walk a long way from their homes?

Oh no, this is bad! These guys are the party crashers. They're trying to ruin our Easter festivities by taking some of our eggs! We can fight them, or we can try to smooth things over peacefully. The choice is yours, but we have to address this problem before they cause more trouble!
Ugh... here they are again. These guys seem to be fixated on crashing our party - and this time, they've bought backup! How will we deal with them today?

Wow, they really have gone all-out on this one. As usual, we have more than one way of dealing with this problem, but it seems that either way would be a challenge. What will it be?
I personally believe that this situation can be resolved without fighting. Maybe if we give them something they really like, we can reach a truce and they'll stop bothering us for a while.
So these guys want to prepare for trouble? Then make it double! If we send our troops to "meet them", I'm sure they'll have second thoughts, and will go look for trouble somewhere else.

This year we decided to hold a "Do-it-yourself" fair to teach people be more crafty and self-sufficient. The guild has been asked to take care of all preparations, so we all have to pitch in!
So these guys want to prepare for trouble? Then make it double! If we send our troops to "meet them", I'm sure they'll have second thoughts, and will go look for trouble somewhere else.

One of our bakers has offered to host a workshop where people can learn how to make some fine bread. Or at least, the basics of making fine bread - he doesn't want to lose any business after all! He's requested that we offer some materials to help with the preparations.

There's a lot of things that can be done with wood and planks, and we'd like to teach them to craft a few easy things. You know, the usual: a stool, a table... We'll need to provide a bit of hardwood, and some tools for this to be a success.

We invited a professional scribe to come to our island and teach a few things about calligraphy to anyone who wants to learn. He was happy to accept... As long as we provide the materials for the drill.

There's a lot more to archery than just shooting a bow. Crafting the bow itself properly requires finesse and practice, and our local bowmaker wanted to hold a workshop to explain why. He's requested a few examples of our longbows for this purpose.

Not everyone is partial to a bit of fish, bread and sausage! Some people have a bit more of an acquired taste, and we want to "treat" them to a cooking course so they can learn some delicious recipes. Let's provide the ingredients!
Our carpenters want to host a more advanced woodcraft course for those who already know their saws from their chisels. We want to teach them how to make sturdy carriages for their domestic needs.

Did you know that gunpowder could be used to season food? How about as a medical supply? I didn't! Our local gunpowder handler would like to teach the public these, and many more facts about the many uses of gunpowder, but he needs us to provide some materials first.

Lumps of granite can be turned into beautiful works of art with the right tools and knowledge. We would like to hold a sculpting workshop for local art aficionados. We need to provide some granite and lots of tools for it, though.
We've been tasked today with providing the entertainment for the children. I already have some ideas, but we'll need the help of the whole guild to pull it off. Can I count on you all?
The kids are impressed with how the bowmen handle their bows, so we've decided to craft some safe toy bows for them to play with, a get a feel for archery. Let's get to it!
It's nice and warm today, so how about we make a small pool for the kids to splash around in and have some fun? I'm sure they'll love it.
Let's have some horseback riding areas spread around for the kids to enjoy. I've already talked to the stables, and they're willing to spare enough horses. Can you take care of the rest?

We called upon a famed storyteller from a neighbouring kingdom to come and tell us of adventures and tales that have never been heard before. Could we get some paper so we could have a written copy of the stories for the future?

Kids love tree forts. We've decided to make a few of them around the island in the pine trees, so there are enough for everyone. I just hope they leave the "no girls allowed" thing be. That is so last century...

Our stable masters have made a small circuit where the kids can race horses. Of course, it's all safe and measured. I checked personally! We just need to provide the carriages and horses, and they'll take care of the rest.
We've got to make sure there are enough food stalls around so nobody gets hungry! How about we make some sausage stands to distribute food?

Our local boy scout group needs new uniforms. The old ones are starting to get worn out and the colours are not what they used to be. Can we provide some cloth and platinum to our local tailors so they can make new, shiny uniforms?

We hardly ever appreciate the efforts of our workers on our island, so I thought it may be a good idea to have our own celebration in their honour. Let's gather the guild to make sure this festival is as good as they deserve!

Our local fishermen have approached me to suggest that the festival may be a good chance to improve their business, so they wanted to host a small event. Can we provide some refreshments for the attendants?

There's a new trend for having your name engraved on marble slabs and using them as decorations on your home. Our artisans have decided to take up a few requests. Can we perhaps help them out with the marble?

The famous writer and work counselor Jerdaint will grace us with his presence at a book-signing session at the festival! We have to make sure that he has enough paper and nibs to sign all the books he can!
There's always been a friendly rivalry between the militia and the soldiers. They've requested a small space and some weapons so they can settle their differences. Can we provide?

No festival would be complete without the traditional brew-chugging contest! The stomach that can hold the most brew will win a fabulous prize that... Oh, wait, there's no prize? We need to change that!
We're expecting a lot of attendants at this festival, so we have to make sure we have enough food for everyone. Let's try to get enough grub for the traditional festive barbecue!

Woah! With all the festival preparations we've been doing, we forgot that people would still be searching and finding eggs. They've almost found them all! I've gathered our best horse riders to quickly hide a bunch more, but we need horses and carriages for them to use!

In order to keep the Easter festivities relevant, we'd like to host an egg decorating contest for everyone who wants to participate. We'll need to provide some fine ornaments for people to use. Could you please gather some?

Several ambassadors from neighbouring kingdoms and lands are coming to visit, and we have to make sure that their visit goes without any problems, so they can put in a good word for us with their leaders. Our guild has been commissioned with this task!
I like to think of ourselves as hospitable hosts, and so I'd like to have a nice memory of the ambassadors being here. We should make a visitor book where we can record their signatures.

Our guests have to eat! I've already devised a menu for them to choose from over the next few days, so the hardest part has been taken care of. What we need from you, is to provide the bread and the brew to accompany these delicacies!
The ambassadors' visit is the perfect time to show how proficient our ironworks are. We should show off how our blacksmiths' work the iron by holding a demonstration session.

Our carpenters work hard to always provide the finest longbows in the kingdom. Our archers have also grown accustomed to these bows, so how about impressing our guests by shooting some flying sausages with arrows?
One of our guests has asked about the process of manufacturing our wheels, since to the naked eye, they seem to be free of imperfections. Why don't we take him to one of our workshops and show him?

If we want to show the ambassadors that we're reliable as potential allies, we need to show them how important they are to us. Please arrange some visits to our allies and make sure they have all they need!
We're in charge of arranging the celebration party for their arrival. Make sure they feel welcomed with a fancy fireworks show!
One of the ambassadors has come to us enquiring about adventures, and has shown some interest in taking part in one first-hand. Would you kindly take him to see one?

This time our guild is in charge of the Capital Island's Easter egg competition! They seem to have liked ours so much they wanted it for themselves - but I say we can make it even better. Think we can pull this off?

Our assignment is to have enough crates to be able to store the eggs that are going to be used in the competition. We're going to need a bit of extra manpower for this... Can you pay a visit to our allies and ask for help?

Well, this is a problem... It seems that we don't have enough actual eggs to use in the competition. But have no fear, I have an idea - why don't we make some artificial eggs out of marble? It would definitely do the trick!

Our task is to provide the third prize for the competition. We have received a request for some raw gold ore. Also, we've been instructed to deliver invitations to our close allies, so let's get to it.

The competition is going to pull in a lot of people, and the food may not be enough to go around. Let's make sure that we ask our allies to make sure that our food factories are on top of their game, and that we provide enough meat for the contest.
We've been asked to provide the podium where the winners will stand at the end of the competition. We're going to need some exotic planks and gold for that to happen. Can you produce some?
We're running short on eggs for the competition, and the only way to meet the quota would be to head over to an adventure and obtain some more there. Grab your troops, we're going on an egg hunt!

The king wants to log the names of the competition's record holders on a big piece of parchment that will be displayed in the town square. We need to provide the fine paper for that, and platinum to adorn the document.

We're running a bit short on the budget for the competition, so we'll need to pull together some extra funds wherever we can. It's time to hit the markets with some rare materials - that will definitely get us what we need!
Greetings. I hope you can help me. I found this person near the tavern. It seems he cannot remember where he is or was. I don't know what to do with him. Could you take care of him?

Where am I? I can't remember anything… It seems I went a little overboard last night. Oh that's right - my pal the Easter bunny asked me to help him hide Easter eggs! But where are they? Hmm... Could you please help me? I'm sure my memory will come back if you give me some brew! Not the rough stuff you can purchase. I want the good, self produced stuff!
I remember myself walking across an island. Hmm.. But where? I'm sure it wasn't here. Could you send out one of your explorers? Maybe he can find a clue.
Looks like a kind of treasure map. Hmm… It shows an island. I need you to get me there! Don't look at me like that - do you want to disappoint the Easter bunny? Come on, let's go!

I can't just go to my Easter pal and tell him some eggs are missing! We need to further enlighten our minds. Since brew doesn't seem to work, we should use bread and water instead. Give me some of yours, and make sure it's the good stuff!
So, this is where we should go. I know, it is no Picasso painting, but it will have to do. Why are you still standing there? Come on, the eggs won't gather themselves!
I am really sorry, but I couldn't hold this man back. He says you owe him eggs. Honestly, I have no idea what he is talking about, but maybe… Hey!

Hey you! One of your settlers has run into my wagon and broken it. When it crashed, all my eggs were thrown from it. Your settler was in a hurry and just gave me your name as the person to go to. He said you would compensate me, so here I am! Give me my compensation and I will forget all about the matter.

So, what's the plan? You don't have one? That is unacceptable. If you do not have a plan, you should find someone who does! Let's think… I think your settler ran into me when I was near a mine or something. Maybe we should begin there?

This really is a mess. I have no time for this! Wait. They said the mining settler painted it while he was in the mine. Maybe we'll find it if we dig deeper?! Let's try it! What? Come on, we don't have all day!

So, back to work! What did you find? A map? Let me take a look! Hmm… looks like an island, but I don't recognize it. What? You do? Oh well, I guess you're not completely useless after all! What are we waiting for? Let's go!
What do you mean "A second map"? Jeez… There's no end to this. Why are you still standing here? Easter is getting closer and closer, and the Easter bunny needs the eggs!

I'm very sorry to disturb you, but I found this strange looking person in front of the mayor's house. He seems pretty desperate. Could you maybe listen to him and help? If anyone can do something for the poor guy, it's you!

Hey, hi! Before I say any more, please allow me to show you a special map that I happen to hold. It can unveil great fortunes to the patient adventurer, but you must hold on to it until I can fully explain what's going on ...

Oh no! That is so cruel! What? Well, the Easter bunny picked my cousin and I to help him with the eggs this year, but I failed the test and he dismissed me. I have to win his trust back! First though, I need to sabotage my cousin's efforts. Go and steal his eggs! Why you, you ask? Well why not?

But this sabotage is not enough! We need to steal… erm… borrow more of his eggs! I'm not sure where the other island lies, but I know someone who does - your baker! The good news is I have spoken to him already. The bad news is he won't help us for free. He wants you to support him, so I guess it is up to you again.

My cousin has an island there? Where did he get it? Anyway, it doesn't matter. Just make sure you get all eggs he has hidden. Why I am not going? Isn't that obvious? I need an alibi for the time being, so if you need to find me I'll be in the tavern!

Well, the Easter Bunny's first criticism was that I have no friends and no one likes me. I'm the shy type, you know? So what's a loner like me to do? That's right! You can help me buy myself some friends. Find some money, give it to me and we can start buying them up! What? Don't worry, you'll get your money back... probably!

The other thing the Easter bunny disliked was that I was not "green" enough… He loves his ecology you know, so I'll show him I'm totally into this whole nature thing and refill some of your natural deposits! What do you think? Nice idea, right?

Greetings! I have a request. I know a guy, a horrible person, always unfriendly and moaning. No-one likes him! However, his cousin has come to see me, and it seems he wants to teach him a lesson. He'll need someone to help him though. Might you be that person? I am sure he will appreciate it.

Oh no! It can't be! He already has way more than me. You! You have to help me! I've made a bet with my cousin that I would manage to get more Easter eggs than him, but he's cheating and now I'm way behind. We need to do outdo him, but your storage is way too full! Come on! Make space for the eggs!

I've heard a rumour that there are hidden Easter eggs on this island, and whoever finds them can keep them. Whatever the story, we need these eggs if we're to win the competition. What are you waiting for? Let's go!

Hey there, what's up? Pay attention! I have good news and bad news. The good news is, I have found the guy who can help us. The bad news is that he only helps people having a certain reputation… which basically means he dislikes your empty storage. I suppose we should fill your storage again then. Am I right?
After our fabulous efforts, the guy agreed to help us and gave me the location of a new Easter egg island. So grab your stuff and follow me to victory!
There is not much time left, and we need more eggs to win the competition. It doesn't matter how you get them. Just get them so I stand a chance against my cousin.

The Chupacabra is a creature that I've long thought was a myth. Dog-like in appearance, it is said to spread a curse that turns even the most mild-mannered people into frenzied berserkers. The beast seems to have made its lair in a cave at the center of the jungle. Get there and take it out!

The natives have erected palisades to trap the Chupacabra and stop the madness from spreading. However, it looks like it was too little too late. The island's whole population has been affected, and they won't let us approach the monster's cave safely. We have no choice but to clear the whole sector of them if we want to reach the Chupacabra. Your soldiers have been instructed not to use lethal force. But could there be way to handle the situation without fighting them at all?
The Chupacabra and the pack of wolves he leads are hiding in that large cave right ahead of us. You know what you have to do to end this nightmare.

You know, I noticed something about the apes you were fighting just now. While they fought fiercely, they did not appear to be affected by the Chupacabra's curse. Could the key to a cure lie in their diet? They mainly feed on the mushrooms that grow between the roots of those large trees they inhabit. If we defeat more apes and collect enough mushrooms, we might be able to produce medicine for the natives!

Welcome to Puerto Sombrío. I heard that your local spy has not reported back for a while... There's not much to the island except for a small port - and yet its governor seems to be living the good life. Something shady is going on here, and we will find out what it is!
Apparently, the governor has hired a load of thugs to guard the route to his mansion and the harbour. You'll have to fight your way through if we want to find your subject.

Do you see those stone towers that are blocking the way? They're certainly well-guarded - but that's not our only problem. Your enemies have smartened up, and have locked the doors! You should be able to craft some lockpicks in your provision house though. Let's open those gates and conquer the watchtowers!

Did you hear? The Settlers Football Championship is coming up again! Counties and Kingdoms from all over the continent will be taking part - and we should too, to gain glory and honour for our kingdom. There are prizes to be won, too! By trading the footballs we gather through quests and activities, we could win some amazing stuff! Let me explain how it all works!
Finish all the introduction quests in order to participate in the tournament.
All parties must be at least level 16 to be able to participate in the Football Championship.
Now the first step. To access information about the Football Championship, open the event window. You can reach it via the options panel, which is right beneath your avatar picture.

Did you notice the football button next to your avatar picture? Using it opens the Football Championship fixture list. This is the most important part of the tournament. Green doors contain your next tournament opponent, brown doors hold a nice present for you, and trophy doors contain a special thank you. However, you can only open a trophy door if you've managed to open every door that came before it. By the way, you can open green doors at any time during the event.

Well, now that's sorted, we should probably take part in our first match! Open your Star Menu, start the adventure “The First Match” and visit the adventure zone.
Hint: You'll find the adventure in the first green door in the fixture list.

At the moment, our Settlers are all going totally crazy about football. As they aren't the tidiest bunch, it's actually possible to find some items by simply collecting the things these football maniacs have left behind.
To find some more exotic items, you can send out your explorers. They'll observe the other teams, and return with interesting items, so we can improve our own tactics.

Once we've collected enough utensils, we should start to transform those into tactics we can use on the playing pitch. Go to your provision house and order a foul. We're going to need it to defeat their midfielder.
Hint: If you have a rarity provision house, you can produce the same items there much faster.

The practice match you found in the fixture list will help us to prepare for the tournament proper. The Knight of Crowrock has agreed to let us practice against his team. Start the match and defeat your opponent!

So, this will be our first real match. Our opponent is the barony of Tepidwater. Much like us, they haven't played many matches yet. Folks say the barony is playing a very offensive 4-3-3 system. We should be especially aware of their midfielders, but at the same time watch out for their three strikers. The baron of Tepidwater has some strong players in his team.

Here comes the next match of the group stage. Today our opponent will be the Barony of Emberstream. The guys from Emberstream are a very defensive team with a strong defensive squad. If we want to make it to their goal, we'll need a plan.

Now it's getting serious. Our first knock-out match, against the Shire of Oxwater. During the group stage they showed skill in attacking, while maintaining a stabile defence. They play in a 4-2-4 system – that means with four set strikers.

In the quarter finals, we will play the Electorate of Sunflower Grove. They've certainly earned their place amongst the last eight teams in the tournament. Similar to our former opponent they play with a strong attacking squad, although their midfield is a little more balanced. This will be a tough enemy.

Semi-finals… what a wonderful day. If you'd have told me at the beginning of the tournament that we would make it this far, I wouldn’t have believed you. But here we are, up against the grand Duchy of Darkwood. What do you need to know about this opponent? They stand closely staggered in a 1-4-1-4 system and have many strong players.

Can you feel it? The air is filled with a mixture of tension, anticipation, and energy… it’s the day of the finals. Our opponent is the Kingdom of Dragonhead. They were always one of the best teams in the tournament, but they'll soon be second best! All players in this team are strong, and they are confident to boot. But they've never played us. Go out on the field and show them what we're made of!

The tournament has started. To win the Settlers‘ Football Championship we have to win 4 matches in a row. Just remember to regularly check the Football Championship fixture list. You can find your next opponents by opening the green doors.
We're not the only ones that are having trouble with the party crashers. Our friends are being bothered by the crashers too! We should help them out whenever we get chance.

Sometimes you can deal with an opponent while using only a single tactic item. If you take a look at the Tepidwater goalkeeper, you will see that he has both the “High Jumper” and “Fast Reflexes” skills. Both can be countered with a penalty kick.
If a tactic item can be used against several skills, it will always affect them in a certain order, as shown in the tactic item’s tooltip. Watch how the skill “High Jumper” gets removed first, followed by “Fast Reflexes”.

Stage 1/4
Your quest has begun… Something evil is going on in your kingdom. Maybe you should try and find something (or someone) to help solve this mystery?
Complete all quests in this first stage of the Crisis Quest "A Great Evil" to receive a small reward. Completing all four stages will net you a tremendous reward.

Stage 1/4
Your quest has begun… Something evil is going on in your kingdom. Maybe you should try and find something (or someone) to help solve this mystery?
Complete all quests in this first stage of the Crisis Quest "A Great Evil" to receive a small reward. Completing all four stages will net you a tremendous reward.

A great evil has befallen your island. Complete all four stages of the Crisis Quest to receive a tremendous reward. Every stage you complete will provide you with a small reward.
Beware: Not all who dare enter this quest chain will prevail! You'll need to be quick if you want to see it through to the end.

A great evil has befallen your island. Complete all four stages of the Crisis Quest to receive a tremendous reward. Every stage you complete will provide you with a small reward.
Beware: Not all who dare enter this quest chain will prevail! You'll need to be quick if you want to see it through to the end.

Something isn't right… Our settlers are tired and exhausted all day. Even nature itself has yet to come out of its hibernation. It is as if the whole kingdom is miserable. Maybe you can provide some refreshments to get your settlers going again?

Something isn't right… Our settlers are tired and exhausted all day. Even nature itself has yet to come out of its hibernation. It is as if the whole kingdom is miserable. Maybe you can provide some refreshments to get your settlers going again?

This whole thing is really alarming. I think we might need some outside help... It is said that a kind healer travels the land. Some folks say she's just a herb peddler, others say she might even be a witch, but if anyone can help, she can. She is said to be very shy, but as she is looking for ingredients for her potions on the island, perhaps she'll scratch our back if we scratch hers?

This whole thing is really alarming. I think we might need some outside help... It is said that a kind healer travels the land. Some folks say she's just a herb peddler, others say she might even be a witch, but if anyone can help, she can. She is said to be very shy, but as she is looking for ingredients for her potions on the island, perhaps she'll scratch our back if we scratch hers?

As you suspected, the witch won't agree to meet you in person. You receive a letter from her with a poorly-drawn picture of what looks like a red monkey. The letter reads: "I am Ma'Bristley and this little reddish fellow is Munchkin. So you need help, you say? You know, you mighty kings and queens, you always seem to appear in times of greatest desperation. But other than that you hardly tolerate an old lady wanting to trespass your kingdom. Well, you say you are different. Prove it to us. Do something truly selfless for somebody else in need."

As you suspected, the witch won't agree to meet you in person. You receive a letter from her with a poorly-drawn picture of what looks like a red monkey. The letter reads: "I am Ma'Bristley and this little reddish fellow is Munchkin. So you need help, you say? You know, you mighty kings and queens, you always seem to appear in times of greatest desperation. But other than that you hardly tolerate an old lady wanting to trespass your kingdom. Well, you say you are different. Prove it to us. Do something truly selfless for somebody else in need."

Stage 2/4
Now that you have the help of Ma'Bristley, you need to discover what evil has befallen your island.
Complete all quests in this second stage of the Crisis Quest "A Great Evil" to receive a small reward. Completing all four stages will net you a tremendous reward.

Stage 2/4
Now that you have the help of Ma'Bristley, you need to discover what evil has befallen your island.
Complete all quests in this second stage of the Crisis Quest "A Great Evil" to receive a small reward. Completing all four stages will net you a tremendous reward.

You receive another letter from the mysterious Ma'Bristley: "I was talking to the spirits of nature. They whispher from a great evil, which has befallen the land - a great evil evoked by a magic. This land has been cursed! The fruits it bears are making your settlers sick. We must do something! There is a magical ritual to help your settlers. I can perform it, but to do so, I need some natural ingridents - actually a lot of them."

You receive another letter from the mysterious Ma'Bristley: "I was talking to the spirits of nature. They whispher from a great evil, which has befallen the land - a great evil evoked by a magic. This land has been cursed! The fruits it bears are making your settlers sick. We must do something! There is a magical ritual to help your settlers. I can perform it, but to do so, I need some natural ingridents - actually a lot of them."

You find another request from Ma'Bristley, lying on your desk: "Now that we have the right ingredients, we can get things ready for the ritual. Produce everything we need, so we can help your people!"

You find another request from Ma'Bristley, lying on your desk: "Now that we have the right ingredients, we can get things ready for the ritual. Produce everything we need, so we can help your people!"

You receive yet another letter from Ma'Bristley. Most of this one is illegible, as it seems to have been written in a hurry: "This shall be a happy day! Gather all your settlers and we will perform the ritual! Let's hope that this will cure your island and its inhabitants of this ominous plague."

You receive yet another letter from Ma'Bristley. Most of this one is illegible, as it seems to have been written in a hurry: "This shall be a happy day! Gather all your settlers and we will perform the ritual! Let's hope that this will cure your island and its inhabitants of this ominous plague."

Stage 3/4
You've averted the immediate crisis - for now. But who was it that summoned this evil upon you?
Complete all quests in this third stage of the Crisis Quest "A Great Evil" to receive a small reward. Completing all four stages will bag you a tremendous reward.

Stage 3/4
You've averted the immediate crisis - for now. But who was it that summoned this evil upon you?
Complete all quests in this third stage of the Crisis Quest "A Great Evil" to receive a small reward. Completing all four stages will bag you a tremendous reward.

Ma'Bristley has sent you another yet another letter: "So... We know that it was magic alright - but I've got a hunch about the school of magic it came from. To get to know more about the magical matrix behind it, I'll need more samples. I need something that saves the magical essence of the curse in a more permanent way. Could you get me some stone, and some samples to compare it with?"

Could you get me some stone, and some samples to compare it with?"

Stage 4/4
Lady Fraila, a powerful witch has sworn to avenge her sister. Can you find a peaceful way to solve the dispute with her?
Complete all quests in this fourth stage of the Crisis Quest "A Great Evil" to receive a small reward. Completing all four stages will get you a tremendous reward.

Stage 4/4
Lady Fraila, a powerful witch has sworn to avenge her sister. Can you find a peaceful way to solve the dispute with her?
Complete all quests in this fourth stage of the Crisis Quest "A Great Evil" to receive a small reward. Completing all four stages will get you a tremendous reward.

Thanks to Ma'Bristley, we found out that Lady Fraila has returned to her birthplace, the Island of the Swamp. She also seems to know that we found out about her plot. We should try to talk it out with her. Maybe we can win her over with some gifts. Let's start putting a decent package together.

Thanks to Ma'Bristley, we found out that Lady Fraila has returned to her birthplace, the Island of the Swamp. She also seems to know that we found out about her plot. We should try to talk it out with her. Maybe we can win her over with some gifts. Let's start putting a decent package together.

I think we should add some variety to our gift basket. After all, we really want to convince her we're good people! Get your settlers to produce the finest materials they can, and add it to your gift basket. Maybe we can even find something exotic - something we can't produce on our own island...

I think we should add some variety to our gift basket. After all, we really want to convince her we're good people! Get your settlers to produce the finest materials they can, and add it to your gift basket. Maybe we can even find something exotic - something we can't produce on our own island...
Now that we've collected all the resources, I will send our gifts and apologies to Lady Fraila. Let's hope we can appease her.
Now that we've collected all the resources, I will send our gifts and apologies to Lady Fraila. Let's hope we can appease her.

I think our gift could use a proverbial cherry on top - just in case. Let's take something really valuable with us to show Lady Fraila that there is really no need to fear us or hate us. But where could we get such a treasure? Maybe something exotic, perhaps? Yes! Let's start an expedition to one of the nearby islands, and find Lady Fraila something she's never seen before!

I think our gift could use a proverbial cherry on top - just in case. Let's take something really valuable with us to show Lady Fraila that there is really no need to fear us or hate us. But where could we get such a treasure? Maybe something exotic, perhaps? Yes! Let's start an expedition to one of the nearby islands, and find Lady Fraila something she's never seen before!

Now that we've solved the immediate crisis, I was wondering if you wanted to find out more about who summoned the forces of evil upon you? To find out more, I would need some samples from your island… maybe we could start with the trees. Deliver me some and I might be able to tell you more.

Now that we've solved the immediate crisis, I was wondering if you wanted to find out more about who summoned the forces of evil upon you? To find out more, I would need some samples from your island… maybe we could start with the trees. Deliver me some and I might be able to tell you more.

Another letter from your favorite pen-pal: "Ok. We now know it was magic, and we also know it was a witch. I just need to gather one final clue in order to identify who actually cast this spell. But for this, we'll need something we only can find deep underground. Oh, and don't forget to provide me with more samples from other kingdoms."

Another letter from your favorite pen-pal: "Ok. We now know it was magic, and we also know it was a witch. I just need to gather one final clue in order to identify who actually cast this spell. But for this, we'll need something we only can find deep underground. Oh, and don't forget to provide me with more samples from other kingdoms."

You have an impressive army, my lord, but I'd like to see just how good they are. I want to put their capabilities to the test with a very difficult task. Your generals are excited, but are you up to the challenge?
The woodcutter is very worried about his children. He needs our help! We must be ready for anything. Who knows what we'll encounter in this dark forest?

In order to find the missing children, our engineers have devised a detector that can locate the white pebbles that Hansel has been leaving. We'll need to provide him with the correct materials to create it.
It seems the wildlife in the area has suddenly become more aggressive... There may be no choice but to make our way through the forest by force.
Our scouts have discovered a suspicious gingerbread house. We heard strange noises coming from within, and suspect that the children are trapped inside!
The Dark Cult? Something's fishy... These guys mean trouble, and, if my suspicion's correct, something much more terrible awaits us inside. Prepare your troops!

The woodcutter is relieved that the children are safe, but unfortunately, the problem persists. He's not a hunter, so the need for food is a real problem for him and his family. Let's hunt some animals for them and provide them with some sustenance!

As I suspected... It's her! Queen Ilsebille is here! She's the one that brought the Dark Cult here! This may be our only chance to capture the Queen and end this all. Let's plan our attack! We must succeed!

Your scouts have returned. The dragon is lying dormant in a cave that was hidden behind the castle. That must be why he hasn't been seen in over a hundred years after he was believed to be slain. Do you have the enchanted sword on you? With it, you can end his tyranny for real this time.

The fisherman's wife, blinded by power, has gone completely mad. She's used her newfound influence to seize control of this island, and has devised plans to take over other lands too! He laments that it's not the Ilsebille he married. We must stop her!

Ever since Ilsebille became the queen, the wildlife has become even more hostile. They're not going to make reaching the castle any easier... I suspect that Ilsebille may have obtained even darker powers, and is influencing them somehow.
The leader of the huntsmen works for Ilsebille, and he's guarding the pond where the cursed prince is. If we are to have a chance of defeating the Queen, we need to save the prince!

The only way we can be completely sure that the prince will be safe from his wife is if we can break the curse. He says that the only way to do that is to use a very specific potion, made using some herbs that can be found nearby. Let's get to it.

The prince is extremely grateful for your efforts in lifting the curse. Unfortunately, there is no time to rejoice. The curse may be gone, but so too are his powers, which were reducing her influence! If we are to stop her, we need to press forward to her castle!
The Queen is trenched up with the remainder of her forces in this area, and did not reply to our surrender request. There's no other way - we'll have to take it by force.

Let’s begin! Your goal is to defeat all your opponents. To achieve this, you should first make yourself aware of each opposing player’s skills. Only then you will know what you'll have to do to defeat them. Each opponent has his own weak spot. To see which skills the player has, simply click on him. Once you have figured out their skills, you can apply the tactical items that counter them.

The Queen has decreed that she wants to be considered the fairest maiden in all of the land - and, in order to achieve that goal, she intends to murder her beautiful, innocent step-daughter Snow White. It seems that Queen Ilsebille is not the only one who deserves to be called an "Evil Queen". This will not be tolerated!
Snow White was last seen around the forest, but it's dangerous for her to go around alone. The wildlife has been unusually aggressive lately. We need to find her!
He doesn't seem to be willing to stop, but I have the feeling that deep down, he's a good person. The Dark Cult has been spotted nearby, probably keeping an eye on him. We need to clear this area.

Snow White has found shelter in a little hut in the forest, inhabited by seven dwarfs. The dwarfs have promised to protect her with their lives, but they've asked for us to take care of the pest problem they've been having in their houses in return.

Snow White's stepmother will definitely try again, unless we do something about it. Sometimes the best defence is a good offence. If we clear this land of Dark Cultists, we will have a clear path to the Queen's castle.
The path is now clear, and the Queen has been barricaded inside her castle, along with the final remnants of the Dark Cult. Gather your troops once more, and let's put an end to this absurd affair.
We caught wind that the Evil Queen Ilsebille has established herself on this island. Once again, we must resolve the situation, and ensure her actions cause no harm to the inhabitants of this region.
It looks like we're on the right track. The wildlife in this area seems more aggressive than usual, which is very likely related to her dark presence. We must make our way through!

The girl says that a big, bad wolf had tricked her grandma and eaten her, and was planning to do the same to Red! A passing lumberjack said that we may be able to get grandma out of the wolf's belly, but we'll have to find something to fill the wolf's stomach with. I know! Some heavy rocks should do!

Grandma has seen things that would have broken stronger folk. She's a real trooper. However, she's still extremely nervous, and is refusing to talk. My own grandma gave me a recipe for a relaxing tea made with grated heart fruit core. Maybe this will help her regain her composure?

The Dark Cult is supporting Queen Ilsebille's evil deeds. She must have promised them power, riches, or something even darker. We have to get our troops moving towards the Queen's castle, and we must not let the Dark Cult stand in our way!
The Queen lies in wait in her castle, readying her final defence. Tell our generals to prepare for battle. We must not give her the chance to escape!

We've received a message that the Evil Queen has been here causing trouble. However, the scouts report there's been no sign of her. No matter. This region is in trouble, and it's our duty to help them out!

The town of Hamelin is being plagued by rats! Apparently, the inhabitants hired a specialist to get rid of the pests with an enchanted flute, but it seems he was double-crossed by the mayor, and is now refusing to cooperate. Maybe we can have a go? Let's clear them out!

We spotted the disgruntled piper in one of the caves. It seems unleashing the rats wasn't good enough, so he kidnapped the children of Hamelin as well! This is a line that should never be crossed. We must help those children!

With the pest problem solved, I thought that we should pay a visit to the mayor and demand an explanation. Unfortunately, he seems to have deployed his military in order to deny us entry! Something fishy is going on, and we must get to the bottom of it. Push forward!

The closer we get to the city hall, the more people I hear asking if we came "to save them from the mayor". Strange. Most of these citizens claim that the mayor had always been nice, up until now. It's time we confront the mayor, and figure out what's going on.

The famous band "The Annoholics" are on tour! And from what I saw on the poster, it seems that they're performing nearby! Maybe we should contact them and see if we can get them to play a special gig on our island. I'm sure that would make everyone happy!

If we are to hire The Annoholics to come to our island, we will need to prepare a contract for them, and ready an upfront payment. Please provide some paper and coins so our messengers can deliver the contract.

Now that we have a contract with them, we'll need to prepare a proper stage so that they can play for us. Please contact our specialist at the provision house, and bring the stage over to the mayor's house when it's ready.

Oh, what a tragedy! It seems that on their trip here, the band hit a patch of rough weather, and their instruments got broken. They won't be able to play like that! The only option we have right now is to create new instruments for them to use. Check the provision house and bring them over!
All the preparations are set - now we just have to spread word around and attract some fans to our island. Let's leave this island for a while and tell our friends about it!

What a mysterious compass this is. It clearly does not point north, but that begs the question - where IS it pointing? One of our researchers thinks he may have an idea about how to solve this mystery, but he needs to have some specific documentation to help him figure it out.

Our research indicates that the curious compass is attuned to a certain specific metal. This metal was used by pirates, in years gone by, to stash their treasure so they could easily find it again later. It seems we may have found some treasure! Let's follow the compass towards other islands, and see how it behaves then.
No matter how often we check it, it seems that the only constant is that it's always pointing east. Perhaps we should try looking there?

The chest is ours - but without a key, it's little more than a really heavy box. Fortunately, we have a locksmith waiting in our provision house that assures me that with enough materials, he can find a key that'll open the chest for us. He promised not to look inside if he manages to get it open.
Well, now this is a peculiar compass. It has quite an odd design, and doesn't actually seem to point north, like every other compass... I wonder if there's more to this little artefact?

When I first found this brooch, I thought that it was an ornament for clothing - but when the children around town saw me holding it, they started telling me how it belongs to a vigilante called "The Custodian", that has been fighting crime on this island. This requires more investigation!

The first mystery we must solve is: Does this vigilante operate only on our island, or is he some sort of travelling hero? Let's pay a visit to some other places. Have our generals yell "The Custodian is coming!" and see if our enemies react.

I'm a bit worried that this vigilante might not fight crime "by-the-book" so to speak... So, I've come up with a cunning plan. We'll fake a robbery in one of our houses, and make a huuuuge racket while doing so. That will certainly attract The Custodian's attention - and perhaps then, we can have a proper chat. Let's prepare some flimsy props in our provision house to make this more realistic.

There are two ways of dealing with this: Either she passes the tests and becomes an official member of the guard, or she will be treated like the criminals she's trying to stop. Having seen her two options, she's agreed to apply to join the guard, as long as she can keep her cool costume. The first test is a written morality test. Please provide the necessary materials to do this.

The second test is a physical test. Our guards must be in peak physical condition to be able to perform with the excellence required by the King. We will construct a difficult obstacle course, which you'll need to provide materials for. Don't worry, though - once the test is done, we can re-use most of the materials used.

She's more than fit for the guard - in fact, our generals are so impressed by her performance, they think she could become a general herself! They would like to perform a special leadership test, where she will join our generals in leading the troops on an adventure.

We found this message in a bottle addressed to a woman named "Miranda". The contents are about how much a man loves and misses her. It's all very cheesy if you ask me, but I'd feel bad if this letter was never received.

Although we don't know who this person is, we should try and send him some sort of reply. He definitely got the wrong person! We should train a messenger pigeon at our provision house to send our message back to where it came from!

We have received a response from the man. His name is Jonas, and he never really expected anyone would ever get this letter! He confesses that Miranda is not the name of a woman, but the name of his cat, who has been with him his whole life. We have to go rescue him!

We brought the man back, but he's in really bad shape... He suffers from scurvy and severe dehydration. My grandma had a recipe for a vitamin-filled brew that should help him to get back into shape. Let's go to the provision house and prepare it!

I bring dire news, my lord! One of our wood workers just found this really sharp claw while in the forest! I have never seen anything of this nature, but one thing is for certain - it's come from a big beast.

If we're going to search for this beast, we must be very thorough. Gather your explorers for a scouting party, and send them out to search for it. If they happen to bring some treasure in the process, then all the better!
We searched the whole island, but we found nothing. Maybe we should search below the surface of the island, too? Maybe the geologists will find something underground...

Having heard the most recent testimony from our geologists, it's safe to say we cannot afford to take any risks. We need to prepare for the worst! If what they said is true, we'll need a really sturdy, and really BIG cage to put the beast in. Let's go to the provision house, and get to work!

With the cage finished, all we need to do now is send a squad of the bravest soldiers to take care of the beast. I've already contacted the barracks, and they are willing to provide the bravest men they can out of their next batch of recruits.

We just found a statue of a little idol. It seems an ancient civilization may have lived on this island long ago! Our local scholars cannot wait for you to let them investigate it so we can learn more!

Our scholars are trying to isolate what kind of material the idol is made of. They've asked if they can borrow some materials fresh from our stores so they can compare consistency, weight, and a lot other words that I don't know what they mean.

As it turns out, the idol isn't made of any material we've seen before. We could always ask the scholars living on our allies' islands, and see if they have any idea what it might be? Oh, but don't forget to take them some presents! We don't want to come across as greedy, do we?

If what our allies said is true, and this idol is actually made of pure gold, it must be covered by a huge amount of dirt and rust... Fortunately, my grandma knows how to make a special liquid that'll remove any rust from gold in the space of just a few hours. Or so she says! We should be able to replicate it in our provision house.

Let's try to look on the bright side. Regardless of what the idol's made of, I'm sure that if it contains even a small amount of gold, we can probably sell it for a profit. It is still a very pretty decoration.
Terrible news! We have received an anonymous threatening letter that states, in scruffy handwriting, that we are going to be invaded soon! We must do something!

We all need to calm down... After all, it may not be anything. But what if it is? It could be a prank... But what if it isn't? My lord, the uncertainty is killing me. We have to fortify the island. Let's put up barricades EVERYWHERE!

Ahhh, I'm still not feeling any calmer... What should I do! What can we do? I'm not used to this kind of pressure! ...I know! We need to have more soldiers! A lot more soldiers! We need to prepare for the worst!

Ok, ok - I think the nerves are starting to go away now... However, not being fully aware of our surroundings is making me a bit twitchy. Let's craft some spyglasses at our provision house, so we can keep an eye on things.

What's that? A single boat!? Could it be a spy? I'll have him arrested immediately! My lord, our personnel are starting to grow restless and hungry. Do you think it would be possible to provide some food, so they can keep doing the great work they're doing in keeping us safe?

A huge fleet has been sighted! One of the ships sent an emissary, who said that the boy we arrested some time ago is in fact the son of a count from another kingdom! I'm afraid I let my paranoia get the better of me, and now we're paying the price. I'm so sorry my lord! But can we perhaps offer a tribute to appease the situation? The alternative is a full-scale invasion!

The count offers their apologies for the misunderstanding, and proposes an alliance as compensation. However, they have a strict policy of only letting people join their alliance if they can earn their general's approval. Take him on an adventure to the far east with you, and let him see what we're made of!
We found this leaflet from a barterer called "Bart". It says he pays well for rare materials. I thought our economy could use a little boost, so I decided to invite him over.

Bart the barterer has arrived on the island. He mentioned he hasn't had much interest from his leaflets, so he's willing to make us a good deal. He's offered me a small (horrible) marble statue, and has asked for a similar statue made of hardwood. Let's use our provision house to produce the goods he's asked for - just make sure you don't clog the production line!

Bart's second deal is a first edition of a rare encyclopedia that he thinks may be useful for our specialists. He's willing to offer it to us, in exchange for a hand-crafted replica of an ancient brass sword.

Since Bart is going to be staying with us for a few days, I think it would be a nice gesture of goodwill to offer him something to eat. Why don't we treat him to some really fancy food? Perhaps this way he'll give us a discount next time...
Bart seems to have taken a liking to us, so he offers us a new deal. He wants a table made of exotic wood and sturdy steel, and will exchange it for a really big granite doorstop. What do you think?

Bart is pleased with the business he's done with us, but he now has a personal request. He tries to collect coins from everywhere he goes, so he would be really happy to trade some refined weaponry for some of our coins, and a golden statue. Otherwise it wouldn't be bartering, would it?

While I was going through my things, I found some papers of mine from back when I was a lot younger. I liked to play make believe a lot, where I'd pretend I was someone else, and so I wrote out entire backgrounds and stories for these characters. It might be fun to share this with other people who share the same interests. What do you think?

Here's what I call the "character sheet". Basically, it defines what your portrayed character will be, who he is, and what he does. In short, it's a player's "identity". In fact, if I could have some time to go through all my existing sheets, I can probably turn it into a game!

I finished creating the rules! Boy, that was complicated. Now, I think we should make several copies of the rules at the provision house, and spread them around the island, so we can see what the public opinion is. Oh! We'll need some dice, too!

I can't believe it! It's a resounding success! In fact, people are playing it so much, it's even created a whole new sub-culture! Very interesting. Very interesting indeed. In fact, we're running short on paper and coal for the game - can you provide some more?

Ahh, you placed your shiny new epic farmyard! Let me tell you a little more about this incredible building. You can expand it with new production chains going forward - but for now, let's start from the beginning.
Let's expand your epic farmyard with a new production chain. Each expansion and upgrade of a production chain requires a blueprint.

This was just one expansion - there are a lot more where that came from! I'm sure you'll discover more blueprints once you start travelling to exotic places. Help the people solve their issues, and earn more blueprints for your epic farmyard.
The spy must be being held in the mansion. If we beat up the governor's guards, I'm sure we'll find he can be persuaded to let your man go. I cannot wait to hear what your spy has learned!

Alright, we've reached our destination. Your navigators have taken a look at my maps and confirmed that this is the only island at which the pirates' fleet can restock. As you know, their ships are laden with treasure that belongs to your allies - and probably that of other parties, too. We shall reclaim it and return it to its rightful owners.

The sailors encamped on the island bear the same emblems as the pirates we were told of. First, let us take care of their leaders. Not only will that teach them a lesson, but they may also reveal some details of the rendezvous with the fleet.

If we want to get the jump on the ships, we must know the exact time and place they'll be docking. If we piece together whatever information we can get out of the sailors' leaders, we should be able to surprise and board them.
Now that we know when and where to expect the ship in the harbor, we can engage its crew in combat before they even land. They won't know what's hit them.

Looks like that ship's load is already equivalent to what was taken from your friends. However, the fleet is larger than that, and if you want to reclaim all the stolen treasure, feel free to attack all four ships. The rightful owners of the treasure will be grateful, I'm sure.
Good day! Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Sonya Graham - you might have heard of me before? I am travelling through our world, exploring exotic places and cultures.
This is The Excelsior. It might look messy, but I assure you this airship is the peak of our industrial prowess. Please, come on board, and let me show you around.

The world has so much to offer, we just have to reach out and take it. I've collected a huge amount of letters on my travels. All the love stories, the drama, the humour... Every letter has its own unique story. Let us reveal the truth behind this short letter here.
We have to reveal mor... no, ALL of them! Please help me gather more crystals, and I will take you with me on my journey!

There's a rumour going around that talks of the presence of a group of spirits known as "The Forgotten"... They're the vengeful spirits of an old civilization that used to live on this island before us. People are terrified by this idea. We must do something!

I think it'd be a good idea to keep the spirits on side either way. Let's prepare something that will please them.

The ruffian! Terrorizing the people of our island just to fill his pockets! This makes me so angry I could scream! Let's assemble the guard, follow him and catch him red handed! What? Too much? No way, I just want to be sure, is all!

And here I was thinking the ancient golem was the last one... This one looks a lot more ferocious - and I guess since fire didn't work, they've gone with ice now!
Our holy water is no longer effective. We'll need something new to defeat this one.
Fortunately, I have a trump card - some glistening water. There's nothing more powerful than this. I'm sure it'll work!
Produce enough glistening water to bring the supreme golem down.
- Defeat the supreme golem by using enough glistening water.

Another supreme golem has gone astray on your island! I've already gathered everything I need from him, but I'm sure your settlers would be grateful if you could defeat this one too.
- Defeat the supreme golem by using enough glistening water on it.

The spy found several clues about the docking schedule. You can collect his findings by the ruins of the mansion. There may be even more clues scattered around the island. If you can find them and piece them together at your Provision House, we can get the jump on the ships at the northern piers. Intercepting one of them should be enough to teach them a lesson. But why stop at one when we can get our hands on two?

A man approached me this morning. He was nervous and excited as he explained to me how close he was to inventing the Philosopher's Stone. He just needs some gold to compare to the one he was able to create.

Today I met a nice man. His name is William, and he told me about his work. He's a director, and he wants to create a new play in our town. I don't want to give too much away, but it's about a man who robs the rich to give to the poor, and William has to find the perfect person to play the main protagonist. The only criteria is, he should know his way around a bow. Can we send some longbowmen over there? Maybe one of them will catch William's attention.
You won't believe it... I just met a man who told me he can get to the moon. Yeah - that moon. He says all he needs is a cannon, a barrel, and lots of gunpowder...

A couple of caring parents approached me today. They told me we need some kind of a library, a place where our kids can learn about the world. We have to prepare the next generation for the world outside, so they asked if you can help them out with some books.
I didn't even know you could do that. This guy from the east is an artist, he just creates sculptures out of paper! Maybe if we give him a lot, he'll create something special for us...
Our town is growing, and we need more food! One farmer had an idea that we could use saltpetre as fertilizer to boost our crops' growth rate. Maybe we should try it.

Our people have been asking for more entertainment. Luckily, I met William. He has an idea - a tournament where our finest knights perform against each other, both on horseback and on their feet. Of course, the contest will have to take place under certain rules... but it could be good?
Some of the richest families have decided to design some fancy furniture to decorate their homes. Only the best wood can be used, of course.
There is a discussion going on. Which swords are better - damascene or platinum? Two guys want to test them out, and maybe bust one or two myths about swords.
Just saw two people discussing whose horse is faster, and it hit me - let's make a wagon race!
A small kid just arrived at our gates. He was dirty and tired, and spoke of a small village that needs our help against some bandits. We should send out some of our troops.
A small kid just arrived at our gates. He was dirty and tired, and spoke of a small village that needs our help against some bandits. We should send out some of our troops.

An ambassador sent by a king from the south just arrived at our gates. He's heard about our victorious troops, and asks if they can train the troops of his king. Would you send out your best man to help him?

Merry Christmas, old friend! I’ve brought some new things with me to make this year’s Christmas even better!
Let me show you the new Christmas surprise, and how to get presents!
My reindeers are gone! Someone must have stolen them! How am I ever going to deliver those presents now!? This is your chance! You can save the day!
I found the evildoer who stole my reindeers! He's hiding on an island. I guess we should set sail and pay him a visit!
I found the evildoer who stole my reindeers! He's hiding on an island. I guess we should set sail and pay him a visit!
I found the evildoer who stole my reindeers! He's hiding on an island. I guess we should set sail and pay him a visit!

First, let's take a look at the brand-new Christmas surprise. Every day, you get to open a door, and find valuable things inside!
For special days like Christmas Eve or New Year’s Eve, you can choose in advance what reward you'd like to have.
And if you manage to open all the doors, you'll get a really special reward!
Even if you miss a door, you can always come back and open it afterwards with some gems.

The next thing I want to show you is how you can produce your own Christmas presents.
For this we need Christmas Bells, Candy Canes and Gingerbread. You can find all the required bits and pieces on your island - all you have to do is pick them up.

Now that we've gathered enough stuff to build our presents, we should just do that.
Click on your mayor's house, select the 'Collections' tab and produce 1 basket of presents.

The last thing I wanted to tell you is that your explorers can also find presents during their treasure searches.
Try it out, and send one of your explorers on a treasure search (short).

Let me tell you a little secret. It's not the reindeers that let my sleigh fly. They're just for show. I mean, I could let kittens drag the sleigh, but just imagine how silly that would look…
The trick here is a magic potion which can make any animal fly. So here's the plan: First, we'll train some horses, and we'll gather some wood to build fake antlers with. After all, they need to look like reindeers when people see them flying!
Then I simply give them my potion, and they should be able to help me deliver my presents.

I'm back, but I'm afraid I can't find the ingredients I need to brew the potion...
Perhaps you could help me out?
Here, take this list. That's everything you need to get. Oh, and could you bring me some malt brew while you’re at it?
The next thing I want to show you requires you to be Level 16. Please come back when you've gained enough experience. For someone with your potential, that shouldn't take too long!
For the next task you need to be Level 23. Please come back when you've gained enough experience.
For the next task you need to be Level 26. Please come back when you've gained enough experience.

Unfortunately, the guy who stole my reindeers has bribed the rulers of the island to protect him!
It seems we'll need to take an army with us if we're going to get them back!

I should have known! The evildoer was hired by the Croaker!

We need a special kind of bird food - one which can't be easily acquired. One general has mentioned that they know the seeds we're looking for, and will bring some back the next time they go on an adventure. We've urged them to go now.

There is a tale of a very friendly breed of deer. It would heighten the mood to have some nice deer in the city when winter comes. The only problem is, we've no idea where to find them. Luckily, one general does and wants to go look for them.
Your generals enjoyed the most excellent training, but military tactics have advanced a lot since then. It would be a good idea to read up on recent developments.

Most of your generals have years of experience on the battlefield, but they are woefully out of date when it comes to modern military science. I'm sure at least one of them would appreciate some further education.
The first step to leading an army is a good understanding of communication. Luckily, I know just the book to get you started.

This final discipline might also be the most important one. A perfect strategy can sometimes turn even overwhelming odds around in your favor. These books might be expensive to produce, but I'm sure they'll be worth it.
Our student is doing well. Next, we will focus on the often overlooked matter of logistics. How do you optimize supply routes? How do you ensure that medical personnel are where they're most needed?

I personally believe that this situation can be resolved without fighting. Maybe if we give them something they really like, we can reach a truce and they'll stop bothering us for a while.
So these guys want to prepare for trouble? Then make it double! If we send our troops to "meet them", I'm sure they'll have second thoughts, and will go look for trouble somewhere else.

Let us read the message... A member of the von Peahead court informs you that his Lord’s rare Larsian silk cat has gone missing. Gundolf von Peahead accuses his fellow nobleman Harald the Softnoggin of pilfering it. The two are preparing for battle over this dispute– can you believe it?

We must defuse this situation. But how can we make them listen to us? These blockheads won’t even accept a flying ship as a sign of importance!
The only language they understand is their own - showy displays of wealth and power. Let's pitch my tent on their battlefield. Add some showy decorations, and bring your personal guard too - that should draw their attention.

Of course, von Peahead has no evidence whatsoever. He only suspects Softnoggin because he was the last person he showed the cat to before its disappearance.
They have promised to withdraw their troops, for now, in exchange for my assurance I'll investigate the matter. Can I count on your support? We’ll use flour to dust for foot and fingerprints!

The most recent prints are from cat paws... It must have escaped on its own! All this madness over a runaway cat!
I doubt that von Peahead will be satisfied unless we find and return his precious pet though. Where should we start looking? I wouldn't be surprised if it had made a beeline for the fish market.
Now that we know the cat is around here somewhere, we just need some bait. Do you have any suggestions?
