Once we have our heading, deliver it to the captain so we can make way.

These rocks do not seem like the Fallen Stars we’ve encountered previously. The crystalline structure suggests we’re dealing with something harder than even diamond.
We’ll need something to get rid of it before the Star Shards can be mined. Something STRONG.

With the chemicals you provided, we can produce an explosive agent that should suffice to see us through the hard rock layer.
Do remember to make sure everyone’s clear of the blast radius, though. Just to be safe.
With the hard rock layer cleared, we can finally prepare the mining equipment, just as we did before.

The S.C.R.A.P.P.E.R.s are prepped and ready.
Place them on the discovered Star Shard deposit so the removal procedure can commence.

Let’s give the S.C.R.A.P.P.E.R.s chance to do the job they were built to do.
Just a shame we didn’t get time to tweak their performance.
As mentioned before, we’ll store the bulk of the Star Shards on board. Nevertheless, it is only fair that you have some to use at your leisure, in return for all the support you’ve provided.

Hello again, Mayor.
As I predicted, it seems the star showers we experienced previously are part of an ongoing phenomena.
We’d better get the Forerunner ready.

The Forerunner, as impressive as she is, is a very demanding lady.
All the advanced equipment we have onboard needs quite a bit of maintenance.
If you'd be kind enough to provide the necessary materials and spare parts, we can have her up and running in no time.

We’ll need to collect Stardust Motes to pinpoint the touchdown location of the Fallen Stars.

Deliver the Stardust Motes to the onboard lab so we can analyze them and chart a course.
Once we have our heading, deliver it to the captain so we can make way.

Getting rid of the Fallen Stars is of paramount importance, but we also need to tend to the aftermath of such endeavors.
The pits left behind after removing the Fallen Stars need to be filled to prevent anything, or anyone, from falling into them.

The soil tainted by the Fallen Stars prevents vegetation from naturally reforesting.
Within the Forerunner we can produce special seeds that can resist the contamination and germinate.

Though they may be enhanced, these seeds won't grow on their own. They need all the normal care and attention, dare I say it, even more so than wild plants.
We shall prepare some special enriched water to try and counteract any effects of the Fallen Stars.

The saplings seem to be growing healthy, but a little fertilizer goes a long way.
I have a formula for a very effective one that can be made in the facilities we have onboard.

Oh my, that is unexpected. The trees we seeded have borne an unusual fruit.
I would feel uneasy leaving those for our people and fauna to eat. There is no telling what it might do to anyone who consumed it.
We should harvest it and store it safely to study it.
The baskets will be stored in your Star Menu.
As mentioned before, we’ll store the bulk of the Star Shards on board. Nevertheless, it is only fair that you have some to use at your leisure, in exchange for all the support you’ve provided.

Hello again, Mayor.
As I predicted, it seems the star showers we experienced previously are part of an ongoing phenomena.
We’d better get the Forerunner ready.

All the advanced equipment we have onboard needs quite a bit of maintenance.

These strange spires cannot be removed by blasting or mining.
Attempting that might things even worse, since they will shatter into a million pieces - and I for one am not looking forward to picking those pieces out one by one with tweezers.
I propose the following...

The energies emanating from the spires alter the flora and fauna, harming the ecosystem - and worse, it disrupts our agriculture.
We have too many mouths to feed to allow such things to continue.
Remove the spires with haste.

Removing the spires exposed stable Star Shard deposits.
We can mine these as usual.
You already know the protocol, so I suggest we execute it without hesitation.

Extraction equipment assembled and ready to be deployed.
We are just awaiting your approval order.
Let us wait until these beauties complete their purpose...
As mentioned before, we’ll store the bulk of the Star Shards on board. Nevertheless, it is only fair that you have some to use at your leisure, in exchange for all the support you’ve provided.

Mayor! Just the person I wanted to talk to.
I’ve been sketching an upgrade package for the Forerunner.
This will improve the amount of Star Shards that can be stored, and the rewards obtained by researching them.
All without compromising any of her already remarkable capabilities.

Please deliver the following list of components as soon as you have the chance. You can commission them from Provision Houses.
I’ll get to work on the modifications as soon as they’ve been delivered.

Thank you, kindly.
I’ll need some quiet time to make the necessary modifications.
I will let you know once they are ready.

In this manual, I’ve written step-by-step instructions for everything the crew will have to do to install the upgrade.
Deliver it to the Forerunner.
Once that it’s done, you can start the upgrade procedure at your own leisure.

Hello again.
As discussed earlier, I've come up with a new set modifications to further improve the Forerunner's capabilities.

I’ll get to work on the modifications as soon as they’ve been delivered.

My Major, the ore we haul from the earth grows poorer with each season. Yet I have heard tell of distant folk who draw greater bounty from lesser stone. Seek out knowledge scrolls during your adventures and bring them back.
The plans are laid before us, yet a refinery is no humble forge. Every channel must carry molten metal without bursting apart. See the construction finished and the mechanisms set in motion.

The refinery consumes fuel like a starving army consumes bread. The old texts speak of refined charcoal and compressed fuel bricks. Strange methods... See that these instructions reach our provisioners.

The new fuel will change the refinery entirely. The furnace will burn hot enough to soften the stubborn ores that once resisted us, and the great mechanisms will finally move with the strength their makers intended.

I have studied the recovered plans night after night, and I am certain now: our refinery was never meant to stand alone.
There are entire techniques missing from its design.
Several portions of the design remain unfinished, almost deliberately so. Empty chambers. Unused pressure lines. Space reserved for techniques absent from the scrolls we gathered.

Rumors speak of northern engineers who harness steam pressure, desert metallurgists who separate ore with powdered salts, and distant island artisans who refine steel through repeated folding and purification.

The refinery functions well enough, Major, yet the copper it yields still bears too much waste within it. I believe the furnace temperatures can be controlled more precisely. With proper calibration, we may yet improve the quality of our copper greatly.

Now that the copper runs cleaner, another flaw reveals itself. Too much heat escapes through the exhaust channels, and the molten metal cools before the casting process is complete. If we redesign the furnace flow, we may increase both yield and speed alike.
Iron is less forgiving than copper. The refinery can melt it, aye, but not consistently. We must improve the furnace lining and reinforce the pressure systems if we are to tame iron properly.
The new iron techniques have exposed another weakness. Our bellows cannot maintain steady airflow during prolonged refinement, ruining entire batches. Larger pressure chambers may solve the matter.

Though the iron quality improves, waste still gathers within the slag pits. Too much usable metal is lost during the refinement process. If we recover these remnants and refine them anew, our efficiency may rival the greatest foundries of distant kingdoms.

Gold tests precision more than strength. Even the slightest impurity dulls its shine and lowers its worth. We must learn finer separation techniques if we wish our gold to rival royal minting standards.

Several crucibles cracked during the last operation, and excessive temperatures ruined entire batches. If we improve the heat regulators and insulate the refining chambers, we may preserve far more precious metal.

Now that our gold refinement nears perfection, demand grows beyond our current capacity. We must strengthen the refinery's upper systems and stabilize the production flow before prosperity destroys its own source.

Titanium is unlike any ore we have refined before. The heat required to shape it strains the furnace beyond safe limits, while ordinary crucibles weaken and split under the pressure. If we are to master this metal, the refinery itself must grow stronger.

Titanium refinement pushes our systems dangerously close to failure. Pipes warp, and entire chambers tremble under the furnace heat. We require reinforced materials and advanced cooling systems if the refinery is to survive continued operation.
Though we can now refine titanium, the process remains painfully slow. If we redirect the furnace flow and optimize the pressure network, production may improve dramatically.

Platinum may prove the greatest challenge yet. Our current methods leave too many impurities trapped within the metal. To refine platinum properly, we must achieve a level of precision beyond anything attempted before.

Our platinum techniques succeed, yet only barely. Minute flaws within the furnace alignment throw entire refinement cycles into ruin. If we improve the refinery's internal precision, the results may surpass all expectations.

We have refined copper, iron, gold, titanium, and now platinum itself. Yet I believe the refinery still possesses untapped potential. One final improvement may elevate this place from a mere industrial center into a wonder remembered for generations.

You've constructed your first building.
Great! You are now able to produce pinewood planks.
Good! Keeping your forests healthy is important to secure a constant supply of wood.

Your geologist has successfully discovered a stone deposit.
Geologists can search for various deposits later on. Be sure to check his abilities often!
Very good! Your mason takes up his employment.
Good. Every workyard needs 1 worker in order to produce goods. Keep an eye on your available living space and population when expanding your town.
OK! Your fish production has started.
Good job! The provision house can change resources into a variety of useful items.
You've just created your first food package.
Good! You've increased the productivity of your workyard for the first time.
You've just claimed your first new sector.

Good job! Each workyard needs tools to operate. Make sure you always have enough tools available when expanding your town.
NOTE: Take a look at the production times of your workyards. A Coppermine produces twice as fast as a Coppersmelter. So a Coppermine delivers enough resources to deploy two Coppersmelters.
The production times are shown in the details tab of each workyard.
Good! Sectors with bandits can't be used in any way. Before you are able to expand to these sectors you have to wipe out the bandits.
Good job! Brew is required for each military unit so keep a good stock if you want to increase your troops.
Perfect! A bronze sword is the most basic weapon, but it is still sharp enough to teach the bandits some respect!
Well done! Your recruits are now ready for duty.
From now on, you can hire an unlimited number of Specialists in the Tavern.
Good! All specialists you hire in the tavern are found in the star menu.
Great! Your Army is now ready to do battle.

You have just won your first battle.
You gain Experience for every defeated enemy unit.
Unlocked: - New building: Bakery - New building: Mill - New building: Bowmaker
- New unit: Bowman
Fantastic! You bakery is ready to produce fresh bread...

That's it! A workyard buffed with the Quality Food buff will work much faster than usual. Watch out for more buffs in the shop or quest rewards
NOTE: Visit your friends and buff their buildings. Buffs applied to friends' workyards will last longer.
Your Explorer is ready for his first mission
Great! Hardwood planks will allow you to create new and advanced buildings.
With hardwood planks and marble you are now set to create more buildings.
Very good! Militias are better melee fighters than recruits.
Great! Note that archers can deal high damage to your armies, but they are not very durable. Use your cavalry units to counter enemy archers.

You managed to complete the main campaign for this milestone.
We hope you had fun ;-)
Good! Note that buildings stop working while they are being upgraded.
Workers bring the goods they produce to the storehouses, and needed resources are always taken from the storehouses.
Your geologist has found a copper deposit.
Perfect! Now your workers can start mining for copper ore
Very well! Coal is used in many production processes so make sure you've always got plenty of coal.
Good. All military units are trained in the barracks. As you can see, each unit has different requirements.
Nice! These garrisons represent your armies.

Perfect!
In an army, bowmen are only attacked once all melee or cavalry units have been defeated.
Additionally bowmen deal high damage to enemy armies.

Very nice!
You can explore any sector adjacent to one of your owned sectors.

Done! I hope that the spirit of the shrine will come back one day to watch over and protect our island!
The lady was so happy to see the ore that she put your name on the sponsors list! Maybe you're in line for a nice gift from her?
There has been a small argument between two lords who both wanted to buy our wheat! Thankfully, our merchants managed to resolve the problem peacefully! Next time we should bring more!
Well done! I'll make sure we won't get any more complains!
Your neighbour was eager to help you. Now you have enough goods to please our guests!
Of course, your friends were eager to help immediately. They are true friends after all.
Theodor admits that good friends can prove to be a great help, and immediately runs off to get some. Let's hope he will be alright.
That was quite a generous gesture from you. Surely, your friend will not forget this. Good thing we found that box!
As you suspected, he wanted to acquire goods he does not really need. Unfortunately, you didn't have much to offer, so he went away. Maybe you have pampered him too much in the past?!
That is enough to begin with. I'm sure he will be able to protect his island from here on.
The additional food should be enough motivation for your settlers, and allow them to flourish again. I wonder where that scent is coming from though…
Well done. This food should be enough to feed his inhabitants. Hopefully, he has learnt something from this.
How rude! They left before we could serve the food! Well, that at least leaves some spare food for our settlers.
The numerous new stories your troops can tell should comfort them for a while.
Never again will bandits walk all over you… Chuck will think twice about it too…
With an assault on the root of all evil, you were able to bring peace back to the island. The inhabitants are very grateful.
With your drastic measures, you showed your settlers that there is nothing to be afraid of!
Your brother is very grateful for your help. Hopefully, he will learn from it… Good thing he knows how to write…
Once again, your brother is grateful for your help. We will see whether he will come and ask for help again next time… Maybe you should send him random resources now and then, eh?
With the help of the swords, your brother will be able to defend himself, but this is definitely the last time you help him out, right?
With the help of the wood, the settlers can at least rebuild the most essential buildings. Well done! I'll have our sages investigate this issue with the sun.
Very well. Now the settlers can build a new farm in the shadows of the old mountain.
It really works. Fascinating! Too bad your stone cutter cannot write to document the procedure.
Well I'll be… it worked! I guess we can use the treatment if we really need it!
That should be enough to clear the dept. Your townswoman is exuberantly happy and vows eternal gratitude.
That was nice of you. You have saved the dogs' lives. Your servants will take care of them from here on.
The additional weapons resulting from the increased steel resources should be enough to defend your settlers.
That should be enough to equip the first hunting session of the royal court. Enjoy the hunt!!
Always make sure you keep trading unneeded goods against other useful resources. It will pay off.
The exchange rate could have been better, but it paid off anyway. It's always worth having a look at trading.
The storage is filled. Well done!
Now your soldiers should have enough resources for the necessary repairs.
Even though the wood will last for quite some time, you should look for the next land... just to be sure.
This stock should be enough, in case the rumours should turn out to be true.
The brothers will be pleased to see and feel the great quality our swords provide!
With all this gunpowder, they should be able to load all their new cannons and help us achieve a perfect victory!
Now your cousin should be able to make the preparations for his first attack. He will contact you again when he is done.
The second wave is invading the isle already. Let's see how far they get.
Well, at least the mercenaries will stay calm now. Soon though your cousin will be in need of a plan, otherwise claiming the island will be impossible.
Finally, your cousin has claimed the island. Good things come to those who wait.
Even though the reward was not as huge as expected, the whole thing paid off. She was no match for you, anyway. Even so, I'm not sure we've seen the last of that witch…
You showed them the ropes. Now, your settlers will think twice before betraying you.
The bowman did not stand a chance against you. Now we are in need of a new quest, but don't worry - we'll find one soon enough.
We took back the castle! And just as I entered the cannon room, I found the attack plans! The next target was to be your city. That was really close.
In fact, your visit was as unpleasant as you anticipated, but on a good note, they now think you're handsome, so that's good news!
Even though you could not get all of them, you were able to lower the attacks to a minimum. Now, the inhabitants can travel again.
Waltor the Grey was sad to hear about his friend. Well, dark magic is not a toy for anyone to play with.
We managed to capture all of them! We even found the shadow essence and locked it in our deepest cellar! Luckily, we saw through them and prevented further damage. Our streets are safe again.
You stopped the terror and granted the region peace again. The people are grateful for your help.
Always keep in mind that mines have limited durability, and you should look after them regularly.
Keep in mind you never can have enough wells, and you should always be sure to have enough water in stock.
Generous as you are, you have granted your inhabitant's request and built more wheatfields. Again, your inhabitants are grateful and happy.
Maybe your ship will appear again, but until then at least your military capabilities have been extended a little. You never know…
It looks like it totally paid off to train elite soldiers. They are considerably more effective than the normal ones.
This should minimize the animal population a bit for now. Just make sure it doesn't ever get too low.
The people began construction immediately after receipt of the resources and are happy to be counted among your inhabitants.
Your new settlers don't know how to thank you. Thanks to your generosity, they promise to remain diligent and loyal.
Your support was very helpful. With the help of the flour they were able to gather enough gold and combine it with tools to make a new mill.
Never would the settlers have expected such generosity. They are very happy to have come to your lands.
Your cousin is very grateful for your help and has sent you a few small items as thanks. Oh well, at least it's better than nothing.
You did not win the competition, but at least you got a little prize.
That should do for the beginning at least. Maybe you can send additional goods later on.
Your brother has a smile all over his face. Well, let's see whether his beloved accepts his proposal…
Hopefully, that example was demonstrative enough for your brother Theodor. Well, if he should not be successful, he will surely return.
That was close again and your brother can be glad to have you. Let us see, how long it will last until he becomes the next problem.
These carriages should be enough for the goods your brother has ordered. What would he do without you anyway?
Against cannons, those ships won't stand a chance. We will see whether they will attack anyway. Oh, and it was fog after all. There are no such things as ghost ships! Right...?
Luckily, our trees are not affected. We can continue our wood production. That was a close shave.
The envoy is on his way. The monument will rise toward the skies…. The king will be proud of you.
The king has sent you a little thank you, and conveys the message that his inhabitants were very glad of your help.
With the tools you sent, the sailors were able to repair their ships and the column could continue on their way. Once again, you have won an additional friend.
We opened the cavern and all we found was an empty chest! Well not completely empty, but the main treasure had already been taken. I wonder who…
Your inhabitants know your good example is to be valued. Now, nothing stands in the way of the holiday and its festivities.
Now he should have got the hang of it, and can continue fishing on his own.
Now that the brew supply is secured, the feast can be readied.
Now the coppersmiths should be able to produce more. The exhibition can begin.
Well, the payment was quite good. Let's see whether the next generation will become as lucrative.
Well, this seems quite promising. It would appear you can look forward to a new farmer in the near future.
Well, that was not what you had hoped for. Just a few old stone heads and clay jugs filled with phosphor. Your brother Theodor has a birthday coming up doesn't he?
After a long search, the monster turned out to be just a wild hog. However, to calm the fears of your inhabitants, you should tell them that the monster is dead.
Indeed it seems to be a huge deposit. Surely, the mine will pay off.
It will take a while to expose all of the bones, but one thing is already certain... They're huge!
The exhibition catches on and your settlers are fascinated by the huge animal. However, it also seems to frighten them. Hopefully, the exhibition was a good idea.
Helvian Kones and your explorers could not find any proof of the existence of such an animal. Now, you just have to convince your settlers that this means the animal does not exist.
You have managed to gather all the parts of the map. However, this time your cousin will have to search for the treasure on his own….
Therewith, you should be able to attract enough animals to send them into other countries.
Therewith you should be able to reforest your wood. At the next walk, the forest will be thicker again.
That was just in time. One of your neighbours had just decided to begin building mines himself. He does not look very happy. Hopefully, this will not bring trouble.
With the help of your militia you were able to find the culprit. It was a neighbouring monarch, casting a jealous eye on your lands. Stay cautious!
Our troops will represent our island! The King will be pleased!
The king was unsure whether your city should qualify. He has delayed his decision and will inform you at a later date.
That should be enough to spare your settlers a little, but maybe a pair of new shoes would have had the same result?!
You finished your last building just as the king arrived. Impressed by the beautiful buildings and your determination, he declares your city to be one of the most beautiful in the land.
Your friend is very thankful and invites you for a visit. Unfortunately, you have no time at the moment, but you will come back for sure.
The king gives you great credit for your participation. He hopes that additional people will follow your good example, and relays his thanks to you.
With the help of a few inhabitants, you managed to catch the bear. In his big compound he seems to feel comfortable, and the people feel safe again. The caretaker has even given him a name - "Tram".
Even though the construction of the statue will still take some time, the king is very grateful for your help and invites you to visit him in his castle. What an honour!
All preparations are finished, and the feast can start. Your settlers will surely enjoy themselves magnificently.
Your trap has been sprung. The shadow has been caught and put in jail. Your streets are safe once more.
Phew! She left! Good work!
That was just in time. Thanks to you Christmas can take place as planned. Santa Claus has sent you a few presents as thanks.
Now your settlers will have a warm and cozy Christmas Eve and will be able to enjoy the feast.
You built the shelter as promised, and the reindeers do not have to freeze anymore. Santa Claus is grateful and sends you some presents.
With these belts Santa's helper should be able to finish the presents. Well done!
It seems your attendant was not exaggerating. Maybe you should temporarily produce this mulled wine yourself?!
As the enjoyable smell of fresh cookies wafts up your nose, you know that you did the right thing. There is nothing better than cookies.
You managed to stop Croaker's plans, but it was a close call. Thanks to you, Christmas can take place as normal.
The Christmas tree looks really adorable on your village square. Setting up a Christmas tree was a great idea.
Out of the marble blocks, your settlers manufactured a really beautiful mantelpiece. Now, Christmas can come.
You managed to stop Croaker's plans, but it was a close call. Thanks to you, Christmas can take place as normal.
The help came just in the nick of time. Without you, they would have been late. As thanks, Santa Claus and mother Holle have sent you some presents.
This method works quite well. Let us hope that more people will follow your good example and use recycling in the future.
It was mostly incoherent, but you got the impression that he was really afraid of something. Additionally, he gave you a strange piece of paper that looks suspiciously like a map. Intriguing…
It was mostly incoherent, but you got the impression that he was really afraid of something. Additionally, he gave you a strange piece of paper that looks suspiciously like a map. Intriguing…
In the tavern you are told that a local salesman has gone missing. He was last seen moving east with his baggage and has not been seen since. Search for clues and find out the salesman's whereabouts.
You found one the salesman's carts and signs of a fight. Look for more clues to find out what happened to the salesman!
You found some of the salesman's missing goods..
You found more of the salesman's goods. He must be close!
You have found the salesman's cart. He must have been ambushed! Find the bandit nest and free the salesman.
You have razed the bandit nest and freed the salesman.
The old forester's wife has asked you not to destroy her boy's camp. Spare them to receive an extra reward!
You have razed the bandit nest and freed the salesman.

A terrified townsman complains to you: "Nowhere's safe these days! Not only do these scallywags entrench themselves in their camps, they also lurk in the dark of the forest! Do these lands a great service and cast these vermin out from their treetop hideouts!"
You have shaken the last of the rogues out of their treetop hideouts and made these lands a bit safer.
This basket should be big enough to collect the Easter eggs from the paper chase. So, let's go!

CAUTION! THE NEXT QUEST WILL START AUTOMATICALLY IN ONE HOUR!
That was quite a successful visit. You found a lot of Easter eggs, too many to take them with you to the next island. What now?
That should suffice to store not only the eggs already found, but all future finds too. Let's go on to the next stage of the paper chase.

CAUTION! THE NEXT QUEST WILL START AUTOMATICALLY IN ONE HOUR!
Once again, you found all the Easter eggs. It's just a little strange that you didn't haven't had a message from the Easter bunny yet. Maybe, something is wrong?
After a long search, your team was able to find the map, and the last stage of the paper chase can begin.

CAUTION! THE NEXT QUEST WILL START AUTOMATICALLY IN ONE HOUR!
You have successfully collected the remaining Easter eggs and brought them to the Easter bunny. He is very grateful and would like to contact you when he is feeling better.
The Easter bunny's brother is very grateful. However, you immediately sense he has another favor to ask. He has another map in his pocket.

CAUTION! THE NEXT QUEST WILL START AUTOMATICALLY IN ONE HOUR!
You return from your Easter egg search successfully. Just as you arrive, one of your settlers approaches excitedly. This does not bode well.
Slowly, he recovers and reports that he searched and searched until he fell unconscious. Now, it is up to you to find all remaining Easter eggs.

CAUTION! THE NEXT QUEST WILL START AUTOMATICALLY IN ONE HOUR!
So, another adventure finished successfully. Let's see what further surprises the rabbit has in store.
That was really good, but that's enough relaxation for the moment. The next map awaits.

CAUTION! THE NEXT QUEST WILL START AUTOMATICALLY IN ONE HOUR!
As you are on your way home you come across a little hut. An old man is sitting in front of it and tells you something remarkable when he sees the Easter eggs: He saw a bunny hiding Easter eggs in a completely unsettled area. Maybe you should ask the rabbit about it?
It takes some time for the potion to take effect. Didn't the old man talk about an area somewhere? Maybe this would be a good place to start until the rabbit recovers his memory.

CAUTION! THE NEXT QUEST WILL START AUTOMATICALLY IN ONE HOUR!
Phew, those Easter eggs were very really well hidden. Now, get home quickly to check whether the potion has taken effect already.
That really was a lot of work, but it is to be rewarded! A message from your doctor reaches you, saying that the rabbit's memory is slowly coming back.

CAUTION! THE NEXT QUEST WILL START AUTOMATICALLY IN ONE HOUR!
No sooner have you secured the last Easter egg than one of your messengers arrives and reports that the rabbit has fully recovered his memory. You start for home immediately.
That should be enough to protect the Easter bunny's brother effectively. Let's go to the last island.

CAUTION! THE NEXT QUEST WILL START AUTOMATICALLY IN ONE HOUR!
Everyone joyfully arrives at your home. The rabbit thanks you very much for your immense help, picks up his backpack and hobbles away.
What are the rabbits doing right now? Well, speak of the devil, isn't that a letter from them?
Well, that is a really huge amount of Easter eggs. What an unusual Easter…
Congratulations! You have found all Easter eggs. Return to your home zone to complete the Easter quest.
Congratulations! You have found all Easter eggs. Return to your home zone to complete the Easter quest.
Congratulations! You have found all Easter eggs. Return to your home zone to complete the Easter quest.
Congratulations! You have found all Easter eggs. Return to your home zone to complete the Easter quest.
Congratulations! You have found all Easter eggs. Return to your home zone to complete the Easter quest.
Congratulations! You have found all Easter eggs. Return to your home zone to complete the Easter quest.
Congratulations! You have found all Easter eggs. Return to your home zone to complete the Easter quest.
Congratulations! You have found all Easter eggs. Return to your home zone to complete the Easter quest.
Congratulations! You have found all Easter eggs. Return to your home zone to complete the Easter quest.
Congratulations! You have found all Easter eggs. Return to your home zone to complete the Easter quest chain.
You have discovered a hidden quest!
You managed to expel the witch and free the king's men. The king expresses his gratitude in the form a decent reward.
Find the seven hidden graves to free the cursed souls that the Witch has bound to her island!
You have found and freed all the damned souls!
A deserted royal regiment is reported to hide among Victor's troops. Make sure they survive so they can be taken before the king for a fair trial.
You managed to catch the deserters! The king shall pass fair judgment on them.

Vicious Victor seems to have driven some local scoundrels to the woods when seizing these lands. His old rival Ruppert the Revengeful is secretly gathering troops and is just waiting for Victor to be cast out so he can return to pester the righteous folks. Stop the evildoer's scheming, and the local regent will increase your rewards even further!
You have successfully prevented Ruppert's ruthless return! The regent admires your prudence and rewards you with additional treasures.
You have discovered a hidden quest!
The mayor is overwhelmed with joy and in an almost solemn gesture hands you a worn and dusty piggy bank.
You have discovered a hidden quest!
The Guild Master thanks you for your helpfulness. "We shall be able to weave the most magnificent wreathes this year!", he exults and hands you a chest of exquisite treasures.
What a glorious victory! Your opponent truly didn't hold back, and showed impressive class, all of which makes this success even sweeter. What a great way to start the tournament!
You stood fast and showed the enemy that you're there's no messing with you! A worthy victory that is going to make a lasting impression on your followers.
You have defeated a worthy opponent with skill and finesse, and your supporters are jubilating. Truly a respectable effort to be proud of!
Your opponent was no match for you! Revel in the glory of this moment while you can, for there are more stiff challenges ahead of you!
You were victorious in what can only be called a remarkable battle! Such a spectacle is a rare sight to behold and your followers are rightfully stoked.
What a triumph! You have proven your strategic brilliance in a truly epic struggle that shall be remembered! Your Settlers shall tell their offspring of this day and proudly look up to you.
You have won the match!
You have won the match!
You have won the match!
You have won the match!
You have won the match!
You have won the match!

What a glorious victory! Your opponent truly didn't hold back, and showed impressive class, all of which makes this success even sweeter. What a great way to start the tournament!
You stood fast and showed the enemy that you're there's no messing with you! A worthy victory that is going to make a lasting impression on your followers.
You have defeated a worthy opponent with skill and finesse, and your supporters are jubilating. Truly a respectable effort to be proud of!
Your opponent was no match for you! Revel in the glory of this moment while you can, for there are more stiff challenges ahead of you!
You were victorious in what can only be called a remarkable battle! Such a spectacle is a rare sight to behold and your followers are rightfully stoked.
What a triumph! You have proven your strategic brilliance in a truly epic struggle that shall be remembered! Your Settlers shall tell their offspring of this day and proudly look up to you.
You have discovered a hidden quest!
You have successfully inspected all the caves.
You have successfully inspected the ruins.
You have found the old well.
"You did it! You cast the nasty old witch out, and our children have returned home safely! We can't ever thank you enough!"

It's fantastic, isn't it? Use this overview as you wish. I will try to keep it up to date as best I can. However, we have to do something about your tree deposits. You should always try to keep your resource production in a green area.
Very good. These two foresters should be enough to refill your wood deposits. Maybe you've seen that we're producing surplus wood. Another sawmill might be useful.

Now, you have it in black and white that efficiency has been improved. Using this method, you can perfect all your production chains. Oh, that reminds me of something: may I introduce you to our new geologist?
Very good. More buildings of one type produce more, of course. Still, there are other ways of increasing production… Hey, a courier is coming. Please, wait a moment.

Very strange… Usually, your brother doesn't give things away for free. Let's hope he is not up to something bad. Anyway, we should get back to your settlers. There are still important things missing in the basic services.
I see you have the hang of it. Don't hesitate to change the options if anything bothers you. Additionally, you can look up all my notes in the archive in case you forget anything.
Your fishermen were really hard working. Seems like they are really satisfied under your leadership. Now the first part of your economy is finished, we can go a step further.

Did you find anything suitable? There are some beautiful things... but enough of that. The merchant is accessible at any time through the treasure chest in the bottom right-hand corner, in case you need something.
Well, that works fine. So, no problem if you ever get yourself stuck. However, moving buildings costs resources, so keep that in mind.
In the archive you can re-read all the help window texts, and if you still have questions, try the forum where a lot of other settlers are willing to help you with their experience.
The merchant is reliable. Maybe you have seen the other resources he has on offer. This makes him a good place to go whenever you need something urgently.
That was fast. Now, you have enough tools in stock. We should think about producing them ourselves, only one by one.
I am really curious as to what the explorer will find. He will be returning in 6 hours, so you can give him some new orders then. Just remember you cannot cancel the search.
Very good - strong allies will definitely prove useful. Social skills are very important. You should never underestimate that.
As you can see, your pinewood consumption has risen rapidly, so it is recommended you take countermeasures.
I knew you would make it. The king will be proud of you. I will report to him immediately.
Bronze bars are very important. If we have to deal with bandits, we can process them into weapons. But first, we need to use them for something else: tools.
I am very grateful. You are really very kind. We have put the fish refiller in your star menu.
My friend the fisherman has come to me and told me he has been catching fish better than ever. He has asked me to convey his thanks. You have mine also - thank you.
The king has noted your efforts appreciatively. I congratulate you. You are really doing excellently. Keep it up!
The farm is the most important building for successful bread production. Theoretically, all farms can harvest from the same wheat field - but the fields will deplete faster that way.
The fields are harvested continuously, and when they are depleted, a new field has to be built. In order to avoid a shortage you can place several fields.
Really beautiful wells. Wells and wheat fields only contain a certain amount of resources. As you progress, you will gain access to higher capacity wells and wheat fields.
Excellent. It's nearly impossible to convince a recruit to fight for you without brew. But of course, brew alone is not enough to recruit units - we need more… correct! - weapons!
Well, it's about time! As soon as we have enough brew and weapons we can begin training.
Very well, I will stop bothering you now so you concentrate on your military concerns.
But now I shall myself retreat. I wish you lots of luck with the bandits. Hopefully, they will not make too much trouble.
That went as expected. The remaining sectors will probably be the same. A great battle lies before us. I hope you will face this challenge!
With it you can see which enemy units can defeat your units, and which is the most effective against the other. You should always refer to it.
Lady Amidale was so astonished that she decided to move her residence to among the ponds! Imagine that! She was most grateful, and her gifts are already here. Take a look!
Well, the bows are a bit small but they will suffice for the start of our bowmen training.
Isn't the mill beautiful? I love the sound of its sails turning. A friend of mine is in charge of it now. I also have another one for the bakery.
Wow, I am really impressed. Finally we can produce bread by ourselves. Since you arrived, everything has improved. Thank you very much.
Hmm… A buff. And how is that supposed to help the military? They don't need sandwiches! They need something more consistent!
I think I have underestimated you in certain areas. That was a clever move. You should go now and look after your production. You always have to keep an eye on the people.
You general was victorious. The sector is free and can be captured. I hope you know how that works… Just in case you don't, start by building a storehouse in the sector.
Good! Celebrate your victory. For personal reasons I have to go on a journey for some time. When I return, I will help you to increase the size of your military.
You were really good. Lord Sardin seems to have prepared you very well. I am truly impressed.

So, how do you like trading? You can always use it to get missing resources or to get rid of those you have in excessive quantities. And remember always to keep an eye on prices - you may find a bargain here or there.
Oh, what a beautiful building. Isn't it noble? That is your ticket to becoming a mighty, influential merchant. I am excited to see how you will use this.
So our information was correct - we have iron deposits. Lucky for us. We will be able to make a lot of beautiful things from them.
Strange… What? Oh nothing. I just received a weird letter from my daughter, but never mind. You know what to do next.
This is music to my ears. Solid weapon production is always a good base for a successful kingdom. But enough chatter - now action is needed.
So what do you think? Not bad is it? That is the result of the splendid training program I personally arranged. Feel free to keep training more units.

Don't they look fabulous? From now on you can build them and make even more space for your settlers. However, remember that residences also need building licences. If you need a building without obtaining a licence, go see the merchant.
I have to admit, you have a really nice little town there. Carry on like that and the king will happily support you. Anyway, that's enough relaxing. Let us get on.
You are getting better and better, I have to admit. It's probably no longer necessary to treat you with so much care. If you continue like that, you will achieve everything you desire.
The travellers were really pleased about the stable. One of your settlers is taking care of the stable and has begun to raise horses, just in case you need some in the future.
You should remember that cavalry always attacks first, targeting the weakest enemy unit first. This will be very useful in your upcoming battles.
I have spoken to the stable manager once again, and he is now receiving enough wheat to feed his horses. Soon the first horses will be ready.
Not that I couldn't do it on my own… but thank you. With that, he has already lost the second bet, the blockhead. He will never learn his lesson.
King Damien believes his ships will amaze his visitors. The ships are a masterwork indeed! Look how amazingly they shine in the sunset! I would sure love a place on one of those ships!

Lord Edword was most impressed to see the amazing mountain now standing high in on his land. I'm not sure the farmers are that happy about it... but that's too bad. Anyway, here is the reward Lord Edword sent us.
The miner's union has promised they will take us on a tour when they're ready. I would skip that, if I were you. Ohh look, they've sent you a gift!
The king promised that when we visited, we would have the best rooms! I do wonder who would simply climb up to the city of their own free will… The king has sent you your reward.
These exotic plants are really dangerous if you don't know how to transport them. Thankfully, the lady has the best escort there is.
I am sure they are going to be able to feed the whole eight island region. The feast will be amazing, I can feel it!
The travellers will be most satisfied with our hospitality! I am sure they will spread our good reputation to the neighbouring islands!

I can already hear the cannons and imagine the gold shining in the sunlight. It must be an amazing experience to see something like that. It would have been so nice to be there. Maybe next year we can attend?
Well, regardless of who won the bet, we did our best! We've even received some crates filled with rewards! Good job!

Not only will this repository be the biggest, but apparently the architectural style is kind of unique. I hope we will have the opportunity to visit it once it's completed. The Tagalian has sent you a thank you package. How nice of him.
We now have an army. I hope that Lord Sardin will be late with his inspection route. The King sent us a reward for being so cooperative.
I've heard about a lot of weird things in my life, but this wall of swords…? Well it seems possible to build one. At least we can say that we played a large part in its creation.
We are done! I still can't figure out how the cook will bake this pretzel but I'm sure he knows. I hope. Anyway, the cook has sent us a reward!
The noble road will be a long and shiny one. We did a great job providing everything we could! The King is most satisfied with us, and he's sent us a present!
Well, we did our best but we couldn't find the queen. Even her ship has disappeared, can you believe that? A mysterious event, if ever there was one. I'm not even sure she was here…
Well we did our best! I hope the chicken parade will be a huge success! Me? No, I wouldn't attend an event with singing chickens. The musician has thanked us by sending these packs of goods!
We have just received the reports! We've wiped out all the bandits, but sadly, it seems that Dagger Island was not their main base! We need to keep looking! The King has sent us something though!

Yes, the ore collectors left this morning! They seemed to be completely satisfied, though I'm not sure we talked them into taking the titanium. It's as if they were afraid of it… anyway, we got our share of payment!
We got the winner! Let's celebrate the work of these brave men! Hurray! The King was very happy to hear of our actions and has sent us a token of his appreciation!

Using all the map pieces we finally found the treasure, but when we… err… opened it… all we found was some pink underwear. Yes, well, at least the old pirate had a sense of humor. He must be laughing in his grave right now.
From now on, most of the bridges of Capital Island will be built from marble! Pure marble! The King is most grateful!
Come cyclone, tornado or hurricane, those buildings are sure to hold strong! The Merchant's Guild is most grateful!
We did our very best, and it seems that we managed to calm spirits down. I think we did a pretty good job - perhaps we should consider starting an anger management group?
Our island is the safest! And you know what? We are going to keep it that way! We won the challenge! The King has sent us a nice reward!

The ship is loaded with all the resources the Captain asked for! He was very generous in showing his appreciation for our help! I hope they do find that lost ship… I even heard the captain was Ironplanks' own son…
Coron Franz is done mapping, and is very grateful we helped him!
The ceremony went well and all our generals were rewarded! I really think that this was a very noble gesture from our King!
The ship has sailed and the battle of the river will commence as soon as they get the weapons we sent them! I really hope they're going to be victorious! They've already sent us the payment!
The kids are back on the ship to Capital Island! They learned a lot, I'm sure! The king seems to be grateful - just look at the reward he's sent us!
The tools are finished and delivered. I hope they are strong enough - there are a lot of holes to dig.
The huts are in perfect condition and the wood is ready to be delivered. There will be a lots of buckets, indeed. Good work!
Thank you, your settlers were a big help! There are a lot of goods to move around!
The whole settlement is bathed in the smell of fresh bread! The men will be happy to hear about the feast awaiting them at the dig site! Wonderful!
Lady Amidale loves marble! She is very satisfied with the quality you supplied! Thanks for that!
You could almost fill a lake with that much water. It will be quite enough, thank you! I really like your wells, you know?
These are indeed amazing tools your people have made! Good work!
The amount of wood you provided should be enough for the first few ships! Very good!
The departing ships move slowly, for they are filled with the steel you provided. Thanks to you, the royal shipyard will be able to make really strong ships!
Imagine the amazing decorations they will make with all that iron cutlery on the table! Good work!
I would definitely like to taste that meal, seeing as you provided the sausages! Well done!
Very good! Now we have time to concentrate on the quest. Well done! I hope many lands will be spotted from the nest!
Is that the stone? Ohh it already looks like a mountain! Good work!
We could organize the Olympics with so many carriages. I will stop one for us. You never know, right? Very good work.
Stop! STOP! Yes, this amount of stone will suffice for now! I'm sure we can get more if we need it! Nice work!
Ohh how beautiful these horses are! My daughter used to pester me for a horse. Maybe now she can have one, what do you say? You did great work for your guild.
We sent the granite to the building site. The builders really appreciated it and have sent you a thank you letter. Good work!
That's a lot of fish. I wonder how they will keep the cats away, ehh? Good job.
The union was really happy see the new tools too! They can't wait to start digging!
With so many planks we could build ourselves a roof above the island! Ha ha!
These planks are truly strong. I could have one hundred settlers stand on that hardwood plank and it would not break! I think. Let's not try that… Good work!
Yes, the mines are ready, and air is pouring in, filling the tunnels. The miners are happy!
They could open up a meat shop down there… At least they won't be hungry anymore! Good work!
By the time they are done, even the king will be able to take a walk down there. The plans are impressive indeed.
Water does magic, if used properly! Good work!
I hope they know what they are doing up there. If I were them, I sure would use a lot of planks for the walkways. Good work!
You have made sure the new residents will be well fed until they learn how to produce their own food. Can I have a piece of bread?
I wonder how many nails they will require to make the structure of the sky town safe. I don't even want to imagine what could happen up there during a serious storm…
We have the bows ready! Winged predators shall fear the sky town archers!
Well, that should be enough I guess! Good work!
We will add some nice handmade saddles to the shipment! Milady will be most pleased, I'm sure!
I wouldn't mind taking a bite of those amazing looking sausage-filled sandwiches! I'm sure milady will love them!
They sure will have a good time! I hope they talk about our brew when they get back home!
The steel swords are shining proudly in the morning sun! The guards are most surprised and thank you very much!
Ever wondered what a double wagon would look like? No? Me neither. Good work with the coins!
Whatever gets broken will soo be fixed! Well done training them!
Either he doesn't know how to use fire, or he is mad, but I still can't imagine eating raw fish. Anyway, he seemed satisfied with the big fish shipment we sent him.
They can bake a hundred loaves of breads with that amount of flour! Good riddance!
I just arrived back from my daily walk, and passed by our grain fields. Gold indeed! Good work!
Why do you need to be an artist to boil an egg?… I don't know. Well he has his water, so… I wish him happy boiling! Ha ha!
Thank our great hunters for the meat. They really did their best!
The idea of matching tables is pretty nice. Remind me to have some of those for our next feast!
Good! In case they want to go and hunt, we sure are ready to supply them with the bows!
They can start a race if they want! Good work!
I bet we could even sell the water to them! But we can't do that, sadly, he he. Good work!
The fresh smell of bread will surely lure some travellers to this region!
Look at all these clean coins! Who would not love to win some of those?! I hope they know how to play bones…
The soldiers are ready for any troublemakers! Well done training them!
Well I hope this amount of gold ore will be enough to cause a storm. I still find this whole thing absurd.
Using coins for that… well I guess the kid deserves it. We did our part.
Well, the cannons are ready. We used our best tools and resources to make them!
Very well done! Now we'll definitely be able to provide the best gold ore if necessary!
Eugh! I don't like fish soup! But nevertheless, good work!
I hope the carriages don't have holes… we don't want the coins to roll… away. What am I thinking?!
There! Now our foresters can start planting the trees and make our animals a big and cozy forest!
We just need to stack the wheat, and some of our hunters will find a good place for it!
Very good! Now we're definitely going to have enough wheat!
Yes, good work! The animals will love the watering pools if we keep them clear!
With the information provided by your scout, we know exactly where the animals will dwell!
Our men can now start creating the feeding garden! Good work providing the hardwood!
It's a shame we have to give away so much brew! But you did it! Great job!
At least that famous repository will have some of the best fish ever supplied! We can be proud of that!
You did a good job with our miners! The iron ore is about to be sent!
The Tagalian called our flour 'white dust'. I'm not sure if he was trying to be funny…
I hope the shelves they make from our hardwood planks will hold for an "eternity", he he.
Yes, now we are prepared! If the Tagalian wants steel swords, we will be ready to make them for him!
I won't count the sword, and I hope Lord Sardin won't either. Looks like enough! Good work!
Yes, the militia seems to be ready and happy!
The horses are strong, the soldiers are strong… they look strong!
Our soldiers are ready for duty! Good work!
Those bows are really long, no joke there. I wouldn't like to run around with one of those, no siree.
Now our storehouse is filled with swords and Lord Sardin seems to be satisfied with you, and that's a pretty big deal if you ask me. Great work!
It seems that the Maiden was with them! The iron ore is ready to be delivered! Thank the Maiden!
Well done! We took the steel from the smelters as soon as they were done. We don't need more statues.
Yes, our blacksmiths are ready! Good work! Your guild is proud of you!
Very good! I know it must have been a hard task, but you and your men did it!
You got the coins? I'm surprised! Well done!
Yes, very good work indeed!
The best water he can have! Good work!
The only problem with flour is that you can't get it off your clothes… Well, you can but it's rather hard.
The mills are ready. I'll have some wheat delivered right away so they can start work.
There. Now he is going to get a lot of new wheat. Thank the maker he doesn't want us to give him new copper.
We have the tools and we have the manpower. We're going to send them to the salt mines soon! Great work!
These new wells will ensure we don't run out of water. Very good!
This stone is really fine. I think the road builders will be extremely satisfied.
I bet they'll be licking every one of their fingers after eating the food we've sent them!
Right, we have the required amount of marble ready to ship! Very good job!
They loved the brew! Good work!
You see? I told you they'd be really happy and work faster!
Our men are ready to leave for Capital Island and be part of the team to build the new road!
Our scout has returned, but he didn't see or hear anything. Shame.
Our scouts have explored all the sectors, but there's no queen or escort in any of them. Weird.
The leader of the scouts can now build the lookouts, and maybe they'll spot the queen and her escort! They have promised to report back daily.
There - at least we've made sure she'll be safe… Good work!
Our search party is ready to leave… or rather gallop away! Ha ha! Good work!
The hunters are very eager to look for the queen while hunting for game. Good work!
Very good - now we are really efficient and proficient! Oh, that rhymes! He he.
The hardwood planks are ready to be delivered to Capital Island! Outstanding work!
I really hope the builders know what they're doing. We sure sent them the best steel we have! Good work!
There - we have enough wheat to feed an army… as long as it's an army of chickens. Wait - that's the silliest thing I've ever heard.
Yes, we have enough barrels. I bet all that clucking… I mean singing will get the chickens thirsty! And they will thank you for the water!
Look at him! There are people who would tend to chickens. What a crazy world.
Yes that lot should suffice! Using those iron swords, they'll be able to defend us for a while, if need be. Good work!
He loved the fish and the front line is ready for duty! Great work!
The bowmen are ready for battle!
The cavalry seem to be fit and ready! We're off to battle soon!
There! We will use the cannons only if we need too! Good work!
The bag was delivered and the captain is already friendlier. Bah, that rat.
The collectors loved the food we served them!
The copper ore is ready to be delivered to their big ship!
We have the iron ore ready to be delivered!
The gold ore is ready to be delivered to their big ship!
The titanium ore is ready! We've packed it very well. I hope they won't get sick anymore! Weird people!
They kind of enjoyed our food, though it's clear that this is not their usual diet. I wonder what do they eat…
I wonder how much time he needs to find the marble deposit!
The food is packed! Great work!
The moment he finds that cold deposit he's going to become a hero!
He got the water! Now he can look for coal and make sure he remains clean all the time!
Yes, that much fish will be enough! I wonder what meal they're going to make. I love fish.
The coins look brand new! I'm sure the winner will be most pleased!
Our explorer came back and has found a pair of leather boots. Black leather. They look piratey enough. And there was a piece of a map inside! Good work!

Well, the explorer found an old cave along the northern coast! Near a small abandoned camp he found this eye patch. There is a piece of an old map glued on the back of it! Better than nothing, I guess.
The explorer has returned, and guess what?! Near the beach, he found a hook! A hand hook, or whatever you call them! And there was a piece from a map skewered on it! Great clue!
Er, our explorer has returned and found this pirate flag! And folded inside the flag was a piece of a map! Good!

Our explorer has brought back a piece of a map! He claims a parrot landed on his shoulder while he was eating a cracker and traded the map piece with him. Hmm... Let's concentrate on the map piece instead of that crazy story.
The explorer has come back! He found an old cannon ball, and under it there was this map piece! Great!
Let me see… yes, these tools look really good. And strong! Great work!
Amazing how they can build all those things from marble! And how beautiful they look!
The mason will now work twice as hard! Good work!
We got the marble! Now I can calm down a bit! Thank you!
Yes, the settlers are ready to leave! Good job! I'm sure they are going to build amazing marble bridges!
Fresh bread! I love how it smells!
Yes, now we are guaranteed to have enough free space to store anything we want. Well, not anything…
They put all the flour into these sacks, and added water. Well… not bad.
The first wall is in top shape! Let's hope we can fix all of them!
The storehouse is ready and empty! If they need the space, we can provide it!
We have all the hardwood they need! Let's load it into the ship!
The planks are done and stashed. Good work!
There! We managed to calm them down. I can't say it was an easy task…
I hope the lords are happy now. Getting that gold was not an easy task.
Indeed, the best breed of horses I have seen for a long time! Very good!
There! With this many sausages we could feed an entire army. And their families. Good work!
Owning that many swords makes us feel safer, does it not? Good work!
Well done! The lord has shut his mouth and returned home!
Very good! Nice armour.
The leader of the soldiers in the group have congratulated our stablemaster!
We placed the new cannons! Good work!
It seems that the bandit issue is now under control. Good work!
The men are ready to defend the shores if necessary! Good work!
The scouts seems to be happy about the coal! If they are happy, we are happy!
I hope they know how to cook! That's some great quality meat there. It would be a shame to see it go to waste!
Do you know the first thing the Captain did when the crates containing the bread arrived on his ship? He opened one up, and started feeding the seagulls. Would you believe it?!
The best steel swords a Captain can have! Good work!
The ship is loaded with barrels filled with our finest brew!
The tallest and strongest bows are on the ship! The Captain is most satisfied!
The Captain couldn't stop smiling when he saw our gift! Good work!
The soldiers are trained and ready! I hope they will protect Coron from any harm!
Look at him riding that horse! He seems to enjoy it! Good work!
Our soldiers know how to make a good sandwich. I hope Coron will like it!
I found an old scroll that holds the secret to building a table in less than ten minutes. Could be useful, I guess.
I sure hope Coron brought enough clothes!
The steel plates will hold the maps in place, and no wind will be able to blow them away. Except a hurricane, of course.
The bows are ready and so is your general! Off they go to Capital Island!
Your cavalry is read to accompany your general! Off they go to Capital Island!
With new swords in their hands, your recruits are ready to escort your general to Capital Island!
The cannons were loaded into the hold of the ship!
The new crossbows look amazing! Good work!
The equipment is ready! Good work!
The bowmakers are up and ready! If there is high demand for bows, at least you know you're up for it!
The longbows are ready to be delivered to our friends! Good work!
These are the finest longbows I've ever seen!
Good wood! Good work! He he!
I really hope the swords we gave them are waterproof.
I find the idea of those exploding globes fascinating. I wouldn't hold one, not me, no thank you.
The adventure was a success and the young apprentice was most exited about it! Good work, the king will be happy!
The adventure was a success and the young apprentice was most exited about it! Good work, the king will be happy!
The adventure was a success and the young apprentice was most exited about it! Good work, the king will be happy!
The adventure was a success and the young apprentice was most exited about it! Good work, the king will be happy!
The adventure was a success and the young apprentice was most exited about it! Good work, the king will be happy!
The adventure was a success and the young apprentice was most exited about it! Good work, the king will be happy!
He really found coins lying unclaimed on the street. Unbelievable how careless people are with their cash. But we can make good use of them, so who cares…
You passed this test. I will contact the king immediately. As soon as I have an answer, and am notified of his next demand, I will inform you.
Hmm… I am not sure whether I like the residences being built so close together, but as long as the king is happy... By the way, he has given you a small reward.
We will see when and how the royal council will react. Until then, you have done everything possible. Well done!
The environment is very important and should always be looked after. However, what is even more important is the king's favor, and thanks to you, it is secured.
There are almost certainly people from the guild in need of stone. If you help them, they are sure to help you in return.
Very well. You should always keep an eye on your storage. Swiftness pays off.
The traveller is very grateful for your help and immediately begins to write a letter to the king, telling of your noble act. Your guild can be proud of you.
That should save the fishing grounds for now. I'm sure the king watched the whole thing with great satisfaction!
The people loved your fish! I bet most of them will look for you next time you come here!
Let me taste that bread. Hmm… hmm… I knew it! It's a pale copy! Our bread tastes much much better!
Very nice of you! I'm sure your friend will return your kindness!
Yes! You did it! Your settlers are satisfied! You are indeed a ruler with outstanding diplomatic skills!
The sandwiches are delicious! I'm sure the settlers will enjoy them as well! What a great cook you are!
You're back? How was it? Good! I'm glad to hear that! Maybe you should rest for a while before returning to your daily tasks!
The iron ore was delivered and the merchant seems to be satisfied. I wonder who he's looking for?
The swords are ready in the storeroom! I hope we don't have to use them!
There! I hope this will calm the farmers down! Now let's have some bread. All this talk of wheat is making me hungry. And thirsty. We should take a horse, don't you think?
There! Next time he comes he will see that we're paying attention to him. Maybe he will be less grumpy too?
Our militia was trained by our best men! The people were entertained and educated at the same time! Good work!
We have the flour in our storeroom! The supervisor should be satisfied now!
Well I'll be, it was a golden coin! I hope it will bring us luck!
The troops are ready for any surprise attacks against our island! Good work!
We've moved the wells, and sure enough the water we've found is much better. Or at least that's what the geologist said. I can't tell the difference, to be honest.
Yes, the planks are now being produced fast enough! If that storm comes, we'll be prepared! Good work!
Very good, now we have the brew and sausages. Now let's wait for those ships… if any come.
Good! We're ready for the new settlers! I'm sure Queen Anita will choose us!
There! Now we lock the doors and hide the key! If I see even one miner hanging around the storehouse I'll alert the guards! Good work!
The cannon has been sold - thank the maker for that! We're not looking for trouble, and that cannon looked like trouble.
Now they have the imported tools, and look at them! They're still using *our* tools! And none of them have opened their mouths since… he he. Good work!
There! The "angel" came and helped us! I hope the lady is happy now!
The baskets are done! I got hungry just looking at them! Very nice job!
You're back! How was it? I knew it won't be a problem for you! Good work!
They received their iron and have already started to come up with their own designs. At least they're going to leave us alone for the time being.
The new bakeries are ready to make us fresh bread every time our roosters welcome the sun and sing their song. Good work!
We have the rooms and the food - visitors can come and get a good night's sleep! Well done!
Yes, this small army can patrol when on duty! Very good!
We got the coins! Now when the time comes, the guild will take care of the rest!
Well… the moment the wildlings saw our troops, they ran back into the deep dark woods. I guess that's that… Good work!
Great work! The technician is pleased with the results! So are we!
Great! You made sure everything works as intended!
Now we can make sure that no gold-eating termites will enter our gold mines! Good work!
What? Nobody can find the fisherman? Are you kidding me? He ran away? Well… at least we have fish…
There they go, with all that iron. It sure will weigh down a lot of pages… a lot of books. Good work!
We've received the marble. I'm sure her sculptor will have a lot of work to do!
So they will waste the flour by using it to track robbers. This I have to see. Good work!
Now we have the bows, the young ones can go and learn how to use them! Very good work!
We made sure to send them our most perky horses! Let's see how true they are to their claim! Good work!
The meat is ready for delivery! I've already sent the instructions to the Royal Cooks! Hope the King will enjoy his boiled meat!
Thank you for finding a hunter. I hope the problems caused by the wild animals will improve soon.
That will teach them a lesson. We'll see if they dare rob the settlers again. But we should build our forces up so we can strike back if they try again.
I see you know exactly what I am talking about. These longbows cause a lot more damage. I hope they will suffice to drive our enemies back.
That worked really well. The potion made from wheat and fish made the bear sleep long enough for us to take him to another island. Now the settlers can enter the woods safely again.
That really looks tasty. Our settlers will be very happy with their new rations. If we also supply the explorers with sausages, they might be able to search more effectively.
It seems demand is high. There are a lot of people who want to settle on your island. You have a good reputation, but deservedly so.
We won, thanks to your bountiful sausage supply. As promised, we would like to give you a part of our reward. Now I have to go back to work. Thanks again.
Unfortunately, I could not find out who the suspicious person was, but I think it was a blonde woman. Anyway, how is the hardwood production going?
Yes, much better. I hate rats, but at least they have helped us be better prepared for the king's next task.

You are becoming a very good leader, which is why I would like to share another tip with you: If you defeat the leader camp of a sector, the remaining enemies in the same sector become very demoralized and give up. They too are defeated, if you will.
Good - with this quantity of longbows we should be able to equip quite a lot of longbowmen. I would suggest we do this next. I'm going to start looking for that suspicious person again.
Steel is very important for weapon manufacture. By the way, I saw the shadow from earlier again. She disappeared in your direction. Did you see her, by any chance?
Very good. The military expansion has worked. In which case, I shall get back to searching for the suspicious person. Keep an eye open and report to me if you see her.
Hi, hi, thank you. I will contact you when it is safe to talk and tell you more about the other islands. You will not regret this.

That was really a good effort for your first adventure, but don't think all adventures will be this easy. They will get increasingly difficult as time goes on. On your maps, you'll find an estimation of the difficulty, indicated with skulls.
So, were you lucky? Sometimes the explorer finds only single map pieces, but you can piece them together too. Just visit the merchant.
What, you're not allowed to tell me the subject of the letter? That's a shame, but I suppose I'll have to get used to it. It must be very important if you get a personal, secret letter from the king.
Good - that should suffice to help your brother out. I'd like to know who this ominous attacker is. Perhaps we will know soon enough.
Uh, thank you. Finally I can get my own back on him! What? No, I don't mean you. As a reward, I can give you some map fragments which I found during my travels.
It seems that we had the right idea about this. I've heard that the king really appreciated our initiative. As a reward, he has sent us some resources to support us.
The message that the recruits are on their way seems to have calmed him down a bit, though he still doesn't want to tell us who this possible attacker might be.
As soon as you think that production is okay, we can continue training the soldiers. Do you think Theodor is really in danger? Maybe he is just imagining things.
At some point, you will almost certainly have a resource that's no use to you anymore. However, before you tear down a building you should always consider selling it through trade instead.
Victory! You've defeated them all and freed your island. Your settlers have reacted with jubilation. I have to admit, I am rather proud of myself. I guided you quite well.
You are really very generous. I hope your brother appreciates it, but most likely not. Hopefully, he is satisfied after taking receipt of the soldiers.
Just like that! It looks a lot better that way. I am sure the king will also be satisfied when he hears of your efforts to please him.
Hmm… Your face reveals a certain anxiety. I'm sure you can handle whatever's written in this letter. Anyway, I have to leave fast before someone spots me. Until next time.
The smell alone is simply sensational. By the way, you can also obtain this wood by trading with other settlers, although the cost is obviously higher.

I don't believe this. It would seem your brother's 'frightening fiend' is simply a lady he was rather ungentlemanly with. She hasn't even threatened him with soldiers, just thrown rotten eggs at his carriage. Unbelievable.
So, did your explorer find something interesting? I told you it would pay off. Anyway, I must go quickly. Until next time.
Thank you for your trust. I will not disappoint you. Hmm? Did I hear a noise? I think someone is approaching. I had better disappear. Until next time.
Wow, that was a really generous reward. I hope no envious individual will try to tarnish your success. We better keep our eyes open, just in case.
Very good, but it was about time. These little monsters feed on everything they can find. Let's hurry and begin processing the wood. It's still free of woodworm.
I have good news. We've found a way to get rid of the wood worm. Now, we can store the wood safely again.
Map fragments are a good thing. I have… Oh no, someone is opening the door. What should I do? Darn it! I'm trapped.
Thank you for leaving us alone for a moment. Seraphina is my daughter. We don't exactly have the best relationship. She left a while ago without even saying goodbye. At least I know where she is now.
Now we should be prepared for the new buildings. I'm going back to study the new plans so we can begin construction as soon as you give the signal. Goodbye.
Wow - a very generous delivery has just arrived from the king. Whatever it is you did, the king seems very satisfied. Well done!
So, did your explorer find something useful? Don't forget, the adventures you'll find on this route might be more difficult to handle, so always take enough units with you.

Could you get hold of some granite? It's quite expensive because it's rare, but there really is nothing better. Some people offer granite through the trade and, in an emergency, there is always the merchant. I heard that sometimes even explorers find granite during their treasure hunts.
Very good. It would be best to send them out immediately to find something. By the way, the explorer you hire from the merchant needs only half the time the normal ones from the tavern take.
You really have a talent for trading. I'm sure the king will recognize that too. Once we've improved your skills a bit, maybe you'll become one of the most successful traders of the country.
You've mastered that really well, but I have to admit I expected nothing less. By the way, have you seen Lord Sardin lately? Since the incident with his daughter he has kind of disappeared.

Very well. That should be enough to do something useful with. What? My father? Oh, he's just sobbing in a dark corner where nobody can see him. It is always the same. Don't worry, he'll soon reappear.
Oh wonderful. Now we can store the items way better. I'm sorry I always seem to ask you for something when I come for a visit. Next time I promise we'll just have a nice chat.
As I said, you can manage that all by yourself. If you still have any questions, feel free to ask, any time. In the meantime, I'll have a talk with my daughter.
So, now I'm eager to see whether it works. It's really very exciting. I admire you for taking care of your settlers so conscientiously. Now I'll mingle and see whether it works.
Titanium is a good metal; solid, but light and able to take a lot of strain. We should be able to produce effective weapons from it. However, it is not cheap.
Hmm… I just saw my daughter in the courtyard. It seems she wants to speak with you. I'm surprised she's helping you so much. Maybe I have misjudged her.
Now your army is on the right track. In my opinion, an army is never too big. Remember to have a variety of units. Having only recruits or bowmen will not suffice.

Wow, what a beautiful building. It really adds something to the city. Can't have been cheap, I'm sure. I'm excited to see how things develop with the carriages. Just remember we need a carpenter before we can use the carriages.
Excellent! The king was enthusiastic and has commissioned delivery of the reward, a really generous reward! Congratulations. In any case, you have definitely secured the king's favor.

We are finished. Definitely one of our best constructions. Do you like it? By the way, I've heard rumours about the carriages being able to carry cannons. I'll check whether I can find plans for that.
Right, that is what we need! No carriages to push around the area. We will be able to make fantastic weapons out of it. You will see!
I just took a look at weapon production. Very beautiful swords I have to admit. What? No, I am not sure where my daughter might be. She tends to keep out of my sight, rather successfully in fact.

Excuse your explorer when he sometimes comes back without an adventure - this route is quite dangerous and sometimes falling back is the better alternative. I have no further routes I can give you. Have fun!

I have to say that adventures are really exciting. I never thought I'd say that. And what do you think about our soldiers? Phenomenal, don't you think? They can take much and deal out a lot. For big challenges you should always take some of them with you.
Yes, these are really strapping young men, perfect for the military. Now we can take the next step in perfecting your army, and increase the amount of units.

Good, now my work here is done. Your military is near perfect - I've taught you everything I know and all nearby enemies have been fought back. With your permission, I will draw back. Contact me if you need my help again.
Well, that looks way better. I'm surprised how fast you did this. Now, there is only a little bit of work left to do to make your city perfect.
