Wow, you really made them pay. You are becoming a veritable bandit's nightmare. The only thing left to hope for is that the king will not hear about it. It would be a shame to be forced to give the gold back to him.
Hmm, that was a lot of work, but the powderhut really looks pretty. Now I shall leave and prepare the construction of the cannon forge. See you later.
So, you've mastered everything there is to do with the store. When we began settling I could never imagined such success. I am glad I was allowed to assist you.

Unbelievable! You really made it. I've just received the letter from the king via express messenger, approving your independence. I congratulate you. You are the first person I know who has managed to do this.

So, did I promise too much? Even Lord Sardin complimented me, and that surely means something. I think I've helped you as much as I can. I will now return to my work. Do not hesitate to ask for my help if you are ever in need of it.
Wow, people are flocking to your city. You seem to have a really good reputation. No wonder, seeing as you have such a good relationship with the king. Now we can continue quickly.
Are you satisfied with your preparations? Do you have enough units and supplies in stock? As soon as you think you are correctly prepared, just contact me and we'll get going.
My father prepared you really well. You worked well, and quickly. You have erased all my final doubts about you becoming the greatest explorer of all times.

You made it. You really made it. You've done everything a person can achieve in one lifetime. Our meeting went fine. We decided to meet once and again and do something. Tomorrow we will go to the firing range. It will be fun!
Of course, the sawmill isn't the only building to have such a window. You should always take a look at the information on each building.
Having a little stock is never a bad thing. Don't forget to check your storehouses regularly to see if anything is missing.
You are developing quickly. This should be enough for wood production to get started. Let's get on with the next resource.
Of course this is true for every deposit, not just stone. Always remember that deposits become depleted after a certain time, so it's good to have another one as a replacement.
Very good. This amount of stone should be sufficient for the upcoming buildings. However, you should always continue producing stone.
That is correct. You can do a lot with this. Don't forget that you need resources to create buffs, such as fish in this case. Do you have enough left?

As you may have noticed, storehouses are not cheap, but having them pays off as they can shorten production times for several buildings at once. If you ever find yourself with a number of buildings whose production times are too long, just place a warehouse nearby.
It's good that you claimed that sector. It seems to be rich in copper. I'm already excited about what the other sectors might hold.
And did you like the islands? Of course you should always go your own way, but considering suggestions doesn't hurt.
That is very kind of you. The king sends you his best wishes and regards.
I see you have everything under control. I just wanted to be sure, but it looks like I worry too much.
Super! Thank you very much. You will not regret this, believe me. I will begin to help with the harvest immediately.
That's really generous of you. With so many wheat fields, we should definitely win the bet.
Ha ha! That made him look really stupid. He didn't bargain with that. I thank you very much. Please take some of my gains as a sign of my gratitude.
Thank you for following my advice. I'm looking forward to the bread production already. Please contact me if you need my help with it.
So, the advice from the farmer was good after all. With this production we are well prepared for the horse breeding that will soon be upon us.
Hmm… I just told him we would help him, and straight away he asked for more bows. He's always been like that - you give him your pinky and he takes off the whole hand.

Why did I insist on helping him? I made a bet with another former student that the time will come when he would need my help. Back then, he had rich parents and bragged about it, but I knew it was nothing but hot air.
Wow, that functions quite well. I am really amazed. So now everything is possible for you. By the way, the mayor sends you his thanks. You really helped him out.
Of course that also applies to stone deposits. You should always have multiple deposits on your island.
Thank you for your help, but please hurry. We don't have much time. Maybe the child is trapped and cannot breath.
Thank goodness, we found the child. That was close. I will go immediately and tell everybody to stay away from the mines.
Thank you. Now I can continue working without problems. I have a feeling that a lot of new construction orders are about to come in.
I brought him the plate and I was asked to tell you thank you, and that a bright future awaits you, with a huge army, great city and lots of capital. However, that's what they always tell you.
Now we should have enough wheat to supply them, should they decide to rest here. In case they decide otherwise, we can still use the wheat ourselves.
The construction of the wells you ordered is completed. It's nice that you always take my advice seriously. I appreciate it.
I see that water production seems to be quite effective. Don't neglect it, or the cavalry training will cease.
And how did it go? Not bad, right? By the way, they say the merchant sells a watermill which produces water from an inexhaustible water deposit. However, it is not particularly cheap.
Thank you very much. Now my relatives can come. I am convinced they will be enthusiastic about your generosity and spread word of it across the whole land.
Exactly these ones I meant. As you probably know already, you can allocate the baskets to your production buildings, and these will produce more effectively for a certain time.

Maybe you're wonder why you were supposed to search for a coal deposit. Well, Henry told me he is now able to build coal mines, and they are way more effective than the coking plant. This is a good time to try out the new mines.
I just returned from the barracks. The troops had all painted their faces black. Looked really frightening. I think it's camouflage training. Very strange.

Good, the construction of the forester was well received. I was concerned whether that would suffice. For the future we should consider something else, because I think this will not be the last time we hear about this initiative.

It's much better that way. Don't forget to keep an eye on your weapon production, as you need your army when expanding your land. And even if you have enough units, weapons are a fantastic good to trade with.

I don't believe it - we really do have gold on this island. That is fantastic! Before we begin to bank it, we should check whether we have multiple deposits and how rich they are. Coin production is quite expensive.

So, what do you think? Did you get an impression? With coins, you can do a lot of different things, not just trade but also hire new specialists. For the moment though, it's a little early to you build your own means of production.

You've really managed to gather quite a solid amount of capital. Did you have any difficulties? Sleep on it, it and if you still want coin production, we'll start work on it. Meanwhile, you should be able to evaluate it yourself.

Not bad is it? Now, you just have to use the buff on the mayor's house, and you'll have 75 extra settlers immediately. If you need to bump up your numbers quickly, you can use this method any time to gain settlers.
Very good. Now we will be able to work, and steel production can begin. I will return to my work and make sure production goes smoothly.

To keep the mine replenished, you can buy refills from the merchant. If you are unable to keep the mine going, just destroy it shortly before it collapses. That way, the craftsmen can recuperate some of the construction resources.
With the additional steel you produce, you can make more steel swords, and with additional steel swords you can train more soldiers.
Hmm… I wasn't expecting that. I have to admit, that wasn't bad. But you have not arrived at the Mount Olympus of adventures just yet. There's still a long way to go.
Well, you seem to have everything under control, even during your adventures. I just wanted to be sure. Very well then, we'll soon be able to begin training the soldiers.
Cool, thank you. With that I can realise my project. What? Oh, nothing special. I just want to help a village defend itself against constant attacks.
Just like that! In doing so you can get way more resources out of the mine. By now, you probably know where to get or produce buffs. The merchant has some more effective ones for sale too.
The farmers just told me that your materials have arrived and are already being utilized. Since the machines can work better now, and there is more space, they produce a lot more.
That should suffice. I never thought production would take that long, but gold ore is always very deep in the mountain. That explains why settlers take so long to extract it.

And how did you like them? Experiencing adventures is a lot of fun, isn't it? And you can discover the coolest things during them. Also, you may occasionally find new adventures that even your explorer can't.

Quite difficult, isn't it? But that is how you should always try to do your adventures - consume as little as possible to get the most out of the adventure. Anyway, I have to go before someone spots me.
Don't get me wrong. I just wanted to inform you before you run out of coal, and the other production chains that need it also stop producing. I wish you the best of luck for your coin production.
Now we have nearly everything we need for coin production. Pretty intensive, don't you think? I told you. However, coins are one of the most valuable resources you can have, so it does pay off.

That was a really exciting competition. Thank you very much for your help. Although this competition is held only once every ten years, I would be very happy for you to take part again next time too. If you need to find me, I'll be back at my work.

Wow, that was really good. As a reward, here's a so-called decoration object. It is the latest fashion at the king's yard. To be more specific, it's a flower bed. You can place it on your island to beautify your city. You'll find it in your star menu.

So, was the production chain still balanced? Don't forget the resources not included in the economic overview, such as building costs or upgrade costs. You should always try to produce a bit more than you need of everything.

Well, the report is finished. I really only have good things to say about you. The pre-production of gold bars is also complete, I see. This means we can commence the last step in your coin production.

Good. Now the woodworm is probably gone for good. It would have been annoying for it to spread to the exotic wood and be obliged to start the whole process again. I'll tell the sawmills they should keep an eye out for these things.

Now you are producing coins. Congratulations. I am eager to see how your coin production will go in the future. Try to upgrade these buildings as soon as possible, as it will make coin production more effective.
Not a bad offer, is it? You should really take a regular look at what the merchant has to offer. It changes from time to time. By the way, this adventure box contains a random adventure. Mystical…

That was really exciting. I think in the long run it would be too much for my old heart. I prefer to stay in my office and support you from there. Speaking of my office, I'll go check whether it is free again.
So, how is coal production doing? Everything fine? That's comforting. In which case, I will report back to my craftspeople. They will be relieved too, I hope. Thank you very much.

You see? Always pay attention when you are adjusting your production chains. Unless of course you buff your buildings all the time. But in this case, an additional building of the same kind might be a better alternative.

So, in conclusion, what do you think of your coin production? Are you satisfied? As I said, it takes some time, but when it is upgraded and becomes more effective, it will also become indispensable. If necessary, you can also purchase gold ore at the trader's.
Wow, you have a lot more than me. I suppose I'll have to go and search a bit more, so that's what I'm going to do, straight away. Until next time!
Very good! Then we know where to get our granite from. I assume the amount of granite will differ a lot from adventure to adventure, but at least we know where to get it from generally.

It is really a lot of work gathering granite, but it's essential so don't pay it any further thought. Just one thing - I'm pretty sure you can also obtain granite through trade. Furthermore, one of our explorers told me that he once found a small amount of granite during his journey, but really not very much.

It's not easy to produce crossbows on your own, is it? However, they do have a lot of advantages. Not only do crossbowmen have the highest damage output, but crossbows also bring a high price when traded.

So I was right, they are just decorative buildings. It seems you can find them from time to time during adventures. By the way, the merchant also has some of these buildings. Some of them can be somewhat complex.

So, what do you think? Did it pay off? Of course you have to consider that prices always differ for many different reasons, for example depending on the time of day. So, even if prices are not good one day, they can change completely the next.
Ha! I just said that. I won the bet. That will teach him to stop underestimating you. To thank you, I'd like to give you something from my reward. Buy yourself something beautiful with it.

Wow, that much granite in one place is definitely rare, I have to say. I mean, I don't know much about this sort of thing, but just by looking you can see how valuable granite is. Take good care of your granite.
I've just returned from my storage inspection, and I have to admit that freshly cut wood smells really fantastic. I also checked the wood for woodworm. Luckily, there isn't any.

Oh, that was quick. Thank you very much. I always feel better when I know the most important building materials are in stock. Now I can turn my attention back to the construction plans for the new buildings. Bye for now.
The more generals you have, the more effectively you can transport your troops to adventures, and the faster you can defeat bandits. This is why having multiple generals is always a good idea.
Ha! I was really in front of you by a nose. However, I didn't win either. Little matter - we both qualified for the next round, which means you'll have a chance to get your revenge.
Oh no! This time you were in front of me. I assume I wasn't paying enough attention. Never mind, once again we both qualified for the next round. This one will decide who is the better explorer.

I'm so very grateful. The help requests were all taken care of, and all the soldiers who requested vacation were able to return home safely too. I couldn't have done it without you. Thank you very much.
Oh, you just returned from a follow-up adventure? So, how was it? Of course, you won't always find construction plans, but a decent amount of coins is common.

I'm really impressed. Not only were you better than me, you also won the whole competition. There's no shame in losing to the best. My congratulations. I'm looking forward to competing against you again next time.
You really taught the other king something. He'll never criticize the trade network again. Even I was surprised how much gold you can earn through it. You've done really well.
I just knew you didn't need any help. It's a mystery why Lord Sardin always thinks you have to have someone standing by your side for the slightest thing. The man's such a worrier.
So, what do you think about the cannoneers? I think they are fabulous. If you're ever forced to fight against buildings, they'll be your most effective weapon.

Thank you for listening to my advice. Now you can train cannoneers. Unfortunately, I have to go on a journey, which is why I won't be able to oversee training. I asked the little man… what's his name? Oliver? The little fat one. Anyway, I asked him to help you.

Just as I said it would be. The king had to let someone read out a plea of guilt, taking back everything he had said. It was a complete success. To show his gratitude for your help, the king has sent you a big present.

Perfect! Now, your island is complete. I think that last touch makes your island one of the most beautiful of all time. By the way, the king thinks so too, and has sent you something as appreciation. Things couldn't get any better!
Very well. You've now finished the first step in creating a basic stable economy. Let's move on to the next one!
The sawmill converts wood into planks, with which you can build new buildings. Now I'll show you where you can find your produced goods.
As you can see, the Mayor's house has different pages where you can see different things. The same is true of storehouses. Anyway, enough theory for now - let's focus on your economy again.

This forester will refill your wood deposits so you always have enough wood. However, refilling usually takes more time than cutting down. To see whether you need an additional forester, you can take a look at the economy overview.
That was really fast. Please remember that resources other than stone might take longer to find. But enough chat, let's get to work!

Good, the stone cutter has begun work. Since he does not supply any other buildings, there is no need to check whether you can perfect his methods. The more masons you have, the more your stock of stone increases.
You've just built your first residence and hopefully created the basis for a successful settlement. May many residences follow and your settlement flourish.
Your fisherman has already begun his work. A lot of things can be made from the fish caught, but most importantly your settlers can work more effectively using them. I'll show you, what I mean.
Ah, the provisions house has already been built. You should take a look. You can commission a lot of nice things there.

There are a lot of different buffs. They differ in duration and effect, and you cannot produce all of them yourself. While playing, more possibilities will become available, so take a regular look at your provisions house.
You have doubled the production of this building for 30 minutes. You should always buff your workyards when you temporarily need more of one specific resource.

The explorer has just returned. He discovered a new sector. Each sector has its own deposits and provides additional building space. So, if you are in need of new deposits or space, don't hesitate to search for new sectors.
This sector is yours now. You are progressing really fast. I will now write my report for the king. It's very pleasing to have only good things to report.
The rumours really were true, luckily! You will be needing copper for further city development. We should make the most of it!
Well, I've settled everything. All deposits you find on this island are your property now. You've also been busy, I see, so let's get on with it.
There's the coking plant. You'll need coal for many different things, which is why you should always keep an eye on your production.
Good, tool production works… Unfortunately, I have bad news. The rumour about the bandits is true. We need to take action. We also need a specialist.
Well, that's a start, but looking around we have still a way to go. First check out the barracks. You'll need a lot of them in the future.
In the beginning there are only recruits to train, but others will come over time. However, training takes time, so plan for it.
You can upgrade nearly all buildings so they produce faster, or make more goods. Upgrading storehouses increases your stock capacity, but the time and resources required increases with every level.
Good, production is working fine. That's a relief. Recruits are the cheapest unit, which is why you should take them into every battle.
A beautiful tavern. I just visited it and you really have fabulous taste. However, let's now take care of your new general.
A nice garrison! Each of your generals has his own garrison where you can assign units to him. You can place them on any green field.

As you might have gathered, to train units takes quite a lot of time. The better the unit, the longer it takes, but when you upgrade your barracks, the time decreases a little. In addition, there are drill plans that can speed the process up. I'll let the merchant tell you more.
And so, everything is settled for you to send your troops to battle. Have you spotted any bandit camps already?
Wow, I wouldn't have credited you with so much command potential. My compliments, that worked out really well.
So, you've created the basis of your weapon production. Just remember that bow production consumes additional pinewood. You know what that means, don't you?
It's great that we have enough hardwood trees on this island. Your hard working settlers are already producing hardwood and hardwood planks. Now, let's get on with producing marble.
So, now we can relax and wait. As soon as we have enough hardwood planks and marble, we can start building new buildings and expand your economy further.

Training the militia really isn't easy. By the way, you should keep an eye on your population because regardless of what you do, you'll always need settlers, whether they're military units, mine workers or woodcutters.
Nice. That doubles our plank production. But now we have negative pinewood production, don't we? It is not easy to keep the production chains balanced…
Good work! We're fearless!
Well, now the basics have been built. By the way, this proportion applies not only to pinewood but to all the different types of wood. When in doubt, produce more rather than less.
What a wonderful place. The people there are always cheerful and ready for a good talk. Take a look when you have the possibility. It'll be worth it!

You can find your purchased specialists in your star menu. You can have multiple specialists of one kind, but the allocation of specialists you can hire from the tavern is limited. When it is exhausted.you have to get additional ones from the merchant.

Wow, did you see how fast that was? Amazing! And I heard it works with all buildings. Furthermore, it also functions for building upgrades - you just have to click on the specific building. Just keep an eye on the prices, as they can differ.

That's how it works! When you have a little deficit in your economic overview you don't necessarily have to build a new building. Sometimes simply upgrading or repositioning a building, like just now, is sufficient.
The mixture will work its magic soon enough! Our hunters will be pleased!
The fish will love the lightshow we're making for them!
There! You did a good thing today! Good job!
We have the flour, and it's well stored. Done and done!
Good! We have the required blankets! Nice work!
We need to keep the water indoors - we don't want it to freeze. Good work!
We gave the man the coins. He is indeed using them to decorate the walls. Well… at least our nobles are happy about it.
Well, he got the stones. I wonder what he will do with them.
The gold ore is available for the painter. The golden wall shall be made. The noble is happy.
The men are ready to carry around the painter's supplies. I hope they don't ruin their clothes…
The copper ore is ready. Does he have the power to smelt the copper?
I still don't believe that he can actually paint marble. But he seems to be sure he can. Anyway, good job!
We now have the tools to build the new houses! Great work!
We now have enough hardwood planks now! Let's make those beds!
Well I hope the architect will be pleased now! You've done a great deed!
Beautiful wells next to beautiful houses! Good work!
There! Looks like our settlers are really happy about the food! Good work!
The decorated residences are looking really good! Our high society members will be most pleased!
The Desert Riders are amazed. Look how they're holding those longbows! Glad to make them happy!
Look how careful they are around the horses! They seem really happy to have them!
We made sure that the wheat is the best a horse can have. I'm sure the horses are going to miss the wheat when they get here.
The casks of water have been loaded onto the ship. Both man and beast will find them refreshing!
Good! Our cavalry will teach them how to use the carriages!
Well… the ship doesn't look like new, but I guess it will manage to transport them back to their lands. Good work!
The cannon forge is ready for the inventor's needs. He seems to be excited.
The steel is ready for him to take back to the island. Good work!
There. That's all the gunpowder we can give him. If he wants more, let him visit the other islands too.
I hope you placed that hut far from the center of the island. I don't trust gunpowder manufacturers.
We got enough saltpetre for the inventor. Good work!
The cannoneer will teach the inventor how to shoot the cannon. Hopefully.
The painter did an amazing work on those walls! We should send him to Capital Island and have him decorate the King's palace too! And look, the nobles want to thank us with these rewards! How nice!

I should've known it! The cold weather isn't about to hit our island at all! Our weather prophet was completely wrong… Well, at least now we have a lot of resources. There's no blaming him - everyone makes mistakes from time to time, right? In any case, the King did send us a reward to thank us for the hard work!
Our island has more homes now, and the King believes we're going to grow bigger in the next few years! Great work!
The Desert Riders look grumpy, but there's a feeling of overall satisfaction in the air. Actually, I'm not even sure they actually know how to smile. They got want they came for, so well done!

The old inventor has all he needs to build his cannon. I don't see how he'll do it all alone on that island of his. Maybe he will hire some people? Nevertheless, we should keep an eye out for him... we don't want that cannonball to land on our island!

Do you like it? It is always a good option to have an important building at the end of the construction queue. By the way, temporary building slots can be bought from the bottom of the list, and permanent ones can be acquired at the merchant's.

Just like that! You get a new settler every 15 minutes. If you have less time and you need new settlers fast, you cannot only buy settlers directly from the merchant but also buy buffs to shorten the time it takes to train new settlers. But always keep in mind that to get new settlers you need adequate free space.
Works fine, right? By the way, you can hire different numbers of settlers for bread. You can even store them in your star menu, meaning that you can produce them ahead of time.

Easy, isn't it? You can refill all deposits to greater than their original amount. But you can only produce refills for meat and fish by yourself. If you want to refill another deposit, you have to take a look at the merchant.
A good option, isn't it? You should always keep trade in mind as a viable alternative. In the right moment, it can save you a lot of time. But always compare prices so that you get a good offer.

It's amazing how fast the consumption of brew and swords has increased. But you should not, of course, neglect your production for trade, because selling extra production is also a good source of income.

Of course, you can also upgrade already existing residences to expand your population capacity if you need to save on building licences. Another possibility is to buy a residence at the merchant's, where construction does not consume building licences.
I'm sorry, but it seems that the Hoarfrost Globe is not in this camp! What a shame! I guess they managed to move it before we arrived! We should continue with our search!
We've found a man saying that the leader, Odinom the Cruel, broke the globe into pieces! Wait wait, don't start smiling just yet - the globe hasn't been destroyed!
The wells were destroyed and the pieces of the globe are buried forever! However, it seems the ice is still devouring the island! I have no idea what to do next!
We won, but Odinom the Cruel managed to escape! It doesn't matter! Quick, men - find that globe! Now!
See? It's dead easy. You can do this with all specialist tasks. It will pay off, especially for the treasure search, but we will come to that later. For now, let's continue with our plan.
Pretty useful features, am I right? Keeping the quests in sight is particularly handy. But I have kept you from your business long enough. Don't let me delay you any further.
Good work! You've finished making your first self-produced resources. What does it feel like? Just wait until we can build huge houses with our own resources!
Yes, very good. Now we have enough pumpkins to continue with our plans to stop the Hollow Man! Here, I've also found some pumpkins for you!
Very good, now my little pumpkins will grow faster! Here, I've found more pumpkins - you can have them!

I hope your friend won't get mad at you, it's just a test after all! But a good one, it seems! Now we know about the true power of darkness! We're one step closer in our quest to defeat the Hollow Man! Oh look what I've found! Some pumpkins for you!
It worked! The very strong light repelled the darkness! Great job! Have some more pumpkins!

We've found a Zombie! He is not that smart… but hey, what can you expect from a guy who has no brains, right? He is going to help you produce resources more quickly! Also, your settlers found some more pumpkins around the dig site!

Mr. Myers came out of his crypt as soon as I placed the chest armour at the front of the door. He does look a little pale, doesn't he? I bet he's going to help you train your military units faster! Great! Now that we have all we need here, we should move on to the final phase of our plan: creating a marble moon!

We got the marble we need! Great! Now I will leave your island to cover the moon in marble. That will scare away the Hollow Man! After he is gone, we're going to use this bag of Sun Buff, a magical powder, that will allow us to bring back the sun! You don't have to understand how this kind of magic works, it's complicated! It was a great pleasure to work with you! Here, take this Sun Buff! Use it, and welcome back the sun!

Well done! You have your sun back! You don't need my help any more, so I shall say goodbye now. Just one thing though - rumour has it that the Hollow Man comes back every year, so maybe we will see each other again next year, when the Hollow Man returns! Farewell!
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You now have stable pinewood plank production and can concentrate on other tasks. Short quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You now have stable stone production and can concentrate on other tasks. Short quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You are now able to produce and use a simple buff on your workyards or on your friend's workyards. Short quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. Now you know the most important comfort functions of the game. Short quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. Now you know the most important facts about claiming new sectors. Medium duration quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You now have stable tool production and can concentrate on other tasks. Short quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. Now you know all important facts about updating older production chains. Long quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You are now able to trade. Long quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You now have stable brew production and can concentrate on other tasks. Short quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You now have your first experience of fighting bandits. Short quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You have dealt with the bandits, and they no longer pose a threat. Long quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You have discovered all the treasure searches, and have had experience of using them. Long quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You are now able to produce and use a new buff on your workyards or on your friend's workyards. Short quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You are now able to recruit any kind of bowman. Medium duration quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You now have stable production of new building materials and can concentrate on other tasks. Short quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. Now you know the issues concerning population, and how to handle them. Medium duration quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You are now able to produce and recruit militia. Short quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You have continuously increased your storage capacity. Long quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You are now able to produce and recruit cavalry. Short quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You have continuously increased your population capacity. Long quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. Now you know everything about fish and meat. Medium duration quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You are now able to produce and recruit soldiers. Short quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. Your brother is now safe and sound. Short quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. Now you know the basics about adventures, and have had your first experience with them. Medium duration quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. Now you know everything about adventures, including the various types and difficulties. Medium duration quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. Now you know about special luxury materials, where to get them, and how to process them. Short quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You are now able to recruit all kinds of different unit types. Medium duration quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You now have well balanced weapon production and a huge army. Medium duration quest chain finished.
You've managed to finish all the subquests. You are now a true master of trading, and your riches are almost limitless. Long quest chain finished.

Very well, it can stay like this for now. I have already told you this, but it's very important: older production chains need to be updated over and over again, as many resources are consumed by multiple production circles.
Well, was an adjustment necessary? At least the butcher is satisfied, so whatever you have done, it was a success.

Did you figure out how it happened? Did you sent too few units with him or did you send your general through an additional agro radius so that he was distracted? Always remember that you have to wait a long time until your general recovers after a defeat.
Yes, this wood will be enough for me to carve the toys from. Thank you!
Oh, smell this amazing snowflake tea! You can't? Well, maybe you need to become an elf yourself, so you can smell snowflakes!
Oh look at all those fish! So many colours!
It seems your attendant was not exaggerating. Maybe you should temporarily produce this warm brew yourself?!
The fairy Vava will come in the morning and will prepare the pretzels for your settlers! I can’t wait. Maybe she'll make one for me too!
Ahh, these hardwood planks are indeed strong! I will have my elves start building the tree holders. There's no time to waste!
The sausage…It's fantastic! I've never had such a tasty meal! I usually only get milk and cookies…
Shady Slayer has received all the iron ore he needs to prepare the iron dust. The shadow should be removed soon and we'll be able to get our yellow star!
Nutty Matty told me that he's never seen such beautiful horses in all his life! He's very happy!
Timble Jude was happy to hear that you care so much for your friends! I'm happy too!
Sirim Seb was pleased with the swift shipment of coal he received. I will make sure to sneak some presents to the naughty kids too. Ho ho ho!
Hmm… I wonder if that will be enough? Maybe I should go and spy a bit more to make sure you are sufficiently well prepared. 'llI contact you as soon as I am convinced.
Wow, people are flocking to your city. You seem to have a really good reputation. Hardly surprising, considering your good relationship with the king. This means we'll be able to continue quickly.
We did it! We defeated the last of them. The future is safe. We have done well, I have to say!
We have no time to waste - I see their witchdoctors have gathered and are up to no good, that much is certainl!

Over there! They seem to have begun some sort of ritual! Can you feel it? It's sending chills down my spine. We must not let them finish their abysmal deeds. Quickly now, we might still be able to prevent them from casting the curse upon all of us!
Smiley Nakrul was more than happy to receive the tools from you! Now he can go ahead and fix my sledge!

Is it just me, or do you get the feeling that Skull was indeed tainted with some… dark energy? I don't believe in magic, but I could swear it was watching us! Anyhow, we did what the King wanted us to do! The reward has arrived!

We tried to ask them nicely, but they were too stubborn to listen. So, they haven't found the treasure or the Skull yet. We should definitely send some spies out to the ruins so they can see themselves. We should also forge on - we need to find their leader.

I can’t believe how aggressive they are. Thank the maker we brought enough military force with us! When words don't help, there's steel, am I right? We should try to find the pirate leader and the Skull.
The spies have reported back! They confirmed that the skull was taken by the pirate leader! I guess this leaves us only one option. Let's go pay the pirate captain a special visit!

Done! The pirate captain was kind enough to release the Skull to our men! He will be taken into custody and transported to Bastille Island, where all the dangerous prisoners end up... eventually! Let's head back to our island! Good job!
Great work! We managed to complete all the tasks we had to do! You are truly a strong leader! The King is proud of you!

It's over! We survived the storm! This crisis really shook everyone up. I think our people will need quite a bit of time to recover. Nevertheless, you did a great job averting disaster. King Damien is sure to be very grateful!
The specialists have returned, and we've managed to get some of the resources we need to start preparations. Good work. It's time to move on to step two.
I knew we could count on our Military Forces to help the miners! You did great too! Let’s move on to the next step of the plan!

We have news from the tower! The storm didn't do any serious damage! The watcher has promised he will supply us with news of the storm if things get worse. He was most impressed when he heard that we were ready to help. Good work!
Wow, having allies is indeed a good thing! Let's hope for the best!
The island and our storage facilities are secure again. The storm is about to hit us, so let's find our way to the shelters. It's going to be all right!

Ha ha! Look at them swimming away with their tails between their legs! Nasty pirates! Good work!
We cleared out the pirate leader's compound! It's time to head to the badlands where the bandits are! Be careful, though - there are more bandit camps on the way, so we're not done with them yet!
That was a hard battle, but we arrived! I can see the bandits are building a huge wall to defend their leader's camp! We're in for some heavy fighting if we want to defeat their leader!
We found it! It was locked away in a small golden box! Our scouts managed to break it open and have found it! I'll send the scroll back to the village at once! Good work!
Well done! We should probably tell the council about the wall - maybe they'll want to remove it and build some ships from all that wood! We'll see! Great job you did here!
We're victorious! The island is now under full control of the council and Lord Walder! We should expect some nice rewards to arrive from them.
Very well done! Lord Walder and the council will never forget your help!
We threw many of them into the sea - look how it has calmed their fury! The raider wing is now clear of trouble!
Harr harr! Cough! How on earth are they making that sound? Right, we're done with the pirate wing.
Ugh! How can these people live in such ghastly places! I'm glad we managed to defeat them! Let's move on - this place gives me the creeps!
Phew! That was a cold approach there! Even under this sun they feel so cold! It might be because of that Hoarfrost Globe they been carrying around all that time! Let's move, good job!
Good work! Listen to this. Some of the prisoners have told us that every clan has a plan on how to invade the island! Maybe we should look into that, huh?
Nice work! Four Invasion Plans on the plate! I'm going to send them to Capital Island and have the King's Generals take a look at them. Maybe we can learn some precious information about our enemy?
Well done! Problem solved! We'll be sending more and more prisoners to Bastille Island, so I hope Count Hackett knows how to handle the situation!
Good work! Gregorid and his island should be safe now! The King will reward us accordingly!
Good, the mountain pass is clear! Let's head into the forest!
The forest is ours! I mean, it's not actually in our possession, but it's safe. Right, let's fight our way inside the village!
We're inside! Head for the main traitor camp and let's finish this once and for all!
Ay! We've found her! Such a smart girl, and a strong one too! Basically she knocked two of our soldiers out before we could convince her of our origin. We've placed her in the safe house!
Done and done! Off to Bastille Island this leader goes! Great job! The villagers will be really pleased to meet you!
Good work! The island is safe again! Good work!
Very good! The tower was partially destroyed when we attacked, so I guess the villagers are doing their share of combat. Good to hear.
The tower is down! Quick, get into the village!
We found all the lizard bones and destroyed them. Nobody can make that flaming potion again! Good work!

The tower is down, and so is the mad alchemist… Well not really. He managed to use some kind of vanishing dust and escaped. I hope that he won't try to come back! Good job, the people of the village are happy to name you their friend and protector!
We should probably keep quiet about what we accomplished here today, as I'm not sure the settlers would understand us helping pirates! Good work nonetheless!
The forest is now bandit free, as strange as it seems to say it like that. Off we go toward the swamps!
The bandit threat has been dealt with! Next we need to find the farms!
The bandits took all the horses with them, but now we have taken them back, haha! Next stop : the gardens.
Good work! We cleared out every single bandit from this island! The pirates will be happy!
No more woodcutting for the pirates!
These burning reeds smell funny. No wonder the pirates love their special brew so much... it smells better than the brew we make.
We destroyed all the poisoned wheat fields. Good work!
Well done! I bet the King's going to hear about this and will reward you!
Good job! But wait! What are those barrels?
Very good, the hard part of the assault seems to be over… or is it?
Good, we managed to sink at least half of the barrels! I wonder if there are more…?
We scoured the whole island and got rid of the barrels! Good work!
Done! What a battle! Very good, I bet we managed to weaken their forces a lot!

The Count has decided to utilize all the various areas of the island. This will give prisoners their own little territories so they won't jump at each other's necks. He has named the place Bastille Island. Maybe one day we might visit, who knows? Good work!
Good work. The stone will sure come useful!
The bread smells very good. Too bad it's going to get cold by the time it reaches Bastille Island.
The builders were happy to receive the tasty fish!
The horses did a great job moving the cargo!
Our crossbows are the best! Good work!
The cannons were delivered!
Sir Rogen is very happy with the package! I saw him trying to hold back a tear before he left. He was indeed a very good general.
Our allies really appreciated our gift, and they've decided to send us the missing resources! Good work!
Strong relations are always a good thing! You never know when you might need your allies!
The fountains seem to be working as intended! What a nice show!
The army is ready for the show!
Sir Rogen enjoyed the adventure very much!
The longbows are ready! Make sure to tell the archers to aim so the flaming arrows land in the water!
The hole seems to be sealed off for good. Or until somebody comes and tries to open it, but who would do that, ha ha?!
Yes! The plank road is finished! Good work!
The copper ore is going to be used to make the cauldrons! Good work!
Good work providing the marble!
The new iron swords are going to be useful, I bet!
The soldiers are ready to help out!
I feel safer now! Good work!
Our part is done! The royal ship will be finished in no time, and we should be proud to have contributed to its construction!
A smiling ally is a good ally!
I don't know if the King has ever tasted our brew, but it's good to know he asked for it, and we delivered!
The recruits are ready to leave whenever the ship is completed!
Good work!
The deposits are filled and now our hunters can resume their work!
The longbowmen are ready for duty!

Well, the expedition has returned with some interesting… erm… vases and broken lances, but they didn't see the lions. They did however find a cave that had a lion carving above the entrance, but it was empty. Good work!
The sausages will make the perfect lure!
The cavalry units are ready for the expedition!
The bronze swords will help a lot!
These horses are the fittest we could find! I hope they'll bring them back in the same condition.
The cook has told me he is very glad we offered them the meat!
Yes! We found it, so now he can have his ritual drink!
The bee problem was solved! We can expect new shipments of honey to come in by the end of the week!
The stone was delivered to the honey supplier!
The new recruits are going to patrol around those fields, for a while at least.
The deposits were filled!
Our allies received our gift!
We have enough troops to send out if needed!
The adventure was fun, and we even took care of some enemies!
The brothers have appeared from a hole in the ground to tell us our soil isn't the best type for their tests, but they were very thankful nonetheless!
They got the fish, cooked it, and now they can get to work!
We have enough troops now.
The tunnels seems to be clean!
The recruits enjoyed the field training.
They welcomed the iron and have left to make new tools!
Our deposits are filled!
The ship sailed off. It was a nice experience, but to be honest I didn't like the furniture. It looked really weird. What sort of person would buy weird furniture like that, really?
Somehow they managed to cut the stone into the shape of flat holding platforms. Good for them.
I've never seen somebody eat a whole loaf of bread so fast.
The marble was delivered!
Done! The fisherman looks a little bit happier!
Err! The Captain has returned, and it appears he has been injured. I feel sorry for him, but maybe he should stick to the sea!
The Captain was impressed!
The pigeon coop seems to be finished! Who should I write to first? My mother?
The planks are the best we could find! Let's hope they will make a nice coop!
The recruits had a lot of fun playing with the pigeons, but eventually all the birds flew away.
The general has returned and he has the seeds!
The water system works perfectly!
The bread was delivered. If I were him, I wouldn't feed the pigeons too much - they'll turn into balloons!
The longbows are at the coop. The bird-master can now protect himself from predators.
Even if the season didn't change, his music touched my heart. I think that one day he will be a great musician. Oh look, he's found a bell and is using it to practice!
Mike was very happy to learn that he can move into the city!
I need to find Samuel, our hunter, so he can help Mike carve new instruments!
Mike loved the meal we prepared for him!
The cavalry units are ready to march!
Mike was excited to be part of an adventure!
Mike has returned with loads of new ideas for songs!
Sir Arminus was honoured to see how happy we are that he managed to find his way home, and that he was so missed! Great work!
The fish meal is ready and it smells so good. It might be a good idea to join the feast!
Very good! So cozy, I'm sure he'll settle back in again quickly!
The horses were sent to welcome the general!
The planks are in place. Danger has been averted!
The soldiers were even dressed in old-style uniforms! I saw a big smile on Sir Arminus' face.
Sir Arminus was happy to receive a medal and be treated in a way he very much deserved!
Eagle Nest was completely abandoned by the time we arrived. There was no way the bandits could have left via the mountain trail - we would have intercepted them. Weird…
The stones were used to fill in the gaps. Now our army can climb up and clear the nest.
The new recruits were added to our army!
The deposits were refilled. The wildlife is blooming again!
Now the recruits are ready to take back Eagle Nest!
The eagles were distracted! Good work!
The mug is ready and the general is satisfied!
We've received a report confirming the Elite Army has arrived safely at Capital Island. The King has sent us a gift! Good work!
The wheat has arrived and cooking has commenced.
They received the marble block!
Our recruits did well and we can now send them our opinion of their tactics.
The adventure did a good job keeping them in shape!
The officers were impressed!
The carriages arrived at Capital Island!
The settler colony arrived this morning. They're not yet ready to join our community, but I'm sure they will… some day.
There's enough stone for them to have those shelters!
Hmm, the idea was for them to forge the swords into plowshares should they need them. Instead the colonists just strapped the swords into their plows. Anyway, whatever floats their boat.
The people have been chosen! A new life begins for them!
The cavalry is ready to guard the perimeter!
We got the additional settlers ready for work!
The planks were sent to the forest!
Theodor was really grateful and promised he will one day pay us back the favor. Just like he said for the last million favors we did for him…
Our friends promised to help with transport!
The recruits are ready to defend the small town. Hope they brought some sunscreen.
The sausages are ready!
The longbows are ready!
The exotic wood planks are ready!
The general has come back with a lot of notes!
We're done here! Let the rain come - we're prepared, except if that legendary four winds storm hits. I hope that will never happen - it would provoke a real crisis, let me tell you.
The settlers were curious about the sudden upturn in work, but nobody asked any probing questions. I'm guessing they trust us enough!
Yes, very good work!
Our friend promised to return the favor!
The hardwood was delivered!
The steel swords are the best we could make!
The Golden Brew Mug is ready. Time to celebrate!
The exploration of the underground jungle was a success! We've found some nice relics that will surely tell us a lot about our ancestors that lived on this island, a long long time ago.
The visit was a great surprise for your friend!
The bowmen are ready for duty!
The longbowmen are ready for duty!
The tools are ready and packed!
The gold ore is ready! I would love to receive such a gift!
The fisherman was not too happy he had to leave his favorite spot but… exploration is more important!
I heard some sailors saying this was the best "Day of the Sailors" they’ve ever experienced! You should be proud of that.
Though I'm not a big fan of fish, the soup turned out to be fantastic!
The marble block looks impressive!
The water is full of fish! Excellent!
The leader was happy to receive the gift!
The steel swords are ready!
The sailors really enjoyed the adventure!
The people that live in the Dark Lands will be happy to see how many nice gifts they've received. I really hope this will help them live an easier life.
The stone will be used to build or reinforce shelters!
The hardwood is ready!
Our friend will surely return the favor!
The militia is ready and dressed accordingly!
Done! Great work!
The transport ship has been fixed! Good work!
We did it! We have our own guild's garden inside the Royal Gardens! The King will come and visit, and I bet he will love it!
Our friend was really happy we visited!
The hardwood has been loaded!
The military units are ready to protect us!
The new settlers are here to stay. We can now leave for Capital Island!
Nice work! We've found the people!
The soldiers were… well, trained. Sort of. Good work!
Well, Will Fixit has done a great job! He merits his name! I think we should have him visit us next year too.
Will Fixit was pleased to see we also brought some gifts with us.
Not sure whether the bowmen will want to climb up very high, but we'll see. Maybe Will can talk some sense into them.
The marble block looks impressive! I wonder whom it will represent when it gets sculpted.
The new breed of fish acts, looks and tastes the same as the old one. Not much improvement, if you ask me.
I'm not sure what he suspected we were doing with horses other than training them. Anyway, he looks pleased now.
Will Fixit had a good time on the adventure!

Good news! Our expedition has managed to help Lord Addam's crew and we've located the three pets. They were being looked after by a tall man with glasses, but he disappeared when we got near. Lord Addam would have liked to thank him for taking care of his pets. Good work nonetheless!
The ship seems to be repaired. Now we can go and look for the pets!
We've counted our military units, and it seems we're ready to handle a pirate attack if necessary!
The gift was well appreciated! Sadly, the pets were not on that island!
The recruits are ready. They'll leave at first light and look for the pets.
The new settlers are here! Now we can go and look for the pets!
The soldiers are ready. Nobody told them the pets might get angry, so let's not mention it either, alright?
They found what they came for, and left toward the forest. I think the whole island was disturbed by their presence. I really hope we never see them again. What a bunch of weirdoes.
The hairy guy got the fish, thanked us and left. Ugh.
The silvery skinned man really enjoyed the show, though he just clapped - there was no emotion visible on his face.
The thin guy came back for the bread. He had a crazy look in his eyes, and left without saying thank you. How rude!
We visited a friend and took a gift. She was really pleased with it.
The leader of the group was satisfied to see how efficient our cavalry is, and it seems he found something.
They didn't care for the Mug, but thanked us for the kind gesture. At least there's that.

This is what I call a total waste of time - the island is completely deserted. There must have been a fire or something - the air sure is weird around these parts. Perhaps we should go back home... Wait! Where did the scout disappear to? Hello?
The wheat stash was replaced. The farmer claims he saw a fiery person run into the barn that night. I'm sure he was hallucinating.
Your friend was happy you visited and helped out. He tells us that all the weird stuff stopped when the scout left! Weird. Let's go explore that island.
We've managed to get the wildlife back to the field, and found a strange white spot where Samuel claimed to have seen the mystery person. Don't go near.
The merchant was happy to receive the iron swords. I asked him whether he had seen anything else dancing, but it seems he lacks a sense of humor.
The wildlife has been restored. We found some weird footprints that were still glowing, but the moment we got closer they disappeared. What's going on here?
The adventure led us to a neighbouring island. It's only a short way to the island of Countess Zavora from here.
We did a great job! The frogs arrived at the southern ponds and thanked us by singing! Great job!
The fried fish bits worked like a charm!
The birds got the message and didn't even go near any frogs. Makes you wonder if we really needed to bring the boys out for this.
The bronze swords are ready to be jumped over by frogs.
Your friend was happy to welcome you!
How nice - our neighbours liked the sausages so much, they've asked for more. We've actually gained a new trading partner - who would have thought it?!
None of the military units has moved in the slightest! The general was probably hallucinating.
The list is done! The Wildlife Control Group should leave now. To be honest, I didn’t know we had so many problems until they arrived.
Apparently we're doing a good job with our fish schools, which is great, but nothing we didn't already know before they arrived.
I think our neighbour didn't even notice our hunters "visiting" their hunting grounds. Anyway, the gifts were very well received and our hunters behaved again, so we've done good!
We need to brush the horses more frequently, and feed them some special wheat for a week or two. Other than that, all seems good.
The check is finished, and it seems we have enough soldiers to protect the wildlife of the island in case of danger. Good to know.
The longbowmen are off to patrol the island and protect the animals.
The fish school was refilled and we've passed yet another test.
We've made sure the children will indeed have fun when winter comes round again! Good job!
Your friend was happy you visited! Sledge building is no longer a secret to you, in fact anyone can do it. I'll talk to our carpenters.
The marble block is ready and the sculpture will soon fulfill its purpose!
You got the recipe! Now head to the island and hand it over to the guild chef! Good work!
The water has been stored!
The new settlers have arrived and are every eager to start work.
The general has returned, and to cut a long story short, he found the deer!
The balloon, as he calls it, seems to be ready for take off! Interesting little man.
The stones were delivered to him. He's started preparing those little bags.
The fish school was refilled and the fisherman has calmed down.
The longbowmen are ready to sail off!
They've returned, and it seems the balloon guy got what he was looking for.
The wildlife has been restored, and the balloon guy has been asked not to provoke any of those sounds again. My ears are still ringing.
The soldiers are ready to help the balloon guy.
The planks are ready to be shipped to island.
The recruits are ready to leave!
The horses were welcomed.
The recruits have proved themselves to be good fighters indeed!
They're back! Warden Tatral enjoyed the trip!
The wildlife has been restored!
The Yellow Caravan is ready to leave. All went as planned! Good work!
Your friend was happy to receive the gift!
They seemed very fond of our offers. A trade well done!
The longbowmen are ready for duty!
Very good trip!
The birds loved the bread! The Caravan leader will surely buy some more bread from us.
We brought the cannons, but when the other people from the Caravan saw them, they got scared. Hey, well, at least we got some nice cannons.
Warden Tatral is ready to go back to his prison island and build The Vault! Good job!
We did it - we’ve beaten the giants! Wait here. I will tell the king of our success.
That was great! I've never seen a Unicorn that close up before. The King will be very pleased when I show him!
Nice work, old friend. I will go tell the King and return with the reward.
The King is beaten! I can’t thank you enough for helping me. Take this treasure I found in the king’s vault.

What an achievement, what a crusade! We've finally managed to expel the clan lords from Dust Hold, leaving their marauding hordes leaderless and easy to disperse. The valiant Ewanian Pioneers finally get to return home, and with them our own beloved soldiers. We can finally say we have brought peace to the troubled lands of Randomar, and in the process, also uprooted a tribe of conspiring bandits! What a well deserved victory!
This will be of great aid to the Pioneers, and it has earned us the King's gratitude and respect. Not a bad move at all!

All those great treasures and artefacts we recovered - what a relief to find so many of them back in our possession. I think we also did well to give that loot up and let the rightful owners reclaim it eventually. Well done.

I think we calmed the situation the best we could in light of the situation, and our Pioneers have finally got some rest. We might actually have made some friends around here. I'm glad you agreed to play along with this.

Impressive, we've found some truly gifted leaders and incredibly disciplined, hard-boiled squads among our troops. The King and his Generals will be more than impressed when they come to inspect them.

It never fails to amaze me, seeing this settlement at work - all the bustling and scurrying. Despite the seemingly chaotic activity, the results are always works of great craftsmanship. It must take a genius to choreograph all this!
This should do. The King's Advisor has announced their interest, so we shall know soon enough whether our preparations meet the King's demands (although I'm more than confident they do).
That was unexpected. It felt like an unusually coordinated effort from their side - how bizarre. We should keep an eye out for further bandit activity.

Did you see their faces? I told you they were going to be impressed! I think the King and his Advisor didn't expect a small island like ours to be so militarily advanced. Our men will lead this quest to glory, I'm sure of it!
This is reassuring. Our men are doing well as we expected, and the Islands are calm… for now.

The King is pleased. Not only did our support turn the tide of battle in his and our favor, but we also took care of a threat that might have jeopardized this entire operation. The King shall not forget.

So, you managed to complete the basics of this competition. Congratulations. You know, there are many more ways to obtain these balloons, such as quests, upgrading buildings, etc. etc. etc. You should try to find them all! How? Well, I guess the best way is simply by playing! Tee hee hee…
See? They're beautiful, aren't they?! Now, you might wonder where to get them, right? Tee hee hee… There are many ways actually. I'll show you!

Well done! You will not know instantly whether you've created balloons. Every now and then you will get a message detailing the balloons you've gathered, so check your mailbox regularly. Let me show you the next way to collect balloons.
Very well, you know how to handle things. Have you already received a message? If not, do not despair! The time will come. Let's go on with our little balloon lesson. Tee hee hee…

See? Pretty easy, isn't it? Tee hee hee… The balloons will be sent to a server storage and count toward your server. Of course, there's a place where you can see how the servers are performing. Tee hee hee….
Marvelous, isn't it? This should answer all your remaining questions. By the way, the window will be updated with every new event, so it's your new source for event-related questions. Tee hee hee…

I hear that everything went well with those buildings. Good… Tee hee hee. There's a possibility strange looking buildings will start appearing again you know. If they do, I'll contact you straight away.

It seems there is no problem too big for you, is there? As you might have guessed, there's a possibility strange looking buildings will start appearing again. If they do, I'll contact you straight away.
As I said, no trouble. It might be a side effect of our party preparations. I'm sure it won't be a problem in the future. At least not a big one… Tee hee hee.
And, what do you think? Do the buildings look strange, or is it the landscape? I suppose it depends on your point of view, doesn't it? Tee hee hee… Anyway - funny!
I wonder whether this will continue. If it does, you should also continue taking care of it. I mean it is fun, isn't it? Tee hee hee…
And? Like it? Quite out of the ordinary, isn't it?! But funny! Tee hee hee… No-one knows exactly where these buildings come from, but things are generally a bit strange these days.
It looks like magic. You click them, they disappear. Amazing! Tee hee hee… There's nothing left for us to do here now. Let's get back to your home zone.
Hmm… I wonder… What? Oh, nothing. Just daydreaming as usual. Tee hee hee… It seems these buildings are appearing on several islands. Pretty interesting, don't you think?
So, have you finished looking? Quite impressive, isn't it? Doesn't it remind you of something in the past, too? I'm not sure about this. Anyway, let's head back! Tee hee hee…
Ta daaa! You made it. Never doubted you would, of course. Now let's go back to the future! Tee hee hee… just kidding! Let's just head back to your home island.

I shall go now. Thank you for your cooperation. I will make sure it has been noted, and recommend you for a nice, shiny reward. Tee hee hee… Don't stop gathering balloons though - the competition isn't over yet. Good luck and goodbye!
Wow, you actually gathered the amount I asked for. Nicely done! I mean, I didn't doubt you would for a second, but I'm impressed nonetheless. Tee hee hee…
That should be enough. It seems you are ready for a new challenge. I will send a message to the settler who alerted me, then we will make plans for how to proceed. Tee hee hee…
Wow, that was a weird adventure, but it was funny. Anyway, let's check what to do next. I'm sure I'll find more things in need of a solution. Tee hee hee…
New settlers, new life, and more fun. Tee hee hee… But this is no time to catch you breath - we need to forge onwards. Still a lot to do!
Nice! Now we're ready for the next step. I'll check the map for the new island. Hopefully, it's not as far away as the last one.
Nicely done. Everyone is happy, and I haven't received any new disturbing news about buildings changing their appearance. I assume this is good. Tee hee hee…
You actually gathered all the balloons. You really are the most impressive person I have ever met. Tee hee hee… Well, I supposed it's time for me to go then.
Great, you found their camp. Now we need to get the violin from them.
Fantastic! The violin is ours!
This forest is full of wild animals, but we have to continue - the blacksmith’s hut should come into sight any minute now.
Great, he gave you his vise just as I said. Thank you very much, old friend. And just in time - it’s already getting dark. Wish me luck that my plan works and I don't end up as bear food.
There is the stable where I've trapped the bear. Be careful - he is much tougher than normal bears.
You did it, great! The wedding is saved, thanks to you!
I knew it - those thugs were no match for you. You've almost reached my rival’s hideout!
Fantastic - you taught that guy a lesson he will never forget!
Well, I'd heard all about your military abilities, but I'm impressed nonetheless. Did you already clear a way through the rocks? If so, we can move on.
Wow, you are a strong person. Tee hee hee… Now let's hurry up - who knows how much time we have to solve this. Not that I have any further information. Tee hee hee...
Tee hee hee… you drove them back. Very impressive. You seemed to quite enjoy it too. But enough chatter - let's continue finding out exactly what the situation is.
What a weird story. A witch came by and used black magic on their houses. Tee hee hee… A likely story. Anyway, there is only one way to find out. Let's go and ask the witch!
This is getting weirder and weirder. A shaman has cursed the village to go back in time little by little. Tee hee hee… Anyway, let's pay him a visit and… talk.
Did you see? The buildings were turned back to normal. We managed to break the black magic spell. Piece of cake! Tee hee hee… Let's head back to your home zone - there is still a lot to do.
Very good, the way is clear now. Let us go on. I am sure there is enough trouble for everyone ahead. Tee hee hee…
Ah, there is the village. Very well, let us see what the problem is. Do you think it is a shaman doing black magic again? Tee hee hee…
Well well… old magic ruins behind this building metamorphosis? Tee hee hee… the people here really do have fertile imaginations. Whatever… let's get to the bottom of this.
There! The toad hopped away. What an ugly thing, that croaker. Tee hee hee… Well, the item has been acquired and used. We can shut down the ruins now.
Well done! The ruins have been destroyed and the village looks normal again. Now we can go back and celebrate your skill for breaking black magic. Tee hee hee…
Good work. You have reached the hut and secured the area around it. You see the little tailor running out the hut with a relieved smile.
You have successfully rescued the stag. The black bull realised he had no chance, and ran away.
Well done! You managed not to lose his trail while fending off hordes of wild animals.
After the fight with the cultists, you find the little tailor in the catacombs below the tower, together with a maiden. “Hurry up, I’ll explain everything later!” he says.
"We're almost there. I can see the top of his castle behind those hills!"
Great! You've defeated the Dark Magician and saved the maiden’s shire.
Did I just see a flash of joy in the eyes of our young friend? It seems our efforts are being met with actual curiosity. Keep going!
I must say, our friend is becoming a connoisseur of sorts. Isn't it touching to see them grow up so quickly?
Remarkable - by now this Geologist deserves to be called a true specialist! I dare say it's because we went to some lengths for his education.
I can hardly believe that our once so undiscerning young friend has made it to such heights. Very impressive!
Excellent! We've turned this boy into a true specialist. I'm proud of him. The right book at the right moment can make all the difference.
Did you see how he just plowed through those documents? Maybe we can turn him into a man with common sense after all.
Well, that turned out to be more productive than I would have guessed. Our lad seems to have a certain talent for what he does. Or perhaps he's just a quicker reader than I thought.
Not bad - he has acquired quite a repertoire. I admit, I'm impressed.
Chapeau! He tought me that a globetrotter does not have to be a lazy prowler. On the contrary, this man has seen the world and is a true expert in his profession.
Brilliant - a little structure and discipline has proved to do him good! He is a truly valuable member of our economy now.
Well done - the city is now free from the bandit’s grip and we can move without fear of attack.
Aha! Look who’s chopping wood over there!
After defeating the creatures in the old iron mine, you discover the second son hiding from the beasts behind some rocks.
It would appear the third son overestimated his abilities. You've found him enchained in the bandit leader’s hut you just secured.
Good job - we have almost reached the tree!
Fabulous! I never really believed your stories about beating up giants, but now I’ve seen it with my own eyes!
Great - you’ve driven the bandits back to their lair to protect their leader.
Wow, what a breathtaking tree. I almost feel bad hurting it. I guess I don’t need to chop it entirely. I’ll just pick up some fallen branches…
Really good work! The town is safe and we've retrieved the cudgel for my master. I’m sure he will be very glad about this.
There's his hut, but who are those people around it?
Alright, my son is safe now. Next, let’s make a plan about how to deal with the inn-keeper.
Well done - we have the cudgel back, and the inn-keeper’s tavern is already in sight.
Yeah, that was one hell of a fight!
Very well, I can almost smell him!
That was fabulous! That greedy guy will not cheat anyone again soon.
You have received additional rewards for completing the Bonus Quest!
You have received additional rewards for completing the Bonus Quest!
You have received additional rewards for completing the Bonus Quest!
You have received additional rewards for completing the Bonus Quest!

You have received additional rewards for completing the Bonus Quest!
Congratulations on your first collection.
You've found it! Amazing!
How fortuitous!
At long last! It is completed!
You're quite the explorer!

You did it again, and have mastered the fairytale adventures. Not only that, but you've upgraded the fairytale castle to level 5 and proved yourself to be one of the greatest war masters around. I'm really impressed. Keep going!
Very well - that should be enough for the first round. Don't look so surprised. Maybe you're wondering why you needed to train so many units. Trust me… Most of them will not come back.

Oh, you're back. How was it? How did you like my friend the tailor? A bit strange, right? But I am sure you two will get along. I hope he rewarded you accordingly? Let's see what you got from the adventure.
So, were you lucky? Didi you see a lot of these new adventures? There's a lot to see with all the different possibilities in the follow-up adventures you can get. Try and find all possible paths.
Wow, that's a lot of beans. Nice work! Let's see what we can buy with them… What? Oh, of course, I meant what **you** can buy with them.
Ah, it's raining beans. Marvellous! I have already an idea of what we can buy with them. Can you guess what it is?
My, it is even taller than I expected. Really breathtaking. Let's take a look at how it works, and what needs to be done to make it produce Magic Beanstalks.

You made it! I don't know how, but you made it. It seems nothing is able to stop you. I always thought that you were pretty skilled, but now I'm really stunned by your abilities. Anyway, enjoy your stalks and don't forget to gather new beans.

So, those are the most important benefits you'll receive! You'll also get an additional building queue slot, and more daily quests per day. So why not make the most of your Premium Time? If you want to add more time, just visit the merchant.
See? Pretty simple. Now you have Premium Time, you can enjoy certain benefits. Let me tell you a little bit more about what you can expect.
Super, right? Your friends will love you! Of course, this also works if one of your friends buffs you while they have Premium Time active too.
So, what do you say? Not bad, eh? Premium Time really pays off, especially with difficult adventures. Although even with easy adventures, the bonus is not to be sniffed at!
