The palisades are crumbling, their magic is undone! We just need to keep going forward, together! Good work!
We cleared out the witches! The cult is in disarray! We won't get a better chance than this - let's go for the treasure.
We found it! My word, it is indeed a sight to behold! Now let's get back and get this artefact in a museum, where it belongs.
Great! You found all the collectibles ! We'll have to keep an eye out for when they reappear next!
Good going - the walls have fallen. This should allow our allies to make some progress.
Great work! Their scouts are in disarray! Nothing stands between us and their stronghold now.
The palisades have fallen! Great work!
Hooray! We made short work of their walls! There's no stopping us now.
Victory is ours! They will sing songs of our deeds for years to come!
Great! You found all the collectibles.
Great, you found a pumpkin!
Ahh, you brought us some pumpkins from your adventure. Good work!
Very well, this should be enough for a little test.
Yeah, that's how you do it! He's already struggling with his balance!
Great, another golem down!
You did it, the Golem has been turned to stone! Now I can finally collect the first crucial piece for my spell: a chunk of its stony skin.
Well done, you used the buff! Let's see whether there's anything else we can do.
Well done, you used the buff! Let's see whether there's anything else we can do.
Well done, you used the buff! Let's see whether there's anything else we can do.
Well done, you used the buff! Let's see whether there's anything else we can do.
Well done, you used the buff! Let's see whether there's anything else we can do.

Behold my power! Erm... Our power... Your Power, I mean! Ahem. You can now transform the island however you wish, thanks to our "ground breaking" technology. Show those accursed mountains who's the boss around here!

That's it! Did you hear what this crazy old veteran is doing in his backyard? He tinkers with gunpowder and his wife tells us that he wrecks their whole garden on regular basis. I believe this might be our chance. Gunpowder, mountains, you catch my drift?
Oh, the sophistication! This man has truly refined the handling of explosive matters. His delicate craft enables him to blow up entire mountains, not just simple rock formations!

Yeees! This crew of fine artisans has reached the apex of their craft. Their understanding of materials, environmental conditions, and their appreciation of a good fireball are just the right tools to get the job done.
Your Epic Workyard is now operating at full speed! You should focus on upgrading it for maximum benefits.
Great! You started up the machines!
Wow! Such productivity!
Extraordinary! It really does do so much more!
Great work! You and your friends and neighbours defeated enough golems to help me collect the ingredients for my banishing spell!
Great, another golem down!
Great, another golem down!
Great, another golem down!
Great stuff - you reached the level we needed. Now, it's time to prepare for the golem's fall!
Whoo! You managed to solve the Halloween Event's basics. With your new knowledge, you should be able to gather tons of pumpkins. Good luck!
So, these are the pumpkin cemeteries. They're a pretty good way to gather pumpkins, but remember - you can only buy a certain amount of cemeteries. They are not unlimited.
Wow, you gathered those in a hurry! Feel free to spend them at the merchant for items, or trade them with other players for luxury resources? It's up to you.
Excellent! Look at the size of that building!
This type of blade shows great improvement over the usual kind.
This is science, harnessing the magic!
The furnaces look much more ornate, too!
Watch those logs closely - blink! - they're coal!
The foliage even blots out the sun!
Great job! Look at those blades sliding through the wood!
Look at them spinning! The technology at work here... It's magic!
The ovens may be cool to the touch, but inside it's a firey hell!
One blast can turn an entire cart of wood to coal!
You can almost feel their edges just by looking at them.
They polish so fast it'll char lesser wood!
Fabulous! You now have all the knowledge you'll need to gather red noses and help us reach our goal!
Wonderful, your explorer has brought you some red noses!
Nice! If we keep on donating noses, we'll reach the server goal in no time!
Great, you found all the items you'll need to build a small basket of red noses.
That's it - the red noses are now in your storage.
Good work! You and your friends have donated enough red noses to fulfill the goal!
Wonderful - you reached the level we needed. Now we can start getting some noses!
Great - now you know all about the Christmas surprise, and how to get presents!
As you've seen, the Christmas surprise has a lot to offer. So make sure you check back every day to get your rewards!
Good stuff, we should be able to create something nice with those resources you gathered.
Nice work! You see, it's really easy to produce presents.
Very good, your explorer has found some presents!

Ohh, those horses really do look like reindeers. That should do the trick!
I'll head off now and brew the potion that'll make them fly! This will take a while, but I'll be back tomorrow!
And up it goes! Look at how well they fly. They really are naturals! Maybe reindeers were the wrong choice. It took them years to get used to flying...
Great, now I can deliver the presents. But we still should find out who stole my reindeers. I'll come back tomorrow. Maybe I'll find some clues in the meantime.
Alright, now we're ready for anything the Croaker throws at us.
Alright, now we're ready for anything the Croaker throws at us.
Alright, now we're ready for anything the Croaker throws at us.
So, we've captured the evildoer! Let's see what he has to say.
So, we've captured the evildoer! Let's see what he has to say.
So, we've captured the evildoer! Let's see what he has to say.
Good work, the troops are ready!
Good work, the troops are ready!
Good work, the troops are ready!
Great work, the path to the Croaker is clear!
We did it, the Croaker is defeated!
Great, the workers have been gathered!
The materials have been delivered and the production can begin. Great job!
It seems the casing is holding strong! We can proceed to the next step.
The materials have been delivered and the blades are under construction! Great job!
The masons have pledged their support for the project! Onwards and upwards!
Beautifully worked marble with iron braces in a spectacular lattice pattern - the craftsmen have truly outdone themselves.
The containment box looks like it could withstand a volcano itself. Great job!
KA-BOOM! A resounding success!
The foresters we have will provide ample supplies of the required seeds. Great job!
It looks like a spider's web of bronze tubing!
Watching this machinery work is truly hypnotic.
The crew has gathered - time to move on to the next step!
They're so sharp and precise, they can slice to a hair's depth.
The Magic Beans are secured now. The container is holding and is also well-guarded.
Clear as water, yet extremely flammable! Keep it contained at any costs!
They look beautiful, even in their delivery boxes.
The scaffolding's impressive enough - just imagine how spectacular the actual buildings will be.
The ovens look like they're made from a single granite block. Exquisite masonry!
It looks like fairy dust mixed with black powder! Handle with care!
Nobody thought the granite ovens could look any more impressive - but the titanium reinforcements managed that.
The masters have gathered!
The security is so tight you couldn't slide a paper between two guards!
They're ... beautiful. They should've sent a poet!
If this doesn't say "commitment" - what will?
The stacks of paper reach the ceiling in some halls.
Smooth, heavy and warm to the touch - these tools radiate immense power.
Nice, now you have enough experience to be ready for the next task.
Nice, now you have enough experience to be ready for the next task.
Nice, now you have enough experience to be ready for the next task.
The bank lets you transfer resources both to and from your guild. Perhaps it'd be nice to leave them a little gift? Here, why not give it a try with these resources.

The guild bank gives you a lot of options for sharing and trading resources and items. To see what's stored in the bank, click on the building. Because there are so many possibilities, the architects left a manual in the building, which explains how the bank works. You can find the manual by clicking on the question mark.
The coast is clear! Onward to the docks!

Excellent job!
The ship is burning at the docks, and through the dense smoke you can see your soldiers "liberating" chests, barrels and packages from its hold.
A fine prize indeed!

Excellent!
The altars lie in ruins and the dark, ominous chanting has been replaced with cries for mercy.
Time to end this madness for good!

With a great rumble, giant slabs of stone are repositioned to seal the tomb's entrance.
A small bird has already perched itself on the top of a statue, as if reclaiming the land for nature once more.
Time to return home, victorious once again!
The last of the bandits' forces are scattered on the island, and will most likely never regroup again. Another successful operation, even with the added difficulty of synchronizing with an ally!
The harbor lies in flames and your forces are ready to take the city. Great job!
The leaders have been captured, and the rest of the city has surrendered. Time to take your prize!

Look at all those wares! This operation was well worth it!
Congratulations are in order!

So, it's all over. Everything's finished, and it's time to say goodbye. I really am grateful for your help. Here, take this - I prepared a small gift as reward for your efforts. Farewell. Until we meet again!
Thank you! This should be enough space to grow some new crops. Which brings me to our next task...
Wow, that was really generous of you. Now, it is up to me to make good use of it. I will return when I am done with plowing and spreading the seeds.
The time has come, the wheat is grown and harvest can begin. I am really thankful for your help. I knew I could count on you.
Well, this should suffice. Therewith, we should have enough wheat to last through the winter, and even a little bit longer.
The first stage of our assault is complete. Time to deliver the final coup!
Garrun is defeated and stands at your mercy. Time to release the fluffy-tailed prisoners.
Congratulations, you managed to find all the hidden eggs before the Easter Egg Hunt timer ran out.

That was really a strange visit. I hope he will do a good job for the Easter bunny. You, however, have already accomplished what needed to be done. I am sure he is grateful... even if he doesn't let it show.
Great stuff! Now stick around a bit so I can tell you the story behind this whole adventure.
Great stuff! Now stick around a bit so I can tell you the story behind this whole adventure.
Great stuff! Now stick around a bit so I can tell you the story behind this whole adventure.
Great - now keep close and we'll proceed with the next stage of our plan!
Marvellous! Now all we need to do is wait and reap the fruits of their labour. Be mindful though - your friends might be doing the same to you!
Great work! This really is a tremendous achievement. Not all rulers are blessed with such wisdom, nor the will to solve a crisis like you just did.

"Well done! You completed the first of four stages. Continue with the next stage, but remember:
Be swift! The clock is ticking!"

"Congratulations! You found out about the curse and managed to cleanse it. You completed the second of four stages.
Now continue with the third stage!"

"You did great! With the help of Ma'Bristley you found out who summoned the evil curse.
Proceed now with the final stage of the Crisis Quest. Your reward awaits you, but you'd best be quick!"
"Fantastic! You managed to solve all 4 stages. Now claim your reward!"
This is really strange. Normally your settlers love those refreshments, but they still don't seem any better. It's as if they're ill…
Well done! We found her. She seems nice enough… although I figure she was more interested in talking to that squirrel of hers than us. Maybe you can try talking to her again.

Ma'Bristley quickly responds after receiving your report: "You did well! Maybe I misjudged you after all… What do you think, Munchkin? Shall we help? Munchkin says: We will help you! So let's get to it."
Ma'Bristley is happy to receive your report and responds: "Finally some good news! Thank the spirits that you know how to lead your settlers, and delivered the goods at record speed."
Ma'Bristley quickly gets back to you: "Magnificient! Now the ritual can start! You really are a ruler who cares for the people. Munchkin is relieved, too."

Ma'Bristley is happy to report back: "Your settlers are already feeling better! I'm glad that I could help. We should savour this moment though, as while the crisis seems to be averted for now, there is still more to be learned. When you have the time, please contact me again."

Mmm-hmm… That is interesting… Very interesting indeed. Well, I can tell you that it appears to be a very powerful spell which has affected your entire island, and everything growing on it… I just can't figure out which school of magic it came from yet.

Ma'Bristley sends yet another letter to you: "I knew it! It was a curse! And what does that tell us, I hear you ask? It tells us it was invoked by a powerful witch, that's what. And I'm pretty sure I know who's responsible. There aren't many witches around that can invoke a curse like that."
You begin to wonder where you're going to put all of these letters.

Judging by Ma'Bristley's latest letter, she's concerned about your well-being. It reads: "Oh… this is not good. I found out who cast that spell. And you won't like the answer… Have you ever heard of Lady Fraila? No? Well, she used to keep herself to herself. But then, one day, she grew bitter. Somebody banished her sister, who also happened to be a witch, from the island where they were born. Some swampy island in the middle of nowhere. Her sister even called herself "Witch of the Swamp". Do you have any idea why she'd have a grudge against you?"
Good work! This is a perfect choice for our gift. I think we're almost finished!
Well, that was the last part. Let's hope Lady Fraila will like it… or is at least willing to negotiate.
Well, this is a good start. But I don't think it will suffice quite yet. We should put some more gifts on top.

Lady Fraila accepted our gift as a token of friendship and swore that she will leave us in peace from now on. If I learned one thing from all of this, it's that we should never anger a witch! But also, never pre-judge a witch as evil. In Ma'Bristley we found a great ally. Let us all hope that something like this never happens again.

Now you know your opponent's skills, you should put your knowledge to good use.
One striker less to worry about!
You defeated the midfielder! Congratulations!
Congratulations! Now you know how to handle yourself on the field!
One game down, only four to go!
Excellent! Now you know everything you need to know to be able to shine at the Settlers Football World Championship. I've just announced our official participation. Let the matches begin!
Well done! You reached level 16. This is our ticket to the World Championship!
Great! Return here if there's anything else you want to know about the event.
So, this is the World Championship fixture list. You know where to find it, and how to use it. And now we have our first opponents! As a reward, you also get your first useful item: a Red Card!
Good work! Now let's finish that match!
Good work! Now you know everything about how to produce tactical tools and how to find the right resources.
Well done! Bananas are used to produce the Foul item in the Provision House. Did we collect all the other remaining ingredients?
Excellent! Wet Grass. The best way to produce a Foul in the Provision House.
Yes! Now that we have the Foul, we should return to the playing pitch.
You won your first match! Congratulations!
Unbelievable! We won the tournament! We won, we won, WE WON!!! Congratulations, now we are officially the Settlers Football World Champions! We wooooooooooon!
Congratulations! We won the first group stage match. If we can win the second one as well, we might advance to the last 16.
That was really a good performance! Thanks to your excellent tactics, it's now official: We reached the last 16!
What a thrilling match! I'm glad we could beat the Shire of Oxwater – even if it was a close call. Let’s see which opponent is awaiting us next.
Unbelievable! You made it! With this victory we reached the semi-finals and are amongst the four best teams of the competition!
We're in the finals! I cannot believe it! We reached the finals! What a game! I always hoped we'd go far with this team, but to actually reach the finals!! I am thrilled!
We did it! We are world champions! WE ARE WORLD CHAMPIONS! I cannot believe it! World champions…
Well done! These are some pretty advanced tactics! Remember, you can see the order in which an opponent's skills will be removed in the tactical item’s tooltip.
Congratulations! We won the first group stage match. If we can win the second one too, we might advance to the last 16.
That was really a good performance! Thanks to your excellent tactics, it's now official: we've reached the final 16!
What a thrilling game! I'm glad we could beat the Shire of Oxwater – the underdogs triumph again! Let’s see which opponent is awaiting us next.
Unbelievable! You made it! We're through to the semi-finals and are amongst the four best teams in the competition!
We're in the finals! I can't believe it! We reached the finals! What a match! I always hoped we'd go far with this team, but to actually reach the finals!! I'm thrilled!
The last weeks have been very exciting, haven't they? I still can't believe that we actually won the finals. I think you've earned yourself the right to build a monument to commemorate our victory!

Congratulations! By defeating the Map Boss, we took this island from our opponent and can gather its valuable resources from now on.
But be aware: Our victory will be envied by others, who might want to steal it for themselves. We should build up some defences to keep them away!
You did it! The big Golem is nothing more than stone now. Perhaps I should collect a chunk of this one as well - it might be better for my spell.
Great, another golem down!

The preparations are ready. We can start our expedition.
Nice work. We're ready to start preparing the troops we'll need for our future explorations.
Great, you got all the weapons we require to equip our troops! Well done!
Our troops are ready to set off on an exploration, just give the word!
With our specialists ready we are well on our way to exploring new lands.
Congratulations! You have completed your first expedition.
Good work. Your marshals are on their way to this mysterious island. They will arrive there shortly.
Great! We've defeated the leader of this colony. Now we can claim its riches!
You have just conquered your first colony. Now we can claim it as our own!
The colony is producing goods nicely!
Great, you have chosen a new expedition.
You've inspected the bandits' defences. I hope you managed to improve the weak points we exploited to conquer them.

Good, our troops are travelling to the new expedition point as we speak. They should arrive there soon.
Great, our tactics worked! The leader of this sector has been defeated!
We have a new colony! It's already started producing resources for our kingdom.
Look at them run! Great work! Now the sector is clear, we can move our marshals forward.
Great work! Now we have a new colony to claim for its resources.
Very good! Now we have a large enough force to set out, and discover our first real Colony.
Great - now you know all about the Christmas surprise, and how to get presents!
