Oh, those horses really do look like reindeers! That should do the trick!
I'll head off now and brew the potion that'll make them fly! This may take a while, but I'll be back tomorrow!
And up it goes! Look at how well they fly. They really are naturals! In hindsight, maybe reindeers were the wrong choice after all. It took them years to get used to flying...
So, we've captured the evildoer! Let's see what he has to say.
So, we've captured the evildoer! Let's see what he has to say.
Good work, the troops are ready!
Good work, the troops are ready!
Good work, the troops are ready!
So, we've captured the evildoer! Let's see what he has to say.
Great! Come back here any time if there's anything else you want to know about the event.
Very good! Now let's deliver those gifts!
Fantastic! Now that we have some of the things we need, we should return to island to deliver them.
Fantastic! Now that we have some of the things we need, we should return to island to deliver them.
Fantastic! Now that we have some of the things we need, we should return to island to deliver them.
You finished delivering the gifts! Everyone's happily celebrating Christmas now thanks to you! What a great feeling!
Well done! You made a lot of children (and a lot of parents) happy! Look at all those beautifully arranged houses. Now, that's the Christmas spirit I'm talking about!

Good thing you checked out the archive!
Remember to come back here, whenever you need help with the colony mode.
Great! Now that you've produced some medipacks, we'll be able to instantly revive our marshals when they get defeated. I, er, I mean if. If...

It's ready. The mining shaft is complete, the supply line is set and the security of the miners is ensured. Thank you very much for your help. I'll have someone prepare a reward for you and send it to your main island.
Very good. The ore has a very high quality as expected. Let's carry on with our plan.
Good work! Now we have enough building space, let's continue with the next step.
The infrastructure and our base are built. We can finally start mining!
Good job. We're nearly done!
No miner can do his job without the proper provisions. Thank you for the help. I think we're done!
You did it! I don't know how, but you stopped the sabotage! Now our miners can go about their business without any more inconvenience.
It's over - the blight is gone! With time, the forest will recover and the animals will come back to our woods. Thank you for doing this for us - we are forever in your debt.
That worked. The animals show signs of getting better. However, they're still in danger, unless we treat the root of the problem.
The potion worked. That is a sight for sore eyes! The tree will bloom soon, and start spreading its magic again throughout the forest.
The powder is doing its job. The forest is looking better than ever.
Good work. The sickness seems to have faded from the land. Thank you!
Marvelous! You managed to settle the conflict between the brewers and bakers from Grain Island. Maybe you should consider a career in diplomacy...
Ha! This place looks as good as new... or as good as old, I guess. Thank you. I feel much better about this place already.

It actually worked! Well done! Both brewers and bakers were a little disgruntled after we revealed the truth about the beer and bread we gave them, but it served its purpose. We made them come back to the negotiation table.
The first negotiation in years was a complete success! Especially thanks to the meal you provided! Thank you, in the name of both the brewer and the baker's guilds.
Thank you very much. The twins are back at their home, safe and sound. Their parents can sleep again, and have sent a small reward to your island.
These bridges should give the patrol team the footing they need to navigate the swamps.
Great - there are already some hints coming in. Let's see whether there's anything viable.
Wow, the helpers did great work there. That will not happen to the twins again.
Oh, this worked perfectly! I think we need more. Visit the trader if you want to buy some.
Great! Now the chickens can relax and hatch their eggs. Here's a small reward for your efforts.
Good job! The nests are free, and waiting for the chickens to come home to roost.
Great, you caught them all! Give them to me, and I'll take them to another island.
You found all the chickens. Amazing! They're usually so good at hiding...
Great work! The chickens are hatching their eggs nicely again.
Great! You found all the collectibles! They'll be transferred to your home island immediately.
Ok then! Now that you know everything there is to know about the Easter building, let's get to work! Chop-chop!
Well, isn't this a beautiful sight? Just remember, the more stuff you do, the bigger the Easter residence will be.
Well done - you found the achievement button. Much like everyone will. Here, take the Easter residence as a token of my appreciation.
Look at all those rewards. You can get extra fame and loot by sending your troops to expedition islands. Remember, you'll earn PvP XP for each unit you defeat.
Well, look at that! Even it is still small, the expedition water castle is quite a sight, isn't it? Remember to upgrade it when you level up!
Our adventures are not finished yet! We have many lands to explore!
Ahh! Well done! This seems to be the perfect spot to start a new settlement. Look at the beautiful grass, how green it looks, how fresh it smells!
Magnificent! A beautiful building! Maybe we can upgrade it later. I need my own quarters you know?
What an amazing battle that was! Your men are indeed great fighters! I bet you have no opponents in your homelands.
Good work with clearing up the ruins.
The villagers are very happy, and incredibly grateful to you. Those who are gathered approach you with a present to show their gratitude.
Look at how nicely the wheat is growing. The villagers are very happy, and some of the kids have been watching the crops grow all day.
That's the boulders out of the way - now we can use the area to start building up the village.
The last potion just arrived, and everything is ready to start the cleansing.
The villagers are admiring the new buildings. They say they're even better than before.
The villagers are admiring the new buildings. They say they're even better than before.

Very interesting... He said that this coin belongs to an ancient tribe from a civilization called the "Tikki". Apparently for the Tikki people, these coins symbolize wealth and prosperity, and are considered sacred. Unfortunately, for us, it's little more than a piece of junk.
This should be enough. The exotic planks will make for a very robust mainframe that should endure the worst weather conditions while at sea. We're ready to go save the Tikki tribe!

"Live and let live" is what my grandpa used to say. Those bandits will think twice before messing with a pacific civilization such as the Tikkis once again. The grateful Tikki people are chanting your name, and want to reward you with an important part of their culture. We should place it somewhere on our home island, so we always remember this day!

Who would have thought that a little coin could be so important? It's clear that we have a lot to learn from other cultures, and a lot of friends to make. The merchant who initially gave me the coin could hardly believe our story. You should have seen his face!
I just received the report confirming that the panda has made it home safely. I miss him already... Do you think we can have one of our own? I'm kidding, of course!
It's working! He seems to be a lot calmer when you're feeding him. What a relief... I was worried he might not make it if he kept refusing to eat or drink!

This cage will do nicely. It's so big, sturdy and comfortable that I'm thinking of ordering one to live in myself! The ship has departed, and all going well, mother and son will be back together very soon.

What a wonderful ceremony! Oh, don't worry about me. I always cry at weddings... The king appreciates our efforts, though, and has insisted on compensating us. We've reinforced a strong alliance today.
This is the most magnificent cake I've ever seen. I'm sure the king and his guests will be over the moon. Do you think they'd notice if I had just a small slice now?
Those rumours about your bravery are true then. It's been a long time since I saw someone fight like that. Thank you for your help, my dear friend.

We freed many of the prisoners, but my wife was nowhere to be found. I came across a man named Ali Baba, a young wood cutter searching for treasure, but he was found and captured by 40 of those bandits! He offered us his help to find my wife, if we can help him find his lost treasure. I agreed, because the chance is high that both are in the same place.

Ali Baba searched the chests for any sign of the treasure. Unfortunately, there was nothing to be found, except a letter showing the location of an oasis nearby. You should rest till the night arrives. Travelling under the burning sun will tire our troops out.
The bandits didn’t expect you and started to panic. This ensured your victory, but also allowed one of the thieves to escape with his caravan - and valuable information in tow.

Ali Baba found a slave girl named Mardschana held captive in a cage. She seems to be attracted to him, the hero who saved her life, and agrees to help you. Her story is a long and sad one. She tells you about all the other islands, where the bandits take the people they've captured. Ali Baba, driven by her story, is determined to find those islands.
You've outdone yourself, my lord! We have all the wood we need! I now understand why your settlers respect you so much!
Do you smell that? Freshly cut mahogany wood! The best of the best!
The sawmill's ready? So soon? That's great news! Now we can produce some planks!
They're so beautiful, these planks! I think I'll have one of your carpenters build me a new bed. My back hurts too, you know.
Outstanding results my lord! The storehouse is filled with wood, and now we can plan ahead! Good work!
How nice these huts are! Woodcutters are truly strong people!
I see that your foresters have learned how to harvest more seeds from the woodland. Good stuff!
Great, the wood's been transported to the storehouse.
We've used up all the platinum to create more supplies! A good economy can only work if the people who run it know exactly what to do! Good work!
No, I won't go near that smelting plant, I might get burned! But good work nonetheless.
The smith is ready! Is it just me, or did the weaponsmith give me a funny look? I just wanted to give him some advice... I do have a diploma in weapon crafting, you know...
It is done! What a spectacular architecture! So elite!
We didn't build a smelter for nothing! Now we can smelt that ore and begin producing weapons.
First class quality! I expected nothing less!
The swordsmen are ready to serve… I mean mingle. The time will come when they will be needed for combat, I'm sure.
We now have a proper cavalry! The horsemen are ready to go into battle! They look most intimidating, if you ask me!
The man takes the wool and produces cloth! Good work!
The shepherd promised me that he will do his best to produce the finest wool! Good man!
Have you felt the quality of these saddles? I think I want one myself! Make it violet!
The horses are equipped with the finest saddles, and are ready to ride! Or to be ridden… or… never mind.
So much elegance in these horses. They reminded me of my own beautiful horse, Jasmin… I mean, technically she was a camel but still… Good work!
These mounted swordsmen will be a great addition to your army! Even I'm scared of them! Well done!
The knights are ready! Every war needs its heroes.
Our ranged company is reporting for duty! Their arrows are sharp and their aim is deadly! Good work, my lord!
The artisan is ready to make the weapons! He does not speak our language though. Where did you find him, if I may ask?
This is fantastic craftsmanship! Look at the shape of this weapon. Truly spectacular! Job well done!
The explorer is back, and he found a new adventure for us! Ready your men!
Your artisan is currently holding a speech regarding the proper use of ranged weapons. Your marksmen are eager to learn more. Good job!
The armoured marksmen are ready for duty! They do look… err… hard to kill?
Your mounted marksmen are ready! Aiming from a running horse must be a difficult task!
No walls will be able to hold back our advance! I wish I could see the face of your enemies when they spot your army!
The man sure knows his profession! I may ask him to build a custom wagon for me, too… strictly for work related tasks, of course.
The foundry is ready, and it will be lit by nightfall! Great!
How magnificent! I wonder if we should keep one of these as decoration? Put it in the middle of the settlement? No?
I can't even begin to imagine how these huge machines are moved! Imagine the enemies' faces when they see this… ha ha!
A bit of training never hurts! Your men stay in shape and now we have more land to cover. Good work!

The rescue party returned, and they brought with them an old man. He's currently being treated at the hospital. As soon as he's able to speak, we're going to bring him over to the town hall. Good work saving him - I have a suspicion he's a very important person...
Being prepared for the worst is not pessimistic! Being careful just makes you, my lord, a better leader! Good work!
This is exactly the amount I need in order to start rebuilding! Thank you, my lord.
Thank you my lord, the planks are ready!
All the granite in the area has been mined and our warehouse is full! Good work!
The mason is ready to start working!
The scouts have returned, and they've marked the location of the deposits on this map here. Good job!
I think that's enough granite for now - but you can decide to mine for more if you'd prefer.
I never doubted you for a second, my lord! Titanium may be hard to find, but you collected it in plenty of time! Good work!
The mine looks like a true piece of art! I'm sure it's safe, too, but I don't have the time to venture deep.
There are quite a few deposits around this area - and now we know where some of them are located. Good job.
The titanium ore is ready for you to use! Great!
Wild Peter told me that the quality of the gunpowder surpassed his expectations! Good work!
The mine is ready, but your miners seemed less than willing to share their techniques with me! Maybe later!
They have returned and none of them are missi- I mean they're all safe and sound! Good work!
We have enough saltpetre now! When the time comes, we can make a lot of gunpowder!
Delicious food is the best cure for the hungry soul! Now, if you excuse me, I have a dinner to catch!
One of the baskets landed on my table, and I must be honest with you - I have never eaten anything this tasty! Aunt Irma works miracles!
I saw one of your workers lick his fingers clean after eating those delicious cookies! You made them happy!
Ahh! Your general returned! The area is bandit free! Now I can have that pie in peace.
Now that we have some knights, we can use them to help with the first steps of building that home for Captain Mapparan.
The explorer is back! He claims Ali Baba was hiding from forty robbers. An oddly specific estimate, if you ask me.
Ahh! The platinum swords are so shiny! Ouch! They seem to be very sharp as well!
There! The storehouse master took the lamp away and had the men return to their work!
Wagons! Use them well to transport the exotic wood! Ships need a lot of it!
The miners are happy and the production is back on track! Great!
The floors may be made of granite, but I hope he has a good pair of slippers - it'll be freezing under foot otherwise.
I've made sure that every saltpetre mine has a huge barrel of water near the entrance from this day on! No fire shall interrupt their work anymore!
My lord! How are we going to safely transport so much gunpowder? Ohh!
The titanium chunks were restored and work can now continue! Great job!
There is no curse that could break through these quality book fittings! The captain will be pleased!
We're done! The majestic ship is ready, and now we're closer to our goals! If you ever have need for a new quest, visit Captain Mapparan!
Done! What a magnificent house…I mean ship!! Let's take a look around, and see what quests await our attention!
Ahh! The Captain indeed has a great knowledge of this world we live in! Make sure to visit him as often as possible!
Ahh the stories that young woman tells, beautiful. Maybe one day you will also have the time to listen to her stories.
I'm not sure this is a good idea, but still - I bring good news. The captain no longer needs the coin! His men unearthed some treasure on skull island. Lucky him…
You are a provider my lord! Your mansions bring a tear to my eye! You should consider tourism, you know? Good work!
How splendid! This is one of the most beautiful manors I have ever seen in my life! It is also the first.
Look at the people moving into the new settlement! They will have a wonderful life here, I promise!
Good! Maybe now those bandits will learn their lesson and leave us be!
I… I think I ate too much. I cannot move. Help!
Captain Mapparan has declared that he will never leave a great leader like you! Good work!
So many adventures, so much experience! Next time Captain Mapparan invites us for some storytelling, we will have our own to tell!
We have all the ore we need! It's time for me to visit Captain Mapparan and offer him the citizenship. Well done, my lord!
You have managed to explore and occupy new lands! Your responsibilities doubled, if not tripled! Go my lord, rule your lands!
Berim Khalar's forces have been defeated! My islands had been liberated! Thank you for your help!

My lord! You've done everything I have asked you for! But I need to be honest with you - I'm really very tired. This exciting adventure we had has made me wish for years of rest. I'd like you to look after my islands for me, as I simply cannot handle running them myself. I trust you will do your best!
Ahh! The magical creatures! Splendid! Thank you my lord.
Ohh, the major general looks so fierce he could burn a hole right through you! Wait, what's that smell?
Your workers were happy to create the planks for you!
I think this amount of mahogany wood should suffice! Good work!
We have enough exotic wood planks! Now we can build more advanced buildings!
The wool is ready! I will have it dyed in gold… I mean yellow paint!
With this much cloth we could cover a grain field. Or two!
Yes, now we have more saddle cloth, and they come in various sizes. It should be fine!
That was a true adventure! I've learned so much!
Ahh! You're back! Have you ever seen such marvels?
Your explorer returned and he has a map for you! Let's see where this new adventure will take us!
Good, now the woodcutters can continue their work!
So many weapons, where are we going to store them?
Your explorer returned and he has a map for you! Let's see where this new adventure will take us!
They've returned! Glorious! I think it's time for them to rest for a spell.
Ahh, good! This saltpetre will make the perfect gunpowder! Now for the next gift.
The smell of this basket is splendid! King Schahri will be more than delighted! Now let's see what we can do about that last gift.
Now I can tell which of your knights is the best! There, that group! They will make a fine addition to the king's guard! Thank you my lord!
The platinum ore is here, but it seems that the only thing that's special about it is the colour. It's really much brighter. Well, at least we have some more platinum ore now.
We have the exotic wood we need. Let's hope that the winds will calm down.
We'll use some of this granite to fill the holes. Or shall we just use stones?
This is more than enough! We'll send some of it to the alchemists!
It seems the report was wrong... At least now we have a lot of titanium. That can't be a bad thing!
The captain was impressed! Good work!
Your miners have replaced the missing stock with platinum ore. Good work!
Now you know all the secrets of the sand dunes. There are many adventures that await in the future, but for now, take some time and rest.
The manors are ready! Now all we need are some decorations, and we'll be able to welcome any visitor of royal blood.
The king was speechless when he saw the gold! He loves gold! Unfortunately, he also asked me about how generous you are so… well, I think I know what he wants next.
The king is impressed with your wealth and generosity! He must leave now, but I'm sure he will be back! Maybe he'll even invite you to his castle?

The bandits, overwhelmed by your forces, decided to point you in the right direction in return for their lives. They pointed towards the east, and mentioned an ancient ruin located there. Magnanimous as you are, you hold your end of the bargain and set them free.

The thieves located in the ancient ruins wouldn't say a word regarding their base, until one of your scouts came in, dragging a messenger with a secret message behind him. When the thieves see that their sneaky messenger had been apprehended, they lose hope and confess that the oasis does indeed exist, and that they have set up their main camp right there.

The thieves' leader has been defeated, but he distracted you for long enough that the rest of the thieves could grab most of their treasure and leave the island. The defeated leader tells you that the woman you're looking for is being held on an island to the east. Ali Baba, on the other hand, has found a report that states that she has been taken to the south... But which one's right?
From the remains of the last camp, you spot Ali Baba's ship in the distance. You go and greet your friend, and, smiling, he tells you that he has a plan to get through the stronghold.

The boulder covering the secret passage crumbles down and reveals the entrance to a dark cave. Ali Baba points inside and tells you that this cave will take you to where you want to go. You're worried that you can't see anything inside, much less an exit, but you decide to trust your friend.

Behind the lair of the giant bat you catch a small glimpse of sunlight. Ali Baba quickly rustles through it to finally reveal the exit of the cave. Your troops let out a cheer as you announce to them that you have found the exit.

When questioning the thieves' leader about the captive women, you observe that the thief starts cackling loudly. Ali Baba fears the worst and starts searching the stronghold's prison, only to find that they're empty. One of your soldiers comes through from the storage room calling you in. What you find inside is unsettling to say the least.

The horrible plant monster withers, revealing the path to the summit of the mountain. You give your troops a rest after the long fight. Feeling refreshed, it's not long before Ali Baba screams in excitement after spotting the ancient library in the distance, as you set off on your way.
Having cleared out the first area of bandit camps, you see a small path that climbs to the next level of the mountain. Understanding what to do next, you proceed along the newfound path.

You are surprised and relieved to see that the bandits didn't destroy any of the books that were kept in the library. However, it's then you realize that the treasure the library holds isn't quite what the bandits expected. You won't find any gold or coins in this library, but the biggest and most valuable treasure in existence. Knowledge.

The defeated raiders try to call reinforcements, but you swiftly put a stop to their efforts. They confess that they were only a diversion while the others pillaged the tombs around them in search for treasure. You quickly recover and give chase to them.

The tomb raiders head back to one of the few remaining camps they have. You spot the temple on top of the mountain, and the obvious defence system linked to it. With your goal clear, you start heading towards it.

The defence system shuts down, and you start searching the temple for treasure. You don't find anything material, but you encounter some very useful chronicles about an ancient race who lived here before. Their wisdom will prove to be a far more valuable treasure than any gold or trinkets that you may have found.

They clearly didn't know who they were messing with. Sinbad praises your battle efforts, but isn't convinced that there won't be any more threats, so he offers to explore the area looking for more enemies.

The inhabitants of the city are very grateful for your help, and offer you whatever little treasure they have in compensation. When you inquire about the treasure and the missing woman, they are sad they can't provide what you were looking for, and repeatedly apologize for disappointing you.

The shady informant has betrayed you! The bandits were working for him all along, and he is not willing to share any information with you. Aladdin is sorry that he was not trustworthy, but he is convinced that he knows something.

In the face of your unstoppable advance, the shady informant panics and tries to make it to the docks. You can sense that his information is way too valuable to let him escape, and continue the pursuit alongside Aladdin.

The cornered informant gives up and shares his information. Both Scheherezade and the oil lamp were on that island, but the informant managed to raise the alarm of your arrival and they were taken to a different island to the north of this one. You are angry that you narrowly missed them, but at the same time happy that you finally have such a solid lead on Scheherezade's location. Aladdin decides to accompany you on your final trial.

The sailors are impressed by your strength, and share with you a few more details. It seems that somewhere on this island there is a cave, in which there are lots of glittering gems. Sinbad seems interested in this, so he decides to accompany you on this adventure.

The sea snake was definitely an unexpected enemy to face, but you prevailed nonetheless. The sunlight reflects across all of its scales, making them glitter like diamonds. Sinbad then starts laughing, as he realizes that whoever started the rumour mistook the sea snake's scales for glittering diamonds.

Buried beneath the remains of the last camp, Aladdin steps on a piece of metal. Removing it from the sand, it turns out to be the oil lamp that he's been looking for! With cheers and laughter, you celebrate the finding, but you keep wondering about Scheherezade's location.

You continue questioning the bandits regarding Scheherezade's location, when Aladdin tells you that one of them is running away with some hostages. You quickly climb the dune to determine their route.

You finally manage to best the leader of the thieves and free the captive women from the dungeons. Scheherezade can't express her gratitude with words, but her beautiful face says it all. Aladdin immediately recognizes the other woman as the Sultan's daughter, Jasmine, upon seeing her up close. They start talking and seem to hit it off with each other.
Excellent! Remember that you can get additional sector deeds from the black market in the shop. Now let's dig up an underground tunnel and take the first of our settlers to it. How exciting!

Thank heavens we were prepared to fight those nasty bandits. How did I know they were there, you ask? The hairs on the back of my neck tingle when there's danger nearby. My uncle Ben told me it's a family trait!
Great work! With these materials we'll be able to at least get started on our constructions in the new land. If we have spares we can always trade them, right?
Mighty fine weapons, these. I wonder if our new friends from the eastern lands have ever seen weapon crafting like this? Our blacksmiths are definitely deserving of our praise!
I knew it, my lord! Our scouts have spotted bandit camps ahead! Take our generals through the underground tunnel that connects the storehouses to the new islands, and prepare for the offensive!
Great, another golem down!
Great, another golem down!
Great, another golem down!
You did it, the Golem has been turned to stone! Now I can finally collect the first crucial piece for my spell: a chunk of its stony skin.
Great, another golem down!
Great, another golem down!
Great, another golem down!
You did it! The big Golem is nothing more than stone now. Perhaps I should collect a chunk of this one as well - it might be even better for my spell.
Great, another golem down!
Great, another golem down!
Great, another golem down!
Great, another golem down!
You did it! The big Golem is nothing more than stone now. Perhaps I should collect a chunk of this one as well - it might be better for my spell.
Great, another golem down!
Great, another golem down!
Great stuff - you reached the level we needed. Now, it's time to prepare for the golem's downfall!
Good work, this should be enough for a little test!
Yeah, that's how you do it! We've got him on the ropes!
Whoo! Now you know the Halloween Event basics! With your new knowledge, you should be able to gather tons of pumpkins. Good luck!
So, these are the pumpkin cemeteries. They're a pretty good way to gather pumpkins, but remember - you can only buy a certain amount of cemeteries. They are not unlimited.
Wow, you gathered those in a hurry! Feel free to spend them at the merchant for items, or trade them with other players for luxury resources? It's up to you.
Fantastic! I promise, I won't bother you with the options menu anymore. You've now learned everything there is to know about it. I am most grateful for your undivided attention!
Fantastic! This granite will definitely help our expansion efforts. And in the worst-case scenario, we can always sell it on the market for a good deal.
These buffs are exactly what we need to keep our production going at full speed. Great work!
Very good! Remember to always keep your specialists busy searching for deposits, or refilling them to keep your production balanced!
Ah yes. I can already see the fine weapons and the saddlecloth that will come out of this shiny platinum. Good work retrieving it.
That was fantastic! Maybe next time you and your generals will break a sweat, huh?
Mighty fine work! Remember to defend the colonies while you have them. We wouldn’t want to see this precious source of goods lost to another expeditioner, right?
Granite, of course, is not the only benefit of going out on adventures, but it certainly comes in handy. We should do this as often as possible.
Excellent. The new units eagerly await your orders at the barracks. Why not take them out on an adventure soon?
Fantastic! Our allies will be most grateful for the assistance we've provided. And who knows, maybe they'll even reciprocate the favor on our own workyards!
See? My sixth sense is never wrong! We'll definitely put the profit obtained on this deal to good use.

Thank you for taking the time out to stop by so often. It may not look like it, but your settlers actually care for you and like to see you around. They work harder and enjoy their work more if they know you’re watching, you know?
That was very helpful indeed. Maybe we should return the favor soon? I'll ask Aunt Irma for one of her fabulous gift baskets for our friends, who came when we needed them most.
Brilliant! These weapons will make our armies substantially stronger. Those bandits won’t stand a chance!
We may not have much need for coins right now, but some other lords desperately require them for their building upgrades. Why not offer some of our spare cash as a trade?

Now this is what I call production! If we can keep this up, we'll have enough platinum to last an age! Try to keep this up for as long as you can, and make the most of our precious, rare platinum ore!

You know what my favorite thing about fairytale adventures is? The fact you get a follow-up adventure in almost all of them, so you can continue your epic adventure. Is there no end to the excitement!?
Very good! Your marshals have performed excellently! I hope that they can hold the colonies until we've had chance to gather their resources. We need all the materials we can get!

Fantastic! Exotic wood can serve a myriad of purposes, from weapon crafting to building upgrades. If you don’t need any more, though, you can always sell it to someone who really needs it in the market.
Ah, this is encouraging. Your army has recovered, and is already raring to go on an adventure. Be nice to them and take them somewhere they can prove how strong they are!
Now that’s what I call teamwork! You supported each other perfectly, and you both got nice loot in return. Wasn’t that fun?

Sometimes I forget how good our friends are. I just hope we can return the favor whenever they need us to! And even if they don’t need it, we should be nice to them as they were to us, don’t you think?
The beauty of coins is that they're always in demand, so it’s easy to barter in the trade house with it. Now that we have a nice stock of them, perhaps it’s a good moment to put them to good use.
Great! I’m sure that the buyers will be more than happy with the deal they got from these materials.
Look at them. Doesn’t it bring you a tear to your eyes, seeing them so happy? It sure does to me… *sniffle*
Splendid! I know grout is hard to come by, but using it wisely may boost your income enormously. I’m glad you followed my advice.
Oh, thank you for your generosity! My cousin Otto has returned home, and told me that if it wasn’t for you they would have been captured by the bandits. You saved their skins!
Nice work! I can’t say I like the idea of someone spreading stuff around the island every day, but I won’t deny that the results of this can be very useful to us!
Great work! One of the generals came to me with a heatstroke, but I already took care of that. Now onto the hundreds of soldiers afflicted by sunburns…

Wow! I have to say, even I’m impressed by that! Your marshals are certainly a force to be reckoned with! Also, I have to give you credit for how well you planned your strategy for attacking the colonies. Great work!
Fantastic! Do you think someone will believe me if I try to sell them in the market?
Great! With the granite we've obtained, we'll be able to either construct more elite buildings, or improve our existing ones. Thank you for your efforts!

I know barazek are hard to come by, but you still gave it to your friends. In fact, I’ve been so moved by your gesture that I decided to give you my own stash of barazek that I took from the desert for when I was feeling hungry. Use it wisely!
Now this is what I call dedication! And not only did you manage to keep the workers in great shape, you also got some gems out of it. It’s a win-win situation, you see?
Wonderful! This will get us back on track to deliver our quota. We'll have to give something very special to our friends to thank them for this gesture, wouldn’t you agree?
Very good! Now let's deliver those gifts!
Fantastic! Now that we have some of the things we need, we should return to island to deliver them.
Fantastic! Now that we have some of the things we need, we should return to island to deliver them.
Fantastic! Now that we have some of the things we need, we should return to island to deliver them.
You finished delivering the gifts! Everyone's happily celebrating Christmas now thanks to you! What a great feeling!
Great - now you know all about the Christmas surprise, and how to get presents!
Great, now I can deliver the presents! But we still need to find out who stole my reindeers... I'll come back tomorrow - perhaps I can find some clues in the meantime.
Alright, now we're ready for anything the Croaker can throw at us.
Alright, now we're ready for anything the Croaker can throw at us.
Alright, now we're ready for anything the Croaker can throw at us.
Nice! Now you have enough experience to be ready for the next task.
Nice! Now you have enough experience to be ready for the next task.
Nice! Now you have enough experience to be ready for the next task.
As you've seen, the Christmas surprise has a lot to offer. So make sure you check back every day to get your rewards!
Good stuff! We should be able to make something nice with those resources you gathered.
Great! Return here if there's anything else you want to know about the event.
Nice work! You see - it's really easy to produce presents!
Great work - your explorer has found some presents!

Oh, those horses really do look like reindeers! That should do the trick!
I'll head off now and brew the potion that'll make them fly! This may take a while, but I'll be back tomorrow!
And up it goes! Look at how well they fly. They really are naturals! In hindsight, maybe reindeers were the wrong choice after all. It took them years to get used to flying...
So, we've captured the evildoer! Let's see what he has to say.
So, we've captured the evildoer! Let's see what he has to say.
So, we've captured the evildoer! Let's see what he has to say.
Good work, the troops are ready!
Good work, the troops are ready!
Good work, the troops are ready!

You are a true hero. Not many people would have gone to such lengths to help random strangers. Me? Well, I've made some new friends. This tribe has lived here for centuries, and has some amazing stories to share!
This is routine for you at this point, is it not?
I'm glad that my invention could be of service. The Nords will think twice before raiding this island again. All that's left to do now is to clear up the mess they've made…
With the tents rebuilt, the natives won't have to worry about freezing to death. But there is one final problem to take care of…
What a feast! You didn't spare any expense, did you? But look at the relief and gratitude on the people's faces! You did something truly great today.
With the city unearthed and the spells lifted, I can finally start exploring the ruins. And all thanks to you!
At last, some quiet! Now let's have a look at the remaining altars…
See how this place's magic invigorates your troops? It appears that every shrine offers a unique boon. I advise you make liberal use of them.

Woah! It really was here! Look at that grandeur! But... there seems to be an invisible force blocking the way... Hmm... Ah, this archway is adorned with some interesting glyphs. They may hold a clue...
Good job activating the altars! Now I just need to… and then… Yes, That did the trick! The barrier has disappeared!
The threat has been lifted, and my curiosity sated. Time to go home.
I knew you could do it! Now for the interesting part...
Good job! Your army can advance to the mountaintop now.
The sword sparkles with energy! Looks like there might be something to the legend. We'll see if it works soon enough.
What a fight! But it's not over yet! I saw Flafir escape when the castle collapsed, even though his wounds should have been lethal. That's the final proof of his immortality.
Excellent! Worst case scenario, if winter doesn't come, the children can use the coal for painting the walls, or something!
I've tried the prototype on, and it's definitely warm! It looks horrible, though. People may actually prefer to be cold rather than wear this... thing.
I just heard back from our writer. He said that even though there were some interesting bits in the painter's memoirs, most of it was rather boring. I think I'll wait for the stage show...
The painter is back, and from the look on his face, I'd say he got some serious inspiration from his adventure. I'm actually somewhat excited to see his next painting now!
Well, I'm back from the visit. He's already produced lots of drawings and blueprints of alternative grapple guns, and in such a short space of time! He may be cuckoo, but he's dedicated!
He seemed pleased with his cloth, at least. Still, no matter how I look at it, I just can't see how this will help him shoot down the moon. Oh well, as long as he's happy, I guess...
Wow, just look at how many volunteers have offered to help! There's a lot of work to be done, but our fantastic settlers will make things a lot easier!

Oh, look at that! It actually works! We should definitely note this down somewhere. That said, I'm pretty sure that even if wheels helped our goods carriers, they wouldn't want them. They're quite proud of their muscles!
Well, even if this doesn't draw the scholars in, just look at how many fancy books we have! In fact, I quite fancy one myself. Wait, how much?! Think I might pass after all...
The carriages are done, but I still don't understand why they... Oh, wait... I understand now. I stepped in some horse droppings. Ew.
I laughed so hard I nearly choked on my water! You should have seen the cannoneers looking at themselves in the pond, and making flirty faces. It was priceless!
Well, I took Lady Amidale to look at the new decorations. She did like them, but I was still hoping for a bigger reaction. Oh well. She'd never notice me anyway...
This crane will definitely help with the construction. I just hope we have a properly trained settler to operate it!
The battle horses have pulled off the job perfectly! I have a feeling they enjoyed the variety too. Well, back to the stables! There's still a lot to do.
That should help reach the quota. Perfect!
Well, it turns out the rumour wasn't true. But on the flipside, we learned that platinum actually makes for great tools! If only the miners could have seen what they were hitting, I guess.
Well, guess what, they were right after all! I'm actually very impressed! Our miners really do know how to make the mine's structure resistant! I guess I lost that bet with the general after all...

The swordsmen came out, laughing very loudly. It seems that the growling the other miner heard was just a very, very hungry co-worker just round the corner. We gave the poor lad a sandwich, and he's gone back to work.
Honestly, I admire the work of the engineer who put it up there. I'm afraid of heights, you know? I probably would have fainted as soon as I got a few inches off the ground...

The wheelbarrows are ready to roll! Plus, the red colour really makes them look stylish. Did you know red things are scientifically proven to be three times faster than different-coloured things? True story!
It may not be practical, but it definitely fulfills its purpose! I just hope Milady Verena doesn't think we're too weird for coming up with this idea.
The Steel Guard welcomes the reinforcements, but they're a bit concerned that we used platinum instead of the almighty steel for our units. If only they saw the things we saw...
Ah, nothing beats this. The nobles can keep their noble and delicate cuisine, I'm happy with sausages. Actually, I could use some more right about now.
I don't know about you, but I don't think this was a very good idea. My bread's burnt to a crisp and barely edible. Some people seem to really enjoy it, though. Maybe it's just not for me?
This party will definitely please anyone who comes to visit! I just hope they go easy on the brew... There needs to be enough for everyone!
Perfect! Just like the one my momma used to take me to! Can't wait to test my skills. That giant fluffy monkey plush will be mine!
I think this will make a nice change to having so much gold around. I don't know about you, but I get headaches when I stare into bright yellow things for a long time.
Even though I didn't win anything, I have to say that was a very mature thing to do. I assume the king has passed a little bit of his wisdom on to him. Maybe I misjudged the kid after all...
The hunter seems confused! This should buy the animals a bit more time to roam free. We can always move him back to his previous spot later!
Excellent. This stable will hold plenty of horses, and is perfect for helping us win the bet! I hope our guild mates are doing as well as we are!
These boxes will work very well. I've personally helped with stuffing them with soft materials, so even if it shakes it won't be a problem. Still, handle with care.
All done! Wait, what do you mean this is too much? Of course we're not planning to aim it at people! At least, not that I know of. I guess ultimately, it's not up to us...
Well that was productive! Mr. Metal has been a big help! Do you think he may have any nice weapons for sale? Maybe we should keep in touch with him!
The troops are exhausted, but they're as motivated as they'll ever be, which is exactly what we wanted to achieve. Good work out there. That was some solid commanding!
Great work! The king will be pleased to know that our soldiers honour the memory of their comrades by carrying on their duties.
The horses are ready for the parade. Everybody knows their part, and the general even wanted to give a speech in their honour. Everything is on-track thanks to the combined efforts of our guild!
The coal has been delivered, and our friends have heard all about our culinary efforts. Hopefully there's enough time to finish baking the pretzel before our guests start arriving.
It worked! The pigeons have left the pretzel alone! I mean, I guess we could have just set up a scarecrow, but where's the fun in that?
The signs are ready, but whoever wrote the names of the towns has got them all wrong! We'll have to take them to the cartographer so he can fix this little problem. Oops!

These are really neat chips. I wonder if the king knows that platinum is actually a bit too valuable to be used for things like this? Maybe we should have suggested he made the chips out of a cheaper material instead... Oh well!
I hope we never have to use these, but it's better safe than sorry. Let your scouts borrow them, and they'll take care of any threat to the queen.
These will do nicely. I'll equip them with visible banners and signs to inform the queen we're not hostile, and dispatch them right away.
The stage is making good progress, but is it a bit too much? If the show is half as flashy as the stage is, this promises to be the biggest spectacle you'll ever witness.

Well now I've seen everything. The animals seem to be attracted to the chicken's clucking. Apparently they cluck at a certain frequency that only other animals can hear. And now I've got a massive headache...
Excellent! We stopped the reinforcements from coming to Dagger Island and made the Nords think twice about helping the bandits again. Now it's up to the rest of the guild to finish the job!

We caught a couple of bandit scouts trying to reach the thieves. Or should I say we caught a "bandit ambassador"? Do bandits even have ambassadors? Anyway, I'm glad that my hunch was right, and we dealt with it quickly.
Platinum is a rare mineral to come by. Maybe the next time we encounter the collectors, they can share the mystery of where the platinum minerals come from.
They seem fascinated by the process! I do wonder how our explorers found the ore before we were able to mine it ourselves, though? Was it just lying on the floor or something?
It seems my intel may be wrong... The treasure seems to be on another island. Looking on the bright side, though, we gained valuable experience and useful loot on this adventure, wouldn't you agree?

The knights have finished their training. Not only do they now know how to fight like a pirate - they know how to talk like one too. I can't understand a word they're saying! Who's Davy Jones and what's in his locker?
The granite should be holding the bridge up well. At least, that's what our architect says. I'm not sure I'm willing to put it to the test. I trust her, but I'm afraid of heights!
The titanium links have been provided and tested out. Even if an elephant walked over this bridge, they wouldn't give in. I just hope they don't bring an actual elephant, just in case.

Huh! Who'd have thought noblemen and women would know their way around a crossbow? I tried to convince some of them to join our brave army, but they just laughed at me. Well, if they're laughing, at least they're not arguing!

When our cavalry reached the area, the racket ceased immediately and there was absolute silence. Ah, it felt so peaceful... I hope this doesn't become a habit, though. I hate sending the army in to deal with petty situations...
The titanium swords have been distributed, and the judges have received one for evaluation. Fingers crossed this helps our standing in the competition!
The men have shown their abilities. You should have seen the audience's faces as they watched the demonstration. Good work!
The cannons are ready! Let's hope we don't have to use them. After all, our cannoneers are no sailors - they work a lot better on land.
We may not have found him, but some of the prisoners we took say they saw the captain's ship floating around the island. I sense we're getting closer. We should head back and deliver our report.
We've received the first edition of the potential printed copy, and Coron is very pleased with it. With any luck, he'll file a request to print a whole batch of them at some point.

Here it is! Initially, I didn't understand who'd want to collect printed maps at all... But now that I see this edition closely... It's so shiny... And the covers are done with the finest materials... I must have this on my shelf!

Our artillery is ready, and the king has demanded a demonstration. As soon as we've given everyone some earplugs, we can get started. The gunpowder you provided guarantees it's going to be heard across the whole island!
These swords will please the king for sure. And, as I haven't seen many other soldiers around with these, we'll impress the others too!
The watchtowers are set, and we've tested the protection by throwing some stones at them. It may not be the same as an arrow, but we can confirm that they're really sturdy.

As I suspected, they'd never seen an arquebus before. They've asked if we'd be willing to share our technology with them in future. We have more pressing matters right now, but we told them to come back in a few months, and we'd gladly help.
The adventure was a success and the young apprentice was most excited about it! Good work, the king will be happy!
The diplomacy missions were a success, and the young apprentice was most excited about it! Good work, the king will be happy!
The crossbowmen have been given instructions and have been deployed. They have also been equipped with an extra supply of caffeinated drinks. Nights can get very long up there!
We tested the range of the mortars, and confirmed that we can hit a target from so far away, our enemies can't possibly strike back. Good work!
We're all ready. I just hope that Sir Rogen doesn't startle himself so much. He's known for just flailing with his sword when he senses danger!
The mortars are ready. I can't wait to see the show. This promises to be beautiful!

Turns out that our plan didn't make much of a difference. The water was evaporating before it reached the bottom of the volcano! At least we managed to make some delicious sausages over at the volcano!

We mixed a bunch of saltpetre with herbs and threw it inside. It seemed to work a bit, so just to test a theory, we threw some gunpowder inside too. Big mistake. Nevertheless, it seems to have improved our situation a little.
Fantastic! These planks are the perfect materials for the king's ship. Great work!
The king's engineers have studied the grout, and have dispatched a few squads to obtain some for themselves! What a relief... Grout is already pretty rare as it is!
That will definitely help us progress a lot faster. And as a bonus, I'm sure it will be a lot of fun!
The geologist took the platinum ore and started running towards the mountains. If you happen to hear a distant "Yippee!", you'll know he's been successful. I wouldn't count on it this time, though...

It seems that we had a partial success! The bees are definitely more calm now with all the smoke, but next time let's use just some wood to make a fire, ok? We've left quite a nasty crater on the farm!
The queen is safe! Hoorah! Our queen? Queen Anita? Heavens, no! She's perfectly fine in the palace! I mean the bee queen! Where would the hive be without its queen?

The brothers came out of the tunnel satisfied with their work. Of course, one of the downsides of it being underground is that we won't be able to check on their work ourselves. We'll just have to trust them on this one!

We've shown the brothers how we grow the magic beans, and they've assured us that it's perfectly safe to continue doing so, as the beans are nowhere near any waste water. We have to keep using only the purest water for these!
The gesture was widely appreciated, and they were really impressed by our exotic wood furniture! We may be getting an order from them soon! Could this be a new business opportunity?

They were really interested in the lesson, but I don't think they understood at all. They bought a huge amount of magic beans, but now they're planning to sell them for mahogany wood directly. Maybe it works for them, who knows.
It's been a while since I saw so many deer in the forest. The birds noticed it too, they look a lot happier!
The new cage is finished, and the birds are currently transferring to their new home. The bird trainer assures us this is perfect for them. Who are we to argue with that, eh?

The composer came back from the adventure with a good grasp of the cannon's capabilities. In fact, he'd studied them so closely, he was temporarily deaf because of the noise! Took us a while to understand why he was yelling to everyone for no apparent reason...

The new lute is ready, and the event is scheduled for tonight. Both musicians are really excited about this, and they've decided to compose an all-new song to commemorate their newfound friendship. Isn't that nice?
The writer is ready to start documenting everything, but maybe we should wait until Sir Arminus is ready to share. He's been through a lot, after all, so first let's take good care of him.
The arsenal is ready. As soon as Sir Arminus is back in shape, he'll definitely want to get his hands on one, so I ordered one to be engraved just for him. Do you think he'll like our gift?
The ladders are ready, and they are now part of the whole operation. Great work!
The marksmen got plenty of practice on that adventure - and now we're ready for the final assault against the bandits. Great work!
The blacksmith is now back on quota, and he doesn't require any additional help. He offers his thanks, and has promised to tell the king about how useful we've been to the cause. Great work!
It saddens me to see our troops depart for war, but when duty calls, we have to answer, for the sake of our kingdoms. I hate war. Why can't we all be friends?

The horsemen have returned with a few maps that may be of interest to our new residents. I've shown them what we found, but they said that they were happy here, and that they would happily stay forever if we let them.
The refugees are very grateful for our help. Our very own foreman will stay with them for a while so they'll have the best possible residencies.

The blacksmiths paid a lot of attention and asked a lot of questions. I think they're ready for action - although I do feel sorry for them... Working in a forge must be hot enough, but a forge in the desert??

Their leader greeted us and we apologized on Theodor's behalf. He says that while some damage has been done, as soon as it's paid back we can come to terms with each other. I'll inform Theodor myself.

The soldiers are back, and ready to become the designated relief party when the storm hits. They are a bit tired, though. Maybe we should have taken this into account when sending them away for training...
The tunnel shook a bit, but everyone's ok. We should continue exploring the mines. Maybe we can figure out why they were abandoned in the first place.

All right! The perfect barn. This should keep the wheat dry no matter how much it rains or pours. I'm actually more worried about what we'll do if people want to get in to shelter! Where will we put the wheat!
Ok! Thanks to our special program, I think they've got quite a good idea about how to mine for rare materials now. When the guild is ready to exploit the mine, we'll be ready too.

We clearly underestimated the sailors. They've been drinking us out of house and home! But, we do have a winner now. Unfortunately, he's really ugly, so the artisan will have a tough time crafting a good looking bust for him.
Ok, the griddle is ready, and the salt has been prepared. Just wait until the sailors taste the meat we cook. They'll want seconds for sure.

The leader of the dark lands' authorities was very pleased with the experience, and thinks that with this newfound knowledge he can help restore order there. It's all thanks to your tactical thinking - great work!
I see some sprouts! It'll be a while before we see if the seeds can help the people here, but it's definitely one step in the right direction.

The captain says he "doesn't need any trinkets to carry out his royal duty", but he appreciates the thought nonetheless. I still think his dedication is commendable, so I sent the mug to his home, where it's currently displayed over the fireplace.
Well, our ornaments are certainly... unique! I don't know if this qualifies as "beautiful", but we'll definitely grab everyone's attention with this now!

Well, Will's creation certainly looks attractive, but... I just can't figure out what it is! Everyone who came to see it has been saying the same thing. I bet this artisan is one of those "abstract" artists I keep hearing about.
Will says he's made some modifications to make it a little bit less hostile. What modifications? Now that you mention it... I forgot to ask. I think he may have just hung them up as decorations.
It's been a while since we set the trap, but so far there's been no sign of the pet. Let's hope that some of our guild mates have been luckier than we have in this regard...
Now this is a cage that nothing will be able to escape from! Oh wait, there's a minor oversight... How do we open it to put the animals inside? I'll go fetch the engineer...

The wise wizard read through the tome in a matter of minutes, and he's asked if he can make a copy himself for his own personal research. I always found these books really boring, but if it's of interest of him...

The wizards say they'd already seen these materials before, but they were equally happy, because they'd just ran out of these two particular materials for their potions, so they happily accepted them.

Turns out the little creature was not really an imp, he was just a very small and ugly man. However, the information he's given us will definitely come in handy. I'll spread the intel with the rest of the guild.
The squad is ready, and I've thought of the perfect name for it: The Haunt Busters! You don't like it? How about the Ghost Squad? The Urban Legends? No? Ok, I give up.

We found a decent amount of those mushrooms, but one of the soldiers didn't know what they were for and ate them. What he didn't know is that they are toxic to humans. He's fine, he just has a tummyache.
The plaque has been erected by the pond. It's actually unusually large for the little message it carries. The frogs may not appreciate it, but hey, it sure looks fancy!
It seems that the signs are working! Our hunters are ignoring the deer and the forests are slowly repopulating. Wildlife Control will be pleased!
Our foresters have given us the report. Exotic trees are far from being endangered. We've kept to our quota, and Wildlife Control is happy to see this report. Great work!
Warm eggnog is the best! Of course, the golden brew mug isn't where the kids drink from, it's where it's served from! You know, for good luck!
The kids had a lot of fun! We should probably think about hiring a gardener, though. Otherwise the whole island will get overrun with magic beanstalks at some point...
Our allies came to visit almost immediately! They seem to be amazed by the technology behind the flying machine. Intriguing!
The traveller was very happy that we could help him out! He'd also never seen any grout before, and has taken a sample to show the folk back on his home island.
I've never really tried eating magic beanstalks, so I can't say whether this plan is actually going to work. In any case, we've done our bit, and the warden is pleased.
The marksmen patrolled the prison, and intimidated the prisoners with their presence. The warden appreciates your help, and looks forward to further collaborations.

They had a lot of interest in the crossbows, but we've agreed that it'd be a very dangerous item to sell straight away. They've devised a handy way to keep things safe, though - now, you get a free course on how to operate a crossbow with every purchase. It's actually pretty clever!

I agree with them that the platinum brew mug is definitely the most impressive thing that I've ever seen, but I doubt that anyone's going to be able to afford one! It's bound to become an instant collector's item!
This is probably not the last we'll hear from him... But that's not important now. You saved the Christmas feast! My gratitude, and that of all the world's children, is yours.
The window might have been empty. We'll take care of that in the next step!
See how the buff's listed in the window now? You can even cancel it early if you want to get rid of the effect. I'll give you some more to play around with.
Awesome! We can get started now!
Ok then! Now that you know everything there is to know about the Easter building, let's get to work. Chop-chop!
Well done... you found the achievement button! Not everyone has the derring-do to find that... Here, take the Settlers University as a token of my appreciation.
Really? You're going to place it there? Oh well, you've been doing this for a while, so I'll let you have your artistic freedom this time. Let's move on!
The strange man in the bunny costume just went by. It seems you really helped him out. Thank you very much. I would have been totally helpless on my own.
About time! I don't have all day! Ahhh… that's good! I'm sure I'll have my memory back in no time! Let's see… where am I?!
Thank god, he found something! Don't know what I would have done without him. Let's see, what does the hint tell us about the egg's location?!
Well, that's a lot of eggs, but I'm not sure you got them all. Hmm… If any are missing, my Easter pal will be mad!
Yeah! That was good. Even better, I've just remembered the location of the other eggs I lost. I'll mark it on the map... Look away, I cannot draw when someone stares at me!
Phew! All eggs together, finally! Man, I was really concerned my Easter pal would never talk to me again. Thanks buddy. Until next time.
That rude person just stumbled away. Are you alright? It was so generous of you to help him. You saved the Easter feast with your efforts. Thank you very much.
OK. I will take this decent compensation and look the other way. So, how are you planning on getting my eggs back? What? You expected me to gather my lost eggs alone? That is the last straw!
I asked the settlers working in the mine, but they weren't sure. They said someone told them something about some eggs and painted it onto a sheet of paper, but I couldn't find any sign of him. Jeez…
Oh my god, that took you, like, years! Have you finally managed it? What do you mean I didn't do anything to help? I was sitting here and giving managerial advice! This was obviously a lot of work!
Oh great! You found them! Let me see! … What the… There are some missing! Are you kidding me? I hope you haven't kept some for yourself?
Nice - I think that's all of them. But with the good news comes some bad, too, as I'm afraid I have to leave you now. I know you'll be sad when I'm gone, but I'm sure we'll meet again. Until then….
Well, that was different. I hope he'll do a good job for the Easter bunny. But you did what you had to do. I'm sure he's grateful, even if he didn't seem it.
Nice, it worked! I'd love to be able to see his face when he realizes his eggs are being stolen. Hey, don't look like that. He is a complete jerk after all!
The baker is incredibly satisfied with your help, and is ready to give us the coordinates for my cousin's other island. We're getting closer!
Oh, back already? So, how was it? Yes, yes, that was the last time we… borrowed eggs from him. Now, we have to rebuild my reputation with the Easter bunny… After some sleep!

Nice, the Easter bunny already recognized all the people gathered around me. That went pretty well! What? Oh, of course you can have the coins back. I was just about to give them back to you anyway! Honestly!

The Easter bunny was so choked up by my efforts, he decided to give me another chance. I'm sure the Easter eggs he lost were also a reason. Well, thanks for your help buddy. I couldn't have done it without you… Well, maybe I could have, but it would have taken a little bit longer.
Ah, how sweet it is to see someone beaten by their own weapons. Even if I do get the impression that his cousin isn't much better. Anyway, here are some Easter eggs for your help. Thank you.
Nice - this should be enough for now. Well then, let us begin our egg hunt. I already have an idea where we can begin.

Very good! We're off to a good start. But of course, this will not be enough to win the competition. I'm sure there are more islands to find eggs on. And I know someone who can point us in the right direction.
Nice, that went fast! What? Yeah, I know it was pretty bad, but we managed, didn't we? So stop sulking! We still have work to do.
Hmm... There are fewer eggs than I expected here. With such a paltry amount we'll lose the competition for sure! We need more eggs!

Wow, look at these piles of eggs. Amazing! And just in time! I will now take the eggs and hurry to the appointment with my cousin. I can't wait to see his face! He he… What? Oh, OK… I'll leave you some eggs too. Until we meet again!
Great stuff! Now stick around, so I can tell you the story behind this whole adventure.
Well! As the saying goes, "all's well that ends well", am I right? Let's hope the party crashers don't bother us for a while.
Well! As the saying goes, "all's well that ends well", am I right? Let's hope the party crashers don't bother us for a while.

These guys sure are persistent! I have a feeling they won't stay quiet for very long. If we've learnt anything from these past few days, it's that I'm sure they'll come back tomorrow as well!
See? There's no need for violence at all! I had a nice talk with them, and took them some presents, and they've agreed to leave us alone for today. Aren't you happy?
