For being such skinny guys, they eat a whole lot of meat. I hope this doesn't backfire on them!
Excellent! Worst case scenario, if winter doesn't come, the children can use the coal to paint the walls, or something!
The people enjoyed the fair very much, and some of the participants discovered they have a natural talent for crafstmanship! We may see some job applications coming in soon!
I don't know about you, but there's not many things that can top the smell of freshly baked bread. Don't you agree? The most important thing is that people enjoyed themselves, and learnt a lot!
Interesting results, I'd say! Not only did they manage to do the basic stuff like some tables, but one of our participants also made a proper wardrobe! I'd say we spotted some real talent today!
I'm happy to announce that the course was a great success. I even had a go myself, although I wasn't very good. It's hard to write properly when you have fingers this thick.
People were really impressed with the creation process of the bows. They didn't think it would be so delicate and precise, which made them appreciate the job of the bowmaker a lot more.

Being notoriously complicated, these may not be the best carriages the kingdom has ever seen, but they are certainly more than functional. The participants were happy to donate them for our storage, too, so win-win!
A lot of aspiring chefs signed up for the course. There were so many people that I had to divide it in several sessions! We should definitely consider doing this more often!

I just had a chat with the lecturer. and he suggested that we supervise gunpowder handling for a while, until the fuss dies down. I couldn't really tell if it was a joke or not. What on Earth did he teach them?
We knew granite is robust, but who would have thought that it could lead to such works of art? They'll stand pride of place in many a house, I can tell!
I'm convinced that the children will be eagerly waiting for the next festival. I don't know, we could always tell them that if they're well behaved, we could put together another one soon?
I've supervised the manufacturing of the bows, and I give them my safety seal of approval. The bows are sturdy enough not to break, but they're also not powerful enough to hurt anyone.
Well, I can tell that they appreciate the pool! And whoever came up with the idea of crafting a trampoline to go along with it deserves to be treated to some brew. What a nice addition!
Some of the horses were too tall for the children, so we made sure that there were also a bunch of ponies that they could use for riding. Everything is set, and I'm sure that they'll appreciate it.

The storyteller gave me a transcript of the stories he's going to tell, and wow... I can tell that the kids are going to love them. I'm even thinking of sitting alongside them, just to listen to them all over again!
Despite all the preparations, I was a bit concerned about the safety of the forts, so I've made sure that there are cushions all over the place in case someone falls. Now it's all about the fun!
The kids are very excited about this! They've even started forming teams and brackets to roll in a friendly tournament! That's actually pretty clever... Why didn't we think of that?
Ahhh, nothing beats sausage with curry. At least we can be sure that nobody will be hungry during the festival. Great job!

I've received the first finished uniform and I have to say that I'm very impressed by it! I will send it over to the head of the boy scouts and see what they think. Ah, whatever. I'm sure they'll love it!
I've received the first wave of feedback about the event, and it was extremely positive! Our guild did a really good job putting this together.
The fishermen are all set and ready to start their event. Let's hope it helps them drum up some business!

People really seem to like the idea of marble name plates. The only ones who complained about it are people with very long names, who're concerned that there aren't big enough plates. Diminutives, perhaps?

The moment we mentioned that Jerdaint would be coming to sign his new book, people went completely crazy and started forming a line. Only problem is, they don't even know where the signing will take place! They don't mind, they queue anyway.
As it turns out, the soldiers may be better at lifting weights, but the militia was better at running. Alas, the rivalry remains unsettled... Oh, you thought they were fighting? Oh, please!

Ok, the contest is ready, and I've told a doctor to be on stand-by in case someone goes overboard and feels sick after. I'm actually excited about this. I've always wanted to see one of these contests!
The food delivery has arrived, and it's been distributed to the cooks. I'm confident that this will be enough for everyone. Good work!
The riders have been briefed and prepared, and their gear is now ready. They will dispatch in a few minutes. This will ensure the Easter event endures!

We've seen some really curious submissions already. There's still some time for the artisans to finish, but I'm sure calling a winner will be a tough decision. If it were up to me, everyone would win!
The ambassadors have been taken care of like kings. Thanks to our combined efforts, I'm sure they'll put in a good word for us with their leaders.
The visitor book is ready, and our first guest has already signed it. Hopefully this will be the first of many friends that come and sign. I can't wait to have it full!
The budget is set, the menu has been taken care of, and there's enough bread and brew to last for weeks. One thing's for sure - our guests will never be hungry. Good work!

The workers were well prepared, and they showed the ambassadors how efficient our foundries are. They were so impressed that some of them are even considering investing in our island for future projects!
Ha, you should have seen their faces! When they saw a guy throwing sausages into the sky they were puzzled, but when our archers shot them and pinned them to a fire, their jaw dropped!
When we explained how much lighter and sturdier things become when you use exotic wood, they took some notes to take back to their artisans. I wonder if this will build us better relations?
Our allies put in a good word for us with the ambassadors, and they're pleased to hear that we take such good care of our friends. This will definitely help our cause.
The fireworks are nothing that the ambassadors haven't seen before, of course, but it sure made them feel important. Great work!
Although the ambassador was sure to stay back when the dangerous bits were happening, he still had a lot of fun with the whole experience. He sure looks like an adventurous fella, that's for sure.
The ling has expressed his admiration for our collective work! The competition will surely be remembered for years to come, and all the contestants are having a lot of fun!
The help our allies provided has proven really valuable. The crates have been completed, and the competition can continue. We even have some to spare in case we run out.
Oh wow, marble eggs actually look just like the real thing! I just hope nobody throws it at anyone or anything that can be broken!

The prize has been crafted and provided to the judges. They're actually a bit worried that the third prize is actually better that what they had in mind for the first, so they'll have to improvise. Oops!
The food problem has been taken care of. There's enough here to feed an army. No... Two armies! No... Three! Well, there's a lot of food, anyway. Nobody will be hungry.
The podium has been created, and has been sent to the capital island. Don't you think that the first place spot is a bit... too high? What if the winner falls?

Wow, that was a close one. We have enough eggs to send to the capital island now. Did your army bring back any stripy eggs for you? If not, don't worry! It just means the king needs all the eggs he can find. They can find more for us some other time!
The hall of fame is ready to be used! There's room to document at least 200 different records. I wonder what kind of categories they had in mind...?
Fantastic! Glad to see that your business sense remains intact! These additional funds will definitely come in handy. Good work!
This was an unpleasant task, no matter how you look at it. Either way, at least we've managed to tear down a section of the palisade. The path to the monster is clear.
Well fought! It's well known that animals are at their most dangerous when cornered; yet you dispatched the Chupacabra and his pack easily.
It works! The inhabitants of the camp have calmed down. That means we can avoid unnecessary conflict by producing more of this mushroom medicine!

Well done! I'm glad that you were able to act so swiftly. Who knows how this would have turned out otherwise? Anyway, there's a fair chance that the creature's demise will also lift the curse. I'll stay behind and monitor the aftermath. If all goes well, I will see you soon.

The problem has been dealt with for now. The governor's "clients" will not dare to come close to Puerto Sombrío.
What about you? Are you ready to leave?
Those fighters were no natives. What is going on here?
Did they really think those gates would stop us? Finding that spy of yours should be just a formality now.
Excellent! Now you know everything you need to know to be able to shine at the Settlers Football Championship. I've just announced our official participation. Let the matches begin!
Well done! You reached level 16. This is our ticket to the Football Championship!
Great! Come back here at any time if there's anything else you want to know about the event.
So, this is the Football Championship fixture list. You know where to find it, and how to use it. And now we have our first opponents! As a reward, you also get your first useful item: a Red Card!
Good work! Now let's finish that match!
Well done! Bananas are used to produce the foul item in the provision house. Did we collect all the other remaining ingredients?
Excellent! Wet grass. The best way to produce a foul in the provision house.
Yes! Now that we have the foul, we can use it on the playing pitch.
You won your first match! Congratulations! The tournament matches may be harder, but it looks like you're well-prepared.
Congratulations! We won the first group stage match. If we can win the second one as well, we might advance to the last 16.
That was really a good performance! Thanks to your excellent tactics, it's now official: We reached the last 16!
What a thrilling match! I'm glad we could beat the Shire of Oxwater – even if it was a close call. Let’s see which opponent is awaiting us next.
Unbelievable! You made it! With this victory we reached the semi-finals and are amongst the four best teams of the competition!
We're in the finals! I cannot believe it! We reached the finals! What a game! I always hoped we'd go far with this team, but to actually reach the finals!! I am thrilled!
We did it! We are the champions! WE ARE THE CHAMPIONS! I cannot believe it! Champions…
That's it! Everyone needs to know how horrible this mindless violence is. For helping me convey such a wonderful message, I'd say you deserve a reward.
Well done! These are some pretty advanced tactics! Remember, you can see the order in which an opponent's skills will be removed in the tactical item’s tooltip.

"Well done! You completed the first of four stages. Continue with the next stage, but remember:
Be swift! The clock is ticking!"

"Well done! You completed the first of four stages. Continue with the next stage, but remember:
Be swift! The clock is ticking!"
Great work! This really is a tremendous achievement. Not all rulers are blessed with such wisdom, nor the will to solve a crisis like you just did.
Great work! This really is a tremendous achievement. Not all rulers are blessed with such wisdom, nor the will to solve a crisis like you just did.
This is really strange. Normally your settlers love those refreshments, but they still don't seem any better. It's as if they're ill…
This is really strange. Normally your settlers love those refreshments, but they still don't seem any better. It's as if they're ill…
Well done! We found her. She seems nice enough… although I figure she was more interested in talking to that squirrel of hers than us. Maybe you can try talking to her again.
Well done! We found her. She seems nice enough… although I figure she was more interested in talking to that squirrel of hers than us. Maybe you can try talking to her again.

Ma'Bristley quickly responds after receiving your report: "You did well! Maybe I misjudged you after all… What do you think, Munchkin? Shall we help? Munchkin says: We will help you! So let's get to it."

Ma'Bristley quickly responds after receiving your report: "You did well! Maybe I misjudged you after all… What do you think, Munchkin? Shall we help? Munchkin says: We will help you! So let's get to it."

"Congratulations! You found out about the curse and managed to cleanse it. You completed the second of four stages.
Now carry on to the third stage!"

"Congratulations! You found out about the curse and managed to cleanse it. You completed the second of four stages.
Now carry on to the third stage!"
Ma'Bristley is happy to receive your report and responds: "Finally some good news! Thank the spirits that you know how to lead your settlers, and delivered the goods at record speed."
Ma'Bristley is happy to receive your report and responds: "Finally some good news! Thank the spirits that you know how to lead your settlers, and delivered the goods at record speed."
Ma'Bristley quickly gets back to you: "Magnificient! Now the ritual can start! You really are a ruler who cares for the people. Munchkin is relieved, too."
Ma'Bristley quickly gets back to you: "Magnificient! Now the ritual can start! You really are a ruler who cares for the people. Munchkin is relieved, too."

Ma'Bristley is happy to report back: "Your settlers are already feeling better! I'm glad that I could help. We should savour this moment though, as while the crisis seems to be averted for now, there is still more to be learned. When you have the time, please contact me again."

Ma'Bristley is happy to report back: "Your settlers are already feeling better! I'm glad that I could help. We should savour this moment though, as while the crisis seems to be averted for now, there is still more to be learned. When you have the time, please contact me again."

"You did great! With the help of Ma'Bristley you found out who summoned the evil curse.
Now, carry on to the final stage of the Crisis Quest. Your reward awaits you, but you'd best be quick!"

"You did great! With the help of Ma'Bristley you found out who summoned the evil curse.
Now, carry on to the final stage of the Crisis Quest. Your reward awaits you, but you'd best be quick!"

Ma'Bristley sends yet another letter to you: "I knew it! It was a curse! And what does that tell us, I hear you ask? It tells us it was invoked by a powerful witch, that's what. And I'm pretty sure I know who's responsible. There aren't many witches around that can invoke a curse like that."
You begin to wonder where you're going to put all of these letters.

You begin to wonder where you're going to put all of these letters.
"Fantastic! You managed to solve all four stages. Now claim your reward!"
"Fantastic! You managed to solve all four stages. Now claim your reward!"
Well, this is a good start, but I don't think it will suffice quite yet. We should build some more.
Well, this is a good start, but I don't think it will suffice quite yet. We should build some more.
Good work! This is a perfect choice for our gift. I think we're almost finished!
Good work! This is a perfect choice for our gift. I think we're almost finished!

Lady Fraila accepted our gift as a token of friendship and swore that she will leave us in peace from now on. If I learned one thing from all of this, it's that we should never anger a witch! But also, never pre-judge a witch as evil. In Ma'Bristley we found a great ally. Let us all hope that nothing like this ever happens again.

Lady Fraila accepted our gift as a token of friendship and swore that she will leave us in peace from now on. If I learned one thing from all of this, it's that we should never anger a witch! But also, never pre-judge a witch as evil. In Ma'Bristley we found a great ally. Let us all hope that nothing like this ever happens again.
Well, that was the last part. Let's hope Lady Fraila will like it… or is at least willing to negotiate.
Well, that was the last part. Let's hope Lady Fraila will like it… or is at least willing to negotiate.

Mmm-hmm… That is interesting… Very interesting indeed. Well, I can tell you that it appears to be a very powerful spell which has affected your entire island, and everything growing on it… I just can't figure out which school of magic it came from yet.

Mmm-hmm… That is interesting… Very interesting indeed. Well, I can tell you that it appears to be a very powerful spell which has affected your entire island, and everything growing on it… I just can't figure out which school of magic it came from yet.

Judging by Ma'Bristley's latest letter, she's concerned about your well-being. It reads: "Oh… this is not good. I found out who cast that spell. And you won't like the answer… Have you ever heard of Lady Fraila? No? Well, she used to keep herself to herself. But then, one day, she grew bitter. Somebody banished her sister, who also happened to be a witch, from the island where they were born. Some swampy island in the middle of nowhere. Her sister even called herself "Witch of the Swamp". Do you have any idea why she'd have a grudge against you?"

And you won't like the answer… Have you ever heard of Lady Fraila? No? Well, she used to keep herself to herself. But then, one day, she grew bitter. Somebody banished her sister, who also happened to be a witch, from the island where they were born. Some swampy island in the middle of nowhere. Her sister even called herself "Witch of the Swamp". Do you have any idea why she'd have a grudge against you?"
That was an extremely impressive feat, my lord! Your settlers will be singing about this conquest for generations to come!

There's no sign of the Queen. While this is unfortunate news, at least we made sure that the Queen and the Dark Cult will no longer bother these people. Hansel and Gretel are finally back home, and the woodcutter has expressed his infinite gratitude to us.
The device seems to work well! We now have a solid lead on where Hansel went. He's a smart cookie, that boy...
That seems to be the last of the enraged animals. I feel bad that it had to come to this, but at least we know that if the children are still lost in the woods, they won't be in quite so much danger.

We found Hansel locked away in the witch's house! In an unusual turn of events, it was Gretel who came out as soon as she saw us, and told us how she'd managed to trick the blind witch. We're going to need a carriage for Hansel, though. He's... incapable of walking right now.
That was the last of the Dark Cult's camps. I see a big castle in the distance, and I'd bet my left hand that it's their headquarters.
Excellent. This will be enough food for the woodcutter and his family to last for several months. They send their most heartfelt thanks.
Victory is ours! We seized the Evil Queen's castle!
The deed is done. Flafir is no more.
Ilsebille is escaping! Part of me is relieved that no harm came to her, but unfortunately, it seems that her madness persists.
It's a bittersweet victory, this one. We're definitely closer to the castle, but the innocent wildlife paid the price. We have to make sure that nobody else is affected by Ilsebille!
Great! We gained control of the pond! Now we need to make sure that the prince stays safe.
Great, the potion seems to have taken effect! The prince is finally free from his curse!
We're close. Very close. One more move, and we'll finally be able to pin her down. Let's get ready!
The castle is ours! But there's no sign of the queen… Where did she go?

To be honest with you, I'm not surprised that Ilsebille was disguised as the queen of this kingdom. Few people are as twisted as she is. The important thing is that Snow White is safe, and the queen has been expelled from these lands. Good job!
There's no trace of her, but I can see the hunter who was hired to kill her! Let's see if we can convince him to change his mind.

As I suspected, the hunter never wanted to harm Snow White. He's just another victim. He spotted some of the wildlife that we encountered before, and has said that he'll try to trick the queen into thinking that the heart of a boar is in fact Snow White's. At least it will buy her some time.
Those were no ordinary bugs! The potions we prepared got rid of the problem, and the dwarfs can now focus on taking care of Snow White full-time.
Well done. It's time to confront the queen!

Queen Ilsebille was impersonating the real queen!? Is she really that desperate for power and attention? She must have known about the real queen's feelings towards Snow White, and taken it to the extreme. That's low, even for her.
The last weeks have been very exciting, haven't they? I still can't believe that we actually won the finals. I think you've earned yourself the right to build a monument to commemorate our victory!
What a match! What a tournament! The opposition was incredibly strong but we managed to come out on top and earn the title of champion! The fans will remember today for years to come.
The queen is escaping! Bah, no matter. We need to make sure that Red and her grandma are safe. We'll catch the queen later!
When we cleared that last cave, we found a little girl wearing a red hood, hiding in a corner. She looks really scared. Let's see what's up with her.
I have no idea where that lumberjack got his medical licence, but all that matters is, it worked. Grandma doesn't look too healthy, though… She's horribly shaken.

It worked! She's feeling a lot calmer now. Grandma said that the wolf "convinced" her to open her door? But… wolves don't talk! That smells like dark magic to me. Ilsebille must be behind this attack…
The Dark Cult is retreating, and the path to the queen's castle is finally clear. Time to give "her majesty" a piece of our minds!
The queen is retreating! Victory is ours!

She was hiding in plain sight! I feel like a complete fool for not noticing before. In any case, the land of Hamelin is now safe from her influence, the rat plague is gone, the children are safe, and the piper wants to atone by helping the town. We should head back and follow the queen.
Well, it cost a lot to make the right flutes, but it seems things worked out for the best. The rats have fled the island, and should pose no threat to the people of Hamelin anymore.

The piper has released the children, and explained what happened with the Mayor. The guilt weighs heavily on him, and he now wants to support us in our efforts. One thing really struck me about his speech, though. He said very firmly "Do not trust the mayor. He seems to be a changed man."
All of this is very strange. Why is the Dark Cult defending the Mayor of Hamelin? Nothing makes sense! In any case, we're getting close now. I can see the mayor's house from here.

What? Queen Ilsebille!? She was disguised as the mayor all along!? It must have been a magic disguise - it looked exactly like the original! She quickly fled the scene, but we found the real mayor kidnapped in the wine cellar.

Wow, what a memorable concert! And the band loved their brand-new instruments! They said they'll always look back fondly on their time on the island, and would be honoured to play for us some other time.

They accepted our offer! W-what? You thought I was trying to scam them by adding some shady clauses in ridiculously small print? No, no! Only bad people do that! The fine print was only to cover our backs in case something happens, that's all! I swear!
The stage has passed all of the safety inspections and is safely stored inside the mayor's house for when the Annoholics are ready to perform. Great work!
These instruments are a fine piece of work! The band is impressed and can't wait to try them out! They will need some rehearsal time to get used to them, though.
I've started to see some new faces around town - some wearing Annoholics clothing - so our efforts seem to have paid off! It's almost time for the concert! I can't wait!
The researcher has found a similarity in the design of the compass and an old pirate legend from the past. He's very grateful to us for letting him study such an interesting artefact.
Nothing around here, apparently... It's strange. Although the compass has very slightly shifted directions, it seems to always be pointing... East?

While fighting the bandits, we managed to find the chest the compass was pointing to! It seems heavy, and we don't have a key to open it, but at least we can take it home and decide what to do with it there.
The locksmith arrived in a bit of a hurry. The chest is open! Let's go check it out!

Well, those were some strange coins! I'm not sure how useful they'll be, but at the very least, we've obtained some knowledge about hidden treasures and legends from the past. And you know what they say - knowledge is the most precious of treasures! In future, let's hope we find a pirate treasure that can pay the bills, though.

Unfortunately, the Custodian does not feel to be ready to become a general as of now. She hasn't completely written off becoming one in future, however, and she's convinced that someone else would take the Custodian mantle. We'll let her continue her vigilantism for now. At least she's following our regulations now.
Strange. Nobody reacted when the generals yelled the name. In fact, I could have sworn that some of them even laughed. This can only mean one thing: "The Custodian" is one of our very own settlers.

Oh wow, that definitely looked ugly. I think our actor may have broken a couple of ribs! Now with the incident clarified, perhaps the Custodian will listen to us. I never expected a lady to be so... brutal.

Well look at those results! She passed with flying colours! At least now that we've spoken to her about what she's been doing, she understands that criminals, although they are criminals, are people too.

It took a bit of effort, but she managed to pass the test. Granted, this is not a test that an unprepared person should be able to easily pass, so given the short length of time she took, this makes it all the more impressive.

The generals are praising her left and right. They say that she even devised a cunning strategy to win a battle without suffering any losses of our troops! They say she would make a fine general, and want to offer her a place in their ranks.

Jonas is really grateful for all the help we've given him. He says that he owes us his life, and therefore would like to spend it here, with us. He's going to go pick up Miranda and settle down here. How great is that?
The pigeon has flown the nest. Now let's hope it uses its training to take the letter to the right man.
Our generals report that they found Jonas on the adventure. He's not looking good.
Jonas is starting to look better. What did I tell you? My grandma knows a lot about medicines and remedies! A special vitamin boost is exactly what this man needed!

Bah, it was nothing more than a conveniently shaped rock! The geologist must have been seeing things, with the darkness and everything. Actually, looking a bit more closely, this "claw" could be nothing more than a sharp, oddly-coloured mineral. There's probably no beast to worry about after all. Strange, how our minds can play tricks on us like that, eh?

The explorers have not been able to find anything. Neither the beast itself, nor any evidence of its existence. Perhaps it's a docile beast? No, what am I saying... This claw is not from a docile creature!

The geologists have returned. One of them is as white as a sheet, and stammers that he saw a huge gray monster underground. Upon hearing its massive roar, he ran away as fast as he could. This doesn't look good, my lord. We have to do something to protect our people!
Yes, this looks good. It can probably hold a bear. Or two. Or Fifty! It's very sturdy!

The men braved the cave, but upon reaching the place the geologist described, they only found an odd formation of rocks. As for the roar? Apparently one of the caves below caved in, which may have sounded like a roar to him. The poor guy was in the right place, at the wrong time.

I sometimes regret having sold that little idol. What if instead of a cheap knock-off, it was an actual piece of culture from an ancient civilization? What if that civilization were simply known for being scammers and liars? Aaah, too many questions. My head hurts. I'm going to take a nap.
The scholars have come back with the results of their research, and the results are... inconclusive. They don't seem to be able to figure out what it's made of!
One of our allies recognized the idol. The idol represents a deity that some ancient civilization worshipped. Rumour has it, this civilization was so wealthy, they made everything out of pure gold!

Well, our scholars are convinced that if the idol had been made of gold, they would have known. So their best guess is that this civilization did not actually have stuff made of pure gold - they simply made it look like it instead! A fake!

Our tradesmen definitely have some interest in the idol. However, due to its special nature, we can't just offer it to anyone. Fortunately, I got contacted by a potential buyer that's offering a nice price for it!

I learned a valuable lesson today. Paranoia and distrust can make you make very bad choices. But looking on the bright side, this little "prank", and the bad experience, has earned us a powerful ally in the end! All's well that ends well.
The barricades are finished, and have been set up. We've even made some makeshift watchtowers to keep an eye on things. But still... It's not enough!
Phew! We now have enough troops to defend ourselves. I feel a little better now...
The watchtowers have been equipped with a spyglass each. Now at least we'll be able to see if anything's coming!

Our guards appreciate that you care about them as much as they care about our island. Meanwhile, we checked with our newest prisoner. He's very confused and doesn't know why we arrested him. I say he must know something... His timing is too perfect! We'll keep him locked away until we understand what's happening.

It's a good thing we managed to talk it out... The little rascal we imprisoned is apparently the count's favorite son, and he fabricated that letter we received as a prank! Everything has been cleared up as a misunderstanding. That boy is in big trouble now. His "prank" nearly caused a war! Teenagers... I don't understand them.

When we returned from the adventure, the count asked how we'd got on. Their general only nodded silently. Apparently this is a big deal, since the general hardly ever shows any kind of emotion or approval at all! The count enjoyed his stay on our island as a guest while you were away, and promises to return... as a friend this time.

Bart's visit was definitely very profitable - both for us, and for him. We've obtained some nice rare materials that will certainly come in handy, and he got... well whatever junk he asked for, I guess? Maybe we should invite him again sometime? He was such a nice guy.
Bart is pleased with the deal, but I have to say... This marble statue is UGLY! Perhaps we should demolish it, and recycle the marble? Yes, I think that's a good idea.
It may not exactly be brass, but it seems that it's close enough. Bart likes this sword even more, so everyone is happy!
I feel a little jealous that Bart had the chance to eat such a succulent dinner. Ah... I'm hungry now...

Well, this is a sturdy doorstop. In fact, maybe a little too sturdy... I'm pretty sure we can make cheaper, reliable doorstops out of our own wood. I suggest we re-use the granite from this, and put it to work as something a bit more useful.

Bart seems to be really happy with the coins we gave him. I don't really get it. We only use one kind of coin as a currency after all, but he seems to firmly believe that every single one is different. Collectors are interesting people, indeed.
I can't believe that Settlers & Bandits is so popular! I hope this serves as a good way to encourage people to use their imagination more, and more importantly to have fun with it!
You know, I think we could have something fun here. In fact, I'm starting to think a lot of people might be interested in this! Are you thinking what I'm thinking?

It's catching on! People are talking about it, and they host regular sessions to play! They're even planning complex stories, and deep character bios. I could have never imagined my childhood hobby would have this many people interested!

The first print of the "Settlers and Bandits" rulebook has been distributed, and I'm starting to see small groups playing! "Settlers and Bandits" is the name I came up with for the game. It may not be very original, but I think it's catchy. Don't you agree?
That is all I can tell you about the epic farmyard. I wish you good luck on your travels, and in the hunt for more blueprints.
The expansion is complete, and it's turned into a nice new well. Just look at how deep it is - and so much water!
You're a very kind person. Meeting with different cultures, and helping the people with their needs. You earned this blueprint.

Wow! You've got to hear this! Your spy has uncovered quite the conspiracy! A group of pirates, and other "explorers", dock at Puerto Sombrío to restock the supplies of their treasure fleets. The loot they're carrying is obviously stolen - but the governor gets bribed to turn a blind eye. I say it's time to claim indemnity for your subject.
This just goes to show that crime doesn't pay! You should probably dispatch a different spy to this place, just to keep an eye on things. In my experience, corruption is not that easy to root out.
That concludes our work here. Are you ready to return home, or do you have any business remaining on this rotten island?
Good job. The remaining pirates look intimidated, and some have already sworn to change their wicked ways. We can expect fewer similar attacks in future.
The preparations are complete. Now we wait.
This should satisfy your allies. Will you be taking care of the remaining fleet before heading for home?
Look at all this stolen treasure! Of course, we'll have to return it to its original owners. But doesn't feel great being selfless? You look like you've grown from the experience.
Finally! Thank you so much for your help! I owe you one. Now, let's get to the exciting part, and use those crystals to reveal the truth about the world we're living in.

Ahhh, I thought this would grab your attention! Some people call it the "Forge of Truth" - a bit of a silly name if you ask me. But there's one thing we know for sure - this is the heart of The Excelsior. I designed it to translate, analyze and piece together snippets of text. It usually works like a charm, but there are still some kinks to iron out: like how the primal energy of the crystals it uses for fuel occasionally transform the paper into completely different objects and resources. Here are some snippets I was able to translate - maybe some of them belong together?
Well, that was exciting! And there's so much more to discover, I'm getting goosebumps just thinking about it.
Aren't they beautiful? Shining so bright, with all those colours, and yet so mysterious to the touch.

W-what happened to the man? He just flew out of the cannon into the blue! I hope he's alright...
The people are grateful for your contribution. Now they are able to teach our youngsters about the world and how it works.
Here - I brought you a crane made out of paper. There's a lot more where that came from, and people are going crazy for it.
Now we just have to wait and see.
It's the Black Knight! He did incredibly well. I didn't even know we had such talented people among our troops.
Look at this fancy furniture! Maybe I should buy some of it...

Well, that settles it. We found out that platinum swords are lighter and faster, but not really more durable compared to damascene swords. Your settlers loved the comparison, though - maybe we should blow something up next time?
Our shoe maker delivered an incredible performance. The skill he must have to control that wagon at top speed - unbelievable.
We banished those bandits, and they'll think twice before coming back.
The band members were really happy about the award. They promised to continue to throw concerts.
Those kittens are so cute. The children love to play with them.
Our troops will leave soon, and help the king to train his troops.
Great - now you know all about the Christmas surprise, and how to get presents!

Alright, now we're ready for anything the Croaker can throw at us.

Great work - your explorer has found some presents!

Oh, those horses really do look like reindeers! That should do the trick!
I'll head off now and brew the potion that'll make them fly! This may take a while, but I'll be back tomorrow!
And up it goes! Look at how well they fly. They really are naturals! In hindsight, maybe reindeers were the wrong choice after all. It took them years to get used to flying...

It’s nice to have a change of scenery every now and then. Scenarios are a lot more relaxed than other adventures, wouldn’t you agree? Although the settlers working at the workyards don’t seem to think so...
Now that was fun! And furthermore, you saved troops and resources thanks to fighting together on your adventure!

Oh, those horses really do look like reindeers! That should do the trick!
I'll head off now and get started brewing the potion that'll make them fly! This may take a while, but I'll be back tomorrow!
And up it goes! Look at how well they fly. They really are naturals! In hindsight, maybe reindeers were the wrong choice... It took me years to get them used to flying...

Good Job! Your vote has been submitted, and we'll see the final results soon.

Ohh, I didn't expect people would vote like that!

That was a nice trip! I hope you got the information you were looking for. If you have any more questions, or are looking for some more information, you should try the archive. There you'll find everything you could ever want to know about the guild market.
Well done. This area should be able to breathe easy again without so many bandits scarring the land.

Incredible. The Varaldsvik Village Elders let us know that they've seen smiles on faces that haven't smiled for decades. With tears welling in their eyes, they are finally able to see hope again, thanks to your effort!
Not only could we help the poor villagers, but we also managed to find some new friends. This Venture is going to be a breeze! Let's continue our journey north.
One step closer to the mountains. Let's go forth without fear!
Another obstacle overcome. We can now head further into the mountains, and continue our search for the ominous Mountain Clan.
Fantastic! You've defeated the Ibexes! But before we continue, could we make a short stop to take a shower?
Good as new! Well, OK - not quite, but at least it looks like we should be able to get across. Is it safe? Yes, yes of course it is! That's why you can go first...

Well, that was tough. It seems the enemies here have some tricks up their sleeves and are somehow influencing the wildlife. We'd better prepare well before we continue our venture. But for now, let us celebrate our recent triumph! Well done.

Apparently, the Nords settled here long ago. We discovered an old children's book depicting the history of the Mountain Clan. It seems they all had very long beards, including the women of the tribe! They were all styled in different ways, hinting towards their various professions. It also showed a man of the Mountain Clan, covered in hair from head to toe. Unfortunately, though, the text below cannot be deciphered any more.
A small step for a carpenter, a big step for... nevermind. Let's get moving!
Good news, the wildlife is no longer in our way!

After investigating the place thoroughly, we found some leg chains that would fit a leg the size of a barrel! The Nords were using it as a cable for the winch on their well. Legends painted on the walls show the sinister people of the Mountain Clan, some as big as trees, biting the head of the Nords' children if they dared to get too close.
Restoring these bridges will not only help us find out more about the Mountain Clan, but will also help the people living here reclaim their land.
Well, that's the wildlife dealt with. Well done! Now, let me through! I want to start digging!
The path ahead is clear, and we have the equipment we need. Shall we push on now, or do you still have business with the other Nords?
I see you got your hands on the bare necessities. You should really consider grabbing more gear if you can, though.
You sure showed the beasties! The chieftain looks impressed. Good position to be in for trade negotiations, I'd wager.
Another job well done. You're a real trooper, ain't ya?
They really should have known better after last time...
What are you waiting for? Distribute these shoes to your army and deep snow will no longer slow you down.
They've delivered the spikes. Once you've handed them out to your troops, they should be able to keep their footing on even the most slippery ice.
I'm freezing just looking at you in that weak excuse for a coat. You should really wear your new clothes.
I see, you've... Wait, I can't see anything! Will you lend me a pair of those goggles, please?
Great! Just deliver everything to the Mead Hall in the village you want to trade with.
A wise decision. It looks like you won't get your hands on enough quality pelts to go through with a fourth deal, but you've done as much as you can.
The chieftain appreciates you helping out his village despite your bandit troubles. He's open to negotiating a trade.

So many unknown paths. So many obstacles. And on top of all that, you're facing weather conditions that are above and beyond anything you've encountered so far. But nothing could stop you, and you sanguinely found your path. Keep it up!

You managed far better than I expected. I thought you'd be dea...erm, exhausted by now. Luckily, the worst seems to be behind us. To avoid getting lost in the mountains, you should never look back - only move forward. Oh, and I want to point out that the paintings you found while excavating the ruins clearly show beautiful women without any weird body hair...or facial hair...
That was surprising. Who'd have thought we'd encounter such a wild creature up here in the mountains? I wonder if the Mountain Clan ever met any of those if they supposedly live here.

So... I guess at least some of the legends about the Mountain Clan seem to be nothing more than the overactive imagination of some frightened villagers. But what is the truth behind these legends? As they say, there's no smoke without fire...

So, what did you find? Ah, interesting... So most mine entrances are a bit smaller than you'd expect, and the handles of the tools are also a bit shorter? Hmm. But the tools weigh too much for children to work with? Remarkable... And what conclusion would you draw from this my friend?

Ah, nice! You discovered another ruin! So what about all that boiling water?
Ooh - turns out they're just hot springs, and the area was most likely used for baths and relaxation. That makes much more sense....

So, you`re saying that even after thoroughly investigatingboth the ruins and the cliffside, you didn't find any warning signs? Remarkable.
Only some ropes, pitons and other climbing gear scattered all over the place... Aha! So it looks like this is a climbing training area! Astonishing...
Awesome! We can get started now!
Ok then! Now that you know everything there is to know about the Easter building, let's get to work. Chop-chop!
Well done... you found the achievement button... Not the first, but a trendsetter nonetheless... Here, take this special Easter building as a token of my appreciation.
Really? You're going to place it there? Oh well, you've been doing this for a while, so I'll let you have your artistic freedom this time. Let's move on!
The strange man in the bunny costume just went by. It seems you really helped him out. Thank you very much. I would have been totally helpless on my own.
About time! I don't have all day! Ahhh… that's good! I'm sure I'll have my memory back in no time! Let's see… where am I?!
Thank god, he found something! Don't know what I would have done without him. Let's see, what does the hint tell us about the egg's location?!
Well, that's a lot of eggs, but I'm not sure you got them all. Hmm… If any are missing, my Easter pal will be mad!
Yeah! That was good. Even better, I've just remembered the location of the other eggs I lost. I'll mark it on the map... Look away, I cannot draw when someone stares at me!
Phew! All eggs together, finally! Man, I was really concerned my Easter pal would never talk to me again. Thanks buddy. Until next time.
That rude person just stumbled away. Are you alright? It was so generous of you to help him. You saved the Easter feast with your efforts. Thank you very much.
OK. I will take this decent compensation and look the other way. So, how are you planning on getting my eggs back? What? You expected me to gather my lost eggs alone? That is the last straw!
I asked the settlers working in the mine, but they weren't sure. They said someone told them something about some eggs and painted it onto a sheet of paper, but I couldn't find any sign of him. Jeez…
Oh my god, that took you, like, years! Have you finally managed it? What do you mean I didn't do anything to help? I was sitting here and giving managerial advice! This was obviously a lot of work!
Oh great! You found them! Let me see! … What the… There are some missing! Are you kidding me? I hope you haven't kept some for yourself?
Nice - I think that's all of them. But with the good news comes some bad, too, as I'm afraid I have to leave you now. I know you'll be sad when I'm gone, but I'm sure we'll meet again. Until then….
Well, that was different. I hope he'll do a good job for the Easter bunny. But you did what you had to do. I'm sure he's grateful, even if he didn't seem it.
Nice, it worked! I'd love to be able to see his face when he realizes his eggs are being stolen. Hey, don't look like that. He is a complete jerk after all!
The baker is incredibly satisfied with your help, and is ready to give us the coordinates for my cousin's other island. We're getting closer!
Oh, back already? So, how was it? Yes, yes, that was the last time we… borrowed eggs from him. Now, we have to rebuild my reputation with the Easter bunny… After some sleep!

Nice, the Easter bunny already recognized all the people gathered around me. That went pretty well! What? Oh, of course you can have the coins back. I was just about to give them back to you anyway! Honestly!

The Easter bunny was so choked up by my efforts, he decided to give me another chance. I'm sure the Easter eggs he lost were also a reason. Well, thanks for your help buddy. I couldn't have done it without you… Well, maybe I could have, but it would have taken a little bit longer.
Ah, how sweet it is to see someone beaten their own weapons. Even if I get the impression that his cousin isn't much better. Anyway, here are some Easter eggs for your help. Thank you.
Nice - this should be enough for now. Well then, let us begin our egg hunt. I already have an idea where we can begin.

Very good! We're off to a good start. But of course, this will not be enough to win the competition. I'm sure there are more islands to find eggs on. And I know someone who can point us in the right direction.
Nice, that went fast! What? Yeah, I know it was pretty bad, but we managed, didn't we? So stop sulking! We still have work to do.
Hmm... There are fewer eggs than I expected here. With such a paltry amount we'll lose the competition for sure! We need more eggs!

Wow, look at these piles of eggs. Amazing! And just in time! I will now take the eggs and hurry to the appointment with my cousin. I can't wait to see his face! He he… What? Oh, OK… I'll leave you some eggs too. Until we meet again!
Well! As the saying goes, "all's well that ends well", am I right? Let's hope the party crashers don't bother us for a while.

There is another bright side to this, however - working with obsidian produces some waste that cannot be used for smithing, but will do us nicely for reinforcing our gates.
Lucky - they found an obsidian shard already! Talk about immediate gratification!
Can you believe it? When they started cultivating new fields, the farmers found a sizeable shard of obsidian burried beneath the earth!

The experiment was a success! It wasn't exactly the most efficient way of doing it, but we got a good-sized shard out of it nonetheless.
If only we had more time to repeat the process.

Ah, how refreshing! This should last for a while.
In the meantime, our scouts have just found out what happened to the well - the jötnar must have used some sort of magic to freeze the river solid! They are truly fearsome enemies!
Ironically, they also found a shard of obsidian in the dried-up well. Someone must have dropped it in there a long time ago. I guess we should thank the giants for this dirty trick.

That should be it! Now all that's left is to wait for the upcoming breeding season, and everything should be back to normal!
It's always important to keep nature in mind!
The hunters have been very helpful, and have delivered a full list of the current deer population on your island.
The hunters could help you track the number of wolves, but it wouldn't help solve the problem of your deer.

Turns out the foresters had all been wondering what was affecting the deer themselves. None were sure what could be behind the situation, but they each promised that they've always been careful to leave the animal's normal habitat untouched.
Everyone's very happy for your help, but we're still no closer to solving the problem. Let's continue with the research.
Your bowmen managed to chase the strangers away. Congratulations! It seems they were the cause of all our deer problems.
The hunters appreciate your help, and have promised to keep an eye on the population to keep nature in balance.
Turns out the little pup and the girl have grown more than a little bit attached. The pup wouldn't be able to survive in the wilderness alone. I guess he'll make a great companion for the girl!
Slowly, the puppy is getting there. The fireplace provides enough heat to warm the little guy up.
It was a good idea to clean the wounds and bandage them. The little pup only needs to rest now.
What a relief! The pup's healing up, and it can already walk again. It's certainly a cute little guy - and it looks like he likes you and the little girl.
We couldn't find a wolf pack that had puppies, or a mother wolf who's searching for her child. So where did he come from?
The girl is holding the pup tight, and the pup is not willing to leave her.

The elders decided to let you in, as in the end, they had no choice. Our enemies have managed to enter the city fortress, and are using abandoned mine shafts to hide and spread throughout our homeland.
I received a map from the Elders showing where the situation is the most dire. My friend, I know this is a lot to ask. But seeing your strength, we could really use your help. Please, help us reinforce our city fortress and retake our homeland!

Well, well, well - what have we here! This dynamite is a specialty of the mountains. It can crack even the toughest and most frozen boulders. We don't have anything to use it on now, but I'm sure we'll find use for it later.

Young clan members, still wet behind their ears, snuck out of the fortress to get a glimpse of our enemies. They found a hidden path through the hills, and used it to get there. Apparently, our enemies were about to discover the path too - so the young clan members threw caution to the wind to defend it on their own! They shouldn´t have risked so much, but they stalled the wild beasts long enough for us to give them a kick in the pants! If we need it, we can take this path too.

We got far too many requests from the townspeople for us to be able to handle them all. We'll have to focus on what's most important.
The clan elders gave me another list of tasks. Looks like we´ll have our work cut out today.
Excellent! Now you know everything you need to know to be able to shine at the Settlers Football Championship. I've just announced our official participation. Let the matches begin!
Well done! You reached level 16. This is our ticket to the Football Championship!
Great! Come back here if there's anything else you want to know about the event.
So, this is the Football Championship fixture list. You know where to find it, and how to use it. And now we have our first opponents! As a reward, you also get your first useful item: a Red Card!
Good work! Now let's finish that match!
Well done! Bananas are used to produce the Foul item in the Provision House. Did we collect all the other remaining ingredients?
Yes! Now that we have the foul, we can use it on the playing pitch.
You won your first match! Congratulations! The tournament matches may be harder, but it looks like you're well-prepared.
The last weeks have been very exciting, haven't they? I still can't believe that we actually won the finals. I think you've earned yourself the right to build a monument to commemorate our victory!
Congratulations! We won the first group stage game. If we can win the second one as well, we might just advance to the last 16!
That was really a good performance! Thanks to your excellent tactics, it's now official: we made the last 16!
What a thrilling match! I'm glad we could beat the Shire of Oxwater – even if it was a close call. Let’s see which opponent is awaiting us next.
Unbelievable! You made it! We're in the semi-finals, and are amongst the four best teams in the competition!
We're in the finals! I can't believe it! We reached the finals! What a match! I always hoped we'd go far with this team, but to actually reach the finals!! I'm thrilled!
What a match! What a tournament! The opposition was incredibly strong but we managed to come out on top and earn the title of champion! The fans will remember today for years to come.

I'm impressed! Everyone, from the players to the fans, said they had a great time and are looking forward to visiting again next year.
In the meantime, you can probably make good use of one of those snack stands.
That looks perfect! I can't wait to play here!
Seems like you've found some very motivated people. Everyone and everything will be in capable hands.
Not a moment too soon! The first wave of people is already arriving. I'm sure your population figures will benefit from the tourism, too.
That's a big stack! You must be very confident about the demand.
They're no masterpieces, but they're solid enough. Time to think about the menu.
Oooh, those look really refreshing. Don't mind if I do! Hey, what's with that judgmental look?! I WAS going to pay for it.
Okay, okay! It's a GOOD sausage in a bun! Everyone will love them!
The tourists are very appreciative of your transportation system. They're even willing to pay for the service!
You can always count on Aunt Irma. The gift baskets were also a great success!
These all turned out pretty well, didn't they. Your Settlers are excellent artisans.
Just having the guards around will make ruffians think twice before starting any trouble. With any luck, they won't actually have to do anything.
Alright!! That should have us covered until the end of the tournament. Who'd have thought such a simple idea would turn out to be such a hit?
Am I just imagining it, or do the players look a little... resigned? Oh well, the fans look really happy so I'm sure it was worth it.
Splendid! We're almost done here, but I did have a final task for you if you want to keep this wave of tourism going...
Everyone loved your stories, especially the little ones! I think many visitors will stay on for a few more days.
You've caught up quickly! But now that you're licensed, there's a lot of work ahead of you.

You managed this crisis beautifully. Not only have you averted disaster, but now we also have the most impressive Forge the world has ever seen, right on our island!
I'm sure all our neighbors will look on in envy!
Splendid! As the path is now clear, we can get a better look at this mountainous menace. We'd better hurry!
All prepared. The expedition crew is ready to leave. Let's head out at once!

Finally, your residents can relax and get a good night´s sleep. You can see the relief in their eyes.
However, we do still have to find a way to mollify the troublemaker in our backyard. Luckily, I think I might have an idea for that!

At last, we´re home again. After spending so long in the cold, I can't wait to relax with the sun on my skin again, and sip a cool, refreshing Red Flying Settler. And maybe a grilled steak too. But I digress.
You did a great job, you know. The battles you fought, the weather you endured, and the value of the work you did for the Mountain Clan cannot be expressed by words.
Congratulations! But we're not quite done yet...

The forge looks incredible... And it's incredibly useful, too! Not only will we be able to manufacture a lot of our weapons here, but we'll also save a lot of space, which we can use for other productions!
But what should we use that space for? That's up to you to decide!
Excellent! Your explorers can find plenty of Shoulder Pads, Helmets, Studs, Wet Grass, and Grease this way. You can use these resources to produce tactical items in your Provision House.
You did well... for a rookie! Ha ha ha!! Fine - as a reward, I'll let you help with the preparations!
Looks like this wise master has taught you everything you need to know, tee hee! Keep contributing to our balloon supply, and you won't regret it!
Thank you! Just keep those resources flowing if you want as many balloons as possible.
You only found half the items? Oh no! Actually, it looks like the other stuff ended up on your neighbours' islands.

The cake was great - although now I think I need a nap... Oh, right! I almost forgot to tell you - you can find more cake ingredients on successful adventures. However, you'll still only find one type of ingredient. You'll have to trade for the other.

If you keep donating balloons to the party, you'll be rewarded handsomely. There are rewards based on your personal contributions, and even more rewards to be earned depending on everyone's donations as a whole! Help each other out to make this anniversary unforgettable, okay?
You! Hey! I just received word of something very curious going on! Let's have some fun!
That whole business was crazy... I loved every minute of it, ha ha!
I don't get why the islanders were so upset about this whole affair. I just thought it was funny, tee hee!
Did you really have to put and end to it? The island looks so boring now!

If I could be serious for a minute... I'd just like to say a big thank you, for all your help.
OK, that's quite enough of that - now, back to be being silly! Tee hee!
And your reward is... a firm and satisfying handshake! Ha ha ha! Huh? Wait, you don't like it? Okay, okay - I have something else...
You did it! Looks like it was just as easy as I thought, tee hee hee!
Looks like you're starting to get into it, too! Let's fill the hall to the rafters with balloons!
Whaaat?! You really did it?? Oh... "yippee!" I guess this belongs to you now...
Wow! This is the closest I've ever come to being speechless! You've more than earned your reward.
Thanks! I found this stuff in the tras- treasure chamber. You can have it, tee hee.

Wow, you're all so incredibly amazing! Thanks so much for helping out! You ended up making me a lot of work, what with having to get all your rewards ready in time and everything, but still - here you go!
What an amazing thing we've accomplished together! Absolutely stunning work, my friends! You've all really earned your rewards. Here they come!
Evil has been banished, and the townspeople rejoice! It appears they've been saved for good. But what about next Halloween...?
We've found it! A tiny island, surrounded by fog. Even so, I still can't believe nobody's noticed it before? It's almost as if it didn't exist until recently...
Good job! That said, I don't like what that scientist said about his lord encouraging him. Could he have anticipated what would happen...?
As frustrating as it is, we can't do anything for now. The scientist promised to inform us when he figures out how to break the castle's barrier. Make sure you're ready!
What a vile creature! A lord that tortures his population for fun? Disgusting! I'm just glad we ended up with you. I hope you know how much the settlers appreciate you!

Well, that's that problem taken care of. For some reason, I have a bit of a bad feeling about leaving so soon, but I can't quite put my finger on why... Still, there's nothing more for us to do here, so let's just say our farewells to the townsfolk and be off.
Well fought! But we have no time to waste. We must act before more golems show up!
Well, that looks sturdy enough. It won't last forever - but if we've done our job properly, it won't have to.
There! I think I can see a structure just ahead. Stay close!

Wait! Stand down! The man swears he didn't know what he was doing.
He says he wasn't aware that the golems were rampaging about. The island's lord was allegedly very interested in this project, and said he'd take care of the golems. I wonder what happened?

This is so frustrating! We're so close, but we still can't do anything! The fact he's choosing to hide behind his magic proves that he's the culprit, too.
I've asked the scientist for help, and he's promised he'll start working on a solution right away. His way of making up for the trouble he caused earlier. He said he might well take a few days, though. I suppose we should return home until we hear from him.
We're getting there. Still a way to go, though.
It feels good to be standing on somewhat even ground again. The castle looks even scarier up close. But that won't stop us, will it?
What is this?! I can't even reach the gate! Some invisible force won't let us enter. Is this some kind of dark magic?!
It looks like "entertainment" was all the motivation the tyrant needed to terrorize an entire island... Now that our job here is done, I'm going to be glad to see the back of this place.

The things we saw in those towers almost makes me feel glad for this detour. It's good that we put a stop to the witches.
Now, let's see if the barrier is gone.
He just... evaporated! Was he not of this world?! No wonder he was so evil!
The preparations are complete, and everything's working. Can you feel that? That's the feeling of relief, knowing we're safe and ready for anything that might hit us.
I just received a letter from our scientist. I hope it contains good news, and not an additional delay.
I hope you did take some time out to enjoy the festivities? Pretty impressive, right? OK - time to move on with the second week. Can I count on you once again?
Oh my... Turns out the rumours were true - the mansion was haunted! You disturbed the ghosts, and now they're all over the place! At least they seem friendly enough...
You saved the lives of so many people. They'll be indebted to you for their entire lives.
The quarantine zone is set up, and your troops are enforcing the perimeter. This is a great start in helping cure the sick people. Well done!
The Mayans are showing signs of recovery. Now, they just need some time to relax. This wouldn't have been possible without you.
A full stomach works miracles when it comes to recovery. Your troops report seeing many more smiling faces than before. Helping can be so heartwarming.
You handled the situation very well. Your support is key to helping those people.
We learnt so much about disease and infection during our travels. Impressive work.
That should be the last of them. I'm so happy we were able to help here.
That's an impressive achievement! The kingdom is very thankful to you for helping them build up their strength.
The resources are instantly used to craft weaponry for the graduating conscripts.
The conscripts are showing good progress in training. Their senses are sharpened, and their skills are honed.
The generals of the kingdom are very pleased by the showcase of your strategic knowledge. They've learned so much, it's hard to know where to begin!
Exhausted, but happy, the conscripts return to their lands.
The security troops are ready! They will ensure the ceremony stays safe.
That was a tough exercise for the conscripts, but they managed to learn everything.
The mayor is very thankful to you, and has invited you to visit his new town!
There is so much to learn about architecture. The inspiration we gathered will help the mayor create a beautiful town.
Good job! Now those workers get to it!
The construction site has been secured. Now, the workers can relax, and focus on their work.
Thanks to you, more workers have arrived at the construction site, and can hardly wait for construction to start.
Those resources should be enough to build a nice, beautiful town.
That should be all construction workers we need. Just look at those smiling faces, traveling back to their home town.
The excavation is complete. The structure we found is really impressive - it'll take years to uncover its secrets.
The workers on site have already started to draw a map of the site in preparation for its excavation.
This find is of historic importance, and the people can't wait to start digging.
Your troops are helping out a lot, and have set up patrols to help keep the site safe from intruders - like thieves looking for hidden treasures...
Word about the newly discovered structure has been spreading quickly, as more and more volunteers arrive to excavate the structure. I'm glad we have enough tools to go round!

We found some clues suggesting other ancient structures may be nearby. The local residents have told us many stories about the ancient cultures which prospered in these lands long ago. We should definitely come back when we're ready to make more discoveries!
Well, I think we can safely say we've sent enough volunteers to the site. The excavation is proceeding smoothly, and we should get some information soon.
