Oh, thank you so, so much! I don't know what I'd have done without you... Now, my sweetheart and I can be together again, and celebrate our love the way it should be.
Just between us, I think this year will be pretty special... It might just be the year when we finally get engaged!

As you can see, spreading flowers around isn't too tricky, but it still requires some effort!
I hope I can count on you my dear!

Oh, they're so lovely... The smell, the colors... even the feel of these blossoms is phenomenal already. When the flowers are ready, they can be spread all over the world in different ways. By making flower bouquets out of them, you can help them reach other islands very quickly, but if you trade them, or spend them at the merchant, they´re sure to cover a long distance! I hope my love will find them!

Nice job refilling the flower farms! Plenty more flowers will be blooming soon, in all the most spectacular colors. Keep it up, and keep growing plenty of new flowers! And don´t forget - they don´t need long to grow!
Nothing is more beautiful than getting flowers! Apart from seeing ones loved ones, of course... No, I will not cry... I will not cry! Stay strong, Flora - stay strong...
Aren´t they lovely! I cannot read them often enough. The poetry, the feelings, the expressions of love! They make my heart race, even though some are already years old.
I can´t believe we made it. I just received a message from my love. It won´t be long before my sweetheart is finally home again.
Good job, my dear. Now, let us meet properly. Please visit me as soon as you have the time.
Oh my, just look around. So many lovebirds have gathered. It fills my heart with joy and happiness.
Piece of cake, as expected of you. There's nothing that can bring you down.
Luckily, they didn't find anything dangerous or crazy. Phew! You won't believe how relieved I am. Thank you!
A big thank you from my friend. Here is a small token of his gratitude.
I knew your specialists would find her. Her husband wanted to thank you with this little present.
Incredible! This guy just won't stop talking about all the exciting places he's been visiting! What did your specialist do? Well, doesn't matter - he has the present.
Well, that was fast! Just when I thought I'd seen it all from you, you manage to impress me again.
We found the drill plan! Good job! Did you see the sparkle in his eyes when he got his drill plan back?
And another task completed! I'm sure we'll have more use for your skills, soon.
Excellent job - here's the data! That should help your instructors. Let's get back to the garden and relax a little. Maybe we'll meet more people there?
Oh, nice! That's exactly what I needed! Thanks for the help - now it's time for me to get back to work!
You did it! That's incredible, thank you!
Oh, that's perfect. Such a nice structure. I just have to put it into the right form ... A gut here, a hit there ... Oh, I almost forgot! Thank you, for bringing this to me.
That's exactly what I need! Off to work again for me - this is going to be perfect!
That is one beautiful chunk of graphite. Thank you for your effort - this is going to help me a lot.
Here, let me take a look... Yes, yes... Perfect! Thank you.
What lovely color and structure... It's beautiful. Give me some time to work on it!
Finally! I'd been having to make do with this iron hammer, and it's just not the same!
Wow, that's an interesting one! If you'll excuse me, I really must dash - I have to start mixing it with all kind of stuff! Oh, and thank you.
You're a life-saver. The happiness in the eyes of that student was plain to see. He's very grateful to you.
There was no treasure? Hmm, that is a little sad... I hope you found something else you can use?
He's alive! That's a huge relief. Thank you for saving him.
Oh, nice! It fits into the garden perfectly. What a lovely sight.
You found it! Perfect! I'll take it to him straight away - oh, he's going to be so happy!
Aaaaaand done! Thank you for visiting us. The preparations are now complete - and some people would like to talk to you!
The time has come to fetch your gift. Click on a Gift Christmas Tree and check your Star Menu afterwards!

Oh, you should have seen the cheers and smiles on the faces of those who were reunited! Some were even crying in happiness at getting medicine for their ill friends and families. And a kid who couldn't remember how sweets tasted just stood there in shock chewing chocolate.
Ahem... It's always hard to keep your composure in times like these. Good job in freeing these people - if only for now. I still can't help but wonder what's going on here...

Great work - now let's continue to the city.
Still, something's been bothering me. I can't stop wondering why these villains aren't setting up their tents, and are instead choosing to camp in caves and holes. As if their appearance isn't wild enough already. On one hand, they talk and fight as if nothing is out of the ordinary, but on the other they look like they're in some sort of gold rush. The village chief told us there aren't any valuable ores or other resources to be found in this region, but I'd discuss this matter with your geologists... Something's just not... never mind. Let's get going.
Though these foes are a wild bunch, I imagined it'd be harder to defeat them. Good work. Now there's only a few enemies left, let us clean out the trash and set the townspeople free.
Fantastic! Now we've established a new method of travel. Who knows what we'll be able to find in the future!
Good work! We're one step closer to being able to help the new band of pioneers on their merry way.
Alright - this should get things started! But we can't stop here - the opportunity is just too good to ignore.
Oh, wow. I knew it would be a masterpiece, but what I'm seeing surpasses even my wildest dreams. I just knew we were missing something from our shores!

Have you also been struck by gold fever? It seems a huge amount of our settlers are willing to travel out to Tavos. I guess it's just in our blood to head out to far-away lands, and start settling in unknown territories...

Thanks for visiting! I hope my crew hasn't scared you too much... Has that tress in your hair always been such a pale white? Ha-whooooo, I'm just kidding. We'll return regularly, and we'll try to be on time every week. But you know, there's nothing like ghostly punctuality whooo-ho-hoo.
Time's up, and the Flying Ghostman returns for our weekly visit home! To wash our sheets and so on... Whoooooo-hoo!
Such a shame. Someone mistook these wisps for tiny ghosts. That's so super-natural-ficial. Typical of those pirates who gave us the false intel.

Whoooooo-ray! It worked! Their pride seems to have taken a bit of a hit, and now the crew is eager to show the living how it's done. They even use phrases like "Thank you my fellow perished one" and "Apologies my immortal fellow".

Isn't he the cutest ghost dog you've ever seen? Did he behave, or did he just howl away at your enemies? Oh yeah! I've just this second realized I forgot to give you some ghost bags for the ghostly doggy-doo. Ah, just kidding - we don't eat anymore, so there's nothing coming out of us. Except for this ghostly goo of course... Ho-ho-whoooooo.

Oh, that was fun. And the enemies you chose were awesome! We avoided the dragon, but the huge slime blobs were very entertaining. And that underground caves we discovered - just amazing. Wait... What do you mean those weren't the evildoers you meant? That wasn't even the island you chose for us? Where have we been then?!

The notes vanished with a glow you say? Ah, that's go-whooooo-od to hear. The mother seems to have had stayed on the bright side of life. But I bet she wasn't the only one who had such a dream. We'll let you know if we encounter more.

What a coincidence! I would never have believed it if I hadn't seen it with my own eyes. I mean, if I hadn't had seen it with my... ghost eye-holes? Ah, whatever. Who'd have thought you'd find the woman taken prisoner by the bandits still unharmed? It's moments like this that make us cling on to this world - and that make the heavens let us stay, I assume. I'd forgotten that even us gho-whooooo-sts can still cry - in a way. What did you say to the family when they asked how you knew about their tragedy? A little bird told you about it?
Oh, these lands are the best we've conquered in a long while! Thanks for the tip! Here, take this as reward!

Oh, so you found the place? And? What did you find, don't keep us on tenterhooks! Oh, what? Seriously, toys?!? Oh, and a picture of a girl. I can just about make out what it says on the back... "I'll bury our childhood mementos, so someday maybe they'll make someone else as happy as us. I'll love you until the end of days."

I only said I 'might' tell you the answer... And no, the answer isn't chicken. Now I'm hungry. This is terrible! Do you know how painful it is to be hungry but unable to eat? This is going to bug me for years again!

And? Did it work? Keep on finding friends in any case, though - you never know when you might need them! Or when they'll need you... Or when you might need each other... Or... Ah, you kno-whooo-w what I mean.
Half the load went straight through the hulk. Let's hope we didn't scare the fishes. Sigh.

Oh, this is so much fun! What are we doing, you ask? Riding horses around the island! At night, of course - that way it's more fun, and no-one can see us. There aren't that many fun activities for ghosts, you know... Oh, some people saw us and got scared? Oh, I see. Okay - we'll only do it for one more night, whooooo-ho-ho.

Apologies - looks like we didn't think this one through. First, we couldn't find the island again and traveled seemingly forever - even though our ship flies faster than birds - then we lost most of the cargo in a storm! We might have to go back with some more later. But the people were very thankful for what they got - they couldn't believe their eyes when coal started "flying" into their warehouse!

It whooooooo-rked! Our ghost blades are shinier than ever, see? Oh, you can't see them, huh? But you could feel it if I just sliced you a bit... May I? OK, OK - apologies, I didn't mean it like that. I just thought someone like you, who produces so many weapons each day, would cherish such a result - no offense intended!
So many people freed, so many soldiers, traders and travellers returned home. So many joyful tears from families and friends. You can rest easy today my friend, for you have done a very good deed!
Oh, how magnificent is the glow from below. The sun's rays, split by the water's surface, reflect off the marble reef and dance like little rainbows along the ship's side. Go take a look yourself!

As good as new! Well, I guess it's more like if the Flying Ghostman was destroyed only yesterday. Ah, I'll never get used to this. Even after hundreds of years, I still stumble over my own words... Maybe it'll impr-whooooo-ve now I'm able to talk to living people more often.
So. Much. Better. Whoooooo-hoo! Sorry for the scares we gave some of your settlers when we flew away, though.
Hah! Thanks to you, we were able to beat the sheets out of those pillows! They'll be back for sure, but we showed them for now!
Sometimes when I wake up at night, I can still hear the quacks. Only kidding - I don't sleep!

The men you sent fulfilled their task meticulously, and even got rewarded with medals by the mayor, who asked them to stay and continue their efforts. All of them agreed, and many even plan to build their own homes over there. One man's even got married already! Can you believe that? Me neither... But I wish the couple all the best.
Your men fulfilled their orders to the word. Congrats! I think it wouldn't have mattered what you told your men - the Duke is pleased enough that you provided the riders.
It's raining... arrows. OK, we probably should have seen this coming. But at least the drought has also been watered down. Better get some whooooo-den umbrellas!

Your men did wonderfully! They even improved on the few issues I picked up on! The men, and the audience, have asked if they can create a permanent show to lighten everyone's mood. You don't oppose, do you? Well, I already told them it'll be fine so... whoooo-hoo.

OK, so now the troops are taking some of the brew as payment for their work, but I guess that's better than it being stolen! At least they're taking less than the thieves would - and your tradesmens' mood has improved drastically.

Oh, those spots you mentioned are perfect! I think we'll check them all out one by one. My crew is already looking forward to it, and they've got their vacation clothes on already... Well, they would have if they could wear clothes, anyway.

Oh, this is a sight to behold. Once our scouts finished making their way around the island, announcing that the area is safe for now, heads and people began appearing from all directions. It seems the word is spreading quite fast. The people do still look like they aren't sure what to believe, however. They haven't been near the city during fall for several years. It seems the evildoers have been getting more aggressive, and have caused more havoc than usual. But now, they have the chance to salvage the ruins, and maybe even rebuild parts of the town. Until the next beasts appear, that is.

So far, so good. Let's push on before the garrisons start doubting our chance of winning. The latest research suggests that there's something in the water that's attracting the evildoers. But that doesn't explain why we've so far remained unaffected, as we also drink the same water. Maybe it has something to do with this volcano, and the air surrounding it? I need more time to investigate - but I'm afraid we cannot stay long.

That was one of the hardest challenges I've had to face in my entire life. There were some ineffably challenging foes to defeat, but you've overcome them all, as always. I am proud and thankful of being able to travel and fight with you.
Oh, right - there's a town behind those rocks! Is this Laeylorn? But... it seems there are ongoing fights. Another group of bandits seemingly arrived shortly before us. We should intervene!
Good solid work. Not like those bandits really stood a chance, but still.
Ah, finally someone opens the door! You know, it's rather unpleasant standing outside and knocking weirdly on so many doors and windows.

See, this is why we cannot divert any attention to searching for missing people right now. We ourselves are also still missing our tailor and one of our healers. Due to constant attacks on our town for a nigh on decade, only a small village remains, and even this is shrinking faster than we can hope to rebuild. There are many villagers who've fled to nearby hideouts and have been left homeless.
Thank you so much for this. Now we have enough room for the majority of people, and we don't have to cram everyone into the left-over buildings.

My sincerest thanks. It's... harder than you can imagine. Especially since I have to maintain my composure. I fear the people would give up completely and surrender their lives if there was no-one there to provide hope.

I will accompany you to your ships personally. We were really lucky you came. Once the situation has calmed down, we'll be more than happy to help you find your friend. When you return, I think it might be a good idea to bring some more troops with you - though I doubt there will be as many bandits as last time.
Wow! I'm impressed. I thought you might try to lure them away or something - I didn't realize you had such an incredible force behind you! I must remember not to get on your bad side, huh?
Phew! Those beasts looked really dangerous, but you seem to take care of such threats with ease!

Impressive! OK - now we should have some time to recuperate. But I fear the pirates will return soon... Maybe even tomorrow! I will be sure to send for you if we need help, so there's no need to remain on the island. But don't wait too long before you send your troops... I don't want to see everything we've rebuilt so far just crumble away. Not again.
And thank you, for all you've done. I have a feeling I'll have reason to say this again and again in future.
As always, an immensely good job. I expected nothing less of you! Thank you so much.

Oh, those are some sturdy barricades! They might not look like much, but with these, our enemies have only one path they can take to enter the town. And we can much more easily defend it. They tried to stop us building up these barricades, but you were far too fast. I guess it's not your first time building and repairing things far away from home?

Don't forget to send the troops! Without them, we cannot dare rebuild the town. Who'd want to start building a smithery if they fear a spear in their back at any time? Only with safety will we be able to return the town to its former glory, and repay you for your help!

Did you use some kind of special fertilizer? These wheat fields are growing faster and stronger than I'd ever imagined. Thank you for this - this wheat should prevent any immediate threat of starving, at the very least.
It almost looks like a normal village now, doesn't it? People are coming out of their houses, and even daring to sit on the benches around town again. Remarkable.
Oh, I get the shivers when I even so much as see those towers... But can I still call you if anyone tries attacking us again?

Why is no-one able to speak for themselves! Everyone just sends us to the mayor without exception. They were reluctant to tell us a lot about Kaedric to begin with, but they practically stopped talking the instant I've mentioned him. Are they afraid of us? Or of Kaedric? Well, at least they confirmed he was here...

It's good to have proof that Kaedric was here. And not only that, it seems he was looking for something around the village and the island. It sounds like he went outside the village, even though Ferri clearly warns everybody against doing so. There are many aggressive and dangerous wild animals on the island, and Ferri doesn't want them to be drawn to the village.

I think I've thanked you so often by now, you must be growing tired of my voice. You are a true friend! Although I am still unsure how any of this will turn out, with your help I'm sure we will be able to find Kaedric, and discover what all this was about!

Ok... He's not here. Let's ask around, and see where he might have ended up. It's really not like him to invite us but then not be there. He's more of an orderly, punctual type of guy.
Oh, it looks like he left us a message?

Finally, we have a clue about what Laeylorn might be. It seems to be an island - one further away from our home than we've ever traveled. It is beyond the stormy regions to the west. Even I have rarely visited these areas, as the Excelsior isn't capable of travelling there. Believe me, we tried, and we almost paid with our lives. I assume the only way to get there is by ship. Or by some kind of underwater vessel, if something so ludicrous should exist. Either way, we have to find a way to go either below, or around these heavy and unpredictable thunderstorms.
Look at all those carts to transport the materials. That is quite a sight to behold!
I already feel safer! Even though there was never a lot of crime here, I doubt anyone will try anything foolish while we're gone now.

Equally spread across all the ships, this amount of food still fills their holds to the brim. But this won't last for long when we're out at sea. Oh, it's been a long time since I was aboard a ship... One that isn't flying, I mean.
Good, good. This setup should keep everything in order until we return.
OK, these ships are getting fuller and fuller...
OK! It seems we have all the basics, but our entourage has recommended we bring along quite a few more things in order to be fully prepared.

Another huge load of resources... I really hope we'll be able to get through the storms and find Laeylorn. I was able to get a better map showing the way to the island, but it's very old, and only parts are visible. Still, it seems Laeylorn has been a very rich country with lots of trading relationships.
OK, that should be enough! I've always liked seeing everything sparkling!
We've got some weird things onboard now... But it can't be helped, I guess!
Nice! I think we're finally prepared for what's yet to come. I think I'd have gone crazy if these preparations had taken any longer!
A great day to start an epic adventure, wouldn't you agree?
Good, good! That puts my mind at rest, at least a little. I thought I'd go crazy pondering over it...

OK! Now let's go back to Laeylorn, continue conquering this new adventure, and find out what happened to Kaedric! Remember, you'll always find the coordinates for Laeylorn in your mailbox after deferring this adventure.
It seems our island is THE birthplace of thrillseeking adventurers. Maybe that has something to do with you? There were more than enough volunteers after all. I shouldn't have been worried.

OK! The troops should have arrived by now. Ever since we created some proper maps of the area, and improved our ships by borrowing some of the engineering feats from the Excelsior, we've been able to get to Laeylorn much quicker!

Oh wow, that really was a lot of supplies! I was watching the dockworkers for hours. If you looked closely, you could see the ships sink a little deeper with every crate and barrel that was loaded on board. These supplies are going to help people that are truly in need. You can be content with your work today.

At least we've found some traces of Kaedric now... Even if we haven't yet found him, we at least know he's still alive. But if he doesn't want to be found, there must be a reason... I hope we'll be able to find out what's behind all of this.

Friggin' unbelievable! Excuse my outburst, but none of the explorers could find a thing! Kaedric's apparently never visited any known town, fishing village or hermit's house! So now what do we do? If we've already searched so far and wide, how are we ever going to find anything? Unless... wait a second...

Still no clues as to Kaedric's whereabouts... I think we ought to go back to Laeylorn and ask around there.
Hmm... You know, it doesn't really help us with the search, and it might just be a random detail, but nonetheless... During several of the searches, we found some red dust. None of the geologists knows what this is - they've never seen anything like it before. But your experts all agreed that this mineral, or whatever it is, would usually reside very deep in the ground.
Hmm... Do you also have the strange feeling that something isn't quite right? Are the people of Laeylorn hiding something?

OK. Everyone's certain that Kaedric hasn't returned, and no-one's heard anything from him since he went to Laeylorn. Can we take a look over there ourselves? Maybe if we promise not to let any beasts reach the town, he'll allow us to take a look around the island?
I truly did not expect this outcome. Let's continue.

Now it's official. Laeylorn has become your partner town. We're definitely counting on you and your help, but I hope we've already proven that we can become a worthy partner in future. All this aside, I think the most important thing is that you've been able to help so many good people! Don't you agree?
You showed those damned invaders! They shouldn't go to other people's islands in the first place!
Thanks again. We couldn't have dealt with them on our own.
Thanks for returning the scrolls and books. They're precious remnants of our past - we wouldn't have got them back without you.
This is such a relief. The people and I can finally feel somewhat safe. Even during ongoing attacks, the noise doesn't reach the village anymore, and everyone can finally rest. All thanks to you.

Good choice!
For now, our town needs to rest and catch up with all the improvements we've been able to install thanks to you. We'll need to gather up all the people that are still scattered around the island, and assign them rooms in the residences. We'll also need to fill all the positions to take care of the farm and food supply, and get to know all the people you stationed here better. Even if they are soldiers, they're still people, and some of them will settle down here for good - and get all the former productions running again. With the protection we have now, we should be able get back into a routine in a few months, I'd say. We'll let you know when we're ready to continue building up this beautiful town once more.

Every single storage building on Laeylorn is filled to the brim with things people can't really use at the moment, but Ferri has ensured us it's fine for now, as he knows we'll take care of it in future. Also, apparently most of the island's weapons are stored in and below the Mayor's House. Turn out there's an unexpectedly large cellar with lots of room directly below it. I guess with all the fighting, they must think it's safer to build under the buildings rather than above ground.

Well, that was new. I mean, those creatures, and the trees and the crystals. But there's also this constant feeling of... dread. As if there's always something standing behind you, but when you turn around, there's nothing there. Once, I even thought I felt someone's breath on my nape, but apparently it was just a gust of wind. Though there were some hints that Kaedric had been there, it looks like it was already some time ago. Still, we did find a list of places Kaedric was apparently going to visit. It looks like Kaedric left it there on purpose, so someone - like us - could follow his tracks.

After sifting through the clues, it looks like Kaedric was looking for something specific. And he was mostly looking at the mountainous areas, if we've drawn the correct conclusions. Still, that doesn't exactly tell us a lot. Let's carry on to the next item on the list.

Hmm. Look at how clear these tracks are... I mean, I know I've probably got better at tracking Kaedric's movements over the last few weeks... But these almost look like he left them behind intentionally. They almost look like hints, or clues to some kind of riddle... I wonder if I'm just imagining it... I mean, he'd have been in a hurry - and he'd have had to stay hidden from any foes...

Well, it's clear that Kaedric is heading towards the rocks. And it looks like he's taken several samples from different ones. But we still don't know what he did with those samples. Off to the next item on the list!
It looks like Kaedric travelled over the entire island... Perhaps he was in disguise? Hmmm, that could have been possible...

Your specialists have gone through the samples we provided, and what they found is a bit worrisome. It's the same reddish powder that was found in our mines some time ago - but they're still unable to identify it. At a glance, it just looks like normal dirt - it's just the color that's unusual.
Looking a little closer, Kaedric was digging holes here and there as he went. He was digging for something specific, that much is clear. Let's take some samples too.

Great. So after much time and effort, we find ourselves back exactly where we started. Kaedric is still missing, we have no lead on where he went, and we have even less of an idea on how to proceed. I really hope he's OK. I guess we'll just have to wait until a new lead shows up. I'll ask the explorers' guild to have everyone keep their eyes and ears open. I'm afraid there's not much else we can do - flying around aimlessly in the Excelsior won't help anyone. But I'm sure this won't be the last we hear about all this...

Well, that's strange... The tracks were almost exactly the same as the ones we've followed before. But this time, there's clearly more of them. And if I'm not mistaken, it looks like someone else either followed Kaedric directly, or followed his tracks just like we did. But then, suddenly, all of the tracks just stop. No more clues, no new list, nothing. But there's also no sign of a fight, or anything similar. It's like the earth just swallowed him up.

At least his explanation wasn't that bad. As he told us before, the monsters around the island are dangerous, and he doesn't want us to get hurt - especially since we became twin towns. He also thinks Kaedric was the explorer that visited some time ago, and that he went westward for something. He did intend to send out his own search party first, as they know the land, and know how to avoid any potential trouble, but it seems he has other priorities he needed to deal with first. On top of that, he mentioned some ancient ruins and treasures he doesn't want to get stolen. It seems he trusts us now, at least... Let's see for ourselves.
Now that these beasts are off our backs, let's take a look around.
I thought so. But it's always better to be sure. Now we know the direction he went in, and we also have a bit of a clue what he was interested in, don't we?

This is really strange... The building is perfectly fine. Not a scratch. It's even been cleaned recently! But it doesn't look like anyone's living here. There isn't even a bed - just some tools for digging and research. Maybe Kaedric's using the house? Hmm, or perhaps not... I guess he'd be too organized to leave such a mess behind. Let's continue along the path.

Aha! It seems there are some small crevasses in the mountains here. Big enough for someone to squeeze through if they really wanted to. And Kaedric's the kind of guy who'd be so curious he couldn't NOT do it... I just hope he didn't suffocate in a small hole underground... I suggest we see if we can get rid of some rock here, and take a look at what's behind these crevasses a bit more safely.

Oookaaay. I was expecting we might find some kind of ruin - not a huge cave entrance like this! You wait here for minute - I'm going to have a little peek inside. If the cave's a bit unstable, I don't want you getting buried because of my curiosity...
Waaaaaaaaahh. Oh my... OK, no... It's not OK! Let's get away from here. Fast! And gather our troops. We'll need lots of troops before we can explore this cave. When I went inside, I just kept going down and down forever, until I turned a corner and saw this huge underground cave. It was so incredible, I stopped to catch my breath - which probably also saved my life. The very next second, some huge - aehm - something rushed past me, hunting something else in the dark. I've never seen anything like it. I hope you don't think I'm exaggerating when I say it was some kind of monster...

Oh, how wonderful! I'll see we sell our share of the resources, and put the proceeds to good use in Laeylorn. That should secure our town's food supply further. Maybe we could even afford some herbs and seasonings now? We haven't had anything like that in a while...

Hmm... It seems the mad scientist found several interesting things - but he also said it's too early to come to any conclusions. That said, he was maniacally grinning and laughing when he was talking about the experiments he's going to be doing next. Just... don't expect to hear anything from him soon. I think he's a little bit... busy.

Laeylorn, now finally able to defend itself, will slowly but surely be able to return to its former glory. That being said, the people might need your help again sooner than you might think - and Kaedric's whereabouts are still a mystery that begs to be solved.

As soon as our economy is back in the black, we can try to expand our city. If the pirates return, I trust I'll be able to count on our allies again? I'll see you get the "gifts" I told you about earlier as soon as possible. If it's not too much trouble, come visit, OK?
Goodbye, my friends!
The time has come to fetch your gift. Click on a Gift Christmas Tree and check your Star Menu afterwards!
Time's up, and the Flying Ghostman returns for our weekly visit home! To wash our sheets and so on... Whoooooo-hoo!
Irma’s pepperoni was incredibly delicious, and her birthday celebration a great success all around. Good job!
Your settlers enjoyed an exciting horse race. To everyone’s surprise, a formerly unknown rider called Sylvana electrified the crowd and won with flying colors.
The traveling actors are grateful for your generosity, and assure you they'll be back again next season.
Your hard work really paid off; the archipelago is a real display of wealth and prosperity.
Oh, what a talented merchant you are. We are very impressed!
Nothing beats the beauty of your newly produced gold coins. Your treasurer just can’t take his eyes off them. Good job!
Oh, yes! Now that it's been upgraded, the mayor’s house looks stunning. Good job!
Well done! Everybody's grateful that you provided the materials your practitioner needed, who can now happily continue to treat your settlers.
You provided the obsidian ore? Good job!
“Thank you! I can make some great massage oil using this oilseed!”
The Bonabertis are highly impressed with their quarters. They even sent some of their homeland’s finest obsidian ore as a way of saying thanks. Nice job!
Good job on these impressive buildings!
Oh my, the interiors turned out magnificently! Thank you for your support!
You did an amazing job with those wild horses – very well done, my lord!
Those wild horses were a handful, that’s for sure. I'm so glad we tamed them!
Look at our gorgeous battle horses - a true sight to behold!
“Oh, look at our wonderful sunflowers – how beautiful they are!”, your love says and gives you a warm smile.
As your newly trained elite soldiers go on a military parade, you hear your settlers cheer and rejoice: “There is no foe strong enough to take on our island’s forces.”
Your heart is filled with joy as you look at your island’s merry and bright youth. The future does look mightily promising.
Having you as a friend is a blessing.
That insecticide works wonders, and soon the locust plague is over. You saved the harvest – great job!
Good job! I'm sure the anniversary party will be a great success!

Great - everything is prepared. You'll surely make a great first impression.

Oh! Hi, I didn't see you there.

Much better! The right amount of shade, not too crowded, not too isolated, the right amount of silence.
Yes, I believe I can work here.
There are my clothes... Here are my tools... And my undergarments... Yes, everything is accounted for.

Oh dear! Not quite the results I expected.
But I have an idea. I have the coordinates of a nearby deserted island where we can carry out our tests in complete safety.

I see... Most interesting. The shape of the scales... The physiology of the gills... Just sad that they do not survive when removed from the water.
Still, that should be enough for aquatic life. Now, let us focus on another group.

Great work! It is a shame that you weren't able to get healthy wild specimens, though. That is to say, the sort that are still alive.
I suppose I'll have to make do with what we have.

Huh... Not exactly what I expected.
Are you sure the ingredients provided were fresh?
Judging by the smell, there might have been a bit of rot in the materials.
Perhaps too much fish was used?
Back to the drawing board

Never fear, I'm sure you are quite capable of finding a use for these materials.
Here. Have a ticket for a ride on one of the royal fleet ships. No harm done.
Make sure everything is well sanded down. Getting splinters in your fingers is a dreadful prospect.

Ah, good, good. I knew you'd nail this task.
Now, I shall put all of these materials to good use.
What do you mean there's no shipyard here?

Good, you're back, and your clothes are dry!
While you were busy looking for the lost city of Atlantis - erm, I mean, saving the sailors - I had an epiphany.
Ha ha! Yes! I believe we're on the verge of a production revolution, powered by all the advancements in science I'm bringing you.

That'll be enough for the mineral part of the formula.
Next, we'll need some veggies.

You don't suppose I should separate the chaff from the wheat all by myself, do you?
Oh! You do?
I guess I'd better get working, then.

Here. Crystal clear instructions.
It is child's play!
Not in the literal sense of course. This is very much adult-like, official business. Super serious. Seriously.
I... I should just stop talking...
Funny story: the numbers didn't lie, but it seems I gave you the work-in-progress version of the formula and not the final one.

I believe my duty here has been fulfilled.
I will now sail back to the mainland and report back to the king.
He'll be pleased to hear what took place here.
When you thought you'd had enough with water in our latest expedition...

No animals were harmed during the making of this procedure.
In fact, I think I made lots of new friends. I can't seem to get away from these animals anymore...

In case you were curious what these were for, well, I do get hungry after a long day of work.
They'll make for great dumplings, yum yum!
Behold my greatest creation! Yes, I did it! This is it, this is the one.

Now that everyone's safe, I have some significant developments to discuss with you.
Please meet me back on your island.

2... 3... 4... Looks like everyone's accounted for, thank goodness.

In the end, the ring was never found, and another was ordered in its stead. Yet the jewelcrafter lacked the needed metals, and so the groom and his companions took up spade and pick to wrest the materials from the earth themselves.
Then, to the wonder of all, the hound came forth and laid the lost ring at the bride’s feet, and thus the riches drawn from the deep were kept, a quiet favor granted by fate.
I swear this story is real. And there are plenty more to tell.
Thus, the order was given: first, the cloth must be gathered, then the trees set into the earth, so that all might be twisted together in proper fashion.

Only afterward did it dawn on everyone that newly planted saplings bear no branches fit for weaving at all. But by then the trees were rooted, the cloth unused, and the bride entirely satisfied with how it would look someday.
I swear this story is real. And there are plenty more to tell.

All eggs are accounted for... Good time to get out of this outfit and relax.

Remarkable... these markings, these diagrams... We shall need stone foundations, great vats, bellows, pipes, and enough hands to raise such a structure. Let us begin the construction before doubt settles in their hearts.

Ha! Hear that rumble? That is the sound of progress itself. Yet the furnace burns weak. Whatever powers these grand refineries in foreign lands, common firewood alone shall not suffice. We have built the beast, Major. Now we must learn how to feed it.

So this is the substance... dense, bitter-smelling, yet it burns hotter than seasoned oak ever could. These mechanisms were never meant for ordinary flame, nor crude substitutes. The refinery was designed around fuels and methods we do not yet fully understand.
Extraordinary. The furnaces burn steadier. The yield improves. And still, I suspect we stand only at the threshold of true industry.
Remarkable. The grinders turn true, the crucibles hold, and the smoke rises proudly above the rooftops. For a fleeting moment, I dared believe we had mastered the craft entirely.
There was a time when this town knew only smoke from humble smithies and the ring of worn hammers. Now behold it. Great furnaces thunder day and night.

Scholars, merchants, and smiths alike journey here simply to witness the refinery in operation.
The refinery stands as a monument to ambition, knowledge, and relentless progress. The people shall remember this achievement long after we are gone. Not merely a refinery. A legacy.
Look at the shine upon those ingots. A simple improvement, perhaps, yet proof that refinement itself may be refined.
Excellent work, Major. The copper now pours like water from the furnace, and the workers produce twice the ingots with much less effort.

Durable and fit for arms and armor rather than simple farm tools. The town guard already boasts that their next blades shall be forged from refinery iron. Your investment begins to reshape this town's strength itself.
The flames burn hotter and steadier than ever before. Iron production has become predictable rather than perilous.
The refinery wastes almost nothing now. Iron flows steadily from even poor-quality ore, and our stores grow faster than ever before. This is no longer mere experimentation, Major. This is mastery.
Beautiful. The gold gleams bright enough to mirror candlelight itself. Traders who once mocked our refinery now seek contracts with eager hands.
Splendid work. Losses have fallen sharply, and the purity of each gold bar surpasses anything we have produced before.
The refinery now produces gold with both speed and precision unimaginable only a few seasons ago. What once stood as smoke and scaffolding has become the beating heart of this town's prosperity.
The titanium emerged lighter than iron, yet stronger than steel. Even the master smiths could scarcely believe what they held. We stand upon the edge of a new age of craftsmanship.

Where once the machinery buckled beneath the strain, it now operates with surprising stability. The workers speak of the refinery with awe, as though it were some great mechanical beast brought under your command.
Titanium refinement now proceeds with efficiency few would dare imagine possible. The town has become a marvel of industry.

The platinum shines with a pale brilliance unlike gold or silver. Even in small quantities, its value rivals entire wagonloads of lesser metals. The refinery has reached heights once thought impossible.
The refinery now handles platinum with remarkable consistency, producing bars of astonishing purity. Word of our achievements spreads far beyond neighboring lands.

At last... perfection. The fires burn clean. The machinery answers without fault. Not a fragment of ore nor a spark of fuel is wasted. What began as scattered scrolls and uncertain theory has become the greatest refinery these lands have ever known.

Thanks to all you have done, the fate of Octavianus's expedition has been revealed. Though his final destination remains a mystery, one truth is now certain: wherever his journey led, he and his companions carried the settlers' spirit with them, founding new settlements and leaving a legacy that endured long after their ships disappeared beyond the horizon. Tinania smiles as she closes the last journal. "For years, I searched for answers. Today, I have found something even greater. His journey was not lost – it lives on in every story, every settlement, and every soul willing to explore the unknown. Thank you for helping me uncover his legacy."

This special offer can only be bought once! It includes workers and a nice stock of building materials. This is all you need to get a head start in developing your city.
Essential for the ambitious builder - a bountiful package of handy planks.
High quality stones. Carved from a rock solid mountain with diligence and affection.
Higher class building materials in one convenient package. Weighs nearly nothing and can be transported to a storehouse near you immediately.
White and shimmering. High class marble blocks, ready for transport to your storage.

This rare and exotic wood puts the cat among the pigeons at the weekly farmer's market. All visitors want to sneak a peak at this strange looking building material. Fortunately, you are the only one amongst the masses who has the necessary wealth for this rare resource...
The stone of the upper class has made its way onto your market stalls. Hard, precious and very rare. But this blank-faced companion seems not to know about the real worth of this resource.
What better way to motivate eager young men to join your glorious army? A shiny barrel of the most delicious brew in the whole kingdom.
In every cellar there is a dusty toolbox. Oh what treasures! A bunch of tools waiting to be put to good use.
10 extra Carriages.
The dream of every explorer, peasant or king. A big chest of shiny gold coins. What more can you ask for?
This parrot has been trained by pirates to find gold. If you feed it enough crackers it will lead your workers to new gold reserves deep in the mountains.
Originally he specialised as a water diviner, but the only thing he ever found was iron. So he decided to become an iron diviner!
The potential of a marble deposit is measured by the quality of workforce organization. An intelligent overseer can increase this potential significantly. Really!
Equipped with a confidence-inspiring wooden rod, this specialist will find new reserves in your copper deposits. Trust him. He's really good.
With these improved chisels, your workers can cut even more stones from a single deposit. It is astounding what a difference good tools can make.
A Battle Hardened General has led armies to many victories. He can recover twice as quickly from defeat than a normal general.
Mysteriously sparkling seeds, fallen from the moon. These can miraculously enrich any deposit to which they are applied. How is this possible, you ask? Well, even Alchemy can't explain everything.
Ah... those were the good old days. When finding new resources was an adventure. Travelling into the mountains, tapping the stone and placing wooden signposts.
A native inhabitant of these parts. He knows the area like no other and can help you map these parts in no time. You just need someone to translate his strange tongue.
Finest fish from Lutetia. You can smell them a mile away. Which doesn't mean the fish is stale, seriously! Just keep in mind that you cannot return the fish once you have bought them.
This improved drill plan includes a new set of orders ("Faster!, Higher!, More!"), a mad drill sergeant and a highly motivating penalty system. Your recruits will be trained in a jiffy!
Prepared by the local witch, this potion will increase population growth significantly. It is nothing but coloured water, but the placebo effect actually works.
A suspicious looking figure in a hooded cloak is offering a big crate of tools. Where do they come from, you ask? Well, sometimes it's better not to know...
This hulk has been damaged in the latest pirate encounter. Still, most of the planks it is made of can be disassembled. Just remove the blood stains and they are as good as new.
A man with an extraordinarily big belly is offering marble in exchange for huge amounts of stones. When asked, he rants about his menhir production, his little dog and his lovesickness.
A big residence offering all the comfort and luxury expected by a noble. Furthermore, this residence is very spacious, so a lot of people can live here.
This ornate water basin is an useful and gorgeous enrichment for every town. Gallons of the freshest water can be gained from this beautiful monument.
This beautiful bench could be the new centerpiece of your town. It's almost too beautiful to take a seat on.
Not as beautiful as the Golden bench, but still an eye-catcher.
With this decadent seating furniture you will show all your visitors the prosperity of your population.
Stone accumulates heat from the sun much better than metal, so your population will prefer these benches to metal benches...
Foreign sailors brought this extravagant furniture into your shops. Looks like it has been carved out of one huge menhir.
This massive monument, in the shape of a gate, is adorned by a huge angel statue. The pretty park surrounding it looks ever so inviting.
This set is especially well-suited to emphasize your urban road system.
This angel exudes calmness to all your inhabitants. Your workers will find their work easy with this monument.
Build to beautify your city
A lantern that looks much better than normal lanterns, but is also more laborious to produce...
A golden lantern looks so good when placed next to your precious gilded bench.
Some standard lanterns to give a little more light.
A stone statue depicting an angel assisting a collapsed traveller. It forms the centerpiece of a small fenced plaza.
A beautiful pavilion where your workers can take a seat and regenerate after their routine duties.
A wonderful maiden made out of stone, built for eternity.
A tarnished bronze statue of a knight on his steed. Ready for battle, it looks like he's guarding the little park that surrounds him.
Build to beautify your city.
Build to beautify your city.
Wheat needs room to grow freely. By halving this space we have doubled the potential amount of wheat for this field. Sure, the wheat might look a little squashed, but it's still edible.
A foreign settler family is looking for a new home. Maybe you can convince them to stay in your kingdom... for a price.

For the last few days, a strange foreigner with a huge covered wagon has been roaming through your lands, snapping up every bronze bar he can get. Curiously enough he pays the owners with precious iron. Sounds like a good deal for both parties.

The last whirlwind that swept over the land destroyed nearly all the woodcutter huts in your land, but this smart salesman has made a virtue of necessity and now sells the ruined huts as high quality pinewood for low budgets.
Does not really help your workers, but looks pretty good.
Small bed with fresh vegetables from the court gardens.
The owner of this poor small handcart always overloaded it. Now that it's broken, it's looking for a new home, somewhere to settle down and spend the twilight of its life.
Even some scattered boxes can look charming when positioned at the right place.
Improves every woodcutter. Visually.
Since the women in your town don't have any time to pick flowers, these poor vessels are unused. You could help them to find a new meaning in life, couldn't you?
With this rustic signpost, none of your inhabitants will ever get lost in your town.
With this rustic signpost, none of your inhabitants will ever get lost in your town.
With this rustic signpost, none of your inhabitants will ever get lost in your town.
Have you ever built a broken signpost? This is your great chance to do so, don't let it slip away!
Positioned at the wayside, this beautiful stone will raise a smile on every passing worker...
Blends very well together with a broken signpost.
Left behind by the owner because of its over heavy load. Maybe you can move it and give it a new home...
Because of its usefulness, some people even call it "Black gold". Nearly every weapon needs this resource for production. With this pile of coal your weaponsmiths will never, ever stand still...

One of your farmers prides himself on having the most fertile wheatfields. All these years he has been ridiculed by his neighbours, but this year he was either lucky or - finally - right. He's offering a huge amount of his finest brew for sale.
A local tool dealer offers flawless tools at the weekly flea market for a very small price. Obviously he hasn't noticed how valuable these tools are in such times.
A huge barrel filled with charming female fish. This will solve the spawning problems in your shoals of fish for a long time...
Shrouded in mystery, this magnificent cheese sandwich has a very special effect on settlers who eat it...
Ten blank building licences directly from the high court of the royal palace. These will allow you to construct even more buildings in your marvelous city.

The over-worked secretary in the royal palace has lost track of how many building licences you have been given already. A little precious gift might convince him to just hand over a whole batch of blank building licences to you...

This basket is filled with the most exotic fruit from all over the world. You can marvel at the numerous different tastes, and forget all your stress. With this fruit your workers just can't stop working.
Rumours talk of a new kind of drink that has made its way into the kingdom. It is said that anyone who drinks it can work non-stop for 24 hours. You might want to consider this...
A perfect eye-catcher made out of blue, farmed flowers. And additionally they disperse a strong perfume, so sweet that visitors have difficulties leaving your town after smelling it.
Some of your inhabitants have become overweight since the last donnybrook. Of course this also affects their capability to work. Maybe serving a big bowl of salad would help fix the situation.
Roses! Your male population has been asking for this for many years, because a bunch of flowers is the perfect apology after a long night in the tavern. Will you do them this favour?
Shiny, yellow sunflowers that put your inhabitants in a bright, sunny mood. Plant them in your town and your settlers will appreciate it with an everlasting smile on their faces.
Your gate to the whole wide world. With this monumental building you are allowed to trade with other players.
Not long ago, a horrible earthquake brought fear and trepidation to all your inhabitants. Maybe you could still look for the silver lining in this act of God.

After the refurbishment of all your residences, the good old wooden floor was replaced by a stone floor. So now there's a huge amount of planks in good merchantable quality and condition looking for a new owner. Can you find them a new home?
This set is especially well-suited to emphasize your urban road system.
A smaller species of tree, more adequate for domestic purposes. Still too large to fit in the living rooms of your residences. Best placed in the front yard.

A lovingly decorated Christmas tree. What else could spread the festive spirit more efficiently in your town? Place it at the center of your town to show all of the inhabitants that the yuletide has begun.
A blank guild membership certificate. Only expert eyes would expose this perfectly counterfeit document as an imitation.

Old, yellowed and tattered certificates for a guild membership. Fortunately, most of the letters have become illegible over all the years, so the high council will never notice if anyone inscribes another member or guild name.
A huge, magnificent and impressive mansion where the guild council board takes place.
This wheatfield is under a spell and planted so tightly that it is perfectly suited as a hiding place for Easter eggs.
A brand-new fish egg breeding ground: the eggs hatch when they come in contact with water.
Everyone knows that rabbit food is an aphrodisiac. This makes it ideal for increasing the population.
If you have a rabbit lucky charm in your workyard, nothing will break and no workers will be injured.
A great great great great great great grandfather of one of your settlers buried some wood to save it from bandits. The wood has turned into coal and you can recover it now.
This is the construction plan of a new experimental building which magically produces unlimited water. The inventor has been accused of witchery.
The best way to protect your flower beds from your neighbour's playing children are these small walls.
The best way to protect your flower beds from your neighbour's playing children are these small walls.
A wall without corners is like a house without a ceiling. These four corner segments will be the best friends of the lonesome straight walls behind your house.

A plea for help reaches your kingdom. Terrified citizens claim they have been repeatedly raided by a band of villains under the command of a strange woman. She calls herself “Wild Mary" and dares anyone to challenge her. The villagers are in desperate need of help.

A rich merchant seeks your help.
Some business partners have double-crossed him and now he wants revenge. They have set up camp in a nearby canyon.
Test Adventure
Test Adventure

Rumours tell of a mighty witch.
She lives in a poisonous swamp and is believed to have the ugliest face you can imagine, with warts all over her deformed nose and a laugh that will freeze your spine. Anyone who dares to journey into her realm is sure to earn fame and glory.

Loyal men they were, but greed turned them into ruthless bandits. The nobles have turned to you for help against these deserters. Be careful if you approach them since these traitors are heavily armed, battle hardened men.

It is a mark of troubled times when even captivity cannot stop wicked bandits from forming new groups of outlaws. Travellers tell of fearsome raids in the nearby forests. The local knights cannot deal with this hardened group alone and have requested your assistance. Send your men and make the roads safe again!

Rumour has it that a couple of dark priests are performing dark rituals. Very dark rituals. There have even been several cats reported missing recently. Understandably, your citizens are more than a little concerned about this. They have turned to you for help and are willing to give what they have in order to compensate you for your efforts.

A very concerned landlord has written a letter to you. One of his previously loyal master archers has turned rogue, living in the forest and stealing gold from rich merchants and nobles. With it, he bribes simple peasants into rioting. You have to stop this at once!
A mysterious rabbit in a dark alley is secretly selling Easter eggs. If you say the password "Easter" to him, you'll be able to buy some.

You have received a letter of challenge from a group called "The Sons Of The Veld". Obviously a new rider clan has emerged and is overconfident about its own strength. This challenge is an affront to your honour. You have to show these savages their place!

You have received a threatening letter containing the demands of a bunch of wild men that landed on the shore not long ago. Apparently, they are part of some kind of wild Nordic tribe that intends to go pillaging and plundering their way through the area. For the sake of your people's safety you should challenge this tribe. Drive them away and restore peace and order to your kingdom.

A claim of sovereignty has arrived at your castle. Hector the Black and his brother Barnabas demand a whole mountain range as their new territory. They have already secretly built black castles and recruited numerous men to defend them. What will you do? Allow this treason to happen? Or will you put an end to this claim once and for all?

More and more townsfolk are drawn to a mysterious order in the vicinity of your castle. After some investigation it turns out that a dark brotherhood is trying to undermine your regency. You cannot allow that to happen! Send your men to stop this foul corruption from spreading.

On a secluded island, a band of pirates has built its headquarters and is attacking helpless port cities and frightening inhabitants for hundreds of kilometers around. If you want to earn fame and glory, visit the island and banish the pirates and their crazy ship's cook.

The last time you went to battle with the witch of the swamp, you defeated her - but a Dark High Priest eluded your grasp. The priest retreated to an abandoned piece of land and performed a dark ritual to bring the witch back to life again. Now, the witch of the swamp is regenerating - and she's planning her revenge against you. Defeat her while she's weak!

You have received word of a mad alchemist who performs experiments on living human beings! He has hired an experienced troop of deadly mercenaries to protect him. You cannot allow this to happen in the vicinity of your realm! Send your troops and stop the madman!
A storm has hit your island and demolished some trees. The forester has collected the branches and given them to the local merchant.
A shady guy is selling a huge amount of marble in a side street of the market. Do not ask him where he got it from. There is talk that the nearby mason and his crew are missing some marble.

While working in one of your woods, a woodcutter has fallen into a hole and found a lot of coal in there. Now he's selling the coal for a small finder's reward and enough to offset his pain and suffering.
On an island next to yours a new settlement is going to be built. The settlers have to deforest the area and you can buy the resulting wood now.
A settler has overestimated the building materials needed for his residence and has a lot of hardwood planks left over. He'd like to sell them as quickly as possible.
A merchant from a far away country wants to sell you exotic wood planks. They are very rare and will allow you to construct high-quality buildings.
A diligent settler has cooked some sausages for your busy workers. In return, she asks only for a little money to pay for the source materials.
A group of bandits has raided a neighbouring village. Now the inhabitants want to come to your settlement, but you will need money to feed them.
A huge stone statue resembling a gargoyle pointing to the north. Weird...
A huge stone statue resembling a gargoyle pointing to the east. Only for statue fetishists…
A huge stone statue resembling a gargoyle pointing to the south. Perfect if you want to make you garden look special.
A huge stone statue resembling a gargoyle pointing to the west. Delivered polished. Includes base.

The Scouts have found a house hidden in the forest where they think the rogues Chuck, One-Eyed Bert and Metal Tooth are living. Travel to the dark part of the forest and check the rumour out. If you find the scoundrels there, catch them and bring them to justice.

The rider clans of the great veld have requested your assistance. Apparently, an evil shaman called "Roaring Bull" has claimed regency over the entire area. He and his fellow shamans command dark magic and fierce warriors. Nobody can stand against them. You will have to send your finest men in order to defeat them.

A spy report tells of a secluded castle in a large valley far to the east. Evidently, the knights there have got hold of some cannons. Those mighty weapons might prove very useful in the future, but the knights surely won't give them away freely. You may have to convince them with a little... manpower.
It is Halloween and the Grim Reaper is visiting you. He wants to make an offer: he will lead your army, and in turn only wants a few pumpkins... and your soul.
Everyone knows that pumpkins grow very well in cemeteries, so why not buy an eerily beautiful cemetery from your merchant?
Everyone knows that pumpkins grow very well in cemeteries. This small one can be built quickly and cheaply, but it will be a long time before you can harvest the first pumpkins.

Everyone knows that pumpkins grow very well in cemeteries. This cemetery is built with the most expensive and high quality materials. This means that pumpkins grow much faster there than in common cemeteries.
Some strange labourers want to work in your factories. They reek, and speaking is not their strong suit, but they work fast and need no sleep.

A certain Mr. Myers has offered to train your army. He is supposed to get top performance from recruits. You'll have to hire him soon though, as he says he'll only be in the neighbourhood for Halloween.
A forgotten culture constructed this building. No-one knows what purpose it serves. Rumours suggest that the overgrown ruin is haunted.
This wall hasn't kept out enemies for a very long time now, but it gives your island a rustic touch (and your bugs a new home).
This wall hasn't kept out enemies for a very long time now, but it gives your island a rustic touch (and your bugs a new home).
This orange vegetable with a cheeky grin can only be harvested once a year. Get it now before they all sell out!
A professor named Frank and Stein, famous for his creepy experiments, has found a way to refill almost empty marble deposits. Do you want to hire him?
This is where you'll find the dead settlers that didn't return from battle. If you look very closely, you can see their souls flying around the building.

A woman farmer has collected a basket of pumpkins, but when one of them started to talk and said that the basket was uncomfortable, the woman decided she'd rather sell the lot as soon as possible! Do you want to buy them?
A lazy settler, who doesn't want to build wheat fields anymore, has had a great idea. He'll build a silo which collects surplus grain, and use it to refill the wheat fields.

A group of the notorious Nords built their camp on a small island nearby. It seems as if they prepare an attack against you. They don’t know that their landing was noticed by you. Therefore it would be intelligent to attack them now.
This Christmas feast can be served very quickly in your Mayor's house and includes a lot of different dishes. You will see that many settlers will visit your city when they hear about the feast.
These very sweet cookies are made with a lot of sugar. If your workers eat some of them, they will have bags of energy and work much more effectively.

One of your settlers, calling himself a deviser, has developed a machine which can heat liquids swiftly and accelerate the process of fermentation. Unfortunately, he has not been able to test it, yet. Perhaps you could give it a try?
At Christmas, a Christmas tree is mandatory. This one here has not only a noble appearance, but also gets delivered with a full collection of decorative lights.
Some of your settlers' children are very talented at building snowmen. If you want a snowman in your city, you can give the children some presents and they will build one for you.
A huge package filled with presents. Could you imagine anything better?
A package including some presents. The perfect thing to bring joy to your beloved ones at Christmas.
A mysterious box, with unknown contents. A dark power seems to be floating around it. The people say that it could even be strong enough to create castles.
A mysterious box, with unknown contents. It smells like many different tasty things. The people say that it could enchant both people and animals.
This new building is really amazing. It can take leftover wood and rapidly process it into coal, essentially giving you an inexhaustible supply of coal.
This deck of titanium shines bright as the sun and would look very good in your storehouse.

A travelling tradesman visits your city. A little box catches your eye. It radiates pure cold. The merchant says that it is capable of creating a snowstorm.
Note: The merchant indicates that the snow storm can slow down travelling.
A mysterious box, with unknown inventory. While holding it you get the impulse to travel far away looking for adventures.

A plea for help reaches your kingdom. Terrified citizens claim they have been repeatedly raided by a band of villains under the command of a strange woman. She calls herself "Wild Mary" and dares everyone to challenge her. The villagers are in desperate need of help.

Victor The Vicious hails from a kingdom far away.
His skills in archery are unparalleled. Some say he shot an apple from the head of his own son! Unfortunately he has claimed the nearby hunting valley of a friendly regent for his own. The regent cannot accept such boldness, and has placed a bounty on Victor's head.

The people of the great veld seek your assistance.
One of the rider clans has started terrorizing the settlers in this region, taking their belongings and stealing their flocks. If no one helps them, they will have to leave their homeland. The local population doesn't possess much, but they are willing to offer their most precious heirloom to anyone who can drive the rider clan away.
A beautiful box containing luxury resource items. It is soft and its golden adornments sparkle in the sun. And it weighs an awful lot.
A huge box, containing common resource items. It is solid and looks inviting. Seems like a good deal.
You have got the coordinates for the first stage of the paper chase. Follow the instructions on the map. Note: The Easter adventures only give rewards when finished in context of the quests.

The coordinates for the second stage have arrived. Now the paper chase can continue. Take your basket and keep on collecting... Note: The Easter adventures only give rewards when finished in context of the quests.

The Easter bunny's brother has already left to hide the remaining Easter eggs. You decide to leave too, and visit the last paper chase island. Note: The Easter adventures only give rewards when finished in context of the quests.

You take a look at the map and immediately guess what the brother is about to ask you; to help collect the missing eggs. He promises to let you keep some of the eggs if you do. Note: The Easter adventures only give rewards when finished in context of the quests.

The map including the new coordinates lies on the desk waiting to be picked up. So, let's go to the next Easter egg search! Note: The Easter adventures only give rewards when finished in context of the quests.

No sweat. Now let's move on. According to the Easter bunny's brother, this is the last area where he lost Easter eggs. So, let's go! Note: The Easter adventures only give rewards when finished in context of the quests.

You got an exact description of the old man. It really seems like the Easter bunny's brother has hidden the eggs in the wrong area. So, the “Easter egg recovery” mission goes on. Note: The Easter adventures only give rewards when finished in context of the quests.

The Easter bunny's brother remembers the first island where he hid Easter eggs by mistake. He also remembers that he could not read his brother's handwriting, so he improvised... incorrectly. You should start a new search. Note: The Easter adventures only give rewards when finished in context of the quests.

Now it seems the end of the chase is really drawing near. You decide to be extraordinarily efficient this time. And with the help of the rabbit, what could possibly go wrong? Note: The Easter adventures only give rewards when finished in context of the quests.

A letter lies on your bed. You open it and see new coordinates for an island. Furthermore, you find an accompanying handwritten letter saying “Thank you for your help. Without you, Easter would have been a disaster. As a gift, we have hidden some more Easter eggs. Have fun searching." Note: The Easter adventures only give rewards when finished in context of the quests.
Just because you're looking for Easter eggs doesn't mean you can't find coal.
This explorer doesn't just look experienced, he really is. Fast as lightning, he finds treasure and can map all target areas. A must have for every explorer.

A small basket of stripy eggs, for those who'd rather not search for themselves.
Please be aware that your remaining eggs will be transformed to gold coins at the end of the Easter event.

A big basket of stripy eggs, for those who'd rather not search for themselves.
Please be aware that your remaining eggs will be transformed to gold coins at the end of the Easter event.
A huge statue of a crazy looking rabbid. Not only is it made of gold, it also makes a noise when you click on it. Awesome!
Allows the particularly busy master builder to issue more building orders simultaneously. Your build queue will be extended by one additional slot.
This general was in many battles and earned honour and fame. Due to his great experience, he is able to command bigger armies than all of his colleagues.

A magnificent, twinkling goblet with cryptic inscriptions on it, telling of triumphal victories and staggering defeats in the year of 2012. The mysterious monument exudes an aura of infectious euphoria and confidence. You find yourself wondering whether you'll get to keep it longer than four years.

The hordes of supporters that you have acquired throughout the championship require housing. Therefore, it might make sense to provide some quarters. Best inform the neighbours that it might get noisy these next few days.
The festive mood seems to have a peculiar effect on the reproductive behavior of your community. The frenzy of competition and victory seems to bring people closer together.
Not only do they promise high spirits and cheerfulness, they also raise the spirit of your settler's workday. This culinary Mexican wave ensures more hat-tricks in the workplace.

These hermit monks have perfected the art of brewing brew to a degree that is only possible due to their dedicated and sacrificial way of life. However, for the greater good of all settlers, they are happy to make the sacrifice.
Buy a sack of useful training materials in order to prepare your boys properly for this major event.
Buy a sack of useful training materials in order to prepare your boys properly for this major event.
Dress your island in the colours of the team you support. This flowerbed let's you nail your colours to the mast. Or ground. At the very worst you might still be able to make a nice wreath from it.
This match can only be repeated for test purposes.
This match can only be repeated for test purposes.
This match can only be repeated for test purposes.
This match can only be repeated for test purposes.
This match can only be repeated for test purposes.
This match can only be repeated for test purposes.

The defensive stance of your first opponent might suggest diffidence, and tempt the foolhardy general into carelessness. However, rest assured that these men, hardened by some fateful battles, have quite a few perfidious tricks up their sleeves, and their injuries may not be as serious as they make out.

They seem unpredictable and wayward, but it would not be advisable to underestimate them. Among them are some of the most experienced and well versed fighters, yet word is that their own trainers seem to struggle with their rigidity. It is even reported that in the face of defeat, some of them become inappropriately headstrong...

You are now facing veterans of this tournament, even if their historical feats are not always undisputed. These all-weather champions seem quick to battle and always ready for a jolly knees-up, but they can also quickly turn a battle in their favor without much of a plan.

One ought to be surprised how ruthless the men from these otherwise cultivated lands can act in battle. These valiant combatants used to win their battles with skill and finesse, proving to be formidable opponents. These days, it is said that when particularly challenged, they resort to combat techniques similar to those practiced in the east.

With almost mechanical routine these contestants have turned many a battle in their favor, often not exactly with tactical flair. It seems that only their predictability and confidence in victory could possibly be their undoing. Yet, they may have met their match with you. If you manage to bring them out of their shell, victory is already within reach.

How deceptively graceful these apparitions may appear when seen scurrying across the battlefield. These sinuous combatants might tempt the short-witted to underestimate their actual proficiency. But beware, your opponents are astute strategists that are up to every trick in the book. Many opponents have already fallen prey to their clever tactical scheming.
Dress your island in the colours of the team you support. This flowerbed let's you nail your colours to the mast. Or ground. At the very worst you might still be able to make a nice wreath from it.

Deep within the bowels of the earth, subjected to incredibly severe conditions, your men have amazingly discovered a gem lode. Only your most adept diggers are capable of unearthing these precious gems while risking their very lives.
Rumours of black magic and sinister curses have surrounded the Endless Mine for decades, until recently, when a resourceful and unflinching young business man decided to avail himself of the concept.
You are one of the most generous people in the settlers' universe, but your friends don't believe you are. Prove yourself with the Gems for friends!
Some of them look a bit old and thin. But as long as they can fight... Who cares?
If you need an urgent supply of well equipped units, these militia seem be perfect for you. Not particularly cheap, but reliable.
The frontlines can be such a busy place - good thing there are these supportive fellows. Alleviate a stressful workday by renting some helping iron-gloved hands.
The village school is filled with the best teachers who will teach the kids how to become the best settlers out there.

A tasty looking roasted duck cooked by the guild's chef himself!
You can give this amazing meal to your settlers, and they will work harder! You can also offer the meal to your friends!

Cooked using the secret recipe of Piero, the King's personal world famous chef, this steaming bowl of pasta will have your whole island begging for more!
You can give this amazing meal to your settlers, and they will work harder! You can also offer the meal to your friends!

Using a secret technique, this friendly scarecrow will help you with the harvest of wheatfields!
You can give this amazing scarecrow to your farmers! Also, you can offer the scarecrow to your friends too!
Some stones may contain chunks of marble, but only professional masons can spot them. And of course, they won't do it for free!

The pirates' island might be just a legend, but recently some wayfarers disappeared north of here, near Skull Cove. We're more than positive there are some nasty pirates hiding there! And we don't like pirates, no sir!
Good news! The guild was able to strike a deal with the Miner's Union! We can now hire a Jolly Geologist with our guild coins!

The home of an elite hunter who doesn't need a specific spot to hunt, but travels all around the island for game. He's known for his exceptional stealth and agility... some even say he used to be one of the royal archers before abandoning Capital Island to live a life of solitude, governed by his own rules and habits.
Opening this magical little bag from Santa Claus will summon a snowstorm that will cover your island with a blanket of snow!
Tired of the cold, snowy winter and long, dark nights? By using the exceptional Solar Flare, you can instantly melt all the snow away from your island, and bring back daylight!

The old astrologist has convinced our venerable King Damien that we are all doomed! A mysterious group of witch-doctors cast a terrible curse over the world a thousand years ago - but luckily, the old astrologist knows how we can escape the disaster. He's opened a gateway in time to take you back to the day the curse was cast. We need you to prevent this cataclysmic ritual from ever taking place!

During an archeological trip, one of our settlers found a brand new and rather special mining cart. The Miners Union decided to make some more and call them "Gold Fever". They're going to use the new carts so they can speed up the gold mining process.
You can give Gold Fever to your miners! You can also offer it to your friends!

The Miner's union has announced it has found a new way to mine stone. Using a special technique, stone is mined in cube shapes, resulting a better yield. They have decided to sell the technique to whomever wants to use it.

Since the settlers in the provision house cannot be sustained with fish platters or sandwiches, what is left? Correct! Chocolate! Give this chocolate rabbit to a settler in the provision house and you will increase motivation.
Always wanted a house by the sea? No space on your island anymore, and don't know what to do? We have the solution! Buy this house built on the water, and your worries will be forgotten.
Buy this adventure to search for Easter eggs. This adventure does not contain any rewards and can only be bought once!
Buy this adventure to search for Easter eggs. This adventure does not contain any rewards and can only be bought once!
