This general was in many battles and earned honour and fame. Due to his great experience, he is able to command bigger armies than all of his colleagues.
Your old friend the little tailor is in a bad way. The king has sent him on a very dangerous task where he can’t succeed alone. Maybe you can help him out?
A village is in need of your help. Their houses have been changing their appearance because of a dark magical influence. Will you help?
Dark ruins glowing mystically, changing the appearance of buildings. This is the problem these people have to deal with. They could really do with a hand.
This is a special buff that can change the appearance of one of your woodcutters, giving them a retro-style look.
This is a special buff that can change the appearance of one of your foresters, giving them a retro-style look.
This is a special buff that can change the appearance of one of your masons, giving them a retro-style look.
This is a special buff that can change the appearance of one of your wells, giving it a retro-style look.
This is a special buff that can change the appearance of one of your farms, giving it a retro-style look.
The Quartermaster General is an expert in logistics. Though not made for fighting, he can transport larger armies in a shorter amount of time than most of his colleagues.
Your settlers couldn't ask for more luxury and space. The Magnificent Residence provides enough room and convenience for a king and his entire court.
You can plant your magic beans in this Fairytale Castle where they will quickly grow into magic beanstalks.
Rumpelstiltskin has enchanted this tower so any settler can spin straw into pure gold here!
A good book can start with just a few rough scribbles on a napkin. To ensure your creatives always have said napkin on them, you should provide them with some Simple Paper.
Not all books turn out to be worth keeping. Sometimes it makes sense just to wipe the slate clean and start over. And frankly, did you ever finish that 1000-pager?
Finally the complaints of your scribes have been heard - here's some paper that doesn't irritate your palm when writing. In fact it's so comfortable that many have been found face down asleep on it.
For extensive writing exercises you will need a fair amount of these. Don't be stingy here - developed handwriting requires some effort. And remember to keep your wrist relaxed.
For all who want to produce serial pamphlets rather than fancy poetry books. No time for squiggly scrawling - here's how you can produce those piles of documents before tonight's deadline.

Of course nobody judges a book by its cover, but there's no denying that a nicely decorated book just looks so much more intellectual. This bag of ornaments will greatly help you make your eternal wisdom look even wiser.
This is a special buff that can change the appearance of one of your woodcutters, giving them a retro-style look.
This is a special buff that can change the appearance of one of your foresters, giving them a retro-style look.
This is a special buff that can change the appearance of one of your masons, giving them a retro-style look.
This is a special buff that can change the appearance of one of your wells, giving it a retro-style look.
This is a special buff that can change the appearance of one of your farms, giving it a retro-style look.
The high court of the royal palace is highly interested in magic beanstalks. They will even offer you these 5 additional building licences for your city.
Each day a small man offers some strange powder on the marketplace. He swears it has the power to put the sun to sleep.

Your friend, the little tailor once again needs your help.
The king you defeated regrets his sins and pledges to approve a marriage between his daughter and the tailor.
But a rival tailor claimed that he did all the hard work and therefore acquired the right for the princess' hand.
To prove his competitor wrong, the princess gave the little tailor a difficult task…

You received a messenger pigeon from your old friend, the little tailor.
He got divorced from the princess, because he realised that she can’t be the right one if she demands from him that he risks his life for no reason.
So he decided to take a journey to learn the wonders of this world.
But unfortunately he wandered too deep into a dark forest and is now stranded in a hermit’s hut. The forest around him is too dangerous to leave the hut alone, so he needs your help to get back home.
You received a letter from your friend, the little tailor. He told you that he has three sons and that he made a big mistake. He now wants to make up for this, but needs your help to do so.

Though the little tailor reconciled with his sons, new problems have arisen. A greedy inn-keeper stole the magical items his sons received from their masters. He once again needs your help to get them back.

A clever blacksmith has realised that what is good for hitting people could also be used for hammering iron. Surprisingly, he was not completely wrong! He has invented a hammer made of 1,000 Damascene swords, and this tool - despite being ridiculously heavy - is alleviating his work miraculously!

The Union of Left-handed Chimneysweepers has gathered noteworthy amounts of heating remnants from their clients' chimneys. Despite seeming somewhat dubious, the Union assures that this is common practice and in the client's best interest. They are now offering people the opportunity to buy coal in neatly pre-packed portions.
With this item you can add 1 day to your Premium time. Active Premium Time gives you multiple benefits. These will be granted as soon as the item is used from the star menu.
With this item you can add 3 days to your Premium time. Active Premium Time gives you multiple benefits. These will be granted as soon as the item is used from the star menu.
With this item you can add 7 days to your Premium time. Active Premium Time gives you multiple benefits. These will be granted as soon as the item is used from the star menu.
With this item you can add 30 days to your Premium time. Active Premium Time gives you multiple benefits. These will be granted as soon as the item is used from the star menu.
With this item you can add 180 days to your Premium time. Active Premium Time gives you multiple benefits. These will be granted as soon as the item is used from the star menu.
With this item you can add 360 days to your Premium time. Active Premium Time gives you multiple benefits. These will be granted as soon as the item is used from the star menu.
Fish platters can be given to workers in your friend's workyards, or your own. This increases production for a certain amount of time.
Can be given to workers in your friend's workyards, or your own. This increases production for a certain amount of time.
A yummy feast that can be given to workers in your friend's workyards, or your own. This increases production for a certain amount of time.
The Major General has seen many battles and is able to command armies of overwhelming size without sacrificing travel speed.
Diligent recruits are immediately ready for battle. They are not very strong but strong enough to keep the enemy busy for a while.
If you are searching for agile, immediate support look no more! These cavalry units are fast, cheap and immediately usable.
Agile and cheap is good but do you need ranged support? No problem! These bowmen are ready for battle and would be happy to fight for your cause.
You need to train many new units but you cannot stay in your barrack the whole time? Let your units make some overtime and they will be ready in no time.
These poor refugees need a place to stay and would be happy if you would give them a chance. Of course, they would agree to help you with your economy and your military in return.
A nice package full with sparkling Gems. Surely, you can make good use of them.
You are in desperate need of granite to upgrade buildings? No problem! Here is an attractive granite package to fill your gaps.
A package holding a good amount of saltpetre. But handle it with caution as there are chemical fluids inside!
You must recruit new units but you also have to produce new weapons? This package holds enough titan ore to produce some new weapons.
You are in need of additional exotic wood? This is your chance! Get some precious exotic wood just today!

You are close to the enemy boss but one camp is still standing in your way? Your units are defeated and your time is running out? Buy yourself a Small Catapult and simply destroy the camp holding you from winning the adventure.

You are close to the enemy boss but one camp is still standing in your way? Your units are defeated and your time is running out? The camp is too heavy for a Small Catapult? Try out the Big Catapult. With this improved version, even medium camps are no problem.

You are facing a camp which would be easy for you to defeat, if there wasn't for this particular unit standing in the way? No problem! With the Weak Point Potion you can easily move these types of obstacles out of your way.

These strong units with long range can be hired to fire once at an enemy camp. Indeed, you can not determine the exact unit type to shoot at, but in general the lesser units you have to fight against, the better, right?

You do not have enough left units to complete the adventure in time? You want to have some units on stock for an emergency case but you have no free settlers left? These stalwart soldiers would love to enter your service. Against a certain payment, of course!
Are you sick of the general stereotype? Do you prefer generals who own a certain energy? The Master of Martial Arts is not only a master in fighting, he also has his own visual style.

This Veteran is a legend among the generals. Not only is he able to command 220 units, but he can also fight! If you want a shiny hero for the battlefield, a soldier who can make a difference, this is your man!
With this pickaxe your settlers can mine gold ore more effectively than ever. Simply use it on the mine and be amazed how much gold ore one mine can have.

One of our traders just arrived back from Nearpole Island bearing bad news! He claims that the most feared Nords invaded the island and they brought a cold wind along! They came from the northern islands that were believed to be buried under the ice. We need to head to Windy Island and see what's happening!
Your iron ore mines are nearly empty and you need backup? With this pickaxe, your settlers can mine from a huge iron ore deposit.

We've had our share of weird people trying to do weird things but this is going a tad too far. There's this alchemist who somehow managed to create the "Cult of the Sleeping Flame". He actually got followers! And that's not all, here comes the best part : he wants to revive a sleeping volcano. Yes, you heard me. Flintrock island is basically on top of a sleeping volcano, and we must go there and save those people before the cult leader burns the whole island to ashes!

We have an urgent matter. Please, sit, there's much to tell. King Damien has an elite group of people called "The Unity". These people are the ones the King trusts and shares all his secret plans with and whatnot. One of the generals who was part of this special group retired some years ago, and the King gifted him an island. Yes, you heard me. The man got an island. Gregorid Skoln is his name, and he lives in honoured retirement on his island, Sleepy Reef, along with his wife and his most beloved daughter, Sabilyn. Sadly, Gregorid had some unfinished business before he left Capital Island, and that business has taken over his island. Some of the traitors stormed the island and are now holding Gregorid and his family hostage. I think this calls for a visit, am I right? Don't forget your sword.

Are you sitting down? This letter here came from pirates! And it's not a call for ransom or a new threat! They need our help! Yes, you heard me well! A group of veteran and retired pirates, who we defeated several times some years ago, are under attack by bandits. They say the bandits came and took over their island. Apparently, the bandits want to become pirates, so they're forcing the veterans to teach them about the pirate life. I'm so confused now... Should we help them? Yes? Well, let's buckle up then!

The remote mansion of Lord Scroogius is being besieged by two competing factions. Due to the lay of the land, a two-pronged assault will be required to break the siege in the little time they have left until their provisions run out. Hurry to help the lord and the reward will be well worth it!

The Pirates have entrenched themselves on this island with a complicated network of unbreakable stockades. Only proper teamwork and synchronized attacks will be able to unravel the island’s formidable fortifications.
A former cannoneer who even in retirement follows his passion for all things that go *boom*. He can help you gain building space by demolishing certain rock formations and smaller mountains.

His ancestors - although short-lived - have passed him down a great deal of knowledge about the art of wrecking stuff. As a professional he is able to blow up bigger mountains than his amateur competitors.

A crew of serious-looking gentlemen with an unsettling appetite for fire and destruction. These guys have the logistics and mental disorder in place to blow up even the largest mountain and create some much-needed building space on your island.

Dark Cultists have retrieved an ancient artefact and secluded it on their fortified island, where they perform unspeakable rituals in its name. Sail forth with your comrades and put an end to this abominable practice!
Both undisputable evidence of your prowess and a greatly improved production building, this truly magnificent structure is every player's desire.
An old treasure map we found hints at a great treasure, hidden on a small island. It seems to be linked to an ancient civilization. Set sail for this island and find the treasure!
Are your storehouses full to bursting point, and you've got nowhere to keep your resources? Then you probably need the Improved Storehouse. It provides three times the space of a normal storehouse.
This energy bar gives your specialists the power they need to achieve even the most difficult tasks in next to no time.

One of the scouts managed to track a Raider ship back to its homeport. His report indicates it's a thriving island governed, in true Raider tradition, by three chieftains. This seems to be as good a chance as any to give them a taste of their own medicine! Strike at their leaders and loot their supplies once they are defenceless!
Studying the cultists' wicked rituals has yielded some unexpected benefits. This carefully studied chant has proven to increase your epic worker's focus threefold.
Want to contribute more to the donation campaign? This basket full of red noses should do the trick.
Want to contribute more to the donation campaign? This basket full of red noses should do the trick.
With this Red Nose for your Avatar you can show your support for the good cause. Additionally we'll donate all the money we make from selling Red Noses to the Red Nose Campaign.

Magic Beans may have amazing properties, but they are still "beans"! When boiled, they turn into a liquid whose energizing properties extend beyond living beings and into inanimate objects. Using it on a huge building full of machinery, like the Epic Workyard, seems the smart thing to do.

As you adjourn to your chamber for the evening, you find a letter lying on your bed with no indication who it's from. Excited, you open it and read through the hastily written lines. It turns out the letter was written by Santa Claus himself! He explains that a grouch named "Croaker" has stolen all the presents and barricaded himself, together with some other bandits, on an island! It's up to you to get the presents back, and save the Christmas feast!
Tea revives the mind! Give this to your pupils and they will be fit for the hard life of a settler in no time.
The Croaker returned and stole Santa's beloved Sleigh. Help Santa to retrieve it and teach the Croaker a lesson.

Do you remember the man who did all those strange experiments some time ago? He was not amused that you destroyed his laboratory. Now, he's back - and he wants his revenge! Quick - stop his new experiments before they're finished!

You've received some new messages from your villagers, telling you there are once again some strange things happening in the woods where you defeated the bandits. The villagers have asked you to take a look and get to the bottom of this new mystery.

Architects from the far north have brought you this plan for a brand new mine. It's as effective as a normal level five iron mine, but with a chic arctic look. However, it collapses when the deposit is empty. So watch out!

A provision house is a must-have for any great monarch, but this is also true for your architects' latest invention: The Rarity Provision House. Not only does it offer rare recipes for buffs, but it's a nice looking building too.

It is a mark of troubled times when bandits join forces to form groups of outlaws. Travellers talk of an island shrouded in mist, where the bandits set sail and spread over the land. Send your men and see to it that this stronghold is destroyed!
This box has been washed up ashore. The weathered label on it lets you assume it comes from a place far, far away and may contain precious things...
A well-traveled architect, who has served under many kings, has made you an offer. He will embellish your island, but you have to trust his taste...
Finally! A building, which produces exotic wood. But beware! Unlike regular work yards, this building depletes after a while.
Finally! A building, which produces granite. But beware! Unlike regular work yards, this building depletes after a while.
A special box for a special day. Take a chance and make a special person happy!
Have you always wanted a way to refill your wheat fields more effectively? Then your wish just came true! This new silo refills your fields in the blink of an eye!
If you have trouble finding that elusive rare collectible that keeps popping-up on your island, some magical creatures can help make things easier.

Garrun the Trapper has decided to take upon himself to sabotage Easter. To accomplish this he has gathered a cohort of poachers, trappers and hounds and is holding many, if not all, of the Easter Bunnies captive on his camp on Egg Island. Set forth to destroy him and liberate the bunnies!
A well voiced speech that can make even the laziest of workers put his back into it.
This time limited mysterious box doesn't just give you one buff. It doesn't just give you two buffs. No, it gives you THREE whole buffs!!! Well, what are you waiting for?
A good choice when you're first finding your footing. Especially useful for constructing buildings, this contains all the resources you need for low tier buildings.
A good choice if you want to expand your empire with larger buildings. Contains all the resources you need for higher tier buildings.
A good choice if you want to boost your military with new units. Contains useful resources that can be used to train new units.
If you have trouble finding the elusive, rare collectibles that are hidden in far away lands, these magical creatures can offer their help.
A mysterious crate, which holds great treasures inside. However, you won't know what you've got until you open it!
Fire a volley of arrows at the enemy camp before attacking it. A number of random units in the camp will be defeated and removed.
Hire this assassin to remove a randomly chosen unit type from the camp completely.
Not only is this Explorer even faster than the Savage Scout - he's very lucky too. Choose him, and you'll find some extra buffs from time to time.
Grout is our masons' latest invention. It helps make our buildings' structure more solid, and allows us to upgrade them to higher levels.
This match can only be repeated for test purposes.
Dress your island in the colours of the team you support. This flowerbed let's you nail your colours to the mast. Or ground. At the very worst you might still be able to make a nice wreath from it.

A box containing useful resources for all football related topics. For example: shoulder pads, shoes or even footballs.
A box filled with fast, adventurous experiences. For the settler who doesn't have enough time or resources, but wants to keep up with the neighbours.
Delicious dates, which encourage everyone to do their very best work.
A very beautiful lantern, fit for Ramadan.
A nice, big collection of different deposit refills, including gold ore and universal refills.
A beautiful collection of all the collectibles you could ever wish for, including Adamantium Ore and Food Carts.

Normally our settlers bind the books, but with this glue our settlers can create books twice as fast. However, keep in mind that your settlers only have a limited amount of time to use the glue after opening before it dries up!
A special looking gold mine, with the properties of a level 6 gold mine. A must have for all gold farmers!
Basically a battle hardened general, but with a veeeery big... helmet!
A very nice general, who almost cares as much for the 220 units he can carry as he does for his looks.
A very beautiful red tree, which can be placed on the home zone to prettify it.
A very beautiful red tree, which can be placed on the home zone to prettify it.
A very beautiful red tree, which can be placed on the home zone to prettify it.
A buff which can help a defeated general to instantly recover. Guaranteed without side effects!
A box containing various adventures like "The Nords" or "Island of the Pirates", epic raids like the "The Heroic Little Tailor" or even co-operative ones like "Tomb Raiders".
The home of a passionate and nature loving fisherman who loves to fish, but does not want to endanger wild fish species. He's known for his boundless knowledge of how to breed fish in great numbers.
Mysteriously sparkling seeds, fallen from the moon. These can miraculously enrich any deposit to which they are applied. How is this possible, you ask? Well, even Alchemy can't explain everything.
A small island where you can learn the basics of how to fight for and gain a colony!
The expedition supplier can transport a large number of troops to a colony island. As he is a specialist in these kinds of risky trips to unknown islands, he cannot be used on normal adventures.
A Veteran Marshal has led armies to many victories. He can recover twice as quickly from defeat than a normal general, and can also bring more troops in to combat.
The expedition quartermaster can transport a lot of troops to an expedition island. As he's a specialist in these kinds of risky trips to unknown islands, he cannot be used on normal adventures.
Are your settlers tired of producing everything by hand? Give them some mechanical help by boosting the assembly lines of the armoury, and you'll increase production a lot.
Is your weapon production a bit too slow, even though you're using all the right materials? Give your productivity a boost with longer working hours in the combat armoury.
Need some more troops for your colony conquest? Start this enrolment campaign in the combat academy to increase motivation.

Do you have too many settlers signing up to join your army? Using these new training techniques in the combat academy will make them get through training faster.
Boot camp
A large Ranged camp meant to boost the defences of your claimed colonies. Can be placed when building up a colony's defences. Troops not included.
A large Melee camp meant to boost the defences of your claimed colonies. Can be placed when building up a colony's defences. Troops not included.
A large Cavalry camp to boost the defences of your claimed colonies. Can be placed when building up a colony's defences. Troops not included.
Legends say that the ancient Mayas left this buff for the one true hero, deemed worthy of carrying it. So, make good use of it!
This resin seems a bit gooey but don't let it fool you! It's every bit as effective as it is gooey!
Another marshal you can recruit, in addition to those in your tavern. You might be able to make use of the help.
A nice compilation of basic ores to speed up production.
A nice compilation of basic wood types to speed up production.
With this weapon production boost, your weapons will be finished in no time!
Give special orders to all settlers in a building to ignore all buffs that have been applied to that building.
Aunt Irma has prepared her special feast, so all settlers in a workyard will have enough power for a 24 hour shift.
Your settlers have acquired a special paper mill. With this, we can make higher quality paper by recycling ordinary ones.
There is a tradesman from a foreign kingdom that's rich in stone, but lacking in wood. He needs to build barrels for his trading house, and would like to exchange stone for some barrels.
One of your settlers has found out how to refill some of our marble deposits. He'd be willing to share this knowledge for some scarecrows and herbs...
A special glue which helps refine the production process of your book binder. With this glue, everything runs faster.
Give your weaponsmiths in the Combat Armoury a boost for their production by teaching them a special song from one of our colonies. They'll love it!
A nice small Christmas surprise package that contains one of a range of various buildings, including valuable ones like improved silos or the frozen manor.
A very mysterious egg containing a random item. From adventures to resources, anything is possible.
An experienced general, whose body is well and truly ready, after his experience in numerous battles.
A gutsy young man with high hopes. Travels faster than a regular marshal.
A brand new mini adventure. Do you dare have a go?
A brand new mini adventure. Do you dare have a go?
These pralines are delicious, and filled with all different kinds of chocolate. Almost anyone would work faster with these.
These stone cubes are special. They can be used on stone deposits to refill them. Awesome!
This chunk of black rock is more valuable than it looks.
Need loads of food? Then these food carts are for you!
With this extractor, it's easy as pie to extract iron ore from deposits.
A special scenario only available during Easter. Find out what happened to the mysterious Easter egg production farm.
This ultra-modern building is very efficient, and allows one single worker to extract all ore from the deposit in short time.
This ultra-modern building is very efficient, and allows one single worker to extract all ore from the deposit in short time.
Contains a minimum of 2 random strongholds. Has an additional chance of getting a random third fortified camp (lvl 2).
Contains a minimum of 3 random strongholds, with a chance of getting a mixed camp. Has an additional chance of getting a random fourth fortified camp (lvl 2).
This resource is accepted by a lot of traders. If you don’t have enough, this package can help you afford the goods you need.
This resource is accepted by a lot of traders. If you don’t have enough, this package can help you afford the goods you need.

Not far from here there lies Grain Island, a small island full of swaying, golden ears, which gave the island its name. On this small piece of land, there are two towns - one producing the most delicious brew in these spheres, the other baking the tastiest bread of all the known kingdoms. The guilds in both towns used to share the grain. They would meet in the Grain House - a place where they would negotiate and distribute it equally. But one day, the two guilds started arguing over which product would be the best, and to which guild the most grain should go. Since that day, there have been no more negotiations in the Grain house, as every guild just tries to get as much as they can. Maybe you can help the two guilds to re-enter negotiations, so our Settlers can feast on the Grain Island's famous exports again.
In a neighbouring city, two twins have gone missing without a trace. The poor kids! Maybe you can help find them?

There's an island, somewhere far from here, where all the infamous bad guys and their clans have been imprisoned. They live there under their own rules, but they're not allowed to leave. The island warden, Count Hackett, has written us a letter saying the clans have started a war between each other to try and win ownership of the island! We must go there quickly and calm them down in our own special way. Yes, that's right - we're going to do a little cleanup!

You wouldn't believe it! The Nords are back, and this time they mean business. They raided an island that produces gunpowder for the King's army, and they took more than one thousand barrels. It takes just one barrel to destroy a small village...imagine what they could do with that amount! If I understood correctly, they want to detonate the barrels, creating a tidal wave that would wipe out several neighbouring islands, including our own. We cannot let this happen! We need to travel to that abandoned island and take care of business!
Give your settlers a nice steak. This will increase their working morale.
They say that the intense blue colour of these flowers cheers up the people who walk by, and brings happiness to whoever you gift them to.
The fragrance of these violets keeps the nasty summer bugs away, so everyone wants them for their garden.

Help the villagers to rebuild their settlement after a serious storm in this challenging adventure.
Attention: you can fail this adventure.
Help King Schahri on his quest to find his lost wife Scheherazade.
Follow Scheherazade's trail with Ali Baba and hunt down the thief.
Follow the trails of the hidden treasure with Ali Baba.
Follow the trails of beautiful women, who are being held captive in a stronghold.
A Sector Deed. Legitimate and signed by a renowned notary. It allows you to claim a far away sector for your settlement.
Help Ali Baba follow the trail of the legendary Treasure of Knowledge.
Unveil the mystery surrounding the legendary Treasure of Wisdom.
Help Sinbad the Sailor save a city from a siege, while gathering leads for Scheherazade's location.
Follow a lead for Scheherazade's location, and help Aladdin find an ancient Oil Lamp.
Help Sinbad the Sailor find treasure hidden in an abandoned cave.
Follow leads pointing to Scheherazade's location with the help of your loyal friend Aladdin.

An island ownership deed. The king himself signed it for you, and wrote on the letter's foot: "I hope this deed provides you with the building space and deposits you need". Use it on an independent island to claim it for yourself.

A man in strange garments who calls himself Nash Williams has shown up in our lands. Madly babbling about the threat of some dark army, he offers to aid in the training of your troops. If you want, you'll have to hire him soon, because he'll be leaving to find some tome after Halloween.

The sinister nobleman introduces himself as Lord Dracul. Thirsty for... battle, he is willing to lead your troops. It seems he does not care for which side he fights; some pumpkins will be all it takes to bring him to you.
Young geologists are always looking for that big find, and sometimes miss the forest for the trees. Diligent experts know that checking twice often yields twice the gains.
Who would have guessed that the results of modern agricultural research would look more rural than before? This farm harvests wheat with incredible efficiency, yet exudes nostalgic charm.
A pink cherry tree imported from the far east. While usually associated with the transience of beauty, this particular specimen is in full blossom all year.
This pagoda, surrounded by flower beds, emanates a sense of tranquility. It makes you want to take a break and meditate.
This skillfully crafted topiary honours the courage of all the settlers who left their old lives behind to come to this island.
A grand lion statue cast in solid gold. The proud animal's majesty is sure to rub off on your island.
Your settlers can expose more granite using this hammer.
Your settlers have found a way to enrich the saltpetre deposits in the mountains. This technology is now available to you.
This pickaxe allows your settlers to access more rich titanium deposits.
Platinum is a very rare metal. It can only be obtained in an exotic area.
This unique wood is very robust. Perfectly suitable for building solid constructions that need to stand the test of time.

Our mice problem is getting worse every week... This leaves us with no choice but to engage in a bit of biological warfare! An expert has offered to share her knowledge on how we can attract enough cats to patrol at least a moderately-sized area.

Oh dear... It seems there were a lot of naughty children this year... St. Nicholas takes these things very seriously, and his companion, Krampus, has taken it upon himself to optimize coal production, to meet the season's demand for punishment gifts.

It's Santa himself! It may not be in his nature to fight, but he can transport your army around the world in the blink of an eye. He is known to make people wait between his random acts of kindness, though.

Whether by witchcraft or science, the engineer behind the watermill has managed to enhance his already impressive invention. It still generates water from nothing, but it does so a lot more efficiently than the original.

In an attempt to keep ancient customs alive, the wrinkled wisewoman offers to teach a ritual to appease the local forest spirits. Even if there were no such things, it's sure to boost the woodworkers' morale.
Ready-for-construction planks made of high-quality mahogany. Their durability and beauty make them perfect for any ambitious project.
Baskets full of reindeer food. With this many, we can easily populate the island with reindeers for a week.
This copper is sold as a heap of tiny pellets. It looks like the seller painstakingly picked it out of our mines' waste.
An overseas mining company is selling large amounts of iron ore. You've never heard of them before, but they appear to be professional and trustworthy.
A pirate crew wants to sell you a "treasure of gold". When you open one of the chests to reveal gold ore instead of the expected coins, they just shrug.
This supply of saltpetre was artificially created by distinguished alchemists. You have very high expectations for its purity, and the samples do not disappoint.
A sinister but grand castle. While it looks scary from the outside, future inhabitants will be surprised by the comfortable interior.
A glorious Arabian-style palace with both golden and colourful domes. Its many luxurious towers can house a small village's worth of settlers.
This elegant mansion is encased in eternal snow and ice, but no one knows why. It has plenty of room for settlers who don't mind the cold.
Two gargoyles loom over the entrance to this creepy tower. Perhaps one of its many inhabitants might actually be a proper witch!
A residence fashioned after a church-like place of ritual of a dark cult. The rough walls and peculiar colours give off an ominous vibe.
A replica of Sir Robin's castle. Unlike the morality of the original's lord, this keep's magnificence and firmness are unquestionable.

From tombs to temples, this explorer is always on the lookout for new adventures! She's already twice as fast as a regular explorer at any kind of task you give her, but if you send her on an adventure search, she will bring back twice as many rewards.
A refined and exotic baker that is willing to lend a hand to improve your bakeries with his methods.
It may not look like much, but on an island like this, it's hard to find large quantities of fresh water, yet easy to find plenty of uses for it.
Today's complete haul from a large fishing vessel. Who cares about fancy Lutetia when regional fish tastes twice as good - and only smells half as strong?
A lot of bakers put a lot of effort into making a lot of bread. They'd appreciate your patronage a lot, too.
An experienced butcher that produces sausages three times as fast as a regular butcher.
500 delicious sausages in one insanely long chain! Just think of all the buffs these could be used for!
Carts full of wheat, waiting to be made into the best brew and bread. They glisten golden in the sun.
A good dozen sacks of wheat flour. As fine and pure as it seems to be, you cannot wait to try whatever amazing bread your bakers will make from it!
A cook is selling cured meat from his storage. He has more than he can possibly put to use, and it'd be a shame to let quality ingredients go to waste...
The perfect weapons for new recruits. While useful in combat, these swords are designed to help their wielders adjust to the weight of a blade before transitioning to more powerful ones.
Basic swords, the likes of which are generally handed out to militia in times of need. They can be efficiently wielded with little to no training.
Standard-issue military swords. Forged from high-quality steel, these reliable blades will please every soldier trained in their use.
These swords are not made from ordinary titanium, but from titanium-based Damascus steel. Its tell-tale flowing patterns show both the sword's beauty, and its incredible durability and sharpness.

Considering the rarity of platinum, it comes as no surprise that only the best swords for the most elite swordsmen are forged from it. Their durability is outstanding, and a single sword will not blunt for a lifetime.
A rack of most-basic bows. While not exactly easy to use, inexperienced bowmen are advised to learn how to use these before moving up to a longbow.
These exquisite longbows outperform generic bows in both range and penetrating power. While archers need special training to properly use them, they are well worth the effort.
Crossbows are both powerful and easy to use compared to traditional bows. Being slow to reload however, crossbowmen still need to bring a lot of expertise with them, because every shot counts.

The arquebus is the pinnacle of ranged warfare! Almost like a hand-held cannon, its sheer power is immense. However, its high production cost and the unique training required to use and maintain it, limit its application to a select few elite marksmen.

These strong and swift horses are trained to endure the sights, sounds and smells of battle. Since they are not bread for endurance however, cavaliers rely on rotating multiple horses for training and battle.
Bred and trained for combat, these battle horses are more comrades than mounts. Platinum barding offers them additional protection to help riders form a lasting bond with their horses.
Defeat bandits and other evildoers with a bang! These cannons sure pack a punch. While they're unwieldy and slow, good cannoneers can wipe out entire armies with just a few shots.

Mortars may be short-ranged and slow, but the explosive power of their projectiles easily outclasses traditional cannons. Because they are somewhat awkward to handle owing to their high arcs of fire, expert besiegers are in high demand.
A colourful box containing a random buff or deposit refiller. A faint golden shimmer shines through the cracks.
Is your army lacking in the archery department? These bowmen will agree to help you out for a little while - for a little pay, of course.
Mercenary longbowmen available for hire! Consider contracting them if you want to dish out more damage in combat.
A rowdy bunch of mercenaries shares a hearty chuckle at the bows and longbows your troops are equipped with. They offer you a good deal on contracting some crossbowmen to demonstrate their power.
Trained cannoneer crews for hire. Their cannons are easily the most destructive weapons among standard troops.
You inspect a group of mercenary swordsmen. They look ordinary on first glance, but you quickly realize that they are trained and equipped exceptionally well.
These mercenaries already impress you by staying in the saddles of their ferocious looking horses. After watching them spar, you feel even more compelled to contract them for a while.
The mercenaries' armour glistens in the sun as does their horses' barding. They look almost invincible to you.
You can hear the sounds of the mercenaries' arquebuses before you can even see their encampment's training grounds. When you arrive, you find the targets riddled with holes.

While you watch these mounted marksman practice, you cannot help but wonder how well their horses must be trained to not shy from the loud noise. Indeed, as you watch on you confirm that that both riders and horses are at peak capacity.
These bold mercenaries brag about being adept both at taking out weak targets, and focusing down tough enemies. Will you contract them to see if they can back up their claims?

Does your army need more offensive power? These besiegers' mortars can demolish large targets or groups of enemies equally well. They are a little slow, however, so make sure to protect them until they are ready to fire.
This band of mercenary cavalry is well known for their swift attacks on unsuspecting targets. Hiring them may help you take down key opponents before they can retaliate.
These guys sure look tough! Better yet, despite being mercenaries, they will loyally protect your personal troops with their lives.
Do you need a lot of pinewood quickly? This large stash was intended as firewood for next winter, but the sheer quantity of it will allow you to use it for any purpose.
Lacking resources to construct or upgrade an important building? This bundle includes enough resources to construct almost any basic or intermediate building.
Are you ready to move on to more expensive building projects? This bundle includes plenty of important resources for advanced construction projects.
Only the best for your settlers! Our bakers and brewers prepared this pack for you - brew for your soldiers, and bread to make sandwiches for your workers.
A famous writer has come to your city to sign his latest book, "Chronicles of a Misunderstood Erudite". Fans from all around will surely come to this event!
A potion that is said to make you see the world through the eyes of a child. This sense of wonder may attract fantastic creatures whose existence you grew up to doubt.

Dress your island in the colours of your national team. This flowerbed lets you nail your colours to the mast. Or, rather, the ground. In the worst case you might still be able to make a nice wreath out of it

Dress your island in the colours of your national team. This flowerbed lets you nail your colours to the mast. Or, rather, the ground. In the worst case you might still be able to make a nice wreath out of it

You recognize the crest of a neighbouring kingdom.
He's frightened and malnourished.
For some reason holding it makes you feel uneasy.
Feeling underprepared for your tournament match? Use these resources to produce the missing tactical items.
Feeling underprepared for your tournament match? Use these resources to produce the missing tactical items.

Your settlers are really enjoying the tournament, and have asked if you could erect a permanent football pitch on the island. While we cannot realize a full-sized pitch at the moment, we can at least build a fun-sized footie pitch.
The natives of a small island need your help! They're being threatened by aggressors from the north.
A dragon has suddenly appeared and started terrorizing a chain of islands. Somebody must stop it!
The legendary Chupacabra has been spotted on an island to the west, where it is spreading madness among the natives. You have to put an end to it!

One of your informants has gone missing! He was tasked with keeping an eye on the dealings of a suspicious island town. They must have captured him because he discovered something they didn't want us to know! We must send out a rescue party!
We have located an island! It must be the one that houses the fabled City of Glory! But why is it teeming with bandits? And where is the city itself? Could the six altars hold the answers?

Pirates have robbed several of your allied kingdoms. We have identified the island at which their fleet is going to restock. If you can intercept them, you can teach them a lesson and return your allies' stolen goods.

A letter from King Damien arrived this morning. We are to travel to Skull Island and stop a bunch of young pirates finding a long lost treasure! I'll tell you more about it all when we arrive! Off we go to Skull Island!
A creepy fellow who knows how to serve with complete devotion. Your troops could probably learn a lot from him.

Be careful with this! One mishap may turn dozens of your settlers into zombies! They may be harmless, but they would surely scare away all the wildlife on our island. Just imagine how scary that would be!
The sticky and half-molten sweets serve as an inspiration to all smelters... or so they claim. They probably just have a sweet tooth.
He may have no head, but this man knows his way around his horses! While he's usually somewhat less than co-operative, he's actually surprisingly willing to help tend to our horses.
A clever hunter came up with a new trap design. Not only is it stronger, but it selectively catches only full-grown game, which is less damaging to the island's ecosystem.
Simulates the reward loot table from the Snow White venture.

The hunter that works out of this hut has perfected the use of traps and tricks, to become the most efficient hunter in the land. Nobody can rival him in terms of efficiency and speed. It seems your butchers will be busy while he's around!

Why wait for Halloween to have your island populated by pumpkin cemeteries? The ever-lasting elegance of pumpkin breeding can be enjoyed all year round with this replica of the building. Note: This building does not produce any pumpkins!
Prove to everyone that you bested the horrible creatures that threatened your island during Halloween! Nobody's afraid of golems when you're around!
An ancient board game... or perhaps it's something more? Legend has it that this board can be used to talk with the spirits, and bring them to you... Ages 6+, from 2 to 6 players!

Did your pumpkin cemetery run out? Don't worry! This fertilizer will bring it back to full health with 10 pumpkins, so it can continue its production. Just make sure it doesn't run out again! NOTE: This item only works on the ruins of a small pumpkin cemetery.

Did your pumpkin cemetery run out? Don't worry! This fertilizer will bring it back to full health with 10 pumpkins, so it can continue its production. Just make sure it doesn't run out again! NOTE: This item only works on the ruins of a common pumpkin cemetery.

Did your pumpkin cemetery run out? Don't worry! This fertilizer will bring it back to full health with 10 pumpkins, so it can continue its production. Just make sure it doesn't run out again! NOTE: This item only works on the ruins of a noble pumpkin cemetery.
I bought these buckets from a fellow named Jack. Take a close look - this is no ordinary paint. It's genuine frost! You could use it to make the whole island look like a mild winter's morning.
The original look for The Excelsior as it was chosen by Sonya Graham
A rustic look for The Excelsior to blend in perfectly with the island.
A fierce champion from the Lands of Anteria. Former Sergeant-at-Arms of the Crown Legion.
An astute champion from the Lands of Anteria. Former member of the Dune Tribe.
An auspicious champion from the Lands of Anteria. Former member of the Frostbeard Tribes.
A distressed woodcutter approaches you. He says that his wife convinced him to abandon his children in the woods, but he's now extremely worried about their safety. Will you help him find them?

A fisherman shares with you the story of how an enchanted flounder granted his wife her wish of becoming all-powerful. Perhaps too powerful. She's become blinded with power, and is now oppressing the land!

The Mayor of the town of Hamelin has contacted you to inform you that a piper has brought a plague of rats to his island. He cordially asks if you could help them deal with it, and promises a huge reward if you do.

The latest reports on the whereabouts of the Evil Queen point to a remote island. The only apparent sign of civilization is a lonely hut in the middle of the island. You decide to investigate a bit further.

You receive a letter from a young maid called Snow White, stating that her evil stepmother, the queen, has had her hunted down just because she's the prettier one. You follow the lead in hopes of finding a clue as to Ilsebille's whereabouts.
A Halloween themed skin for The Excelsior to make it look a bit more spooky
This is the construction plan for a new, experimental building, which magically produces unlimited water. The inventor is being accused of witchcraft.
The village school is filled with the very best teachers, who'll teach the kids how to become fine settlers.

Whether by witchcraft or science, the engineer behind the watermill has managed to enhance his already impressive invention. It still generates water from nothing, but is even more efficient than the original.
A lazy settler, who doesn't want to build wheat fields anymore, has had a great idea. He'll build a silo, which collects surplus grain and uses it to refill the wheat fields.

The home of a passionate and nature-loving fisherman who loves to fish, but takes great care not to over-fish the wild stocks. He's known for his great knowledge of how to breed fish in large numbers.
This new building is really amazing. Here, wood leftovers can rapidly be processed into coal, giving you an inexhaustible coal supply.

Are your storehouses full to bursting point? Are you struggling to find somewhere to put all your resources? Then you probably need the improved storehouse! It provides three times the space of a normal storehouse.
A large residence, offering all the comfort and luxury a noble expects. Furthermore, this residence is very spacious, so a lot of people can live here.
Ten blank building licenses, direct from the high court of the royal palace. These will allow you to construct even more buildings in your marvelous city.

Mills are nice, but isn't there always room for improvement? Our engineers thought so, and devised a much more efficient design that allows it to produce flour much more quickly. They say took years of research, but really they just strapped more donkeys to the wheel.
Because there can never be enough greenery on your island, here's a pack of three trees to decorate it. Why not try out some different combinations, and see where they look best!

A very thorough explorer, devoted to searching every corner of the world for treasure. She is faster than regular explorers, and will bring twice as many rewards when sent on any kind of treasure search.

A claim of sovereignty has arrived at your castle. Hector the Black and his brother Barnabas are demanding a whole mountain range be granted to them as their new territory. They have already secretly built black castles across the mountains, and recruited numerous men to defend them. What will you do? Allow this treason to happen? Or will you put an end to this claim once and for all?

Someone stole all the colours.
The order of The Black Knights is recruiting. Help them conquer the world.
Here's a nice decoration - a topiary shaped by a master gardener to resemble the Easter Bunny. Or at least, how he imagines the Easter Bunny would look (since nobody has ever seen him).
Have you always wanted a way to refill your wheat fields more effectively? Then your wish just came true! This new silo refills your fields in the blink of an eye!

A claim of sovereignty has arrived at your castle. Hector the Black and his brother Barnabas are demanding a whole mountain range be granted to them as their new territory. They have already secretly built black castles across the mountains, and recruited numerous men to defend them. What will you do? Allow this treason to happen? Or will you put an end to this claim once and for all?
With this item you can add 1 day to your premium time. Active premium time gives you multiple benefits. These benefits will be granted as soon as the item is used in the star menu.
Open the Mystery Box to receive a reward

In a mountain on a nearby island, a valuable ore vein has been found. You have been asked to help with the construction of a mining outpost, and to provide it with security. You'll receive a large reward for your help.

A pigeon landed this morning, bringing news from your good friend Lord Walder the Bold. Or is it bald? Either way, he requested your attention regarding a small problem. His people live on an island that's ruled by a fierce pirate leader, but they get along well. Neither hurts the other, and peace fills the air. Then two weeks ago, an unknown bandit gang appeared from the badlands, and they seem to want to take the island for themselves. Lord Walder needs your help! I say we rally some of our military forces and pay them a visit!
This leather collar looks very expensive. It appears someone has attached a message to it?
An island has been plunged into darkness, and shrouded in eternal mist due to some sort of curse. Could the ghost musicians that Sonya claims to have met be the cause of it?

A blacksmith has come up with a more durable design for horseshoes. While it will require valuable platinum, I'm sure your generals will appreciate the new, sturdier design on their more challenging adventures.

Are your plain old bakeries struggling to keep up with your sandwich consumption? Well fear not, as science has the answer to this terrible problem! This bakery is equipped with optimized ovens and extra-precise hourglasses.
Adults need their toys too! This mechanical box includes one or two state-of-the art improved buildings. Who says science has no place in the festivities?

The rangers of a nearby town are calling for aid. A strange sickness has fallen upon the trees near their settlement. They've done all they can, but it seems to be spreading into the forest, and even to the local wildlife. If we help them out, perhaps we can find the cause of this strange plight.

Sonya has heard a rumour about a legendary Mountain Clan, who she believes may be the only ones who can help us with our current mountain difficulty. With little in the way of other options, we probably don't have a choice but to set out on this epic venture, chasing a myth of an old Clan of Nords. Will we actually find the help we seek, or is it all nothing more than a legend? There's only one way to find out...
Mary, Santa's wife, has grown bored of sitting around at the North Pole all year. She promises to bake you some cookies if you let her beat up some bad guys.
These bold mercenaries brag about being adept both at taking out weak targets, and focusing down tough enemies. Will you contract them to see if they can back up their claims?

Does your army need more offensive power? These besiegers' mortars can demolish large targets or groups of enemies equally well. They are a little slow, however, so make sure to protect them until they are ready to fire.
Some of them look a bit old and thin. But as long as they can fight... Who cares?
The frontlines can be such a busy place - good thing there are these supportive fellows. Alleviate a stressful workday by renting some helping iron-gloved hands.
If you need an urgent supply of well equipped units, these militia seem be perfect for you. Not particularly cheap, but reliable.
These guys sure look tough! Better yet, despite being mercenaries, they will loyally protect your personal troops with their lives.
Is your army lacking in the archery department? These bowmen will agree to help you out for a little while - for a little pay, of course.
Mercenary longbowmen available for hire! Consider contracting them if you want to dish out more damage in combat.
A rowdy bunch of mercenaries shares a hearty chuckle at the bows and longbows your troops are equipped with. They offer you a good deal on contracting some crossbowmen to demonstrate their power.
This band of mercenary cavalry is well known for their swift attacks on unsuspecting targets. Hiring them may help you take down key opponents before they can retaliate.
Trained cannoneer crews for hire. Their cannons are easily the most destructive weapons among standard troops.
You inspect a group of mercenary swordsmen. They look ordinary on first glance, but you quickly realize that they are trained and equipped exceptionally well.
These mercenaries already impress you by staying in the saddles of their ferocious looking horses. After watching them spar, you feel even more compelled to contract them for a while.
The mercenaries' armour glistens in the sun as does their horses' barding. They look almost invincible to you.
You can hear the sounds of the mercenaries' arquebuses before you can even see their encampment's training grounds. When you arrive, you find the targets riddled with holes.

While you watch these mounted marksman practice, you cannot help but wonder how well their horses must be trained to not shy from the loud noise. Indeed, as you watch on you confirm that that both riders and horses are at peak capacity.

These horseshoes are made of dark glass, but they're at least as hard as steel somehow! Have you ever seen anything like it? I got these crates from a Nord merchant, but even she couldn't explain where it came from.

The search for the Mountain Clan leads you deep into the mountains. Canyons and harsh weather, along with many junctions and hidden paths, await you on your quest to reveal the secrets behind the legends.

We got lucky and secured a huge haul of omniseeds! It is said that these rare, magical seeds have fallen from the moon. You'd think with the amount we've found we could figure out why they work on all kinds of deposits, but it still remains a mystery.
A pretty park that celebrates the beauty of spring. A perfect place for holding seasonal festivals!
An epochal enemy reigns high in the mountains, and has caused havoc for many decades. There are several paths to victory against this evil - but which will you choose?
Some gems to help you make smoother progress while testing on the test environment.
Simulates the reward loot table of the "At the Foot of the Mountain" venture.
A young boy was playing on the beach and found a very beautiful stone. But what kind of stone is it? And is it valuable?

Have you heard about the tradition of egg rolling? It's a game that children play all over the world at Easter time. It's a little silly, but our military instructors have found it to make excellent and engaging training for your troops!
This talisman is said to be enchanted. Bury it in the ground and you'll be rewarded with a week of sunshine - or so the legend claims...

Far up in the mountains lies the rumored domain of the Mountain Clan. Few have heard the stories about the Mountain Clan, and no one who lives has actually seen one of their tribe members. Be the first to discover their domain, and find out the truth behind the legends.
These horseshoes are forged out of star dust, and improve the walking speed of your generals.

The last time you met the crazy ship’s cook, you defeated him and his crew and banished them from the island. After that defeat, the crazy ship’s cook went back to his parent’s house. Now his mother is watching over him. If you want to finish him off, you'll have to take on his mother first.
This fellow showed up here, determined to become the best geologist ever. He's practiced his entire life, and has developed a knack for finding bountiful iron deposits.
The deer population is shrinking! You'll need to figure out what's causing it, and find some way of restoring the natural balance. Find the source of the problem, and help the deers to recover.
Just as you start your journey north, the weather suddenly worsens. There is no way to move forward in this storm. You'll have to find a way to brave this harsh environment somehow.
Simulates the reward loot table of the "Unknown Regions" venture
Simulates the reward loot table of the "Mountain Labyrinth" venture
Celebrate like the Nords. A festival hall to start various zone wide effects.
A smokery in the style of the Nords. Smokes fish to produce a tasty buff.
A young girl was playing in the forest and found a little, wounded puppy. Help her nurse the puppy back to health!
The experience of long, hard fights against the Jötnar will help your workers boost their productivity.
I'll be honest with you - this man scares me a bit. His single-mindedness towards geology makes him appear almost mechanical. But you can't argue with results.
The Friar's Lantern has already misled a lot of travelers. Be careful!
The tundra is one of the most beautiful, and most dangerous areas.
The sun will shine upon your island, and play tricks upon your mind.
Let your troops participate in harsh environmental training with the mountain clan.
A classic residence of the nords.

Dress your island in the colours of the team you support! This flowerbed lets you nail your colours to the mast. Or, rather, the ground. Even if your team doesn't win, at least the flowers might make for a nice wreath.

Dress your island in the colours of the team you support! This flowerbed lets you nail your colours to the mast. Or, rather, the ground. Even if your team doesn't win, at least the flowers might make for a nice wreath.

Dress your island in the colours of the team you support! This flowerbed lets you nail your colours to the mast. Or, rather, the ground. Even if your team doesn't win, at least the flowers might make for a nice wreath.
