Do your Settlers enjoy stadium snacks? Why not build a snack stand so you can produce snacks, or a selection of other buffs yourself! Unfortunately, they aren't very filling, so you'll need a lot of snacks to satisfy a whole workyard!
Simulates the reward loot table of "The Siege" adventure
Simulates the reward loot table of the "Buccaneer Roundup" adventure
Simulates the reward loot table of the "Lakeside Treasure" adventure
Simulates the reward loot table of the "Raiding The Raiders" adventure
Simulates the reward loot table of the "Tomb Raiders" adventure
Simulates the reward loot table of the "Whirlwind" adventure
This is a special buff which lets you change the appearance of one of your woodcutters, giving them a retro-style look.
This is a special buff which lets you change the appearance of one of your masons, giving them a retro-style look.
This is a special buff which lets you change the appearance of one of your wells, giving it a retro-style look.
This is a special buff which lets you change the appearance of one of your farms, giving it a retro-style look.
This is a special buff which lets you change the appearance of one of your foresters, giving them a retro-style look.
How many of your troops will it take to deal with that monster? None! One shot from this oversized weapon is enough to take out even the biggest threat. Better make the shot count!
Bored by golden sparkles everywhere? This will make your home island shine in all sorts of colours! While this zone-wide buff is active, buffed buildings shoot fireworks instead of sparkling.

Need a few more balloons to get that reward? Looking for a way to help everyone achieve that worldwide event objective? This pack of balloons might be just what you're looking for.
Just remember - they'll disappear when the event is over!

If you're looking to make a large balloon contribution, but you don't have the time or resources, have I got an offer for you!
Keep in mind that all balloons will disappear when the event is over!
This Barracks expansion lets you train your troops even faster.
This Elite Barracks expansion lets you train your troops even faster.

Have you ever used a "Skin Change" buff on one of your buildings, but later came to regret it? There's no need to demolish and rebuild! Don't you know it's just an illusion? I know a hermit who will gladly teach you to see straight through these falsehoods!
We want to test stuff here - can't just leave you at level 1 for that, can we? Gain however many levels you deem necessary.
If you need a higher PvP level to properly test things, be our guest!

Need some candles to put on your Birthday Cakes? This event resource can usually only be found by players of level 51 and above. Combine with Cake Dough in the provision house to make Birthday Cakes that buff your Festival Hall.

Instant cake dough for Birthday Cakes! This event resource can usually only be found by players below level 51. Combine with Candles in the provision house to make Birthday Cakes that buff your Festival Hall.
This building comes with a cadre of scouts. They'll evaluate the situation on any adventures you start, to ensure you get the most out of them.
The Settlers Headquarters, based on the old design from The Settlers 2
We want to test stuff here - can't just leave you at level 1 for that now, can we? The same as the other item, just 10x.

Ah, I see you're looking at these mansion blueprints. You've got a fine eye! But I must warn you - there may be something otherworldly in those angles and lines! Every time someone follows these plans, the house appears to draw in dozens of ghosts in an instant.
A most curious building. I have never seen anything like it before. It comes with piles of arcane equipment that, I've been assured, can transform one resource into another in the hands of an expert.

I don't know what to make of this man! It's obvious that he's some sort of genius, but he seems to have trouble making anything useful. That may be because most of his ideas revolve around explosions... Still, he's looking for work, and you look like you could use more explosions in your army. What do you say?
Many famous bakers were needed to get this cake done. It is a must have for any celebration in the Festival Hall.
A rustic look for The Excelsior, to blend in perfectly with the island.
A Halloween themed skin for The Excelsior, to make it look a bit more spooky.
A medic who was promoted to the rank of general. He cares deeply about his troops, and uses his medical skills to patch them up after battle.
Sweets from Oriental lands in the south. They're sure to boost the productivity of your provisioners.
No-one knows where it comes from - but it certainly boosts productivity!
Used to train your specialists' bronze skills.
Used to train your specialists' silver skills.
Used to train your specialists' gold skills.
Increases the population limit.
Increases the population limit.
Increases the population limit.
Increases the population limit.
Increases the population limit.
Increases the population limit.
A robust tower providing living space for your settlers
Increases the population limit. Functions as store house entry for production buildings.
These are no ordinary pets. When their owners lend them some of their power, they become very inciting...
A geologist who specializes in finding copper.
Increases the population limit.
Increases the population limit.
Increases the population limit.
This geologist is the generalist under all other geologists.
Luxury apartments AT the sea are a thing of the past. Living luxuriously ON the sea is the flavor of the month!
Why limit the Christmas spirit to a few weeks per year, when you can have it whenever you like? Just hold a Christmas Market and all nearby Settlers will be imbued with the holiday spirit.
Transforms a Residence into a beautiful, small Christmas variation.
Transforms a Residence into a sophisticated Christmas variation.
Transforms a Residence into a fancy Christmas variation.
Transforms a Residence into a beautiful, small Christmas variation.
Transforms a Residence into a sophisticated Christmas variation.
Transforms a Residence into a fancy Christmas variation.
Transforms an Improved Floating Residence into a tranquil winterly variation.
Transforms an Improved Floating Residence into a tranquil winterly variation.
When looking into his eyes, you can clearly see his candor.
Sometimes, plain white paper just isn't enough. To write beautiful greeting cards to your grandmother and all your settling friends, advanced paper is the best choice.
Tired of rebuilding coal mines? Get the "Endless Coal Mine"!

A beautiful, yet small island, whose population is a bit eccentric. They've asked you for help against the bandits that have been giving them a hard time. Help them, so you can return the coin that was stolen from them, and remove the curse surrounding their otherwise peaceful island.
The most beautiful, and also the most useful Christmas Tree you'll ever have. Soak up the Christmas spirit, and receive a random gift every 7 days.
Santa's let you in on his secret for storing huge amounts of resources.

Every now and then, a group of muscular Smelters decide to pose for a calendar for charity. To get into shape for the event, all the smelters in the area, and all the workers in the epic forge work extra hard.
Changes your Mayor's House into a playful Christmas variant.
Changes your Mayor's House into a playful Christmas variant.
Changes your Mayor's House into a noble red variant.
Changes your Mayor's House into a noble red variant.
Changes your Mayor's House into a noble blue variant.
Changes your Mayor's House into a noble blue variant.
A beautiful bench, perfect for winter. Sit down and cuddle on it with a cocoa or a hot lemon tea.
Bring Christmas to every corner of your island with this tranquil Christmas Hut.
This sweet little lantern will let the Christmas Spirit shine across your island.
A must have for all Christmas Fans, and a tribute to nut enthusiasts everywhere.
Nothing says Christmas more than a big bunch of neatly packed Christmas presents.
A traditional Christmas decoration, with its roots in the folklore of the Ore Mountains.
A production building for Valentine Flowers.
Any complaints about taste regarding this building are in vain. This is by far the tastiest residence you can get!
A package of beautiful flowers, which can be traded in for unique items during the Valentine's Event.
A package of beautiful flowers, which can be traded in for unique items during the Valentine's Event.
Fill your town with love! While this buff is active, any buffs will create lovely hearts instead of sparkles.
A fertilizer for your flower farms, if they need to be revived.
A decorative version of the Flower Farm.
A pavilion, where your settlers can meet and be together.
The patron of love, reminding your settlers of the most valuable thing in the world.
What a lovely shape for a tree.
Some people say throwing flower petals into the fountain will grant a wish.
Every town could use some more vegetation...
Settlers can relax on this bench, and pass the time.
The shape of this flower bed is really unique.
Proper mood for celebration.
An intelligence gathering building that crafts star charts.
Information about how to add more detail to your star charts.
The best you can find, when it comes to creating star charts.
Her kind voice helps her gather information about the largest treasures.
His handsome looks help him gather information about easy to mine deposits.
A special public building that buffs residencies in an area around it. The more residencies you buff, the stronger the effect is. It can even trigger quest lines with buff rewards.
Changes a Christmas Market to a normal market.
Changes a Christmas Market to a normal market.
Only the wisest and bravest dare to start an adventure in the challenging weather conditions evoked by sprinkling secret powders in the air.
By finding a vein of gold that runs so deep it'll last for several generations, the mine will appear all but endless. Just don´t let the gold fever get a grip on you!

With a special technique, iron ore can be extracted from all kinds of rocks. It took years to develop the method, and it's rumored that a certain alchemist involved in the research even went mad during the process. Still, it's hard to deny the result is remarkable!

Ghosts of deceased settlers and soldiers keep appearing after you defeat their nemeses, freeing them of their earthly burdens. But instead of haunting the living, it turns out these are actually very friendly spirits, who want to help you in your efforts to conquer the evildoers. As they're spirits, they can't fight your battles for you - but they can help you produce bronze really quickly! Nobody really knows how the ghosts do it - so just imagine how hard it was for Sonya to convince everybody else that this would work out!
People crazy in love will do everything better if they can infuse their love into it.
Hugs & kisses are reminders for every soldier that there's always someone waiting for them.

Sonya, Anslem and the Mad Scientist met for an amicable drink to reminisce about their past adventures: of the giant plants and scary dragons they've slain; of the foreign countries they´ve travelled; and the magnificent structures they´ve seen. Suddenly, Sonya challenged the Mad Scientist to come up with something more wondrous and spectacular than anything they've ever seen - and she bet he couldn´t without ending up blowing it up. However, the very next day, the Mad Scientist visited Sonya holding some crumpled sheets of paper - paper which was covered in some scribbles that looked suspiciously like a construction plan...
A courageous Cossack from the Lands of the East. A graduate of the Imperial Academy.
A geologist with a heart of gold. It seems as if the gods want to reward her kindness and hard-working nature.
A house in a tree is like a dream come true.
Growing up as a princess taught her diplomatic skills, and gave her the charisma to always get that little extra.
For those who believe the letter to be mightier than the sword, the improved lettersmith will fulfill their every need.
Fire a volley of flaming arrows at the enemy camp before attacking it. A defined amount of random units in the camp will be defeated and removed.

A geologist with a penchant for soccer and archeology. As he enjoys more than just looking for resources, he also has a chance of finding great treasures on certain searches deep underground. He's also twice as fast as standard geologists.
Eager to go on her next adventure, her pace is unrivaled.
Need some more space? Build this beauty of a tower between your other buildings to free up some building space and store more goods at the same time!

If you ever want to show a friend you care, you could send them flowers... Or, if you really care, you could send them this amazing buff! They'll definitely appreciate you for it. Don't believe us? Check out the effects your friend will be able to enjoy below!
A redecorated version of the Wondrous Residence. A must for all summer enthusiasts and soccer fans. Instead of tokens, this variant will require soccer balls to upgrade.

If you ever want to show a friend how much you care, send them flowers. Or, if you REALLY care, you can send them this amazing buff! They'll definitely appreciate you for it. Don't believe us? Check out the effects your friend will be able to enjoy below!
A must-have for every settler. Worth 3 times its gem value! Check out the glorious content!

After years of continuous work on refining his most successful creation, the inventor of the watermill and the improved watermill has surpassed himself with this magnificent beacon of water production.

A message bound to the foot of a dove revealed a call for help from faraway lands. For a decade, all kinds of evil foes have swarmed into the small town of Kalijenorod all year long. The declining population cannot explain why this is happening, and are unable to defend themselves any longer. Though the invaders do not attack the people directly, the townsfolk are no longer able to live a peaceful life. Will you help them drive out the evildoers?
Friendly, brave and very decisive, she doesn't waste time, and is eager to make every treasure search worth every second.
Festively redecorated, this wondrous residence shines with a new light to celebrate all settlers. The fact it doesn't require any special resources to upgrade it is a gift in itself.
A bundle to celebrate the jubilee! 3x buildings, 3x specialists and over 50 buffs! Worth more than 3 times its gem value! Don't miss out on this amazing time-limited offer!
With Teutonic thoroughness, every last bit of useful resources is found. But this takes takes time.
Settlers from the continent had to flee to the far-away Tavos archipelago to start a new life there. But they need more settlers to assist them on their epic journey.
Gives your Mayor's House the nostalgic look of a level 1 Mayor's House.
Gives your Mayor's House the nostalgic look of a level 1 Mayor's House.
Gives your Mayor's House the nostalgic look of a level 2 Mayor's House.
Gives your Mayor's House the nostalgic look of a level 2 Mayor's House.
Changes your Mayor's House into a sinister looking variant. Only for true villains!
Changes your Mayor's House into a sinister looking variant. Only for true villains!
Need help during ventures, or just need a general capable of leading a huge army? Don't get fooled by this one's friendly appearance - recruit him while you can!
A small but powerful time-limited bundle with a great discount, only available during the anniversary. Check out the cool content below!

Treat yourself with this delicious little package to make your settling life a bit easier. It won't hurt if you spoil yourself a little bit with this tasty, time-limited delicacy. Where else do you get a delicacy that costs 3x less than the ingredients normally would? Yum!

Are your specialists trained the way they should be? Do you need more books to tell your explorers what to look for during searches? Do your generals need some more tricks up their sleeves? Get more adventure bookbinders, and speed up book production with each additional building.

Pirates have robbed several of your allied kingdoms. We have identified the island at which their fleet is going to restock. If you can intercept them, you can teach them a lesson, and return your allies' stolen goods.
The legendary Chupacabra has been spotted on an island to the west, where it is spreading madness among the natives. You have to put a stop to it!

Once so lovely, something strange happened to this explorer. After an adventure to a certain island, the lady returned feeling a bit unusual, and without any memory of what exactly it was that she'd been doing. Now, she feels stronger than ever, with a distinct power of persuasion.

Never look down on the baby of the family. Despite looking much like his brother, the Younger Gemini General doesn't draw his strength from a huge army. Instead, he relies mostly on himself, and only takes a handful of units with him to guard his back. One can only speculate as to where his strength comes from, but his reddish skin suggests something supernatural.
An eerily awesome package for new starters, or those who want to boost their effectiveness during the event.

A cart of pumpkins seemingly started to move on its own. Only when looking closely could you see that the pumpkins themselves were pushing the cart. At least, until a farmer caught them and made them available for sale. A small fence around the cart suffices to keep them in place.

A lantern containing tiny swirling ghosts. Somehow looking like luxury housing for the dearly departed, the lantern seems to be from another realm of existence. It's not clear how the merchant got his hands on this item - it just appeared, available for sale.
A supernatural general accompanied by two cunning explorers? What more could you want! And don't forget the 30 days premium time.

For a decade, all kinds of evil foes have swarmed into the small town of Kalijenorod all year round. The colder it gets, the nastier the enemies become. Even during fall, you can see the immense threat to the people. It's unthinkable that children still live there, and families refuse to leave their home. The onslaught seems to be connected to the disruption that took place a decade ago. But what is behind this bane?
Driven by the desire to save her loved one, this general became as tough as tin and as fast as a fish.

"You don't have to go far to find happiness" could be the motto of this explorer. For him, there's no need to travel to distant shores, or with extraordinary speed. Appreciating the small things, he excels at short and medium treasure searches.

Ever fancied living a secluded and peaceful life on the water, yet still being close to land? This small river house has got you covered! Although it might get cramped if you invite too many people...

The smells and sounds of baking, handicrafts and singing surround the Christmas Bakery. Just being close to this sweet building already lighten one's mood. With special events, this building can boost different productions greatly!

After years of research and refinement, finally a building has been invented that is capable of producing a wide range of oils for all needs - the Oil Mill! From oiling tools, weapons and oil stones, to improving the performance and longevity of machinery, the oil mill has every settler covered. And yes, it can even help with preparing food and feeding livestock! You've never seen horses with such soft fur...
Oil for all your needs. Allows your productions to reach their highest efficiency.

This overwhelming, time-limited, luxurious package leaves nothing to the imagination. It's everything you could ever want in one enormous bundle, with an incredible 66% new year's discount! Get it while you still can! 3 powerful generals, 2 mighty explorers, 2 outstanding geologists, 2 endless mines, 3 special buildings, and so much more in this one bundle to rule them all!

This time-limited mega-bundle offers everything you need with an outstanding 66% new year's discount! Get it while you can! Includes Vargus, one of the best generals in the game, an endless iron mine, oil mill, adventure bookbinder and much more!

Sometimes even the friendliest, loveliest and most kindhearted of all Settlers gets forgotten, and doesn't get the gift of a Valentine. So, this is your chance to get that Settler a real token of love. Who is that Setller, you ask? Well, it's you! Get this event-exclusive bundle to prove your love to - ahem - yourself.
As a people expert, and a very loving person, he's able to transport a huge amount of units quite quickly, but cannot fight himself.

Has gone through pain again and again for her loved ones, but has never once thought about giving up. On the contrary, all her fights have made her stronger, brighter and keener than any other explorer.
An upgrade for those who love the river life, but aren't quite so keen on standing shoulder to shoulder with everyone at dinner. The most snugly house that was ever built on water.
The snugly, but much fancier way to live the Settler life in peace and harmony.
You'd be surprised at the sweet, useful things a chocolatier can create.

A beautiful spot filled with the memories of generations gone by. It's said that even your great grandmother once sat in the shadow of this charming old tree to secretly meet your great grandfather during their break. Tears soon sealed their joyful engagement, as they did for hundreds of others. It's said the love and energy stored in the tree are transferred to every loving soul who rests a while nearby - which is probably why so many friends and families come here for a picnic.

One morning, a farm settler knocked himself unconscious while trying to crack open the eggshell of an unusually heavy and hard egg, thinking his head would be tougher. In that very moment, he understood why his favorite hen was so heavy. Luckily, his family and friends kept him from trying to take a look inside the hen to discover its secrets, but ever since that day, the hen has lived in its very own luxury nest, where it continues to lay titanium ore eggs.

By disguising himself and his garrison to look like bandits, he is able to land sneak attacks and even weaken his foes before the actual fight begins. This makes him particularly formidable against boss units. But don't tell anyone, this information is all highly confidential! Ssshhhh!
An impressive load of advanced tools to push your peak productivity.
A cartful of the most beautiful Easter Eggs. A whole school class helped search to find them - and the helpful little Settlers were even allowed to keep the superfluous ones.
3 amazing explorers in one neat bundle! Including books to get them ready asap!
A whole water town in one bundle! All 5 water buildings in one pack just for you! Including tokens for some upgrades!
Can't decide which champion you like the most? Why not get all 3 of them at once for the price of 2?!
Are your military endeavors lacking a little something? This is it!
Looking for something more extravagant? Check out this utility bundle!
All the endless mine, in one neat bundle. With a bonus geologist who was stuck in one of the mines!
Fancy some improvements?
Who doesn't like to feel special? Convert coins into something even shinier!
Oh, what's this? For a boat full of brew, someone's willing to provide extra coal, water and storage space...
Sshhh!!! Don't tell anyone you found me! If you absolutely have to, just say something like "Have you found the secret package?" Let's play some hide and seek, OK?
A crucial pack for every settler. Worth 3 times its resource value, get your buffs now! Only one purchase per player.
When the warm sun kisses the earth, magnificent sunflowers turn their beautiful golden heads to the sky.
One of your settlers has developed a special fertilizer for raising sunflowers, which increases the production yield of sunflower farms enormously.
Sylvana is a Cossack woman and a born leader. She’s kind, yet tough, but always fair. Don’t underestimate her, as she really knows how to make your cavalry fight.
A city split by a landslide encounters strange evil-doers and is in dire straits. Will you be able to help them?
This tribute honors all diligent bakers. Let's celebrate the early risers that deliver the island’s famous warm and fragrant bread.
All goods are stored, delivered and taken from here. Has the capacity to store 32,000 resources.
Sylvana is a Cossack woman and a born leader. She’s kind, yet tough, but always fair. Don’t underestimate her, as she really knows how to make your cavalry fight.
3 amazing explorers in one neat bundle! Includes books to get them ready ASAP!
With this amazing bundle, you'll never run out of storage space.
With these mighty powerful generals, you won't have to fear even the strongest of cultists.
Are your military endeavors lacking a little something? This is it!
Looking for something more extravagant? Check out this utility bundle!
Three endless mines in one bundle. And apparently with a geologist still stuck in the mine!
Fancy some improvements?
What's not to like about a full week of premium time? For only 20,000 iron, this is a real bargain.
Oh, what's this? Someone's willing to provide 3 building deeds in exchange for water?
So, you finally found me, eh? Now bring me some fish, or else I'll…

Whilst conducting a wide range of experiments in an attempt to find a stronger metal, a new way of producing tokens was discovered instead. While still an expensive and elaborate process, it provides an additional path to those precious tokens.
This well-rounded package gives you everything you could ever need right now!
With this flowerbed flag you can make yourself a make-believe pirate island. You might even attract some real pirates that come and hide a treasure on your island. You never know...

In between haunting all those adventure islands, the Cultists somehow managed to summon a skeleton. As it turns out, that thing came with a crazy bundle of various items from past events - and some extras!

Your settlers have worked hard, and succeeded in understanding the process of refining oil, enabling several new options for its production. From now on, you'll even be able to make oil out of fish! Can you imagine? The only thing you’ll need to start producing oil is a teensy-weensy single unit of oil itself. If you haven’t had access to oil yet, why not ask a friend or guild member, or go to the trade market? Now, everyone can produce oil!

A group of tinkerers have secretly come together to create this fantastic, if slightly obscure building. To watch the 10th anniversary celebration, an idea was born to not just climb high, but to fly into the sky and have the best possible view of all the festivities and fireworks. After months of preparation and testing, take off was still a challenge too far, as the constuction plans included a space to celebrate and live. But with a little help from Sonya, the celebrative lookout was finally able to launch.

He's every bit as bold as his looks suggest. He absolutely loves to go on a treasure search, and usually brings home 50% more rewards due to his boldness. Whether on treasure or adventure searches, rumor has it he hasn’t come home without a buff yet. Impressive, isn’t it?

Carefully looking in every nook and cranny, the Diligent Geologist can find even the best-hidden treasures. Her passion began as a child when she accompanied her father on treasure hunts at the beach. She sure takes her time though, and enjoys the search more than her findings. She still remembers her father saying "If you're lucky once, you're always lucky twice".
As wise as his beard is long. He's never been the bravest or strongest among the ranks of the generals, but makes up for it with his extraordinary sageness.

To celebrate the anniversary with all of you wonderful people, we put together a couple of premium bundles with some of the latest content, all wrapped up with an amazing discount on top. The all-new bundles will exclusively be available throughout the anniversary event.

To celebrate the anniversary with all of you wonderful people, we put together a couple of premium bundles with some of the latest content, all wrapped up with an amazing discount on top. The all-new bundles will exclusively be available throughout the anniversary event.
Newer is not always better. These traditional techniques for training out in the fields have been proven to increase soldiers' capabilities for moving and fighting with armor.

Sometimes, the old recipes outshine the new ones. By mixing and preparing some basic materials, and adding a little extra sauce, you can create something truly special. No-one even thought it was possible, but now medipacks can be produced just like in the old days.
Nostalgia overwhelmed a builder when he found a blueprint of this cozy and roomy country house. He just had to build it.

Recently, one of your settlers found some dusty old blueprints in his attic. These buildings look intriguingly familiar, don't they?
With this awesome bundle you'll get all 3 of them at once.

A mysterious island has suddenly appeared out of the morning mists, visible on the horizon. Several fishermen and boats that ventured near have given similar reports about seeing evildoers roaming around the island. Strangely, however, it seems everybody saw completely different types of evildoer, but no leaders at all! Either way, you cannot let something like this go unchallenged so close to your own island.

There is nothing in life the Chummy Geologist wants more than to be your friend. To befriend you, he'll either find deposits really quickly, or return with sweet chocolate from his longer searches once every couple of searches.

Incredibly fearful and startled by the faintest of noises, he takes four times as long to complete searches. On the plus side, he'll also bring back four times the treasure on treasure searches, and often some omniseeds, too. And that’s not all: thanks to his particularly sensitive nature, he always has a small chance of finding something extraordinary like crystals, premium time items or precious books. Artifact, rarity and adventure searches are excluded from all loot bonuses.
The Bewitching Explorer has chosen some really enticing items for you in this time-limited Halloween Special. Come closer, have a look…

A most curious building. I've never seen anything like it before. It comes with piles of arcane equipment that can transform one resource into another - or so I've been assured - in the hands of an expert.
A very beautiful palm tree, which can be placed on your island to prettify it.

This noble ghost seeks retribution, and believes you to be the perfect partner to accomplish it.

A seed that lets you plant a tree as black as night. Once the pride and center of a witch's dance, this seed mysteriously found its way into your hands. The tree that springs from this seed will swallow the light surrounding it, and in return emit a diffuse, arcane blue light. Just standing beside such a tree, you can feel its arcane power permeate through you. You feel a strong urge to get as many of these trees on your island as possible, and wonder if this is part of its magic.

You feel a strong urge to get as many of these trees on your island as possible, and wonder if this is part of its magic.

You feel a strong urge to get as many of these trees on your island as possible, and wonder if this is part of its magic.

A creepy variant of the wondrous residence. A must-have for enthusiasts of scary times. Instead of tokens, this variant will require pumpkins as upgrade costs.
A scarily magnificient bundle. An elite troop of generals with some equally elite housing. Event limited bundle with an insane 50% discount! Get it now or fear the consequences! Muahahaha!
Not zombies, but still creepy! Get your hands on a bunch of halloween generals at a sweet discount! Don't trick yourself, treat yourself!
Brilliant beautification for any settlement with lots of building space. It's also the perfect bundle for brilliant scientists who want to get their own laboratory!

One of the Bonaberti family’s belongings, a beautiful untouched island in the far south, has been overrun by unknown bandits. The Bonabertis, though incredibly wealthy, are not exactly experienced in warfare. Therefore, they've trustingly turned to you for help: could you please eradicate the hostiles on the island? The rewards will definitely be worth it!
A small but impressive bundle for everyone preparing to become a famous adventurer.

This is the package for experienced adventurers that want to mentor others about to embark upon a great journey. After all this time, it might be nice just to listen to others who've explored unknown lands.
On a far away venture, a trader companion came across this incredible deal and knew you wouldn't be able to resist.
A decorative metal bowl filled with burning coals that can be placed on your island to prettify it.

When he's not passing the time by admiring the Gingerbread House, this explorer really likes going on treasure hunts. In fact, there’s only one thing he likes more - and that's presents. He'll always bring home 4 times the amount of event resources during events.
With the Specialist Christmas Bundle, you'll get 3 powerful specialists, many useful military buffs and a number of premium days.

The Gingerbread Bundle packs together 2 gingerbread buildings, along with some nice decorations and skins to give your home island that special Christmas vibe. You won't find a better deal for your gingerbread needs anywhere, that's for sure!
The Christmas Premium Bundle contains highly valuable buildings, a ton of useful buffs, and a nice amount of event resources for you to spend!

When he's not passing the time by admiring the Gingerbread House, this explorer really likes going on treasure hunts. In fact, there’s only one thing he likes more - and that's presents. He'll always bring home 4 times the amount of event resources during events.
Don’t let yourself be fooled by his pale blue skin colour. Deep down inside burns the will to conquer. He strikes hard, and will improve your army’s defensive units.

Grant yourself some high culture and build the wonderful Concert Hall. This building lets you change your background music, while at the same time benefiting from some very powerful zone buffs. Cooldown: 24 hours, can be reduced by additional buildings of the same type.
An awesome package for new starters, or those who want to boost their effectiveness.

A freezing bastion against the winter cold. Could someone please call a heating engineer? This magnificent and unique winter residence is a must under every Christmas Tree. Requires 4,500 presents to fully upgrade this beauty!

Everyone likes Christmas music, right? When you apply this sheet music buff to your concert hall, the musicians will play “We Wish You a Merry Christmas”, and a musical boost will be applied to increase the production speed of your barracks and elite barracks. That’s pretty groovy, isn’t it?

Everyone likes Christmas music, right? When you apply this sheet music buff to your concert hall, the musicians will play “Silent Night”, and a musical boost will be applied to increase the production speed of your barracks and elite barracks. That’s pretty groovy, isn’t it?

Everyone likes Christmas music, right? When you apply this sheet music buff to your concert hall, the musicians will play “Jingle All the Way”, and a musical boost will be applied to increase the production speed of your barracks and elite barracks. That’s pretty groovy, isn’t it?

The romantic explorer loves to go on long treasure searches - but once abroad, he always gets distracted chasing love! While that means he takes twice as long to return, the good news is he'll bring back 12 times the rewards.
The loner general is a rather egotistical character, but fortunately there's more to him than that: he's an expert in how to lead and attack with offensive units.

Explorers and geologists don't always see eye to eye, but some do have the endearing custom of coming together for some well spent quality time during Valentine’s. At least, those who don’t already have a significant other to bewitch...
With this special bundle, you'll have more space for your population in no time. Actually, lots of space!
Your island’s foes never sleep, whether it's Valentine’s or not. With this bundle, you can help reinforce your island's defenses with a sizable military boost.
The perfect place to live for any settlers that celebrate love and friendship. Snuggle together and enjoy the view from the most romantic of residences.
Sometimes your settlers just want to revive and relax. Make your settlers happy and build this wonderful spa.
Sometimes your settlers just want to revive and relax. Make your settlers happy and build this wonderful spa.

The old astrologist has convinced our venerable King Damien that we're doomed! The whole world is doomed! The world will end because of a terrible curse, cast by an old and mysterious clan of witch-doctors over a thousand years ago!
Make preparations for the end of the world with this time-limited and event-exclusive bundle.
Make preparations for the end of the world with this time-limited and event-exclusive bundle.

Build the perfect place for all the love-seeking, helplessly romantic settlers on your island. The Lovers' Statue will kindle the flame of love for all that long for it. Can be upgraded to bronze and gold forms.
The motherly explorer really cares. In fact, she cares so much, she'll always bring back 4 times the loot from all treasure, rarity and artifact searches.
Everything blooms and thrives splendidly in the spring - even the Wondrous Spring Residence. The most beautiful flowers have been sown on it, in it and all around it. It’s beautiful!
There are lots of happy rabbits in the rabbit retreat. The food is so excellent, our sweet rabbits produce magic beans out of it!
Benefit from a huge discount on these 3 buildings – with a Prestigious Friend Buff on top. This bundle is event-exclusive!
This is our springtime specialist bundle. Get it now and take advantage of some sweet premium time, along with 4 great specialists to make spring really special. This bundle is event-exclusive!
There is simply no better deal than the event-exclusive Easter Super Bundle. Spend eggs to get everything listed below.
An impressive bundle to help any and all settlers.
An awesome and exclusive Scenario Adventure Season bundle.
Get yourself some refillers, resources and flaming arrows with this time-limited bundle.
The benevolent explorer is always trying to do good.
There's nothing like a nice, calm boat tour. Get yourself one of these lovely swan boats, while pushing your population limit.
A tribute to all copper mine workers.
A time-limited exclusive summer event bundle to help all settlers out there.
A time-limited exclusive summer event bundle to help all settlers out there. Includes the all-new, dark roofed warehouse.
A time-limited exclusive summer event bundle to help all settlers.

A time-limited, exclusive summer event bundle designed to give you a little boost.
The Royal Explorer rules. He's incredibly quick, and sometimes even finds tokens during adventure searches, which he loves to collect - but he'll still always hand them over to you. Eventually.
The Sophisticated Geologist is - surprise! - sophisticated. Sophisticated… and insanely fast. In fact, we’ve never seen a geologist so fast.
A special tribute to all knowledge seekers. By putting this profession on a pedestal, your Settlers are inspired to print their own books.
A tribute to one of the most productive buildings, the oil mill.
At the Balloon Market, various wonderful balloons are on offer. There definitely will be something for everyone!

General Loudmouth is loud, bold and always full of energy. In battle, she has this striking expression on her face, always showing determination and a strong will to win. She is hard but fair to all the soldiers in her army, and very caring toward her battle horse.

A time-limited exclusive anniversary event bundle. It’s packed full of sweet items from the last events, which some of you may have missed due to us changing from our Flash client to the new, swish Air version of our game. This is your chance to get your hands on the content and take advantage of a huge 70% discount!
Are your old buildings looking a bit hard on the eyes? Why not give them a fresh coat of grout with a brand-new Grout Factory!
Once a raiding boat, now repurposed as a storage vault for countless stolen riches.
A scallywag obsessed with finding treasure and adventure.

After several years of being just an ordinary geologist without any peculiarities, he made the mistake of going too far into one of the ancient pharaohs’ tombs. Needless to say, he got cursed, and has had to live his geologist’s life as an undead mummy ever since.
Here's where all sorts of rocky goods are processed.
A new settler has come to town - and one with a very sweet spot for pumpkins, it seems! Have a look at just how gorgeously this mansion’s decorated.
A tribute to the mighty grout.
A frighteningly helpful bundle for everyone, with useful buildings, specialists, and buffs.
Often finding itself as the target trick-or-treaters, the pumpkin mansion is ready to receive the Halloween spirit with copious amounts of candy.
Treat yourself with this horrifyingly useful set of buildings, specialists and buffs.
Get the Halloween Spirit going with this convenient bundle.
Give yourself the gift of victory with this bundle, including specialist and battle consumables.
Jingle all the way with this super helpful bundle of production buffs.
Don't be fooled by the fact that he's made from wood! He uses this condition to his advantage - after all, wood is tougher than skin.
A gorgeous palace made out of eternal enchanted ice. It has a lovely view too!
A warehouse made in the Inuit style. Very useful for storing perishable goods, as it keeps them fresh. Very fresh.
Being made of bread, what he lacks in mobility he makes up for in luck, as he always seem to find a few extra resources - and sometimes even items.
With love and care, all sorts of toys are made here. There's something for everyone! Have you been naughty or nice?
This giant globe and its ever-swirling snow capture the Christmas spirit all year long. Everyone that comes close to it is filled with warm feelings of wonder and joy.
A place were couples usually go on a first date. Also, most first kisses happen here too. It's said that bonds that begin here last for a lifetime.
Its walls are built with an ancient stone that teems with magic. Settlers who dwell in it are filled with an overwhelming feeling joy and love.
This tribute honors all the stout titanium miners. Raise your pickaxe in celebration of this valuable resource.
This is not a filthy, damp hole, filled with vermin and stench. It is a bunny burrow.
She is protected by a divine force. This protection is extended to all that fight by her side.
With strong legs, he hops his way in and out of tasks 3 times faster than a standard explorer. His magical bag allows him to store copious amounts of magical goods.
Here we turn all that starch from wheat into sweet treats that will ruin your teeth and make your children hyper.
A lovely thatched house by the seaside.
Don’t let the spooky masks intimidate you. It’s much more welcoming than it looks, and spacious too!
Invest resources to produce buffs that can strike your enemies before they can see you.
Produce zone buffs that allow you to recover troops after battles.
Never be caught flat footed by your enemies.
Get the most out of the Earth's riches with this bundle.
An agricultural wonder of a bundle.
Roman architectured housing from a well-remembered era.
A very spacious Mayan dwelling from a bygone era, now repurposed for storage.
A Mayan toolsmith structure from a bygone era. Don't be fooled by its ancient looks - techniques passed down through the generations make it remarkably effective.
An ancient Roman fishing vessel that now serves as an expert fisherman’s dwelling. It might look improvised, but it is remarkably effective.
A terrifying sight. Only the bravest dare to venture within its halls.
Abandoned ages ago because of the stories surrounding it. It is said that plentiful riches await those brave enough to dare it.
Develops techniques and methodologies to improve the production of artillery-related products and buffs.
Like your favorite granite pit, but endless, though slower. You can't have it all.

A veteran of countless epic battles, he is adept at leading elite groups of highly trained infantry solders. He employs a defensive formation that few have been able to even make so much as a dent in.
A prestigious award that serves as proof of being an accomplished businessman.
All goods are stored, delivered and taken from here.
A rustic hunting lodge, your latest kill roasting on the fire, and your little partner massaging your feet, while the little ones play on the floor with the dogs.
A warehouse made from a gigantic barrel. Nobody has a clue who or what made it, or what was once stored in it. A bit over-the-top if you ask me...
Here your troops have the opportunity to fill their bellies with a delicious meal before setting out on adventures. You know what they say: "an army marches on its stomach".
This ultra-modern building is very efficient, and allows one single worker to extract all the ore from a deposit in short time.
A movable entertainment center where people can have way too much to eat, too much to drink, and too much fun. But mostly too much to drink.
A very pompous, very expensive, very sought-after vacation accommodation. Well worth its price tag.
A star has fallen from the sky. It's made of pure crystal.
A high vantage point that allows rangers to take care of the local fauna.

Overcrowded at home? No more room to hoard stuff you never use? We’ve got you covered. Build your new storage offshore! Cannot be used to transport goods or conquer new lands, but it sure has enough room to hoard stuff away!
Breathtaking exhibits, ranging from stone sculptures and history to mind-boggling displays of metalwork.

There are still many wolf packs in the forest. They live in peace with the residents, and sometimes they even help each other out. A beautiful example of different species living together.

Rina is a very passionate explorer, and loves to analyze and collect everything on her journeys. She is very fast, and her only goal has always been to be on adventures.
This dusty bag doesn't look promising, but removing the dust reveals some spooky buildings and buffs.
Everyone forgot about this crate. It got lost in an abandoned building, but it seems to include a lot of useful specialists and buffs.
This chest really looks uncanny. If you’re brave enough, open it to see the brave specialists, spooky buildings and useful buffs it contains.

Bjoern is a very friendly general. People gather around him and want to follow him. This leads to him being a non-combative general who’s more focused on the well-being of his troops. He’s also capable of hiring recruits during his travels.

This cemetery got forgotten about decades ago, but with space being limited, some inhabitants decided that this could be the perfect place to live. Now they have shelter, and are close to the loved ones they lost.

A scarecrow was once used to scare away birds and protect fields - but this one is special. It looks alive, and many people are afraid. If you want to protect your village from strangers, this skeleton scarecrow can help you.
Nobody knows exactly who was laid to rest here. But everyone’s very sure that he or she must have been a very popular person.
Place an Ofrenda at home and use it as an altar to never forget the settlers you lost in battles.

The Blacktree Explorer is obsessed by the Blacktree. She loves all variations of it. She is so committed to the Blacktree that when she returns from exploring, she always brings one of the famous Blacktree buffs back with her.
This warehouse is flying! It's unbelievable. It's so haunted that it started to levitate. This is our opportunity to place it in the water!

No one would ever say that our good old farms are old - but they are! Some settlers took the time to improve the productivity of farms and came up with the Bio Farm, which is just incredible. It doesn’t need additional wheat fields anymore!

Do you remember the master archer who stole from the rich? Well, he’s back! Or at least, that’s what we think... It may just be a copycat. Nevertheless, someone is rioting within our noble kingdom, stealing from rich merchants to fuel another riot. Please, find this guy and put a stop to it before he does any further harm to our kingdom...

Do you remember Sir Robin, the king of the traitors? Well, he’s back! Some of his loyal followers freed him from his prison. Ever since, he’s been hiding on an island nearby. Finally, we’ve managed to locate him, and it’s time to take action! We need to put him back in prison before he starts attacking our beautiful kingdom!

A plea for help reaches your kingdom.
Terrified citizens claim they have been repeatedly raided by a band of villains under the command of a strange woman. She calls herself "Wild Mary" and dares everyone to challenge her. The villagers are in desperate need of help.

The daughter of one of your settlers has run off with a wicked rogue!
The concerned father has turned to you in desperate need of help. He cannot afford to equip enough men to bring his daughter back, and since the rogue and his outlaws are dangerous men, you are the only one that can help.

A rich merchant seeks your help.
Some business partners have double-crossed him and now he wants revenge. They have set up camp in a nearby canyon.

There be pirates!
Peg-legged good-for-nothing brutes are at large near a beach to the south. The surrounding settlements tremble in fear. They have collected quite a decent sum of coins as a reward to anyone that dares to scare the pirates away.

Rumours tell of a mighty witch.
She lives in a poisonous swamp and is believed to have the ugliest face you can imagine, warts all over her deformed nose and a laughter that can freeze your spine. Anyone who dares to journey into her realm is sure to earn fame and glory.

The people of the great veld seek your assistance.
One of the rider clans has started terrorizing the settlers in this region, taking their belongings and steal their flocks. If no-one helps them they will have to leave their homeland. The local population doesn't possess much, but they are willing to offer their most precious heirloom to anyone who can drive the rider clan away.

Loyal men they were, but greed turned them into ruthless bandits. The nobles have turned to you for help against these deserters. Be careful if you approach them since these traitors are heavily armed, battle hardened men.

Victor The Vicious hails from a kingdom far away.
His skills in archery are unparalleled. Some say he shot an apple from the head of his own son! Unfortunately he has claimed the nearby hunting valley of a friendly regent for his own. The regent cannot accept such boldness, and has placed a bounty on Victor's head.

It is a mark of troubled times when even captivity cannot stop wicked bandits from forming new groups of outlaws. Travellers tell of fearsome raids in the nearby forests. The local knights cannot deal with this hardened group alone and have requested your assistance. Send your men and make the roads safe again!

Rumour has it that a couple of dark priests are performing dark rituals. Very dark rituals. There have even been several cats reported missing recently. Understandably, your citizens are more than a little concerned about this. They have turned to you for help and are willing to give what they have in order to compensate you for your efforts.

A very concerned landlord has written a letter to you. One of his previously loyal master archers has turned rogue, living in the forest and stealing gold from rich merchants and nobles. With it, he bribes simple peasants into rioting. You have to stop this at once!

You have received a letter of challenge from a group called "The Sons Of The Veld". Obviously a new rider clan has emerged and is overconfident about its own strength. This challenge is an affront to your honour. You have to show these savages their place!

You have received a threating letter containing the demands of a bunch of wild men that landed on the shore not long ago. Apparently, they are part of some kind of wild Nordic tribe that intends to go pillaging and plundering their way through the area. For the sake of your people's safety you should challenge this tribe. Drive them away and restore peace and order to your kingdom.

You have received word of a mad alchemist who performs experiments on living human beings! He has hired an experienced troop of deadly mercenaries to protect him. You cannot allow this to happen in the vicinity of your realm! Send your troops and stop the madman!

A claim of sovereignty has arrived at your castle. Hector the Black and his brother Barnabas demand a whole mountain range as their new territory. They have already secretly built black castles and recruited numerous men to defend them. What will you do? Allow this treason to happen? Or will you put an end to this claim once and for all?

The rider clans of the great veld have requested your assistance. Apparently, an evil shaman called "Roaring Bull" has claimed regency over the whole area. He and his fellow shamans command dark magic and fierce warriors. Nobody can stand against them. You will have to send your finest men in order to defeat them.

More and more townsfolk are drawn to a mysterious order in the vicinity of your castle. After some investigation it turns out that a dark brotherhood is trying to undermine your regency. You cannot allow that to happen! Send your men to stop this foul corruption from spreading.

A spy report tells of a secluded castle in a large valley far to the east. Obviously the knights there have got hold of some cannons. Those mighty weapons might prove very useful in the future. Yet, these knights surely won't give them away freely. You may have to convince them with a little... manpower.

On a secluded island, a bunch of pirates have built their headquarters. Within a radius of hundreds of kilometers they attack helpless port cities and frighten inhabitants. If you want to earn fame and glory, visit the island and banish the pirates and their crazy ship's cook.

The last time you battled the witch of the swamp, you defeated her, but a Dark High Priest escaped. The priest retreated to an abandoned piece of land and performed a dark ritual to bring the witch back to life again. Now the witch of the swamp is regenerating and planning a vendetta against you. Defeat her, while she is still weak!

A group of the notorious Nords have built their camp on a small island nearby. It seems as if they are preparing an attack against you. However, they don’t know that their landing did not go unnoticed, so it would be a clever move to attack them now.

The last time you met the crazy ship’s cook, you defeated him and his crew and banished them from the island. After that defeat, the crazy ship’s cook went back to his parent’s house. Now his mother is watching over him. If you want to finish him off you'll have to overwhelm his mother first.

The Scouts have found a house hidden in the forest where they think the rogues Chuck, One-Eyed Bert and Metal Tooth are living. Travel to the dark part of the forest and check the rumour out. If you find the scoundrels there, catch them and bring them to justice.

As you adjourn to your chamber in the evening, you find an unsigned letter lying on your bed. Excited, you open it and read through the hastily written lines. It is from Santa Claus himself. He reports in short words about a meanie called "Croaker" who has stolen all the presents and barricaded himself on an isle together with other bandits. Get the presents back and save the Christmas feast!

As you adjourn to your chamber in the evening, you find an unsigned letter lying on your bed. Excited, you open it and read through the hastily written lines. It is from Santa Claus himself. He reports in short words about a meanie called "Croaker" who has stolen all the presents and barricaded himself on an isle together with other bandits. Get the presents back and save the Christmas feast!

A plea for help reaches your kingdom. Terrified citizens claim they have been repeatedly raided by a band of villains under the command of a strange woman. She calls herself "Wild Mary" and dares everyone to challenge her. The villagers are in desperate need of help.

The map shows the coordinates of an island in the north of the country. It looks quite small and easy to find. Now the Easter egg paper chase can begin. Note: no general is needed to complete the adventure. Simply visit the island and gather all the eggs.
This island looks pretty small too. Let's see what the Easter bunny has figured out for you this time.

After a strange kind of goodbye from the Easter bunny's brother, you arrive at the new isle. This time it is a bit bigger than the last few ones, meaning that it will probably be a lot more challenging.
After arriving on the island, you immediately see that the Easter eggs were not hidden properly… They are lying in every corner of the isle. Well then, let's get started!

This island seems similar to the last one. Easter eggs are lying everywhere, randomly spread, waiting for someone to pick them up. You should have enough practice by now to get through this pretty quickly.

This is supposed to be the last island the Easter bunny's brother lost Easter eggs on. The end of the odyssey seems close, even though this island appears thick with vegetation. It will not be easy to find all Easter eggs here.
The old man's description brought you here. The island is very mountainous. How did the Easter bunny's brother come up with the idea to hide Easter eggs here? Whatever... Go for the Easter eggs!
Hmm.. This time there are no mountains but the main part of the island is all desert, and it is really hot. Think positive: at least there are no mountains.
The rabbit wasn't exaggerating; there really are quite a lot of wild animals in these dark woods. Hopefully, they haven't eaten most of the Easter eggs already.
Finally, you have reached the end of your search and can now do your own little Easter egg hunt completely relaxed. However... the island is huge. Happy hunting.

The defensive stance of your first opponent might suggest diffidence, and tempt the foolhardy general into carelessness. However, rest assured that these men, hardened by some fateful battles, have quite a few perfidious tricks up their sleeves, and their injuries may not be as serious as they make out.

They seem unpredictable and wayward, but it would not be advisable to underestimate them. Among them are some of the most experienced and well versed fighters, yet word is that their own trainers seem to struggle with their rigidity. It is even reported that in the face of defeat, some of them become inappropriately headstrong...

You are now facing veterans of this tournament, even if their historical feats are not always undisputed. These all-weather champions seem quick to battle and always ready for a jolly knees-up, but they can also quickly turn a battle in their favor without much of a plan.

One ought to be surprised how ruthless the men from these otherwise cultivated lands can act in battle. These valiant combatants used to win their battles with skill and finesse, proving to be formidable opponents. These days, it is said that when particularly challenged, they resort to combat techniques similar to those practiced in the east.

With almost mechanical routine these contestants have turned many a battle in their favor, often not exactly with tactical flair. It seems that only their predictability and confidence in victory could possibly be their undoing. Yet, they may have met their match with you. If you manage to bring them out of their shell, victory is already within reach.

How deceptively graceful these apparitions may appear when seen scurrying across the battlefield. These sinuous combatants might tempt the short-witted to underestimate their actual proficiency. But beware, your opponents are astute strategists that are up to every trick in the book. Many opponents have already fallen prey to their clever tactical scheming.

A rich merchant seeks your help.
Some business partners have double-crossed him and now he wants revenge. They have set up camp in a nearby canyon.

One of our traders just arrived back from Nearpole Island and has some grave news! He claims the most feared Nords have invaded the island and brought a cold wind along with them! They came from the northern islands that were believed to be buried under the ice. We need to head to Windy Island and see what's happening!

The old astrologist has convinced our venerable King Damien that we're all doomed! In fact, the whole world is doomed! Apparently, the world is soon going to end because of a terrible curse, cast by an old and mysterious clan of witch-doctors over a thousand years ago! However, luckily, the old astrologist also knows a way we can escape the disaster. He's opened a gateway in time to take you back to the day the curse was cast, and we need you to prevent the cataclysmic curse from ever being set upon the Earth in the first place! Can you hear their shamans chanting? Quick! There's no more time to waste - go and avert what will otherwise be the end of us all!

A letter from King Damien arrived this morning. We are to travel to Skull Island and stop a bunch of young pirates finding a long lost treasure! I'll tell you more about it all when we arrive! Off we go to Skull Island!

A pigeon landed this morning, bringing news from your good friend Lord Walder the Bold. Or is it bald? Anyway, he requested your attention regarding a problem he has. His people live on an island ruled by a fierce pirate leader, but they get along well. Neither hurts the other, peace can be smelled in the air. Then two weeks ago an unknown bandit gang appeared from the badlands, and they seem to want the island for themselves. Lord Walder needs your help! I say rally up some of our military forces and pay them a visit. Do you agree?

The map shows the coordinates of a small and easily located island in the north of the country. Looks quite small and easy to find.
Note: No general is required in order to complete the adventure. Just visit the island and gather all Easter eggs. Note: This adventure contains no rewards!

Even though this map is no Picasso, it serves its purpose and shows an island far away. Looks promising...
Note: No general is required in order to complete the adventure. Just visit the island and gather all Easter eggs. Note: This adventure contains no rewards!

A map of an island even the most casual sailor knows.
Note: No general is required in order to complete the adventure. Just visit the island and gather all Easter eggs. Note: This adventure contains no rewards!

It is said that on this island lie a lot of Easter eggs, so if you want to help the Easter bunny, this might be a good place to start.
Note: No general is required in order to complete the adventure. Just visit the island and gather all Easter eggs. Note: This adventure contains no rewards!

That is one of the islands belonging to the Easter guy's cousin. You've heard the cousin is pretty nice, so maybe it would be OK to borrow some of his eggs?!
Note: No general is required in order to complete the adventure. Just visit the island and gather all Easter eggs. Note: This adventure contains no rewards!

That is the other island belonging to the Easter guy's cousin. You've heard the cousin is pretty nice, so maybe it would be OK to borrow some of his eggs?!
Note: No general is required in order to complete the adventure. Just visit the island and gather all Easter eggs. Note: This adventure contains no rewards!

There's a rumour going around about some islands with hidden eggs the finder is welcome to keep. What are you waiting for?
Note: No general is required in order to complete the adventure. Just visit the island and gather all Easter eggs. Note: This adventure contains no rewards!

There's a rumour going around about some islands with hidden eggs the finder is welcome to keep. What are you waiting for?
Note: No general is required in order to complete the adventure. Just visit the island and gather all Easter eggs. Note: This adventure contains no rewards!

There is an island somewhere far from here where all of the infamous bad guys and their clans are imprisoned. They live there under their own rules, but they're not allowed to leave. The island warden, Count Hackett, has written us a letter saying the clans have started a war between each other to try and win ownership of the island! We must go there quickly and calm down them using our own techniques. Yes, that's right, we're going to do a little cleanup!

We have an urgent matter to attend to. Please, sit - there is much to tell. King Damien has an Elite Group called "The Unity". The King trusts them implicitly and shares all his secret plans etc. with them. One of the generals who was part of this special group retired some years ago, and the King gave him an island. Yes, you heard me, the man got an island. Gregorid Skoln is his name, and lives an honourable retirement on his little island, Sleepy Reef, along with his wife and most beloved daughter, Sabilyn. Sadly, Gregorid had some unfinished business before he left Capital Island, and that business has taken over his island. Some of the traitors have stormed the island and are now holding Gregorid and his family hostage. I think this calls for a visit, don't you agree? Don't forget your sword.

We've had our share of weird people trying to do weird things, but this is going a tad too far. There's this alchemist who somehow managed to create the "Cult of the Sleeping Flame". He actually has followers! And that's not all...here comes the best part: he wants to revive a sleeping volcano. Yes, you heard me. Flintrock island is right on the top of a sleeping volcano, and we must go there and save those people before the cult leader burns the whole island to ashes!

Are you sitting? This letter here came from pirates! And it's not a call for ransom or a new threat. They need our help! Yes, you heard me right! A group of veteran and retired pirates, who we defeated several times some years ago, are under attack by bandits. They write that the bandits came and they took over their island. Apparently, the bandits want to become pirates, so they're forcing the veterans to teach them about pirate life. I'm so confused now. Should we help them? Yes? Well, let's buckle up, then!

You wouldn't believe it! The Nords are back, and this time they mean business. They raided an island that produces gunpowder for the King's army, and they took more than one thousand barrels. It takes just one barrel to destroy a small village...imagine what they could do with that amount! If I understood correctly, they want to detonate the barrels, creating a tidal wave that would wipe out several neighbouring islands, including our own. We cannot let this happen! We need to travel to that abandoned island and take care of business!
Your old friend the little tailor is in a bad way. The king has sent him on a very dangerous task where he can’t succeed alone. Maybe you can help him out?
The map shows a small island quite far away. On the picture, it looks different from the other islands you've seen before. A new experience awaits you, it seems…
Buildings are appearing all across another kingdom, and the inhabitants are scared. They await a hero to take care of the phenomenon. Are you that hero?

The jester has given you a map with a funny looking island on it. It seems to be far away, but something a little different will make for a new experience. As a experienced settler, can you really let this opportunity slip through your fingers?
The island on the picture looks somehow familiar to you, but you don't know why. Anyway, the jester wants you to travel there and make your own appraisal, so maybe you should do so.
Buildings are spreading like mushrooms. Sounds pretty strange, and yet interesting. It seems no-one can handle this problem except you. All hopes are pinned on you. Will you live up to expectations?

The map shows a big island with a village located on it. It seems the settlers there are having problems with some strange magic that has changed the look of their buildings. The source of the problem has to be somewhere on the island.
The new adventure leads you to an island famous for its beautiful ruins. It seems the inhabitants there have the same problems as the last ones: their buildings look different than usual.

Your friend, the little tailor once again needs your help.
The king you defeated regrets his sins and had pledged to approve a marriage between his daughter and the tailor.
But a rivaling tailor claims he did all the hard work, and has therefore acquired the right to the princess' hand.
To prove his competitor wrong, the princess has given the little tailor a difficult task…

You have received a messenger pigeon from your old friend, the little tailor.
He has divorced the princess after realizing she couldn’t be the right person for him if she demands he risk his life for no reason.
So he has decided to go on a journey to see the wonders of this world.
Unfortunately though, he has wandered too far into a dark forest, and is now stranded in a hermit’s hut. The forest around him is too dangerous for him to leave the hut alone, so he needs your help to get back home.
The new adventure leads you to an island famous for its beautiful ruins. It seems the inhabitants there have the same problems as the last ones: their buildings look different than usual.

The map shows a big island with a village located on it. It seems the settlers there are having problems with some strange magic that has changed the look of their buildings. The source of the problem has to be somewhere on the island.
You have received a letter from your friend the little tailor. He says he has three sons, and has made a big mistake. He now wants to make up for it, but needs your help to do so.

Though the little tailor has reconciled with his sons, new problems have arisen. A greedy inn-keeper has stolen the magical items his sons received from their masters. Once again, he needs your help to get them back.

The remote mansion of Lord Scroogius is besieged by two competing factions. Due to the lay of the land, a two-pronged assault is required to break the siege in the little time they have left until their provisions run out. Hurry to help the Lord and the reward will be well worth it!
The Pirates have encamped on this island with a complex network of unbreakable stockades. Only proper teamwork and synchronized attacks will be able to unravel the island’s formidable fortifications.

Dark Cultists have retrieved an ancient artefact and secluded it on their fortified island, where they perform unspeakable rituals in its name. Sail forth with your comrades and put an end to this abominable practice!
An old treasure map we found points to a great treasure hidden on a small island. It seems to be linked to an ancient civilization. Set sail for this island and find the treasure!

It is a mark of troubled times when wicked bandits form new groups of outlaws. Travellers talk of an island shrouded in mist, where the bandits set sail and spread over the land. Send your men and see to it that this stronghold is destroyed!

One of the scouts managed to track a Raider ship back to its homeport. His report indicates the Raiders are based out of a thriving island, governed, in true Raider fashion, by three chieftains. If you ask me, this would be a great opportunity to show them how it feels to be the target of a raid! We should strike at their leaders and loot their supplies, once they are defenceless!

The Christmas feast is in danger once again! A letter from Santa explains that his old nemesis, the Croaker has stolen his sleigh! And without the sleigh, there's no way to deliver the presents to the children!
It's up to you to get the sleigh back, and defeat the Croaker!

Can you still remember the man who made these strange experiments some time ago? He was not amused that you destroyed his laboratory. Now, he wants revenge. Fast! Stop his new experiments before they are finished!

You've received some new messages from your villagers, telling you there are once again some strange things happening in the woods where you defeated the bandits. The villagers have asked you to take a look and get to the bottom of this new mystery.

Garrun the Trapper has decided to take upon himself to sabotage Easter. To accomplish this he has gathered a cohort of poachers, trappers and hounds and is holding many, if not all, of the Easter Bunnies captive on his camp on Egg Island. Set forth to destroy him and liberate the bunnies!
Oh, this is exciting! A practice match against the Knight of Crowrock and his entourage. We can use this to figure out how to play the match.

So, this will be our first real match. Our opponent is the Barony of Tepidwater. Much like us, they haven't played many matches yet. Folks say the barony is playing a very offensive 4-3-3 system. We should keep an eye on their midfielders, but at the same time watch out for their three strikers. The Baron of Tepidwater has some strong players in his team.

Here comes the next game of the group stage. Today our opponent will be the Barony of Emberstream. The guys from Emberstream are a very defensive team with a strong defensive line-up. If we want to make it to their goal, we'll need a cunning plan.

Now it's getting serious - our first knock-out match, against the Shire of Oxwater. During the group stage they showed skill in attack, while maintaining a stable defence. They play in a 4-2-4 formation – that means with four forwards.

In the quarter finals, we will play the Electorate of Sunflower Grove. They've certainly earnt their place amongst the last eight teams in the tournament. Similar to our former opponent they play with a strong attacking squad, although their midfield is a little more balanced. This will be a tough opponent.

The semi-finals! We're up against the grand Duchy of Darkwood. What do you need to know about this opponent? They stand closely staggered in a 1-4-1-4 system and have many very strong players. They are one of the best teams left.

It’s the day of the finals. Our opponent is the Kingdom of Dragonhead. Going by their results so far, they've clearly been the best team in the whole tournament – next to us, of course. All their players are strong, and they are said to be confident. But then, they've never played us. Go out on the field and show them what we're made of!
Expedition Island
Contested Island

Since Santa's reindeers are missing, he's a little short on time - and he could use our help! Close to our kingdom, there are a few smaller islands with loads of families living there. They're not exactly in a very Christmassy mood, as they heard that Santa might not make it to their island this year. If we deliver the presents instead, we could help Santa, and bring some Christmas spirit to those poor families too! Wouldn't that be the right thing to do at Christmas?
