In a mountain on a nearby island, a valuable ore vein has been found. You have been asked to help with the construction of a mining outpost, and to provide it with security. You'll receive a big reward for your help.

The rangers of a nearby town are calling for aid. A strange sickness has fallen upon the trees near their settlement. They've done all they can, but it seems to be spreading into the forest, and even to the local wildlife. We should help them out, and perhaps we can find the reason for this strange plight.

Not far from here there lies Grain Island, a small island full of swaying, golden ears, which gave the island its name. On this small piece of land, there are two towns - one producing the most delicious brew in these spheres, the other baking the tastiest bread of all the known kingdoms. The guilds in both towns used to share the grain. They would meet in the Grain House - a place where they would negotiate and distribute it equally. But one day, the two guilds started arguing over which product would be the best, and to which guild the most grain should go. Since that day, there have been no more negotiations in the Grain house, as every guild just tries to get as much as they can. Maybe you can help the two guilds to re-enter negotiations, so our Settlers can feast on the Grain Island's famous exports again.
In a neighbouring city, two twins have gone missing without a trace. The poor kids! Maybe you can be of help finding them?

For a long time now, where Easter eggs come from has been one of life's biggest mysteries. Well, here's the truth. In a well hidden village, on a well hidden island, in a well hidden part of the world, there lies a small egg farm. But lately, there's been a problem. Polecats have overrun the island, and occupied the chickens' nests so they can't lay any eggs! Help the chickens to get their nests back.

An anxious villager approaches you asking for help. There was a serious storm on their island, and the villagers can't afford to make the essential repairs they need. Their harvest was bad, and hunger is starting to haunt the people. Are you willing to help them?
Recommended level: 50+

A beautiful, yet small island, whose population is a bit eccentric. They've asked you for help against the bandits that have been giving them a hard time. Help them, so you can return the coin that was stolen from them and remove the curse surrounding their otherwise peaceful island.
Ali Baba gave you this map. According to his information, a beautiful woman is held captive here. All you can do is set out, and have a look around for her.
The orient king approaches you with an urgent request - his wife is missing! Last seen on a nearby island. You arrive on the island and get a really harsh welcome..

Ali Baba shares a possible clue to the location of the king's missing wife. The thieves may also be using the cave where they stash their treasure for holding people hostage. You both decide to investigate this a bit further.

Ali Baba approaches you with another clue. Beautiful women are being held captive in a heavily guarded stronghold. It seems impenetrable at first, but Ali Baba has urged you to wait for him to arrive, assuring he'll be able to help you find a way in.

The map you found on the previous island led you here. Ali Baba is convinced that something big is hidden here. You decide to trust his hunch and search the island for the missing Scheherezade, and the treasure Ali Baba is after.

Your search brings you to this island, where it appears a long lost civilization once lived. Ali Baba mentions that perhaps the treasure he searches for is also here. Curious about the ancient civilization, you decide to help.

On your search for hints about the missing Scheherazade, you meet the intrepid sailor Sinbad. He recommends that you ask the people of the island for information, but the island is currently being besieged by apes! You decide to help the locals with their problem.

You and Ali Baba decide to go separate ways, but he puts you in touch with a friend of his. The man, known as Aladdin, has heard rumours about a beautiful woman arriving on the island, and offers to help... for a price.

The leads are solid, and all the information points here. You finally arrive at the island where the king's wife, Scheherazade, is being held captive. Aladdin has joined you, following a lead of his own on the oil lamp.

The clues you found brought you to a man named Sinbad - an experienced sailor that knows the area like the back of his hand. You hear from the locals that there may be a large amount of treasure hidden on this island, so you decide to investigate more.
The natives of a small island need your help! They're being threatened by aggressors from the north.
A dragon has suddenly appeared and started terrorizing a chain of islands. Somebody must stop it!
A distressed woodcutter approaches you. He says that his wife convinced him to abandon his children in the woods, but he's now extremely worried about them. Will you help him find them?

A fisherman shares with you the story of how an enchanted flounder granted his wife her wish of becoming all-powerful. Perhaps too powerful. She's become blinded with power, and is now oppressing the land!

The Mayor of the town of Hamelin has contacted you, to inform you that a piper has brought a plague of rats to his island. He cordially asks if you could help them deal with it, and promises a huge reward if you do.

The latest reports on the whereabouts of the Evil Queen point to a remote island. The only apparent sign of civilization is a lonely hut in the middle of the island. You decide to investigate a bit further.

You receive a letter from a young maid called Snow White, stating that her evil stepmother, the queen, has had her hunted down just because she's the prettier one. You follow the lead in hopes of finding a clue as to Ilsebille's whereabouts.
The legendary Chupacabra has been spotted on an island to the west, where it is spreading madness among the natives. You have to put an end to it!

One of your informants has gone missing! He was tasked with keeping an eye on the dealings of a suspicious island town. They must have captured him because he discovered something they didn't want us to know! We must send out a rescue party!

Pirates have robbed several of your allied kingdoms. We have identified an island, where we believe the fleet is going to restock. If you can intercept them, you can teach them a lesson and return your allies' stolen goods.
We have located an island! It must be the one that houses the fabled City of Glory! But why is it teeming with bandits? And where is the city itself? Could the six altars hold the answers?

An island has been plunged into darkness and eternal mist by some sort of curse. Could the ghost musicians that Sonya claims to have met be the cause of it?
This venture is based on the story "Roxy and the Music of Avalon" by contest winner TheJollyOne!

With your islanders in distress due to the volcanic outburst, Sonya has thought of a way to solve the crisis. Old legends speak of a mysterious Mountain Clan in the far north. The only problem is, the region isn't mapped out and it's been a long time since an adventurer has dared to travel so far north. Sonya is eager to head out, but first we should make sure we're well equipped. Let's get ready to go and make history!
Just as you start your journey north, the weather suddenly worsens. There is no way to move forward in this storm. You'll have to find a way to brave this harsh environment somehow.
Deep in the mountains where nobody has set a foot in decades, a labyrinth of paths unfolds. Will you be able to reach the exit alive?
After aiding the Mountain Clan to safeguard their border, the time has come to strike back. With the Mountain Clan backing you up, you embark on a Venture to wage war against epic foes.
High up in the mountains, people fight a desperate battle for survival and the good of all mankind. Will you be able to change their fate?
A call for aid from a hitherto unknown island. Artificial creatures are threatening to destroy the inhabitants' town! Can you defend the people, and investigate the golems' source?
Something's still not right on the island where you fought the golems. The town is under attack once again, as it seems the true culprit is still at large!
The barrier around the tyrant's castle has a weak point! If you follow the scientist's instructions, you may still get to face that villain.
With your support, Santa was able to build a magical Christmas Wonderland to bring joy to abandoned children. Deliver Toys to the children to make them behave, as Santa seems unable to handle them!
With your support, Santa was able to build a magical Christmas Wonderland to bring joy to abandoned children. Deliver Toys to the children to make them behave, as Santa seems unable to handle them!
With your support, Santa was able to build a magical Christmas Wonderland to bring joy to abandoned children. Deliver Toys to the children to make them behave, as Santa seems unable to handle them!
You and the real Santa have discovered that an evildoer is using magic to trick everyone. Deliver Santa's spell-breaking gifts to free everyone and reveal who's behind this mysterious scheme!
You and the real Santa have discovered that an evildoer is using magic to trick everyone. Deliver Santa's spell-breaking gifts to free everyone and reveal who's behind this mysterious scheme!
You and the real Santa have discovered that an evildoer is using magic to trick everyone. Deliver Santa's spell-breaking gifts to free everyone and reveal who's behind this mysterious scheme!
A city split by a landslide encounters strange evil-doers, and is in dire straits. Will you be able to help them?

The split city situation is getting ever more dire, as winter is fast approaching. On top of the mad invaders, the piercing cold is becoming almost unbearable. Are you capable of helping the townspeople again?

While searching for Sonya's missing former mentor, a new and far away island has become the center of attention. Adventures, secrets and revelations await, but they lie a many-day long sea voyage away. Are you ready for this huge endeavor?
After following Kaedric's tracks, your people discovered a colossal underground cave. However, unknown challenges are lurking in the dark. What might the true nature of this place be?

A mysterious island has suddenly appeared out of the morning mists, visible on the horizon. Several fishermen and boats that ventured close enough have given similar reports about seeing evildoers roaming around the island. Strangely, however, it seems everybody saw completely different types of evildoer, but no leaders at all! Either way, you cannot let something like this stand so close to your own island.

One of the Bonaberti family’s belongings, a beautiful untouched island in the far south, has been overrun by unknown bandits. The Bonabertis, though incredibly wealthy, are not exactly experienced in warfare. Therefore, they've trustingly turned to you for help: could you please eradicate the hostiles on the island? The rewards will definitely be worth it!
As I explained before, there's an island somewhere out there which has the perfect conditions for us to carry out our research. Let's find it.

Do you remember Sir Robin, the king of the traitors? Well, he’s back! Some loyal followers have freed him from his prison. Ever since, he’s been hiding on an island nearby. Finally, we’ve managed to locate him, and it’s time to take action! We need to put him back in prison before he starts attacking our beautiful kingdom!

Do you remember the master archer who stole from the rich? Well, he’s back! Or at least, that’s what we think... It may just be a copycat. Nevertheless, someone is rioting within our noble kingdom, stealing from rich merchants to fuel another riot. Please, find this guy and put a stop to it before he does any further harm to our kingdom...

A mysterious island. Your explorer found a hidden island! Fame, glory, adventure and - most of all - treasure awaits! ...behind the hordes of enemies, that is.

A haven of beautiful islands. Your explorer found the location of a secret archipelago, rich in natural resources. Explore the beautiful islands, and set out to make one of them your colony. But beware! The inhabitants might not welcome you with open arms...

An expedition island! Your explorer has found the location of a secret colony island, extremely rich in natural resources. There are signs of previous battles everywhere, meaning someone else has likely found it before you. Conquer the island and snatch it from its previous owner to take control of its resources. But beware! Other explorers might find the island too, and then their armies will be landing on your doorstep...

The wild woman has been driven away! As you return to the villagers with the good news you are greeted cheerfully. Another bandit leader has been defeated and the land is safe once more. The village elder is proud to hand over your reward.

Oh joy!
The daughter has been returned to her loving father. The family reunion is indeed a happy one. The rogue had apparently twisted the daughter's mind into thinking that her father was keeping her in a gilded cage. Stuff and nonsense, of course.

A bounty well hunted!
The vicious business partners will think twice about double-crossing honest merchants in the future.

The shores are safe again!
With vigilance and dedication you've removed all the scum from the ocean. Not even a single eye-patch is left. Good work! The villagers happily hand over your reward.

And thus you defeated the mighty witch of the swamp!
Everyone is sure to hear of this heroic feat.
The people of the veld are forever grateful for your help. In a joyful celebration with dancing and percussive music they declare you an honourary member of their tribe.

You brought those deserters to justice. They can now spend their time in prison thinking about what they did to the people they swore to protect. Your nobility is very happy with your success and is delighted to reward you accordingly.

In an epic battle you bested Victor's men!
Only by the favor of the gods did the scoundrel escape captivity. Still, the valley has been freed and the regent rewards your effort handsomely.

Those men were stronger than expected and still you managed to break their band into pieces. The roads are safe to travel again and the local knight happily hands over your reward. You're a shining example to them.

You encountered armoured henchmen, vicious ruins and black magic, but in the end you were victorious. The dark priests have been driven away and the world has been freed of those evil rituals. You were even able to return numerous cats to their loving owners in your town.

Your decisive action has put an end to these peasant riots. All bandits have been put into prison. Unfortunately, the mysterious master archer has escaped. Who knows when he will assemble new outlaws to threaten the merchants again? Well, at least for now the forest is safe again.
The fight was tough but you were victorious. That should teach those savages a lesson. Nobody challenges you and walks away unharmed. Your name will surely be remembered by those rider clans.

By burning the ridiculous letter of demands in front of the defeated Nordic tribe, you made it quite clear who is the true king of these parts. The tribe has agreed to leave your shores peacefully, never to return.

After a decisive battle, the mercenaries have been beaten. Thankfully you were able to free those poor townsmen. They are forever grateful. Additionally your men have destroyed the laboratory and looted it for any useful remains.

Hector and Barnabas have proven to be worthy opponents. Were it not for their treason you could almost congratulate them. Now they are on the run, their castles smashed and their men scattered. Just goes to show; if you claim a territory you should be able to hold it.
One by one the witch towers have fallen. Your soldiers have shown extraordinary skill while fighting against this overpowering enemy. The loot they brought back is well deserved!

The brotherhood is destroyed! Your men have successfully captured the leaders of this dark brotherhood. Still they seem unwilling to revoke their teachings. Maybe some other time the brotherhood will rise again. You must be ever watchful.
Explosions and searing flames marked much of this battle, but in the end your men remained victorious.
You have put the crazy ship’s cook and his pirates to flight. Now the sea is safe again. The inhabitants of the port cities show their thankfulness and donate their riches to you.
It was an uphill battle, but you defeated the new army of the witch of the swamp. Try not to imagine what would have happened if she had been given more time…
The arrogant Nords were surprised by your attack and had no chance of winning. Before they could react, your men chased them away.

No one had imagined that the battle against the mother of the crazy ship’s cook would be so difficult, or that such heavy losses would be incurred, but you have banished her and her son from the seven seas.
As you suspected, the rumours were true. You found the bandits and brought them to justice one by one. The woods are now safe again, thanks to you.

You had never seen a creature like Croaker before. He said he wanted to destroy Christmas because he didn't appreciate joy. However, you have managed to put an end to his plans. The Christmas feast is saved.

You had never seen a creature like Croaker before. He said he wanted to destroy Christmas because he didn't appreciate joy. However, you have managed to put an end to his plans. The Christmas feast is saved.

The wild woman has been driven away! As you return to the villagers with the good news you are greeted cheerfully. Another bandit leader has been defeated and the land is safe once more. The village elder is proud to hand over your reward.
That should be all Easter eggs for this isle. Quite a lot to carry around. If all islands contain that many Easter eggs it will become difficult to carry them at all. But for now, let's go home!
Once again, your Easter egg search was successful. It's good that you stored the Easter eggs from the first search, otherwise it would have been too much to carry.
This isle was a lot more difficult than the others. Nevertheless, you managed to find all Easter eggs once again, finishing the paper chase. Congratulations!
The Easter bunny's brother must have had a real huge hole in his backpack, considering how many Easter eggs have fallen out of it. You should go home for now and check whether there is any news.

It's astounding that all the Easter eggs are safe and sound even after falling out of a back pack and lying around for quite some time in the wilderness. Anyway, you managed once again to secure all the Easter eggs, and can now make your way home.
Well, that was the last Easter egg. All the missing Easter eggs should be together again. Now, you just have to find a way to carry them all home.
Now the mountains are free of Easter eggs. The only thing left is to hope the next islands are easier to cross.
Who would have thought that one day you would be searching for Easter eggs in the desert? Let's hope the eggs haven't become completely hard boiled after all that time in the sun.
Unbelievable! All the Easter eggs have been found, and the Easter bunny's brother is safe too. A total success.
You have truly become a master hunter. An Easter egg hunter, that is. Now you can return home with your large collection of Easter eggs.
What a glorious victory! Your opponent truly didn't hold back, and showed impressive class, all of which makes this success even sweeter. What a great way to start the tournament!
You stood fast and showed the enemy that you're there's no messing with you! A worthy victory that is going to make a lasting impression on your followers.
You have defeated a worthy opponent with skill and finesse, and your supporters are jubilating. Truly a respectable effort to be proud of!
Your opponent was no match for you! Revel in the glory of this moment while you can, for there are more stiff challenges ahead of you!
You were victorious in what can only be called a remarkable battle! Such a spectacle is a rare sight to behold and your followers are rightfully stoked.
What a triumph! You have proven your strategic brilliance in a truly epic struggle that shall be remembered! Your Settlers shall tell their offspring of this day and proudly look up to you.

Done! The Hoarfrost Globe was destroyed, and the Nords will think twice before they try something like that again! Sadly, Odinom the Cruel managed to escape, and I fear this is not the last time we will hear of him. Anyway, it's over! No, don't go yet…you see, we've found a frozen chest inside Odinom's tent. It contains several "interesting" items that we must take back to Capital Island. However, you may keep this one. I'm sure it will be of great use to you. Let this be our little secret...

A bounty well hunted!
The vicious business partners will think twice about double-crossing honest merchants in the future.
Now how does that feel? Not only have you defeated all of these hideous wretches, you also saved the entire world from destruction! All hail our savior!
I have personally sealed the Skull and had it delivered to Capital Island! The King will be most satisfied when he hears of your victorious campaign! Great work!
Lord Walder and the council have decided to build a statue in your honour. It will be placed at the plaza in their village! Sunrimm Island is safe again, thanks to you!
Congratulations! The Easter egg search was successful. You found all the eggs! You can return now to your home zone.
Congratulations! The Easter egg search was successful. You found all the eggs! You can return now to your home zone.

Well done! Count Hackett got his island back, and all the bad guys were sealed off inside their little territory. I hope they won't cause any more trouble!

The family should be safe now, but I've advised them to get more guards on the island - they shouldn't risk another unfortunate problem like the one we just resolved! Thank the maker we arrived in time! Good work!

Flintrock island is safe again...the volcano will not erupt in the near future. Let's hope that it won't ever erupt again. The people of the island asked me to give you these gifts. We did a good thing here!

Great work! Those bandits should learn to behave, not to become something even worse! The retired pirate veterans are very happy and grateful for your help, and they promised to talk with their relatives about considering retirement too. Pirate life is dangerous, after all.
All of the barrels are now on the bottom of the sea, and the Nords are once again defeated! Very well done!
The King has been defeated, the little tailor is safe, and you've obtained quite a lot of treasure. This calls for a feast!
That was a really new experience, and a strange one. Anyway, the people you helped are happy and can go on living as normal. If you can call living there 'normal'.
You managed to find and remove all the out of place buildings. Well done! The inhabitants are happy and can continue their everyday lives as if nothing had happened.
You were able to solve the problem on the island and return successfully. The settlers are happy and thankful, and they hope you will come back and visit them sometime soon.
It seems everyone is very grateful for your help. The jester is eager to know your opinion. Have you figured out why the island looks familiar? Is it familiar at all?
You did it, and lived up to your expectations. The jester seems especially satisfied. Not sure whether that's a good or bad thing though.
You managed to defeat the shaman and return everything back to normal. The jester and the settlers living there are satisfied, and you can go back to your everyday business.
The magic bond between the ruins and the village has been broken, and once again you have restored the buildings to their normal condition. Well done!
Finally! I’m now married and still alive, all thanks to you my old friend! Let me give you something for your efforts.

You have saved a whole kingdom, and the tailor has finally found a wife who truly loves him. Last but not least, you have also found a great amount of treasure in the ruins of the Dark Magician’s castle.
You managed to defeat the shaman and return everything back to normal. The jester and the settlers living there are satisfied, and you can go back to your everyday business.
The magic bond between the ruins and the village has been broken, and once again you have restored the buildings to their normal condition. Well done!
Congratulations! Not only have you found the little tailor’s sons, you've also helped them get their apprenticeships!
Well done! You’ve got the stolen goods back, and taught the greedy inn-keeper a lesson he will never forget!
Congratulations! Your teamwork has paid off. Or, at least, that's what Lord Scroogius will tell you.
Congratulations! You teamwork has paid off. The pirate threat is once again eliminated from these islands!
Congratulations! The Cultists have scattered! May peace reign once more within the islands!
Congratulations! Your teamwork has paid off. The treasure is yours - at least, until you get it to a museum and get your reward.
Congratulations! Those men were stronger than expected but with the aid of our allies we managed to break their band into pieces.
This magnificent strike at the heart of their leadership should set the raiders back, at least for a while!

Happy days! You managed to defeat the Croaker and get Santa's Sleigh back.
And in the ruins of the Croaker's lair you found some treasure.
You managed to defeat the mad scientist once again and stopped all the experiments. However, at the last moment, he slipped through your clutches. Let's hope he doesn't come back any time soon.
Who would have thought that someone would move in here again? Nevertheless, you cleared the area once more, and everything has returned to normal. For now.
Garrun lies defeated and you proceed to open all the bunny cages. What follows can only be described as an avalanche of fluffiness. Easter is saved!
Well done! The real matches will be a lot tougher, but it looks like you're well prepared
Congratulations! We won the first group stage game. If we can win the second one as well, we might just advance to the last 16!
That was really a good performance! Thanks to your excellent tactics, it's now official: we made the last 16!
What a thrilling match! I'm glad we could beat the Shire of Oxwater – even if it was a close call. Let’s see which opponent is awaiting us next.
Unbelievable! You made it! We're in the semi-finals, and are amongst the four best teams in the competition!
We're in the finals! I can't believe it! We reached the finals! What a match! I always hoped we'd go far with this team, but to actually reach the finals!! I'm thrilled!

You did it! You managed to defeat the sabotage effort, and secure the vein. The foreman is pleased, and sends you the reward to your island.
You did it! You helped the rangers revitalize their island. The rangers are pleased, and sent a reward to your island.
Well done! The bakers and brewers are back at the Grain House to start negotiating. Maybe soon our Settlers will be able to enjoy their tasty products again.
You were able to help the villagers find the kids! Hopefully, this won't happen again - but if it does, we'll know who to call!
Great! Now the chickens can relax and hatch their eggs. Here's a small reward for your efforts.

The Tikkians are very happy about your help - but they're even happier that you brought back their coin! It is of inestimable value for them. To reward you for your good deed, they've announced you an honorary citizen of Tikki island.
Great Job! You've rebuilt the settlement and the villagers are very thankful.
You've managed to hunt down the thief and free a slave girl named Mardschana. She seems to be attracted to Ali Baba and agrees to help you on your quest.
You've met Ali Baba, the young woodcutter, who agrees to help you find Scheherazade.

It was too late. The thieves have taken most of the treasure and left. Ali Baba notices that there are two different trails left by the thieves. You collect the remaining treasure and leave, wondering which of the trails will take you to Scheherazade.

You realize that the "captive women" that you were looking for were none other than finely crafted female sculptures. Ali Baba tries to comfort you by reminding you there are still a few loose ends that the thieves have left, and that there may be still hope.

Despite the lack of clues about Scheherezade's location in the library, one of its books catches your eye. It talks about great riches, legendary sailors and hidden treasures on a neighbouring island. After discussing it with Ali Baba, you both decide it's worth investigating.

Inside the temple, you find invaluable information about the ancient civilization. Their knowledge, traditions, and wisdom passed on throughout the centuries. Unfortunately, there are no clues about Scheherezade whatsoever. Ali Baba notices a legend in the chronicles mentioning islands with great treasures and legendary sailors. Given that you don't have any more leads to follow, you decide it's worth taking a look.

The crazed apes ran away, and the city is free again! The locals shower you with praise and riches, and start calling you their saviour. There doesn't seem to be anything else in the way of treasure or clues here, though. Having hit a dead end, you hope Ali Baba has more luck finding his treasure and the missing Scheherezade.

The cornered informant spills the beans. A beautiful woman was indeed brought to this island not long ago. Unfortunately for you, both the woman and the oil lamp that Aladdin is looking for were recently taken to another island. You and Aladdin decide to go to this island to confirm the informant's claims.

In the dungeons of the old palace you encounter Scheherezade, King Schahri's wife, and another beautiful young woman that Aladdin recognizes immediately as Jasmine, the sultan's daughter. Leaving Jasmine and Aladdin for their new adventures together, you take Scheherezade back to her husband, who lavishes you with riches and praise in appreciation.

The sea snake has been slain. There are no signs of any treasure or Scheherezade at all, but you find a silver lining knowing that the shiny sea snake scales are worth a lot, so long as you can figure out where to take them. Having hit a dead end, you hope Ali Baba has better luck than you.
What a feast! By repelling the Nords and rebuilding their village, we saved the natives and earned their trust. I can't wait to study all their legends! I think you're due a reward!

The knowledge I found within the ruins is priceless! This civilization was technologically advanced even by today's standards. It has already inspired me to come up with several new inventions! What do you think of this mine? I'll let you keep the prototype.
You've stopped a dangerous threat - and I got to see a live dragon! I know the latter wasn't a priority for you, but I still appreciate it. I have just the thing to thank you..

Good news! With the Chupacabra gone, the people have indeed already started to recover. This whole business was quite interesting, from both a zoological and medical perspective. As way of thanks, I have designed this modern mine for you.

Looks like the mission was a huge success. You freed the spy, earned the governor's respect and returned the treasures to the peoples they were stolen from - but not before I analyzed some of the more interesting artefacts! As you haven't really got much out of this endeavour, let me at least share this invention with you.
Unbelievable! We won the tournament! We won, we won, WE WON!!! Congratulations, now we are officially the Settlers Football Champions! We wooooooooooon!

The Evil Queen, defeated, flees towards a different land. Although your job is not yet done, the inhabitants of this land are grateful for your help. The fisherman begs you to help his wife, and bids you good luck with your adventures.

As it turns out, the mayor was in fact Queen Ilsebille in disguise! You managed to avoid the set-up and defeat her once again. The inhabitants of Hamelin hail your success, and they accept the piper as one of their own. After all, he was only another victim of the Evil Queen.

The Evil Queen has been defeated once more, and Hansel and Gretel are back with their father, where they belong. The food you gathered on your hunt will ensure that they won't go hungry for a long, long time.

Snow White's stepmother, the Evil Queen, was in fact Queen Ilsebille in disguise! It turns out her real stepmother was being held captive. Snow White and her stepmother had a long overdue talk, where they agreed to become better friends, and exchange beauty tips.

Now that the Evil Queen's been forced off the island, Red and her grandma can go back to living a peaceful life in their hut. Still, somehow, you quite can't shake the feeling that this may not be the last time we hear from Queen Ilsebille...

Your allies send their sincerest thanks. They've even said I can perform my research on some of the artifacts you recovered. This would not have been possible without your help! Please accept this as a token of my gratitude.

What a beautiful song! Just listening to it was worth the trouble, was it not?
Don't worry - I was just joking. The islanders and I have prepared some actual rewards for you

A great beginning to a great venture! You conquered new enemies and the harsh environment alike. But the journey has just begun, and there's a lot more to come. The challenges we'll face aren't getting any easier, but the rewards will be worth it. Now let's head out, and conquer new frontiers!

Was the landscape not a big enough challenge? Did you really have to fight those bandits, on top of everything else?! Not to worry. Once again, you overcame every obstacle. Time to see what else this continent has in store for you.

Mountains are full of challenges, but you burst through them all. Despite the harsh environment, and barely any help, you overcame a labyrinth of obstacles and enemies. Will anything be able to stop you? Continue your journey north, and find out.

Unthinkable. Unfathomable. Formidable. Once again, you have proven yourself, and the story of your journey into the mountains will be shared as a legend by generations to come. The Frost Giant's generals weren't able to stop your iron will, and Risi has drawn his last icy breath.
The Mountain Clan has declared this week as "The Settlers" Festival Week, and prepared a banquet for you and your troops. The celebrations will continue for long after you've left.
The Mountain Clan is finally able to recuperate from the years of fighting. And with the borders now open, and trade routes slowly growing, they will be able to restore the former glory of their clan.

What a great achievement! You managed to save the legendary Mountain Clan from their imminent destruction, and in the process gained an ally for a lifetime. But the battle is not over yet. The Mountain Clan is still desperately holding the lines against the ancient evil.
The townsfolk send their thanks, and the scientist sends an apology. I have a feeling we'll be seeing them again sooner than we'd like, though...
That didn't really feel like a success, but all we can do now is wait. And prepare.

You did it! It may have taken a while, but evil has been banished from the island. The people no longer need to fear for their lives, and are busily rebuilding the houses that were destroyed. They send a reward for you, too.
Finally, those annoying cries have stopped..ribbit...I mean, it's good to see those tiny people smiling again. Bring more gifts.
Finally, those annoying cries have stopped..ribbit...I mean, it's good to see those tiny people smiling again. Bring more gifts.
Finally, those annoying cries have stopped..ribbit...I mean, it's good to see those tiny people smiling again. Bring more gifts.

So it was Ribbitha...She wanted to get revenge for her twin brother Croaker, because he's been losing to you for years now. Well... she clearly underestimated your skills.
You were able to free all those Settlers in the end, and the children above all! This also explains why Santa was unable to locate the children. Ribbitha used her evil tricks to hide their presence. Good that this is over now, and the families can spend the rest of the holidays together!

So it was Ribbitha...She wanted to get revenge for her twin brother Croaker, because he's been losing to you for years now. Well... she clearly underestimated your skills.
You were able to free all those Settlers in the end, and the children above all! This also explains why Santa was unable to locate the children. Ribbitha used her evil tricks to hide their presence. Good that this is over now, and the families can spend the rest of the holidays together!

What a relief. You beat the evildoers surrounding the city; the people were able to recuperate, and at least they can have a few days of rest before more foes arrive to terrorize them. Even if this victory is only a short-term remedy, the tears of joy the people shed showed it was not for naught.

Wow, that was unexpectedly difficult. Quite curious how those apes banded together with those bandits? They probably came in over the mountains to the north. Imagine what it would have looked like had the route not been blocked by a mountain ridge... Yet in spite of all those vicious creatures, you came through and managed to protect the people from a devastating fate. Hopefully, they'll hold out through the winter again. But according to people's reports, both the foes that arrive, and surviving in general gets much worse during the winter. Can you imagine? It's doubtful anyone would even attempt to do anything about it. Or would you dare to try?
Laeylorn took you into its fangs and didn't let go. Or did it?

A weird feeling wraps around your body, even though you've managed to fight through all these new threats. But have you really left the adventure behind? The feeling that something has not yet been concluded seems to stick to your innermost core. Still, it's nothing a good night's sleep won't fix, right? And you can always come back if the nagging feeling won't leave...

After the evildoers had been defeated, they started to disappear like fog. Then the whole island began to vanish bit by bit! The troops barely made it back to their ships, and some even had to swim as the ground melted into thin air under their feet.

Well done! The island is free from bandits again. The Bonabertis are very pleased with your work, and have started searching through their treasure chambers to find something that would adequately reward you.
Not quite what we expected, but I'm glad you're all home in one piece, albeit soaking wet.

That was a real fight, but you managed to defeat Sir Robin and his men once more! Leave the rest to us. We’ll take him back to prison, where he belongs - and where he’ll stay for the rest of his life!
Well done! Here’s your reward. It was a pleasure seeing this evil man be defeated. Finally, the rich can relax and enjoy their riches again. Thank you so much.

The wild woman has triumphed! Your men were not able to defeat the fiendish bandits of Wild Mary. Those wicked men were just too strong this time. Frightened, the villagers tremble in their homes waiting for the next impending raid...
And so the father's daughter was nowhere to be found. Eventually a letter from her arrived, saying that she was in good hands and very happy, but her father still mourns her loss to this day.

How very disappointing.
You were not able to hunt the bounty properly and thus the scoundrels can continue to double-cross honest merchants freely.

And pirates swarm the coast...
There is nothing you can do about it. Drinking rum, playing illegal games and laughing at your efforts to drive them away, the pirates continue to spread fear and agony.

Fame and glory are not for you!
The witch has driven you away. Her magic was too strong and her evil henchmen backed her up, defeating your troops with seeming ease. Be careful next time you wander near her tower, for it rises in the night sky like a dark omen...

The veld is not a safe place any more. Rampaging rider clans roam freely and unchallenged. Your men were no match for their massive horses and swift spears. The local settlers have been driven away from their homeland...

Solid as a rock, the traitors stand in your way. Against their thick armour and strong swords your men didn't stand a chance. With this, the deserters have made a name for themselves and may cause much trouble in the future. Your nobility is very displeased with the whole situation.
The razor sharp arrowheads instilled fear in your men. Victor the Vicious has trained his bandits well. Your men were no match for his troops and the valley stays in his possession.
Was it lack of training or just bad luck? The outlaws have proven too strong for your men, the local knights have been overwhelmed and this region of the land is now feared by all passing travellers.

What magic is this? Your men were not able to pierce through this daunting opposition. The priests' henchmen, encouraged by their black magic, bested your men in combat. Your townsfolk tremble in fear...

You have encountered a master archer indeed. Your men did not stand a chance against this well trained bunch of bowmen. The landlord is very disappointed with your defeat and is looking for more competent help.

What a disgrace! You were not able to defend your honour against those loud-mouthed savages. They have proven to be formidable enemies. It would be best if you retreated for now and regained your strength. New challengers will almost certainly show up in the future.

The tribe has proven to be stronger than you thought. One by one your soldiers were defeated until no one was left to fight. What can you do against this unstoppable rage? Best leave them alone and wait until they leave these shores on their own...

The mad alchemist did a good job hiring these mercenaries. Their experience was too much for your troops. Nobody came near the laboratory to stop him. Who knows what evil experiments have been conducted? Perhaps you will never find out...

You were not able to defeat the black knights. Their fortifications were too strong. There's nothing left to do except acknowledge their claim of sovereignty. This mountain range is now in the firm hands of those vicious brothers.

Your men were not able to defeat the shamans. Their magic has proven too strong for you. Even your finest soldiers didn't stand a chance against this overpowering enemy. You must accept their claim of regency and retreat to your own lands.

The brotherhood is a formidable adversary. Your men were not able to capture their leaders. Instead, many of your men were lured into their ranks by their corrupted magic. You have to get your men to retreat, and defend your remaining townsfolk. Be wary, for the brotherhood is always watching.

What mad god invented those mighty weapons? Deafening explosions and iron-melting fire drove your men to take flight in panic. You were not able to secure even one of those mighty weapons. Maybe you should try to send more experienced men in future...
Your soldiers had no chance against the hundreds of pirates. They hired every man who has ever set foot on a ship.

The witch and her lackeys are serious opponents, despite being weakened. You and your army fought to the last man, but it was not enough. Now the witch of the swamp will have enough time to regenerate her full power.
The Nords were better prepared than expected. Someone must have warned them. Your men fought bravely, but the enemies numbers were too high. Let's hope their next target is not your kingdom.
Nothing is more dangerous than the love of a mother. Your battle-hardened men fled from a woman.

Your scout's reports underestimated the number of soldiers allied to the rogues, meaning you arrived there with way too few men. Accordingly, you were not able to break through enemy lines and have been forced to fall back.
Unfortunately, Croaker had more help than expected, meaning that you could not reach him and retrieve the stolen presents in time. Hopefully, there will be another chance to save the Christmas feast.
Unfortunately, Croaker had more help than expected, so you couldn't reach him and retrieve the stolen presents in time. Hopefully, there will be another chance to save the Christmas feast.

The wild woman has triumphed! Your men were not able to defeat the fiendish bandits of Wild Mary. Those wicked men were just too strong this time. Frightened the villagers tremble in their homes waiting for the next impending raid...
You weren't up to your opponents battling abilities, but you are in good company there - these contestants have trounced many a skilled adversary.
You seem to have fallen victim to the enemies' unpredictability. Or you just weren't up for it?
Humbly, you have to acknowledge your opponents' superiority; you were just no match for them. Better luck next time!
Your adversary's determination seems to have been too much for you. A well earned victory for your opponent, one might say.
There is no disgrace in losing this battle; your opponent was simply ahead of you. However, let us hope you do not intend to continue like this.
Well, you seem to have succumbed to their superior looks after all! Nevertheless, in the end they simply outsmarted you. What a dramatic conclusion to a great tournament!
You weren't up to your opponents battling abilities, but you are in good company there - these contestants have trounced many a skilled adversary.

How very disappointing.
You were not able to hunt the bounty properly and thus the scoundrels can continue to double-cross honest merchants freely.

The invaders have proven to be stronger than we thought. One by one your soldiers were defeated until no-one was left to fight, and many of them are now trapped in the ice. The island is now a frozen prison for those who lived here... Who knows where these bringers of frost will land next...
They defeated you? We can not afford to let this happen, too much is at stake! But that is the beauty of time travel, all is not yet lost. Go back again and teach those foul creatures a lesson!

I can't believe this! Oh well, they managed to find the Skull and escape by the time our troops had found the pirate captain's camp ! It's no use chasing after them… they've sailed into that storm to the east. Maybe we'll get them next time, huh?

Sadly, your enemy had more experience in surprise attacks. Somehow, they reached the village and captured Lord Walder and the council, forcing you to leave the island. Maybe next time we'll come more prepared!
Retreat! It's too much, sorry! The clans seem to be too powerful, even for us! We need to regroup and approach the island with a new tactic!
Oh no! There's way too many of them for our troops! We need to retreat and use another plan! Maybe next time we'll be more prepared!
I guess the "Cult of the Sleeping Flame" has strong followers, stronger than our army, apparently. We need to regroup and try again. We can't let those maniacs burn down the island!
No! Call back your men, this is not going to work, I'm sorry! We need stronger troops and better tactics. Regroup and let us try again later.
We didn't expect so many Nords on the island. We should leave now, and come back with a bigger army… they're just too powerful! I'm sorry!
Ouch, that was quite a beating. Let's hope the little tailor has found a hole to hide himself away in. He is no longer welcome in this realm.
You were too late. Although the little tailor was able to escape the bear and his rival, he will probably never be respected.
You were unable to protect the little tailor. You can only hope he will find his way out of the forest alive…
Sadly, you did not manage to gather all the items. Well, better luck next time.
It seems you had problems collecting all the items. I hope you will do better next time.
You failed to remove all the objects. This makes me sad, but I am sure we will manage it during the next adventure.
Those islands are really weird. No wonder you failed to collect everything. Let's head back to your home zone.
Oh I'm pretty sure you can do better than that. Please concentrate.
You failed to defeat the shaman. Now the settlers have to live in their weird-looking houses. However, they still hope you will come to their aid.
You failed to defeat the shaman. Now the settlers have to live in their weird-looking houses. However, they still hope you will come to their aid.
The ruins are still standing and the bond still exists. With a little more effort, you will surely be able to destroy them.
The ruins are still standing and the bond still exists. With a little more effort, you will surely be able to destroy them.
You were unable to help the little tailor’s sons and unite the family.
Too bad - it seems the stolen goods are now out of your reach.
Well, too bad! Lord Scroogius' fortune is now divided between the bandits. Better luck next time!
The bad part is that there's so much treasure the pirates are going to spend on themselves .
On the positive side, you didn't end up on the sacrificial table yourself ... unlike most of your men.
Bad luck! The cultists finished a dark ritual using the artefact and the island disappeared again into a strange mist. Don't worry, we will find it again!
Was it lack of training or just bad luck? The outlaws have proven too strong for your men, the local knights have been overwhelmed and this region of the land is now feared by all passing travellers.
Oh no! You didn't manage to stop the experiments - but there might still be time! The experiments aren't quite finished - so you may be able to have another go.
Unfortunately, you didn't manage to clear the area, so the villagers will continue shivering in a state of paranoia for now. They'd be thankful if you gave it another try.
The Easter is in great jeopardy now! Who's going to deliver all those eggs, if the bunnies are hopelessly trapped?
We could not defeat the Knight of Crowrock. Luckily, this was only a practice match. I hope we're better prepared for the next one.
We have been defeated by the Barony of Tepidwater. Good thing there's a second group game waiting for us.
The Barony of Emberstream defeated us in this match... shame on us - we disappointed our settler fans.
The Shire of Oxwater defeated us... This is a disappointing day for us - even if we fought hard.
We lost! It was a close match, but the Electorate of Sunflower Grove had been the better team today.
We almost made it... but only almost. In the end, it all comes down to the small differences when you play at such a high level of skill.
Oh no! We lost the finals! So close and yet so far. But our settlers are proud of us and our team. No one expected us to come this far.

We're too late. The vein rights have gone to another person. The foreman was ordered to leave, and there is nothing left for you to do but return to your island.
Unfortunately, you were not able to save the children in time. Hopefully, the other villagers will have more luck than you - but for now, you can do nothing but hope.
Oh no! The chickens still aren't hatching their eggs. There'll never be enough eggs for everyone this Easter now!
The two towns are still in conflict. So no delicious bread, and no tasty brew for a long, long time.
Now the sickness has infected everything on the island. In few weeks, this island will become a desert.
You failed to complete the expedition training island.

Unfortunately, you were not able to drive the bandits from the island. Since you couldn't reach the main Tikki camp to return their missing coin, the bandits continue reinforcing their settlement, and the Tikki island remains cursed.
The thieves were too strong and were ultimately able to repel your efforts. Ali Baba encourages you to regroup your forces and try again.
The thieves laugh at your futile efforts at breaking through their camps. You decide to regroup your forces at home, and have the last laugh next time.
The greedy thieves don't want anyone near their treasure and they have made themselves brutally clear about it. You decide to regroup your army and reconsider your approach.
Unfortunately, you were not able to make it through the center of the stronghold. Ali Baba, fearing for the captive ladies, suggests you to regroup and try again.
You didn't manage to help the villagers. They remain at the mercy of the storm.
The arid terrain and fearsome enemies eventually took a toll on your troops, and you were defeated. You retire to your home, hoping that perhaps you'll get another chance some day.
The tomb raiders proved to be more troublesome than petty thieves. You retreat, leaving the tombs at the raider's mercy, and the mystery of the ancient civilization unsolved.
The frenzied apes repel your forces with all their savage might. The inhabitants of the city start to lose hope when they see you retreat.
The sellswords hired by the informant prove to be too powerful for your troops, and he manages to escape with the information you were looking for. There is no choice now for you but to retreat.
Defeated, you never manage to reach the cave where the treasure allegedly lies. Sinbad and you retreat, wondering if the treasure cave of legend actually exists.
So close, and yet so far away. Scheherezade's location was finally at hand, but the enemy ultimately managed to block your efforts to reach her.
It feels terrible to leave the native populace in such a sorry state, but you can't help them at the moment. We'll have to wait for a better opportunity.
Returning from that island empty handed is rather disappointing. Considering its history, there must be something valuable to find there... You should start another expedition when it's convenient.
Flafir has been around for centuries, and is a cunning opponent. This defeat is nothing to be ashamed of. Let's retreat for now, and return once you've recovered from this defeat.
Oh no! It seems Croaker was better prepared this time round. Somebody else will have to get that sleigh back before Christmas.
It was wise to withdraw from the island, as we were in over our heads. We cannot ignore the creature either, though. You should train more troops, and then have another go at this hunt.
Puerto Sombrío is surprisingly well defended! But that's just further proof that something fishy must be going on there. We should return as soon as possible.
You missed the ships by a hair's breadth and lost your chance to intercept them. It looks like their raids will continue for now.
The fisherman is still out there and needs your help. Come back when you're ready.
Snow White is still in danger. Please return here when you're ready, and we can attempt to rescue her again.
Hansel & Gretel are still missing, and their parents don't know what to do.
Red Riding Hood went missing when she went to visit her grandmother. The details are unknown.
The rats overran Hamelin, and nobody could stop them.
Are we really leaving the islanders to this dark fate? I understand that you were in over your head this time, but be sure to return eventually, okay?
Despite all the unforeseen challenges, you did your best to find out the truth about the Mountain Clan. However, their secret remains intact. Will you be able to uncover it next time?
You couldn't have known the environment would be this harsh! There's nothing you can do except pull back for now. Maybe you'll start a new expedition into the Nords' lands another time.

Did you get lost? Don't worry. As they say, there will always be a second, or even a third chance. Just don't make the same mistakes again. Prepare well, and you will surely succeed when you return to the Mountain Labyrinth.

There is no shame admitting defeat against an enemy that has withstood decades of war against one of the mightiest clans out there. We have to prepare our troops, and map out our strategy to overcome all obstacles as efficiently as possible. Next time, we will prevail!

No wonder the Mountain Clan hasn´t been able to defeat their nemesis yet. The sheer volume of wildlife that keeps pouring into the Mountain Clan´s territory has been keeping them more than occupied!
We should prepare our troops, and gather enough resources to help them out of their misery. Next time they won´t stand a chance!
I understand why you struggled - those golems are incredibly resilient. I wish we could have helped more, but what's done is done.
That climb was too much for your troops. Fighting corrupted animals is one thing, but fighting them on such a steep path is extra taxing. I can't blame you for retreating.
I can't believe we were defeated! So much was on the line! I hope those poor villagers will find a way to manage without us...
Hach can't you do anything ri- I mean, please, these children need their toys...so my sensitive ears can finally get some rest. Hurry! Ribbit.
Hach can't you do anything ri- I mean, please, these children need their toys...so my sensitive ears can finally get some rest. Hurry! Ribbit.
Hach can't you do anything ri- I mean, please, these children need their toys...so my sensitive ears can finally get some rest. Hurry! Ribbit.
Fudge! This evildoer's plan must be stopped, and the children must be saved! You have to come back as soon as possible.
Fudge! This evildoer's plan must be stopped, and the children must be saved! You have to come back as soon as possible.
Fudge! This evildoer's plan must be stopped, and the children must be saved! You have to come back as soon as possible.

Let us hope the people will be able to hold out until we're ready for another attempt at freeing them of their besiegement.
Regather your strength, and head out to help these people!
It seems the people have gotten used to living with the constant onslaught, and instead just hide away. Not surprising when they're facing these kinds of enemies. Will you hide as well?

You may have lost this battle, but you haven't given up just yet. You'll soon be able to return, and try a new approach to defeating your opponents. It's not like this colossal cave is going anywhere fast...
Laeylorn's mesmerizing streets won't leave you so soon. Return whenever you feel the time is right.
It looks like the fallen enemies have re-emerged from the mist. You have to get rid of them before they become a threat to your island!

How very disappointing.
You were not able to completely chase the bandits away from family Bonaberti's island.
Wait. No. This isn't how it should go! Let's do that again.
No! How is this even possible? Sir Robin really is a tough enemy... Please, hurry and try again!
We should hurry - we need to inform the rich merchants that their gold is still in danger. What a disappointing outcome. Let's discuss another strategy - we can’t give up like this!

All hail, This is your brother Theodor. I have heard the rumour saying you have located to a new island to build a new settlement there. My congratulations. As a small present, I have transferred some resources to your star menu to support your project. I would be happy to receive an invitation to visit from you. After all, I'm sure there is much you could teach me.
Best wishes Theodor

All hail!
I am writing you this letter personally to inform you about a competition. However, this competition is not official, which is why no one else must learn of its existence. From time to time, I will give certain assignments to a few different people. If you manage to complete the given task, you will be greatly rewarded with goods and my gratitude. If not, you will not receive any further assignments, and thus will also no longer receive rewards or help from me. The current task is written in your quest book.
I wish you the best of luck. Your king

Greetings,
As you managed to finish the last task successfully, I have a new task for you. Your new goal has been entered into your quest book. The conditions are the same as last time.
Good luck, Your King

Greetings!
I'm pleased to see you've completed all the tasks I gave you. However, I'm eager to see how you will handle this next one. As always, you will find the new task in your quest book. I will be following your progress.
Good luck, Your King

Dear Sir / Madam, You have been chosen to represent your city by participating in the countrywide adventure competition. The rules are simple: there are three rounds. Each round has its own goals. Whoever accomplishes them qualifies for the next round. After three rounds, the person who has finished the rounds the most effectively wins. The goal of the first round is to complete 5 adventures. This competition is secret. You are only allowed to talk to other combatants about it. If you should break this rule, you will be disqualified.
Good luck!

The surprise event is about to begin tomorrow at 10:00 CET. An obscure group of priests prophesied the end of the world before the end of the year 2012. As it turned out, they were wrong. But rumors point to a curious case of transposed digits - some of their records clearly state the year 2021! Now, the priests are back to get their revenge, and have already tried to end your island’s legacy by shutting off Adobe Flash. But we will fight them together. This will be your part: You will have to gather all your military forces to defeat the priests in a special adventure – as many times as you can. All servers will have to work together to stop our impending fate. Each player will need to complete the adventure “The End Of The World” as many times as possible in order to save the world. The amount of adventures you'll need to complete depends on the number of active players. There are 3 reward tiers, based on how many adventures are completed globally. The countdown for all the completed adventures will start on March 5th and end March 15th. For more details, please take a look at the forum.
